papers.title: GNBAN: Graph Neural Basis Attention Networks for Long-Horizon Forecasting over Large Entity Sets
papers.abstract_en: Demand forecasting at the bottom of a retail hierarchy requires predicting tens of thousands of correlated long-horizon series across products, stores, and regions. Modern systems must scale across massive catalogs, capture shared demand dynamics, and remain interpretable enough to be trusted. Classical statistical methods need a separate model per series and are hard to manage at scale; deep autoregressive models struggle as the joint state grows to tens of thousands of dimensions; and recent graph-based forecasters, while capturing cross-entity dependencies, often produce opaque long-horizon forecasts. We propose GNBAN (Graph Neural Basis Attention Network), an end-to-end architecture combining heterogeneous graph representation learning with an interpretable basis-decomposition head. Retail data are represented directly as a heterogeneous graph derived from the relational schema, so a single model serves the entire catalog. Rather than predicting the horizon directly, GNBAN decomposes each forecast into trend, seasonal, and generic components. Its key innovation is a per-basis attention mechanism: each basis function keeps its own learnable query and retrieves information independently from the entity's historical neighborhood, letting different bases specialize to distinct temporal patterns while preserving interpretability. On two large-scale benchmarks, M5 Walmart and Favorita Grocery Sales, evaluated under matched protocols, GNBAN improves volume-weighted WRMSSE by roughly 4-5% over a matched graph baseline. Qualitative analysis shows the learned decomposition exposes trend, seasonal, and residual demand drivers without post-hoc explanation methods. These results demonstrate that scalable relational forecasting and interpretable forecast decomposition can be achieved together in a unified graph-based framework.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出GNBAN（图神经基注意力网络），一种端到端架构，用于大规模零售层次结构中的长期需求预测。它将异构图表征学习与可解释的基分解头结合，将每个预测分解为趋势、季节和通用成分，并通过每个基函数的独立注意力机制从历史邻居中检索信息。在两个大型基准（M5 Walmart和Favorita Grocery Sales）上，与匹配的图基线相比，GNBAN在体积加权WRMSSE上提升了约4-5%。定性分析显示，学习到的分解能揭示趋势、季节和残差需求驱动因素。
Motivation: 现有方法在大规模零售需求预测中面临挑战：经典统计方法需每个序列一个模型，难以扩展；深度自回归模型在高维状态空间表现不佳；基于图的预测器虽能捕捉跨实体依赖，但长期预测缺乏可解释性。
Method: GNBAN将零售数据构建为异构关系图，单个模型服务整个目录。其核心是每个基函数（趋势、季节、通用）拥有独立可学习的查询向量，通过注意力机制从实体历史邻居中检索信息，实现可解释的基分解预测。
Result: 在M5 Walmart和Favorita Grocery Sales基准上，与匹配的图基线相比，GNBAN在体积加权WRMSSE上改进约4-5%。定性分析表明分解组件可解释，无需后处理解释方法。
Conclusion: 结果表明，可扩展的关系预测与可解释的预测分解可以在统一的图框架中同时实现。

papers.title: ScaLe-INR: Scale and Learn Implicit Neural Representations
papers.abstract_en: Implicit Neural Representations (INRs) parameterized by multilayer perceptrons excel at modeling continuous signals. However, a key challenge persists as INRs fundamentally suffer from spectral bias and information cross-talk. When a single network attempts to capture multi-scale phenomena, high-frequency weight updates destructively interfere with the underlying low-frequency structural approximation. We introduce Scale and Learn INR (ScaLe-INR), a novel multi-branch architecture that resolves these limitations by explicitly matching the signal's frequency spectrum with the optimal operating region of the INR. Drawing upon the Fourier inverse scaling theorem we demonstrate that applying directional coordinate scaling expands a network's representational bandwidth along specific spatial axes. To mathematically enforce functional disentanglement and minimize task-specific information leakage between branches, we propose a Directional Edge Guidance Loss, a spatially-conditioned sparsity prior derived from ground-truth gradients. By constraining the high-frequency branches to act as strict, localized edge-filters, ScaLe-INR eliminates spectral cross-talk, accelerates convergence, and achieves high-fidelity signal reconstruction on complex multi-scale topologies. We evaluate ScaLe-INR across diverse reconstruction and inverse tasks, demonstrating substantial performance gains over existing state-of-the-art (SOTA) methods. The proposed architecture improves upon the nearest baselines by +5.16 dB in image reconstruction and +0.65 dB in image denoising. Furthermore, it achieve an impressive figure of 50.02 dB on audio reconstruction and 0.999 IOU(Intersection Over Union) on 3D reconstruction which beats the all SOTA models.
papers.comment: Submitted as a conference paper to NeurIPS 2026

TL;DR: 本文提出ScaLe-INR，一种多分支架构，通过方向坐标缩放和方向边缘引导损失解决隐式神经表示中的频谱偏差和信息串扰，在图像、音频和3D重建任务上超越现有方法。
Motivation: 隐式神经表示（INR）受频谱偏差和信息串扰限制，单网络难以同时捕捉多尺度信号，高频更新干扰低频结构。

Result: 在图像重建上比最佳基线提高+5.16 dB，图像去噪提高+0.65 dB，音频重建达到50.02 dB，3D重建IOU为0.999，所有任务超过现有SOTA。
Conclusion: 该架构显式匹配信号频谱与INR最优操作区域，消除频谱串扰并加速收敛，实现高保真多尺度信号重建。

papers.title: Applicability of memorization indicators for early spotting of overfitting while recalibrating sEMG-decoders on low sample sizes
papers.abstract_en: Deep learning models for surface electromyography (sEMG) can benefit substantially from subject-specific (re-)calibration, since no sufficiently large and diverse datasets are available to train fully generic decoders. However, for user acceptance, the number of repetitions that can realistically be collected during calibration is severely limited, which increases the risk of overfitting and, in extreme cases, can even degrade performance compared to the uncalibrated model. Classical overfitting indicators such as validation performance and regularization with early stopping are difficult to apply in this low-sample regime, as they require additional held-out data that is rarely available in practical calibration scenarios. In this work, we investigate a recently proposed class of memorization indicators based solely on the activation statistics of rectified linear units (ReLU) in deep neural networks, which can be computed directly from training data without any extra validation set. We conduct a transferlearning experiment on a benchmark sEMG dataset, where a convolutional neural network is first pre-trained on multiple subjects and subsequently fine-tuned on individual users using only a small number of repetitions. During calibration, we monitor both decoding performance and the activation behaviour of the last hidden layer. Our results provide first evidence that decreases in test accuracy during fine-tuning are ac companied by characteristic changes in activation rates, indicating that activation-based memorization indicators are a promising tool for early spotting of unsuccessful learning in low-sample sEMG calibration settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究在表面肌电图（sEMG）解码器重新校准的低样本量场景下，利用基于ReLU激活统计的记忆化指标（memorization indicators）及早发现过拟合。实验表明，微调过程中测试精度的下降伴随着激活率的特征变化，表明该类指标有望成为低样本校准中早期检测无效学习的工具。

Method: 基于深度神经网络中ReLU激活统计的记忆化指标，在预训练卷积神经网络后对少量样本进行微调，监测最后一隐层的激活行为。

papers.title: WattLayer: Get Layers Right to Estimate Inference Energy of Neural Networks
papers.abstract_en: The widespread adoption of Artificial Intelligence (AI) has led to increasing concerns about energy consumption, yet there is a lack of standardized methodologies to accurately estimate AI inference energy consumption, particularly across various tasks and architectures. In this study, we propose a task independent, layer-wise energy estimation model for AI architectures. Our model is evaluated on a large dataset of more than 100,000 layers for 295 neural network architectures across 3 widely-used tasks and 3 distinct hardware platforms. Our approach achieves a median error of 19.6%, outperforming state-of-the-art methods. We further show that layer-wise decomposition generalize to new tasks without complete retraining, by leveraging shared layers across architectures. It offer tools, insights and a precise methodology to empower stakeholders in designing energy-efficient AI systems.
papers.summary_zh:

papers.title: USAD: Uncertainty-aware Statistical Adversarial Detection
papers.abstract_en: Statistical adversarial detection (SAD) treats detection as a two-sample test. Given a reference set of clean examples (CEs) and a batch of queries, potentially containing an unknown mixture of CEs and adversarial examples (AEs), SAD decides whether the query distribution drifts away from the CE distribution while controlling the false-alarm rate. Existing SAD-based methods mainly use maximum mean discrepancy (MMD) to measure the distributional discrepancy. However, MMD's distributional properties limit its ability to capture characteristic uncertainty patterns of AEs that are crucial for detection: AEs typically exhibit abnormal feature spread (i.e., global uncertainty) and instability under perturbations (i.e., local uncertainty). To close the gap, we propose Uncertainty-aware Statistical Adversarial Detection (USAD), which explicitly captures these uncertainty patterns with two new statistics: (1) Variance Discrepancy (VD), which measures the difference in feature spread between AEs and CEs to capture global uncertainty differences. (2) Perturbation-based Covariance Discrepancy (PCD), which compares feature covariance under Gaussian perturbations to capture local uncertainty differences. By aggregating VD and PCD, USAD achieves superior detection performances over baseline methods against various adversarial attacks, highlighting the importance of considering characteristic behaviors of AEs for effective SAD. Our code is available at: https://anonymous.4open.science/r/USAD.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出USAD（不确定性感知统计对抗检测），针对对抗检测中两类不确定性模式（全局：特征扩散异常；局部：扰动下不稳定），设计了两个新统计量：方差差异（VD）和基于扰动的协方差差异（PCD），并聚合它们进行检测。在多个对抗攻击下取得了优于基线方法的检测性能。
Motivation: 现有基于最大均值差异（MMD）的统计对抗检测方法不能有效捕捉对抗样本（AEs）的特征扩散异常（全局不确定性）和扰动不稳定性（局部不确定性），导致检测性能受限。
Method: 提出USAD方法，显式捕获全局和局部不确定性：使用方差差异（VD）衡量特征扩散差异，使用基于高斯扰动的协方差差异（PCD）衡量局部不确定性，并将两者聚合用于两样本检测。
Result: 在多种对抗攻击下，USAD在检测性能上优于基线方法，表明考虑对抗样本的特征不确定性行为对有效统计对抗检测很重要。
Conclusion: 通过聚合VD和PCD，USAD实现了对对抗样本的更好检测，突出了考虑对抗样本特征不确定性模式的重要性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Hippocampus-DETR: An Explicit Memory Object Detection Framework Based on Hippocampus Modeling
papers.abstract_en: This paper addresses the lack of explicit memory mechanisms in current object detection models and proposes Hippocampus-DETR, a novel detection framework based on biological hippocampal memory modeling. This framework integrates a hippocampal memory network module, HipNet, into the DETR architecture and systematically simulates the anatomical structure and functional organization of hippocampal subregions, including the entorhinal cortex, dentate gyrus, CA3, CA1, and subiculum. Through this design, Hippocampus-DETR realizes pattern separation, pattern completion, importance filtering, and information integration of visual encoding features. During training, different memory submodules are optimized using a layer-wise training strategy, ultimately forming a memory system with memory retrieval and completion capabilities. Experimental results demonstrate that Hippocampus-DETR achieves higher detection accuracy than current mainstream models. More importantly, models equipped with this framework also exhibit excellent generalization ability and data efficiency in tasks such as few-shot image classification, multimodal feature construction, and image restoration. Subsequent experiments further validate the functional necessity and internal interpretability of each memory submodule. This study not only provides a novel object detection framework, but also offers a feasible technical pathway for integrating neurocognitive mechanisms with deep learning models, highlighting its significant value in improving model learning efficiency and task robustness. The project is available at https://github.com/2186cloud/hipnet.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对当前目标检测模型缺乏显式记忆机制的问题，提出了一种基于生物海马体记忆建模的检测框架 Hippocampus-DETR，将海马体记忆网络模块 HipNet 集成到 DETR 架构中，模拟海马体亚区的解剖结构和功能组织，实现视觉编码特征的模式分离、模式完成、重要性过滤和信息整合。实验结果表明该框架在检测精度、泛化能力和数据效率上优于主流模型，并在少样本图像分类、多模态特征构建和图像修复等任务中表现出色。
Motivation: 现有目标检测模型缺乏显式记忆机制，限制了其对复杂场景的学习效率和泛化能力，受生物海马体记忆系统启发，旨在为深度模型注入类似生物的记忆功能。
Method: 提出 Hippocampus-DETR 框架，核心是 HipNet 模块，该模块模拟内嗅皮层、齿状回、CA3、CA1 和下托等海马体亚区，通过分层训练策略优化各记忆子模块，形成具备检索和完成能力的记忆系统。
Result: 在目标检测任务上达到比主流模型更高的检测精度；在少样本图像分类、多模态特征构建和图像恢复等任务中展现出良好的泛化能力和数据效率；消融实验验证了各记忆子模块的功能必要性和内部可解释性。
Conclusion: 该研究不仅提供了一个新颖的目标检测框架，还为神经认知机制与深度学习模型的融合提供了可行的技术路径，对提高模型学习效率和任务鲁棒性具有显著价值。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: CSD: Content-aware Speculative Decoding for Efficient Image Generation
papers.abstract_en: Speculative decoding (SD) has emerged as a key solution to accelerate the inference of autoregressive models. However, in the field of image generation, it faces the challenge of low acceptance rates, and directly relaxing its criteria leads to degradation in image quality. In this paper, we propose a novel content-aware speculative decoding algorithm, termed CSD, which integrates an entropy-based probability relaxation mechanism with an optimal resampling strategy to enhance the inference efficiency for autoregressive image generation. By leveraging the informational uncertainty inherent in different regions of an image, CSD dynamically adjusts the acceptance probability of candidate tokens, increasing the acceptance rate in low-detail areas to accelerate generation. Moreover, a distribution alignment filter is introduced to ensure the output distribution to be aligned with the target model, which significantly improves the generative quality. Experiments conducted on Lumina-mGPT and Janus-Pro demonstrate that the superiority of the proposed CSD. Our source code is available at https://github.com/aderfebr/CSD.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种内容感知推测解码算法CSD，通过熵驱动的概率松弛机制和最优重采样策略，提高自回归图像生成模型的推理效率。CSD根据图像不同区域的信息不确定性动态调整候选令牌的接受概率，并在低细节区域提高接受率以加速生成，同时引入分布对齐滤波器保证输出分布与目标模型对齐。在Lumina-mGPT和Janus-Pro上的实验证明了其优越性。
Motivation: 现有推测解码在图像生成中接受率低，直接放宽标准会导致图像质量下降，亟需一种既能提高接受率又不损害生成质量的方法。
Method: 提出内容感知推测解码CSD，包含熵驱动的概率松弛机制（动态调整接受概率）和最优重采样策略，以及分布对齐滤波器，确保输出分布与目标模型一致。
Result: 在Lumina-mGPT和Janus-Pro上的实验表明，CSD在加速生成的同时保持了生成质量。
Conclusion: CSD通过内容感知的动态接受概率调整和分布对齐，有效提升了自回归图像生成的推理效率，且代码已开源。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: Video-MME-Logical: A Controlled Diagnostic Benchmark for Video Temporal-Logical Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Recent interest in multimodal large language models (MLLMs) raises a central question: can they reason over dynamic visual evidence rather than merely recognize objects or events in individual frames? This ability, which we refer to as video temporal-logical reasoning, requires models to maintain, update, and compose evidence as visual states evolve across frames. Existing video benchmarks often conflate this capability with scene complexity, static recognition, or uncontrolled temporal variation. To isolate this capability, we introduce Video-MME-Logical, a controlled benchmark organized around five temporal-logical operations: state tracking, sequential counting, temporal ordering, dynamic spatiality, and structural composition. The benchmark contains 25 fine-grained task categories generated with controlled object states, transitions, temporal dependencies, and logical compositions. It enables difficulty-controlled final-answer evaluation by varying temporal horizon and reasoning complexity, and supports intermediate-state diagnostics by verifying whether models recover the required logical reasoning trace before producing the final answer. Experiments with state-of-the-art MLLMs reveal a substantial human-model gap, especially as temporal-logical complexity increases. Supervised fine-tuning on up to 500K generated samples improves performance but remains insufficient to close the reasoning gap, positioning Video-MME-Logical as a scalable testbed for analyzing and improving temporal-logical reasoning in MLLMs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Video-MME-Logical，一个受控的视频时间逻辑推理基准测试，围绕状态跟踪、顺序计数、时间排序、动态空间性和结构组成五种操作构建，包含 25 个细粒度任务。通过控制时间跨度和推理复杂度实现难度可调的最终答案评估，并支持中间状态诊断。实验表明，最先进的多模态大语言模型与人类存在显著差距，且随着时间逻辑复杂度增加差距扩大；即使使用多达 500K 生成样本进行监督微调，仍不足以弥补该推理差距。
Motivation: 现有视频基准常将时间逻辑推理与场景复杂度、静态识别或不受控的时间变化混杂，无法孤立评估模型能否在动态视觉证据上进行推理（即视频时间逻辑推理），因此需要专门的控制性基准来隔离这一能力。
Method: 设计 5 种时间逻辑操作（状态跟踪、顺序计数、时间排序、动态空间性、结构组成），生成包含精确控制的对象状态、转换、时间依赖和逻辑组合的 25 个任务类别。通过改变时间跨度（temporal horizon）和推理复杂度控制难度，并引入中间状态诊断以验证模型是否恢复所需的推理轨迹。
Result: 在多个最先进 MLLM 上的评估发现，人类与模型之间存在显著性能差距，且该差距随时间逻辑复杂度增加而扩大。在多达 500K 生成样本上的监督微调虽能提升性能，但不足以消除推理鸿沟。
Conclusion: Video-MME-Logical 可作为分析并提升 MLLM 时间逻辑推理能力的可扩展测试平台，当前模型在此类推理上远未达到人类水平。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: NormAct: A Benchmark for Hidden Social Norm Compliance in Embodied Planning
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) are increasingly deployed as embodied planners in egocentric environments, where task success requires not only achieving instructed goals but also acting in socially appropriate ways. While explicit goals may render certain actions optimal, implicit social norms often impose hidden constraints. Existing evaluations typically focus on explicit goal achievement or direct norm knowledge, seldom assessing whether planners can infer and apply these hidden constraints within action sequences. We introduce NormAct, a benchmark for embodied social-norm interactions that evaluates plans on Goal Achievement, Norm Compliance, and overall Task Success. NormAct uniquely embeds hidden norms within ordinary tasks, testing whether models can realize them without explicit instruction. Experiments with state-of-the-art MLLMs (GPT-5.4, Claude Opus 4.7, Gemini 3 Pro) reveal a significant gap: models achieve explicit goals in 67.3\% of cases, but comply with hidden norms in only 26.4\%. Cue-condition experiments indicate that this gap stems not from a lack of general social knowledge, but from challenges in activating and grounding relevant norms in context. To address this, we propose NormPerceptor, a context-conditioned cue generator that infers scene-relevant norms prior to planning, increasing Task Success from 24.2\% to 46.7\%. Our results underscore the importance of enabling embodied agents to proactively detect hidden norms, ground them in visual evidence, and integrate them as action-planning constraints. Our benchmark is publicly available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/Caleb196x/NormAct.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 NormAct 基准，用于评估多模态大语言模型 (MLLMs) 在具身规划中遵守隐藏社会规范的能力。实验发现，模型在显式目标达成率为 67.3%，但隐藏规范遵守率仅为 26.4%。为此，提出 NormPerceptor，一种上下文条件提示生成器，通过事先推断场景相关规范将任务成功率从 24.2% 提升至 46.7%。
Motivation: 现有评估仅关注显式目标达成或直接规范知识，忽略了具身代理在行动序列中推断和应用隐藏社会约束的能力。
Method: 构建 NormAct 基准，在普通任务中嵌入隐藏规范，同时评估目标达成、规范遵守和整体成功率。提出 NormPerceptor，在规划前推断与场景相关的规范并生成提示。
Result: GPT-5.4、Claude Opus 4.7、Gemini 3 Pro 等模型在显式目标达成率为 67.3%，隐藏规范遵守率仅为 26.4%。NormPerceptor 将任务成功率从 24.2% 提升至 46.7%。
Conclusion: 研究表明，具身代理需主动检测隐藏规范、基于视觉证据验证并整合为行动约束。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Pepti-drift: Toxicity-Repulsive Drifting for Antigen-Conditioned Discrete Peptide Generation
papers.abstract_en: Peptides are a promising therapeutic modality that combine the chemical tunability of small molecules with the target specificity of macromolecular therapeutics. However, designing antigen-specific binding peptides while avoiding toxicity remains a major challenge for therapeutic peptide discovery. Here, we present Pepti-drift, a toxicity-aware latent refinement framework that generates peptide candidates through a single antigen-conditioned drift step. In a peptide embedding space, Pepti-drift learns to attract generated peptide latents toward antigen-matched binding peptides while repelling them from toxicity-associated regions. This is challenging because binding-promoting physicochemical features often overlap with toxicity-associated features in peptide representation space. To address this, we introduce a warm-up strategy to stabilize this competing objective by first learning binding-oriented attraction and then increasing toxicity repulsion.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Pepti-drift，一种毒性感知的潜在精炼框架，用于抗原条件化离散肽生成。该框架在单一漂移步骤中生成肽候选，通过吸引生成肽走向抗原匹配结合肽并排斥毒性相关区域来优化肽嵌入。由于结合促进特征与毒性特征重叠，采用预热策略先学习结合导向吸引再增加毒性排斥。
Motivation: 设计抗原特异性结合肽同时避免毒性是治疗性肽发现的主要挑战，现有方法难以解决结合与毒性特征重叠的问题。
Method: 提出Pepti-drift，在肽嵌入空间中通过单一抗原条件化漂移步骤生成肽候选，学习吸引生成肽走向抗原匹配结合肽并排斥毒性相关区域。引入预热策略，先优化结合吸引再逐步增加毒性排斥，以稳定竞争目标。

papers.title: Parameter-Efficient Quantum-Inspired Fast Weight Programmers for Traffic-Matrix Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: Traffic matrices (TMs) capture network-wide origin-destination demand and are central to traffic engineering, yet accurate whole-matrix forecasting remains challenging when prediction must be performed under the memory, update, and training-budget constraints of online network control. This paper investigates whether compact quantum-inspired recurrent models can provide effective TM forecasts without relying on dedicated graph, transformer, or diffusion modules. We adapt gated quantum-inspired Kolmogorov-Arnold network fast-weight programmers (QKAN-FWPs) to direct multi-step Abilene TM forecasting, where each model predicts the next 20 five-minute frames of a 144-channel origin-destination (OD) matrix from a two-hour history. We benchmark three QKAN placement variants against a matched-size long short-term memory (LSTM) network, a larger LSTM, and a classical gated fast-weight programmer under a shared fixed-budget training protocol. Among the evaluated recurrent models, G-QKANFWP achieves the best pooled root-mean-square error (RMSE), while using only 22.4% of the larger LSTM. It also outperforms both the matched-size LSTM and the classical G-FWP baseline, indicating that the gain is not due to gated fast-weight framework alone. Convergence and channel-wise analyses further show that the quantum-inspired variants obtain lower validation-loss area under the learning curve (AULC) than matched-size recurrent baselines, while G-QKANFWP and GQKAN-FWP achieve substantially more OD-channel wins. These results identify a classical slow programmer with a quantum-inspired fast programmer as a promising accuracy-efficiency design for resource-conscious network traffic-matrix forecasting.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究利用参数高效的量子启发式快速权重编程器（QKAN-FWPs）进行网络流量矩阵预测。在Abilene数据集上，G-QKANFWP模型在预测未来20个五分钟帧时，取得了优于匹配大小的LSTM和经典门控快速权重编程器的均方根误差，仅使用更大LSTM 22.4%的参数。收敛性和通道分析显示量子启发式变体具有更低的验证损失曲线下面积。

Method: 将门控量子启发式Kolmogorov-Arnold网络快速权重编程器（QKAN-FWPs）适配到多步Abilene流量矩阵预测，比较三种QKAN放置变体与LSTM和经典门控快速权重编程器。使用固定预算训练协议。

papers.title: Scalable and Differentiable Point-Cloud Registration Using Maximum Mean Discrepancy
papers.abstract_en: We present MMD-Reg, a novel correspondence-free approach to point-cloud registration that is differentiable and has linear computational complexity in the number of points. We model registration as a nonlinear least-squares problem based on the Maximum Mean Discrepancy, approximated using random Fourier features. The resulting objective can be solved efficiently with standard methods such as Levenberg-Marquardt, and the solution is differentiable via the implicit function theorem. This allows MMD-Reg to be used as a differentiable optimization layer within end-to-end trainable models, supporting registration under challenging conditions such as poor initial alignment and partial overlap. We demonstrate this Neural MMD-Reg formulation by integrating the layer with a set transformer, training the resulting model in supervised and unsupervised settings, and comparing its performance against recent learning-based methods. We also evaluate standalone MMD-Reg, comparing its accuracy and scalability against widely used non-learning-based registration methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出MMD-Reg，一种基于最大均值差异（Maximum Mean Discrepancy）的免对应点云配准方法，具有可微性和线性计算复杂度。该方法将配准建模为非线性最小二乘问题，通过随机傅里叶特征近似MMD，并利用隐函数定理实现可微优化，可作为端到端可训练网络中的可微层。实验在挑战性条件下（如初始对齐差、部分重叠）验证了其性能。
Motivation: 现有基于学习的点云配准方法通常需要对应关系或密集特征匹配，且计算复杂度高；非学习方法在初始对齐差、部分重叠等挑战场景下性能受限。本文旨在开发一种可微、可扩展且免对应的点云配准方法，以适应端到端训练。
Method: 提出MMD-Reg框架：将点云配准视为基于MMD的非线性最小二乘问题，使用随机傅里叶特征高效近似MMD，并采用Levenberg-Marquardt等标准方法求解；通过隐函数定理使解可微，从而集成到神经网络中。进一步提出Neural MMD-Reg，将MMD-Reg层与Set Transformer结合，支持监督和无监督训练。
Result: 摘要报告，Neural MMD-Reg在挑战性条件下（如初始对齐差、部分重叠）优于近期基于学习的方法；独立MMD-Reg在精度和可扩展性方面与广泛使用的非学习方法相当或更优，且具有线性计算复杂度。
Conclusion: MMD-Reg为点云配准提供了一种可微、免对应、可扩展的解决方案，可轻松嵌入端到端学习框架，适用于需要鲁棒配准的多种任务。

papers.title: Quantum Dynamic Time Warping for Multivariate Time Series Classification
papers.abstract_en: Dynamic Time Warping (DTW) is a cornerstone for time series classification, but its reliance on Euclidean distances fails to capture latent cross-channel correlations in complex multivariate data. We propose a hybrid Quantum Dynamic Time Warping (qDTW) architecture, replacing the classical distance metric with the parameterized geometry of a quantum Hilbert space. Through structural ablation on benchmarks up to $C=8$ spatial dimensions, we establish fundamental topological rules for quantum sequence alignment. We introduce a Unified Pre-Embedding Adjoint Ansatz that decouples trainable entanglement from classical data, eliminating the severe phase-scrambling and information bottlenecks inherent to traditional measurements. We demonstrate this decoupled architecture allows untrained quantum kernels to act as highly expressive baselines, while parameterized training effectively untangles deeply overlapping hyper-dimensional data. Furthermore, we identify a strict spatial-temporal expressivity tradeoff: temporal depth (data re-uploading) is necessary for dimensionally restricted univariate circuits, but applying it to wide multi-qubit registers triggers chaotic frequency-spectrum explosions and representation collapse. By navigating these topological hazards, our multivariate quantum architecture outperforms classical baselines, setting a new standard for integrating parameterized quantum circuits with dynamic programming
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出混合量子动态时间规整（qDTW）架构，用量子希尔伯特空间的参数化几何替代经典欧氏距离度量，用于多元时间序列分类。通过结构消融实验建立了量子序列对齐的基本拓扑规则，并引入统一预嵌入伴随拟设（Unified Pre-Embedding Adjoint Ansatz）来解缠可训练纠缠与经典数据，解决传统测量中的相位混乱和信息瓶颈问题。
Motivation: 经典DTW依赖欧氏距离，无法捕捉多元时间序列中潜在的跨通道相关性，量子方法有望利用希尔伯特空间的高维特征来建模这种相关性。
Method: 提出混合量子DTW架构，用参数化量子电路的输出距离替换经典DTW中的欧氏距离；设计统一预嵌入伴随拟设，将可训练纠缠与经典数据分离，避免相位干扰；并分析了时空表达能力的权衡：对宽多量子比特寄存器应用数据重新上传会导致频率谱爆炸和表示崩溃。
Result: 在最多8个空间维度的基准测试上，所提多元量子架构优于经典基线方法，并建立了量子序列对齐的拓扑规则。
Conclusion: 通过规避拓扑风险，参数化量子电路与动态规划的结合在多元时间序列分类中展现了潜力，但需要谨慎设计避免深度数据重新上传带来的表示崩溃。

papers.title: ATOD: Annealed Turn-aware On-policy Distillation for Multi-turn Autonomous Agents
papers.abstract_en: Training small language-model agents for long-horizon interactive tasks requires both fast imitation and reward-driven improvement. On-policy distillation (OPD) provides dense teacher guidance and typically improves rapidly in the early stage, but its gains saturate once the student approaches the teacher, limiting the final performance ceiling. Reinforcement learning (RL) directly optimizes environment rewards and encourages exploratory improvement toward a higher reward-defined ceiling, but sparse and delayed feedback makes early-stage learning much less efficient than OPD. In this paper, we propose ATOD (Annealed Turn-aware On-policy Distillation), a hybrid online distillation algorithm that explicitly exploits this complementarity. (1) ATOD uses an annealed OPD-RL schedule: OPD dominates early training to approach teacher-level behavior, while RL is gradually strengthened to drive reward-based exploration. (2) ATOD introduces Turn-level Disagreement-Uncertainty Reweighting (T-DUR), which softly amplifies high-utility turns and improves dense supervision in long trajectories. Experiments on ALFWorld, WebShop, and Search-QA show that ATOD consistently outperforms competing post-training baselines: across the three student sizes, ATOD improves average success rate by 3.03 points over OPD and 23.62 points over GRPO, while surpassing the corresponding teacher models by 2.16 points.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出ATOD（退火轮次感知在线蒸馏）算法，结合在线蒸馏（OPD）和强化学习（RL）的优势，通过退火调度使OPD早期主导学习、RL后期推动探索；并引入轮次级别分歧-不确定性重加权（T-DUR）以增强长轨迹中的密集监督。在ALFWorld、WebShop和Search-QA上，ATOD在三种学生模型大小下平均成功率比OPD提高3.03点，比GRPO提高23.62点，并超越对应教师模型2.16点。
Motivation: 在线蒸馏（OPD）早期提升快但后期饱和，强化学习（RL）潜力高但早期效率低，现有方法未能充分利用两者的互补性。
Method: 提出ATOD，核心包括：（1）退火OPD-RL调度，初期OPD主导、RL逐渐增强；（2）轮次级别分歧-不确定性重加权（T-DUR），放大高效用轮次以改进长轨迹的密集监督。
Result: 在ALFWorld、WebShop和Search-QA上，ATOD在三种学生模型大小下平均成功率比OPD提升3.03点，比GRPO提升23.62点，并超越教师模型2.16点。
Conclusion: ATOD通过混合蒸馏与强化学习，有效提升多轮自主智能体的性能，尤其在长轨迹任务中超越教师模型。

papers.title: Grounded Iterative Language Planning: How Parameterized World Models Reduce Hallucination Propagation in LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: World models for language agents come in two useful forms. An agent-based world model calls an LLM API and reasons flexibly in language, but its errors appear as hallucinated state changes that are hard to score with ordinary regression losses. A parameterized world model is a trained transition predictor; its errors are easier to measure with quantities such as NodeMSE, delta accuracy, and validity accuracy, but it is usually weaker as a standalone planner. We compare these two families on four graph-structured planning benchmarks and introduce operational hallucination metrics for the agent-based case. The comparison motivates \textbf{Grounded Iterative Language Planning} (GILP), which trains only a small parameterized backbone and combines it with API-based agent reasoning. The backbone supplies valid actions, predicted state deltas, risk, and value; the LLM drafts an action and imagined delta; and a consistency gate asks for revision when the two disagree. On real GPT-4o-mini calls, GILP reduces hallucinated-state rate from 0.176 to 0.035. In calibrated simulator ablations, it raises success from 0.668 to 0.838 while adding only ~22% extra LLM calls.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文比较了基于agent的世界模型（使用LLM API，灵活但错误难以量化）和参数化世界模型（可训练，错误易测但规划弱），并提出Grounded Iterative Language Planning (GILP)。GILP训练一个小型参数化backbone提供有效动作、状态增量、风险和值，LLM起草动作和想象增量，通过一致性门控要求两者不一致时修订。在GPT-4o-mini上，幻觉状态率从0.176降至0.035；消融实验中成功率从0.668提升至0.838，仅增加约22%额外LLM调用。
Motivation: 基于agent的世界模型错误以幻觉状态变化形式出现，难以用回归损失衡量；参数化世界模型错误易测但作为独立规划器较弱。需要一种结合两者优点的方案减少幻觉传播。
Method: 提出GILP：训练小型参数化backbone预测有效动作、状态增量、风险和值；LLM基于当前状态起草动作和想象增量；当backbone与LLM的预测不一致时，触发修订流程。
Result: 在真实GPT-4o-mini调用中，幻觉状态率从0.176降至0.035。校准模拟器中，成功率从0.668提升至0.838，额外LLM调用仅增加约22%。
Conclusion: GILP通过结合参数化模型的精确性与LLM的灵活性，有效减少了语言智能体中的幻觉传播，且计算开销可控。

summary_sections.motivation: 基于agent的世界模型错误以幻觉状态变化形式出现，难以用回归损失衡量；参数化世界模型错误易测但作为独立规划器较弱。需要一种结合两者优点的方案减少幻觉传播。
summary_sections.method: 提出GILP：训练小型参数化backbone预测有效动作、状态增量、风险和值；LLM基于当前状态起草动作和想象增量；当backbone与LLM的预测不一致时，触发修订流程。
summary_sections.result: 在真实GPT-4o-mini调用中，幻觉状态率从0.176降至0.035。校准模拟器中，成功率从0.668提升至0.838，额外LLM调用仅增加约22%。
summary_sections.conclusion: GILP通过结合参数化模型的精确性与LLM的灵活性，有效减少了语言智能体中的幻觉传播，且计算开销可控。

papers.title: Accelerating Hierarchical Sparse Predictive Coding with Hybrid Amortized Inference
papers.abstract_en: Hierarchical predictive coding provides an interpretable framework for perception as error-driven inference in multi-layer generative models, while sparse coding imposes parsimonious latent representations through explicit sparsity constraints. Their combination yields hierarchical sparse predictive coding models with appealing computational and neuroscientific properties, but practical use is often limited by the cost of iterative latent inference. In such models, each input may require many recurrent refinement steps before a useful sparse representation is obtained, and this burden becomes more severe as the hierarchy deepens. We study this bottleneck by holding the hierarchical sparse energy fixed and varying the inference procedure. The comparison includes four schemes: classical iterative inference based on ISTA, an accelerated MFISTA reference, structurally informed amortized inference using a LISTA-style bottom-up encoder adapted to the hierarchical model, and a hybrid method in which this fast amortized initialization is followed by a small number of corrective energy-based refinement steps. Under this shared objective, we measure reconstruction quality, sparsity, latency, and stability on static image benchmarks. The results show that a shallow LISTA-style initializer plus short corrective recurrence improves over pure amortization while remaining much faster than long iterative inference.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究层级稀疏预测编码模型中的推理瓶颈，比较了迭代推理（ISTA）、加速迭代（MFISTA）、结构感知摊销推理（LISTA风格）及混合方法（摊销初始化加少量校正）。在静态图像基准上，混合方法在重建质量、稀疏性、延迟和稳定性上优于纯摊销，且远快于长迭代推理。
Motivation: 层级稀疏预测编码模型因迭代推理成本高而难以实际应用，尤其是层级加深时，每个输入需要多次递归细化。
Method: 固定层级稀疏能量函数，比较四种推理方案：经典ISTA迭代、加速MFISTA、适应层级模型的LISTA风格自底向上编码器（摊销推理），以及该摊销初始化后接少量基于能量的校正步骤的混合方法。
Result: 在静态图像基准上，混合方法（浅层LISTA初始器加短校正递归）在重建质量、稀疏性、延迟和稳定性上优于纯摊销，且远快于长迭代推理。
Conclusion: 混合摊销推理能在保持速度的同时提升性能，为层级稀疏预测编码的实用化提供方向。

papers.title: Distributed Air-Gap Flux and Rotor-Current Fusion for Operating-Regime Identification in a 10-MW Kaplan Hydrogenerator
papers.abstract_en: Reliable monitoring of hydroelectric generators requires descriptors that capture both electrical loading and electromagnetic field behavior. This work investigates operating-regime identification in the Porjus U9 10-MW Kaplan hydrogenerator using synchronized measurements from ten stator-mounted Hall probes and six rotor-current channels. Seven steady guide-vane-opening settings are considered, and each 300s record is divided into 1s windows. The resulting windows are represented by spatial Fourier descriptors of the circumferential air-gap field, probe-wise temporal flux indicators, and channel-wise RMS rotor-current features. Correlation analysis and principal component analysis are used to examine how the feature groups vary with the operating point, and Random Forest, radial-basis-function support vector classification, and multilayer perceptron models are evaluated for supervised identification of the guide-vane-opening state. The analysis shows that RMS rotor-current features mainly track the loading axis, while the magnetic-flux features reveal complementary information associated with spatial imbalance, waveform distortion, and weak low-frequency modulation. Spatial descriptors alone provide limited separability, yielding test accuracies below 27%, whereas rotor-current features alone reach about 84-85%. Combining flux and current information gives the most discriminative representation; the SVC-RBF model achieves 99.5% test accuracy and macro-F1 score. The results indicate that distributed air-gap magnetic sensing, when fused with rotor-current measurements, can support accurate and interpretable data-driven monitoring of Kaplan hydrogenerator operating regimes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文利用定子霍尔探头和转子电流通道的同步测量数据，对10MW Kaplan水轮发电机进行运行工况识别。通过空间傅里叶描述符、时间磁通指标和RMS转子电流特征，结合随机森林、SVC-RBF和多层感知器进行监督分类。磁通与电流融合后SVC-RBF模型达到99.5%测试准确率和宏F1分数。
Motivation: 水轮发电机可靠监测需要能够捕捉电气负载和电磁场行为的描述符，现有方法可能缺乏对运行工况的精确识别。
Method: 使用10个定子霍尔探头和6个转子电流通道的同步数据，提取空间傅里叶描述符、探针时间磁通指标和通道RMS转子电流特征，采用PCA和相关性分析，并用随机森林、SVC-RBF和多层感知器进行导叶开度状态监督分类。
Result: 单独空间描述符测试准确率低于27%，单独转子电流特征约84-85%，融合后SVC-RBF达到99.5%测试准确率和宏F1分数。
Conclusion: 分布式气隙磁感应与转子电流测量融合可支持准确且可解释的水轮发电机运行工况数据驱动监测。

papers.title: Optimizing Teacher-Student Partitioning for Scalable Knowledge Distillation on HPC Systems
papers.abstract_en: Knowledge Distillation (KD) enables training smaller student models under the guidance of larger teacher models, and the widely adopted TRL library implements it. Yet, TRL treats both models symmetrically, missing opportunities to exploit their pronounced asymmetry in memory footprint, and communication requirements. This paper presents an HPC-aware methodology for KD that decouples teacher and student partitioning efficiently. Our approach achieves up to 67% higher samples-per-second than TRL by avoiding unnecessary teacher-model data structures and selecting the best split strategy. We combine vertical and horizontal partitioning of models, deriving an analytical expression that identifies the existence of inflection points between splitting regimes. These results showed that exploiting teacher--student asymmetry through topology-aware parallelism notably accelerated GKD training on production HPC clusters at our company
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种面向高性能计算（HPC）系统的知识蒸馏（KD）方法，通过解耦教师和学生模型的分区策略，利用两者在内存和通信上的不对称性，实现最高67%的样本吞吐量提升。方法结合垂直与水平分区，并推导出分区模式间拐点的解析表达式，在工业级HPC集群上加速了GKD训练。
Motivation: 现有知识蒸馏实现（如TRL库）对称地处理教师和学生模型，未利用两者在内存占用和通信需求上的显著不对称性，导致资源浪费和性能瓶颈。
Method: 提出HPC感知的KD方法，将教师和学生模型的分区解耦，避免不必要的教师模型数据结构，并通过联合垂直与水平分区选择最佳拆分策略；推导解析表达式识别分区模式间的拐点。
Result: 相比TRL，该方法在样本吞吐量（samples-per-second）上最高提升67%。
Conclusion: 利用教师-学生不对称性并结合拓扑感知的并行性可以显著加速知识蒸馏在HPC集群上的训练。

papers.title: Text as Illumination: Spatial Contrastive Retinex Learning for Language-guided Medical Image Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Language-guided Medical Image Segmentation (LMIS) has shown great potential to improve the delineation of anatomical structures and lesions by integrating clinical textual information. Existing methods generally rely on either implicit interaction between textual and visual features or auxiliary coarse-grained supervision for cross-modal alignment. However, these methods lack explicit and fine-grained constraints to ensure semantic consistency, causing a mismatch between language and the segmentation outputs. To address this issue, we propose Text-as-Illumination Retinex Network (TIRNet), a novel Retinex-inspired framework that treats text embeddings as semantic illumination for feature modulation, thereby improving semantic consistency in LMIS. TIRNet introduces two key blocks integrated at each decoder stage: (1) the Retinex-inspired Text Modulation Block (RTMB), which employs positive and negative illumination maps to enhance text-relevant foreground features and suppress background interference; and (2) the Consistent Detail Compensation Block (CDCB), which selectively recovers high-frequency details via a consistency-gated mechanism conditioned on illumination reliability. Furthermore, we propose a Multi-Scale Illumination Supervision Loss (MSIS-Loss), comprising a Region-Grounded Contrastive Loss (RGC-Loss) that enforces cross-modal similarity to be concentrated in text-relevant foreground regions and suppressed in background regions, and a Background Suppression Loss (BS-Loss) that provides pixel-level supervision for negative illumination maps, jointly ensuring a precise cross-modal alignment at each decoder stage. Extensive experiments on the MosMedData+ and QaTa-COV19 datasets demonstrate that TIRNet achieves state-of-the-art performance in LMIS. The code is available at: https://github.com/anaanaa/TIRNet.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Text-as-Illumination Retinex Network (TIRNet)，一种基于Retinex理论的框架，将文本嵌入视为语义照明来调制特征，以解决语言引导医学图像分割中的跨模态语义不一致问题。TIRNet包含Retinex文本调制块和一致性细节补偿块，并引入多尺度照明监督损失，在MosMedData+和QaTa-COV19数据集上达到最先进性能。
Motivation: 现有语言引导医学图像分割方法缺乏显式和细粒度的跨模态对齐约束，导致语言与分割输出之间的语义不匹配。
Method: 提出TIRNet框架，包含：(1) Retinex文本调制块，通过正负照明图增强文本相关前景并抑制背景；(2) 一致性细节补偿块，基于照明可靠性选择性恢复高频细节；(3) 多尺度照明监督损失，包括区域接地对比损失和背景抑制损失，实现逐解码器阶段的精确对齐。
Result: 在MosMedData+和QaTa-COV19数据集上，TIRNet取得语言引导医学图像分割的最先进性能。
Conclusion: 将Retinex理论引入跨模态特征调制，通过显式照明图约束实现文本与视觉特征的语义一致性，为LMIS提供了新范式。

papers.title: Position Bias Correction is Insufficient for One-Pass Attention Sorting
papers.abstract_en: Long-context language models suffer from position bias, where information in middle positions is underutilized. Attention Sorting addresses this by iteratively reordering documents based on attention patterns, but its multiple sort-and-generate cycles increase deployment cost. We hypothesize that position bias is the primary bottleneck and propose Debiased One-Pass Attention Sorting, which estimates a per-prompt position-bias curve from the low-attention majority of documents and uses it to correct raw attention scores (via subtraction or division) to enable single-pass sorting. Our experiments on two models refute this hypothesis in the tested setting: on LLaMA-2-7B-32K-Instruct, debiasing produces identical results to uncalibrated single-pass sorting (94.83\% containment accuracy), while on YaRN-Llama-2-7b-64k, debiasing improves accuracy by 8.67 percentage points but remains 14.84pp behind iterative sorting, closing only 37\% of the gap. These results suggest that position-bias correction is insufficient to match iterative sorting, and that repeated reordering provides additional benefits beyond bias correction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对长上下文语言模型的注意力排序（Attention Sorting）中多轮迭代成本高的问题，提出一种基于位置偏差校正的单轮排序方法（Debiased One-Pass Attention Sorting），但实验表明该方法无法完全替代迭代排序，仅能缩小部分差距。
Motivation: 迭代式注意力排序需要多轮生成与重排，部署成本高；研究者假设位置偏差是主要瓶颈，若能校正则可实现单轮排序。
Method: 从低注意力文档中估计每个提示的位置偏差曲线，通过减法或除法校正原始注意力分数，使得单次排序即可得到与迭代排序相近的结果。
Result: 在LLaMA-2-7B-32K-Instruct上，校正后与未校正的单轮排序结果相同（94.83%包含准确率）；在YaRN-Llama-2-7b-64k上，校正将准确率提升8.67个百分点，但仍比迭代排序低14.84个百分点，仅缩小37%的差距。
Conclusion: 位置偏差校正不足以匹配迭代排序的性能，重复重排提供了超越偏差校正的额外收益。

papers.title: NLL-Guided Full-Attention Layer Selection for Training-Free Sliding-Window Adaptation
papers.abstract_en: Hybrid attention models that mix full and sliding-window attention across layers offer a promising approach to efficient long-context inference, but the critical question of \emph{which layers} should retain full attention remains unsolved. Existing methods use either fixed periodic patterns or attention-based heuristics that may not capture what matters for downstream accuracy. We propose NLL-guided layer selection, a training-free method that directly measures each layer's importance by computing the negative log-likelihood degradation on answer tokens when that layer uses sliding-window instead of full attention. On LongMemEval with Qwen3-4B, our method achieves 64.6\% accuracy using only 1/4 full-attention layers, matching the 1/2-FA periodic baseline (65.0\%) while halving the computational budget. NLL-guided selection outperforms the SWAA-reported periodic 1/4-FA baseline by 10.4 percentage points and a matched LightTransfer-style baseline by 26.4 percentage points. De-confounding analysis shows the signal is consistent with long-range attention needs rather than generic layer sensitivity. The method requires only $\sim$15 minutes of one-time calibration, advancing the efficiency-accuracy Pareto frontier for long-context LLM deployment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种无需训练的NLL引导层选择方法，用于混合注意力模型（全注意力和滑动窗口注意力混合）中决定哪些层保留全注意力。该方法通过计算每个层使用滑动窗口代替全注意力时答案token的负对数似然下降来度量层重要性。在LongMemEval上使用Qwen3-4B模型，仅用1/4全注意力层达到64.6%准确率，接近1/2周期基线的65.0%但计算量减半，并显著优于其他基线。
Motivation: 混合注意力模型中如何选择保留全注意力的层是关键问题，现有方法使用固定周期模式或基于注意力的启发式方法，可能无法准确反映对下游准确性的重要性。
Method: 提出NLL引导层选择方法，通过度量每个层使用滑动窗口代替全注意力时在答案token上的负对数似然下降来评估层重要性，无需训练。
Result: 在LongMemEval基准上，Qwen3-4B模型仅用1/4全注意力层达到64.6%准确率，与1/2周期基线（65.0%）相当，比周期性1/4基线高10.4个百分点，比LightTransfer风格基线高26.4个百分点。校准仅需约15分钟。
Conclusion: 该方法推进了长上下文大语言模型部署的效率-准确率帕累托前沿，信号与长距离注意力需求一致而非通用层敏感性。

papers.title: SHIFT: Gate-Modulated Activation Steering for Knowledge Conflict Mitigation in Retrieval-Augmented Generation
papers.abstract_en: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) enhances LLMs by incorporating external knowledge to support response generation. However, conflicts between retrieved context and parametric knowledge have emerged as a critical challenge in RAG systems. To mitigate such conflicts, numerous studies have attempted to identify and edit knowledge-related internal neurons, aiming to improve the ability of LLMs to rely on contextual evidence during generation. However, these neuron-level approaches may introduce unintended cascading effects that compromise the general capabilities of LLMs, as the modified neurons are often entangled with broader model behaviors and functionalities. In this paper, we introduce SHIFT, a novel framework that reformulates neuron-level modification as learnable gate modulation, allowing LLMs to adaptively regulate internal activations for knowledge conflict resolution. Technically, our SHIFT equips LLMs with a lightweight gate module and optimizes fewer than 0.01% trainable parameters while keeping the backbone model frozen. During generation, the gate module adjusts the model's internal representations to adaptively leverage contextual and parametric knowledge. Extensive experiments on six datasets validate the effectiveness of our SHIFT in comparison with various competing baselines. All datasets and code are available at https://github.com/OpenBMB/SHIFT.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出SHIFT框架，将检索增强生成（RAG）中知识冲突缓解问题从神经元级修改转化为可学习的门控调制。通过一个轻量级门控模块（少于0.01%可训练参数）在冻结骨干模型的情况下自适应调整内部表示，以平衡上下文知识与参数化知识。在六个数据集上的实验表明，SHIFT在缓解知识冲突方面优于多种基线方法。
Motivation: RAG中检索上下文与参数化知识之间的冲突是关键挑战，现有神经元级修改方法可能因神经元纠缠而损害模型的通用能力。
Method: 将神经元修改重新定义为可学习的门控调制，在冻结骨干LLM的情况下，仅优化少于0.01%的可训练参数，通过门控模块在生成时动态调整内部表示以利用上下文或参数知识。
Result: 在六个数据集上的实验表明，SHIFT在缓解知识冲突方面优于多种竞争基线。
Conclusion: SHIFT通过门控调制有效缓解知识冲突，且参数量极小，代码已开源。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Output-Space Allocation Costs for Calibration-Guided LLM Compression: An Empirical Study
papers.abstract_en: Training-free compression methods for large language models (LLMs) often use calibration data to guide compression decisions. ROCKET, a recent method combining sparse-dictionary factorization with multi-choice knapsack problem (MCKP) allocation, derives its per-layer factorization from an output reconstruction objective but uses weight-space Frobenius error as the MCKP allocation cost. We investigate whether aligning the allocation cost with the output-space objective improves compressed model fidelity. On Qwen3-8B at 50\% compression, our ROCKET-ActCost achieves +0.8 percentage points higher average accuracy across 8 zero-shot benchmarks (53.1\% vs 52.3\%), but increases WikiText perplexity by 16\% (61.46 vs 52.98). This accuracy-perplexity tradeoff reveals that different allocation objectives favor different downstream metrics. The high correlation ($>$0.99) between weight-space and output-space errors limits allocation divergence, explaining the modest effect size. On Llama-3.2-1B at 20\% compression, the two methods produce near-identical results (53.3\% vs 53.5\% accuracy, 14.45 vs 14.66 PPL), suggesting that the effect of the cost function is minor at lower compression ratios.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究无训练LLM压缩方法中，将分配成本与输出空间目标对齐的效果。基于ROCKET方法，在Qwen3-8B 50%压缩率下，使用输出空间成本（ROCKET-ActCost）在零样本基准上平均准确率提升0.8个百分点，但困惑度增加16%。在Llama-3.2-1B低压缩率下效果微小。
Motivation: 现有压缩方法如ROCKET使用权重空间Frobenius误差作为分配成本，但分解目标基于输出重建。本文探讨对齐分配成本与输出空间目标是否能改善压缩模型质量。
Method: 在ROCKET的基础上，将多选择背包问题（MCKP）的分配成本从权重空间Frobenius误差改为输出空间重建误差，得到ROCKET-ActCost。
Result: 在Qwen3-8B 50%压缩下，ROCKET-ActCost在8个零样本基准上平均准确率53.1% vs 52.3%（+0.8），但WikiText困惑度从52.98升至61.46（+16%）。在Llama-3.2-1B 20%压缩下，准确率53.3% vs 53.5%，困惑度14.45 vs 14.66，差异很小。权重空间与输出空间误差相关性>0.99。
Conclusion: 分配成本的目标影响不同下游指标（准确率 vs 困惑度），存在权衡。在高压缩率下效果中等，低压缩率下效果微小。成本函数的选择对压缩质量影响有限。

papers.title: Improving Adversarial Robustness via Activation Amplification and Attenuation
papers.abstract_en: The existence of adversarial attacks is often attributed to the presence of non-robust features in neural networks. While prior defenses reduce their impact via pruning, masking, or feature recalibration, we instead propose to jointly learn to amplify and attenuate these signals through a simple activation scaling mechanism. To this end, we introduce Activation Amplification and Attenuation (A3), a lightweight plug-in module that enhances adversarial robustness with minimal modifications of the activations. A3 dynamically rescales the activations using a learnable mask and a scaling factor derived from the original activation magnitudes. The influence of adversarial perturbations can be amplified or attenuated using the same learnable parameters by simply flipping the sign of the scaling operation. The amplified signals serve as negative references to construct novel contrastive and ranking loss functions. Experimental analysis shows that learning to degrade the predictions in amplification mode simultaneously improves adversarial robustness in attenuation mode. Moreover, A3 relies on only a small number of learnable parameters, with most of its behavior being determined by the scaling mechanism rather than additional network capacity. Extensive experiments demonstrate that integrating A3 into different backbones, datasets, and training methods consistently improves adversarial robustness while introducing negligible computational and memory overhead compared to existing plug-in modules. Code is available at: https://github.com/tgoncalv/A3.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出激活放大与衰减（Activation Amplification and Attenuation, A3）模块，通过动态缩放激活值来增强神经网络的对抗鲁棒性。A3 利用可学习掩码和基于原始激活幅度的缩放因子，通过翻转缩放符号实现对抗扰动的放大或衰减，并引入对比和排序损失函数。实验表明，A3 在多种骨干网络、数据集和训练方法上一致提升鲁棒性，且参数极少、计算和内存开销极低。
Motivation: 现有防御方法通常通过剪枝、掩码或特征重校准来减少非鲁棒特征的影响，但本文提出联合学习放大和衰减这些信号，以更有效地利用它们提升鲁棒性。
Method: A3 是一个轻量级插件模块，通过可学习掩码和从原始激活幅度导出的缩放因子动态重缩放激活值。通过翻转缩放操作的符号，即可用相同的参数实现对抗扰动的放大或衰减，其中放大信号作为负样本构造新的对比和排序损失函数。
Result: 集成 A3 到不同骨干网络、数据集和训练方法中，均一致提升对抗鲁棒性，且相比现有插件模块，引入的计算和内存开销可忽略不计。
Conclusion: A3 仅依赖少量可学习参数，其行为主要由缩放机制决定而非额外网络容量，是一种轻量且有效的鲁棒性增强模块。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: CANNs: A Toolkit for Research on Continuous Attractor Neural Networks
papers.abstract_en: Continuous attractor neural networks (CANNs) are the canonical computational framework for how the brain encodes continuous variables such as spatial position, head direction, and movement direction, and explain the activity of hippocampal place cells, entorhinal grid cells, and head-direction cells. CANN research, however, is fragmented: most results rest on lab-specific implementations, general-purpose simulators lack CANN-specific abstractions, and the path from spike trains to attractor geometry in real recordings lacks a standardized toolkit. Here, we present a comprehensive open-source toolkit that unifies the full CANN research workflow. It combines three tightly integrated components: 1) canns, a Python library on BrainPy/JAX that provides standardized 1D/2D CANNs, spike-frequency-adaptation variants, grid cell networks, hierarchical path-integration models, and brain-inspired attractor architectures, together with curated datasets, task generators, an analyzer module and trainer modules for biologically plausible plasticity; 2) canns-lib, a Rust acceleration backend delivering hundreds-of-times speedups for spatial-navigation workloads and modest gains for Ripser-based persistent homology; 3) ASA (Attractor Structure Analyzer), a PySide6 pipeline applying persistent homology and cohomology to experimental neural recordings to detect ring-like and toroidal attractor signatures in real data. The toolkit ships with full-detail reproducible pipelines that recover recent CANN results including SFA-driven anticipative tracking, theta sweeps in head-direction/place/grid systems, and hierarchical path integration.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍了一个名为 CANNs 的开源工具包，旨在统一连续吸引子神经网络（CANN）的完整研究流程。该工具包包含三个紧密集成的部分：基于 BrainPy/JAX 的 Python 库 canns，提供标准化的 1D/2D CANN、尖峰频率适应变体、网格细胞网络等；Rust 加速后端 canns-lib，用于空间导航工作负载的高速计算；以及吸引子结构分析器 ASA，通过持久同调分析实验神经记录中的环面吸引子特征。工具包附带可复现的流水线，能够复现包括 SFA 驱动的预期追踪、头部方向/位置/网格系统中的 theta 扫描以及分层路径积分等最新研究成果。
Motivation: 当前 CANN 研究分散在实验室特定实现中，通用模拟器缺乏 CANN 专有抽象，且从尖峰序列到吸引子几何的标准分析工具缺失，阻碍了研究整合与复现。
Method: 提出一个三组件工具包：1) canns Python 库，基于 BrainPy/JAX 提供标准化 CANN 网络、数据集、任务生成器、分析器和训练模块；2) canns-lib Rust 加速后端，通过硬件加速提升空间导航工作负载性能；3) ASA 图形界面，利用持久同调和上同调检测真实神经记录中的环面和环形吸引子特征。
Result: 工具包能复现 SFA 驱动的预期追踪、头部方向/位置/网格系统中的 theta 扫描以及分层路径积分等最新 CANN 结果，且 Rust 后端在空间导航任务上提供数百倍加速。
Conclusion: 该工具包为 CANN 研究提供了统一、可复现的标准化工作流，覆盖从网络构建到实验数据分析的完整环节。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Understanding Rollout Error in Graph World Models
papers.abstract_en: World models are often used for planning by rolling learned dynamics forward. Many planning environments, however, are not vectors or images; they are graphs of agents, tools, skills, routes, and dependencies. In these settings, a local prediction error may stay local or spread through the graph, and the failure mode changes again when edges are predicted rather than fixed. This paper studies long-horizon rollout error in Graph World Models (GWMs). We formulate a unified fixed-edge and dynamic-edge GWM framework with action nodes for node-, edge-, and graph-level decisions. We develop graph-valued rollout bounds that separate topology-induced amplification from model-induced amplification, and we introduce a joint node-edge operator for dynamic-edge rollouts. Guided by the analysis, we propose Error-Aware GWM, which combines spectral regularization, rollout consistency, and critical-node weighting. Across synthetic topologies and heterogeneous agent-graph testbeds, rollout error and planning regret grow with horizon, dynamic-edge training is needed when structure evolves, and Error-Aware GWM prevents long-horizon divergence while preserving prediction accuracy. Real-world graph benchmarks clarify the scope of GWMs: they are most useful for dynamic graph rollout and agent planning, while specialized graph models remain strong on static or sparse prediction tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究图世界模型（Graph World Models, GWMs）中的长程展开误差。提出了统一固定边和动态边的GWM框架，推导了图值展开误差界，区分拓扑诱导和模型诱导的放大效应。基于分析提出Error-Aware GWM，结合谱正则化、展开一致性和关键节点加权，在合成拓扑和异构智能体-图测试平台上防止长程发散并保持预测精度。真实世界图基准表明GWM在动态图展开和智能体规划中最有用，而专用图模型在静态或稀疏预测任务上仍强。
Motivation: 许多规划环境是图形式（如智能体、工具、技能、路径和依赖关系），而非向量或图像。在这些环境中，局部预测误差可能局部化或通过图传播，当边是预测而非固定时，失败模式会变化。因此需要研究图世界模型中的长程展开误差。
Method: 提出统一固定边和动态边的GWM框架，包含动作节点用于节点、边和图级决策。推导图值展开误差界，区分拓扑诱导和模型诱导的放大效应。引入联合节点-边算子用于动态边展开。基于分析提出Error-Aware GWM，结合谱正则化、展开一致性和关键节点加权。
Result: 在合成拓扑和异构智能体-图测试平台上，滚动误差和规划遗憾随范围增长，动态边训练在结构演变时是必要的。Error-Aware GWM能防止长程发散同时保持预测精度。真实世界图基准表明GWM在动态图展开和智能体规划中最有用，而专用图模型在静态或稀疏预测任务上仍强。
Conclusion: 本文揭示了GWM中的展开误差特性，并提出了有效的缓解方法。范围上，GWM最适用于动态图展开和智能体规划，对于静态或稀疏预测任务，专用图模型可能更优。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: MindFlow: Harmonizing Cognitive Semantics and Acoustic Dynamics for Facial Animation Generation in Dyadic Conversations
papers.abstract_en: Generating lifelike facial animation for dyadic conversations requires reconciling high-level cognitive intent with precise low-level motor reflexes, yet existing methods fall short in the semantic understanding of dialogue context and in precise dynamic control. In this paper, we propose MindFlow, a dual-pathway generative framework inspired by the Ventral-Dorsal pathway model in neuroscience, which decouples generation into two collaborative streams, thereby harmonizing deep semantic reasoning with fine-grained control. In the Ventral module, we transform the conventional Sentence-Action approach into a novel Chunk-State approach that models raw acoustic streams as a context-aware, evolving emotional state chain, capturing subtle paralinguistic nuances and mid-utterance emotional shifts missed by sentence-level modeling. The Dorsal module features a conditional autoregressive flow matching network for high-fidelity facial motion, driven by high-frequency acoustic cues and modulated by emotion states, plus a Selective Acoustic Injector for adaptive audio gating to ensure robustness in talking-and-listening dynamics without interference. Extensive experiments demonstrate that MindFlow achieves superior semantic appropriateness and motion naturalness compared to state-of-the-art baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MindFlow，一种受神经科学中腹侧-背侧通路模型启发的双路径生成框架，用于生成双人对话中的逼真面部动画。腹侧模块将句子-动作方法转换为块-状态方法，将原始声学流建模为上下文感知的演化情感状态链；背侧模块使用条件自回归流匹配网络，通过高频声学线索和情感状态调制生成高保真面部运动，并引入选择性声学注入器实现自适应音频门控。实验表明，MindFlow 在语义适当性和运动自然性上优于现有基线。
Motivation: 现有方法在对话上下文语义理解和精细动态控制方面存在不足，无法同时捕捉高层认知意图和底层运动反射。
Method: 提出双路径生成框架：腹侧模块采用块-状态方法建模声学流为情感状态链；背侧模块使用条件自回归流匹配网络，结合选择性声学注入器实现自适应音频门控。
Result: 在多个数据集上，MindFlow 在语义适当性和运动自然性方面优于现有最先进基线。
Conclusion: 双路径框架能有效协调认知语义与声学动力学，实现更逼真的对话面部动画生成。

papers.title: TRUST: Efficient Abdominal Trauma Recognition via Image-to-Ultrasound-Video Transfer Learning
papers.abstract_en: Abdominal ultrasound is indispensable for rapid, noninvasive trauma triage. However, interpreting the subtle dynamic cues embedded in continuous scanning is time-intensive and operator-dependent. Parameter-Efficient Image-to-Video Transfer Learning (PEIVTL), which efficiently adapts pre-trained image models to the video domain, notably through visual-textual alignment, offers a promising paradigm for ultrasound video analysis. Nevertheless, substantial spatiotemporal and semantic variations arising from physician-dependent scanning practices continue to limit the effectiveness and generalizability of this framework. We propose TRUST, a scan-aware PEIVTL framework that explicitly models fine-grained spatiotemporal variations to enable reliable ultrasound video understanding. First, we introduce a Cross-Frequency Collaborative Adapter (CFCA) that establishes mutual constraints between low- and high-frequency components, enhancing discriminative spatial feature extraction under heavy speckle corruption. Second, we design a Multi-Granularity Motion-Aware (MGMA) module that integrates local temporal convolutions with motion-prior-guided global self-attention, jointly capturing stable intra-view patterns and abrupt inter-view transitions to characterize complex scanning dynamics. Third, a Visual Query Semantic Aggregation (VQSA) module dynamically generates text prototypes conditioned on visual features, enabling adaptive visual-textual alignment robust to intra-class variability under diverse scanning conditions. Experiments on in-house ultrasound trauma datasets demonstrate that TRUST outperforms state-of-the-art methods by 9.63% with superior computational efficiency.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出TRUST，一种面向腹部超声视频创伤识别的扫描感知参数高效图像-视频迁移学习框架。通过跨频协同适配器、多粒度运动感知模块和视觉查询语义聚合模块，分别解决散斑噪声下的特征提取、复杂扫描动态建模以及视觉-文本自适应对齐问题。在内部腹部创伤数据集上，TRUST以更高计算效率超越现有方法9.63%。
Motivation: 腹部超声视频中，医生扫描习惯导致显著的时空和语义变化，现有参数高效图像-视频迁移学习方法在超声视频分析中鲁棒性和泛化性不足。
Method: 提出TRUST框架，包含三个核心模块：Cross-Frequency Collaborative Adapter (CFCA) 通过高低频分量互相约束增强散斑噪声下的判别特征；Multi-Granularity Motion-Aware (MGMA) 模块结合局部时序卷积与运动先验引导的全局自注意力捕获稳定视角与视角间突变；Visual Query Semantic Aggregation (VQSA) 模块基于视觉特征动态生成文本原型实现自适应的视觉-语义对齐。
Result: 在内部腹部超声创伤数据集上，TRUST以更优的计算效率超越当前最优方法9.63%。
Conclusion: TRUST通过显式建模扫描相关的时空变化，为可靠的超声视频理解提供了有效方案。

papers.title: ModaFlow: Modality-Aware Flow Matching for High-Fidelity Virtual Try-On
papers.abstract_en: Image-based virtual try-on has emerged as a compelling task in e-commerce and augmented reality, yet existing methods struggle to simultaneously preserve fine garment semantics and adapt to diverse person body geometries under large clothing-body deformations. We present ModaFlow, a modality-aware flow-matching based framework for high-fidelity virtual try-on that achieves precise alignment between textual descriptions and garment appearance. Unlike prior methods that treat multimodal conditions uniformly, ModaFlow introduces a modality-aware guidance scheme: visual garment embeddings extracted by a pretrained image prompt adapter provide deterministic, persistent structural guidance, while textual embeddings generated from garment descriptions are controlled via classifier-free guidance (CFG) with adaptive scaling and zero-initialized velocity. To further enhance flow field accuracy, we propose two regularization losses, cosine similarity and perceptual flow discrimination, that jointly improve directional consistency and perceptual realism of the velocity field. Additionally, a mask manipulation strategy stochastically samples among box, transparent, and relaxed masks during training, simulating diverse occlusion scenarios and enabling robust inference under unpaired settings where only a box mask is available. Experiments show that ModaFlow achieves state-of-the-art results in both qualitative and quantitative evaluations, reducing FID by approximately 30% on paired and 20% on unpaired benchmarks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ModaFlow提出一种基于模态感知流匹配的虚拟试穿框架，通过模态感知引导方案（视觉嵌入提供持久结构引导，文本嵌入通过分类器无指导自适应缩放）和两个正则化损失（余弦相似度和感知流判别）提升流场精度，并采用掩码操作策略增强鲁棒性。在配对和未配对基准上FID分别降低约30%和20%，达到最先进水平。
Motivation: 现有图像虚拟试穿方法在保持精细服装语义和适应不同人体几何形状方面存在困难，尤其在大变形场景下表现不佳。
Method: 提出模态感知引导方案，视觉嵌入由预训练图像提示适配器提取，文本嵌入采用分类器无指导（CFG）自适应缩放和零初始化速度；引入余弦相似度和感知流判别两个正则化损失；训练时随机采样框、透明和松弛掩码模拟遮挡。
Result: 在配对和未配对基准上FID分别降低约30%和20%，定性定量评估达到最先进结果。
Conclusion: ModaFlow通过模态感知流匹配和正则化损失有效提升了虚拟试穿的保真度和鲁棒性，但摘要未提及在复杂背景或极端姿态下的局限。

papers.title: An Embedded Real-Time License Plate Recognition System for Complex Traffic Scenes
authors: Udaya S. K. P. Miriya Thanthrige
papers.abstract_en: Vehicle license plate recognition is an integral component of intelligent transportation systems. In this work, we present an embedded real-time license plate recognition system customized for developing countries. We address the challenge of handling complex, unstructured traffic scenes with diverse vehicle types while implementing the system on an embedded platform for low-cost deployment. Our method consists of license plate detection on a multi-vehicle image, followed by character recognition on the detected license plates. Both steps use lightweight convolutional neural networks to balance accuracy and efficiency. We also introduce the SL-LPR dataset of Sri Lankan road images, which contains a variety of vehicle types and traffic conditions typically seen in developing countries. On this dataset, the license plate detection and character recognition models achieved 93.6% mAP and 87.88% accuracy, respectively, and were competitive against larger models on several public datasets. To achieve real-time performance in a resource-constrained embedded environment, we applied low-bitwidth quantization using the Brevitas library and implemented FPGA acceleration for the models using the FINN framework. The end-to-end system can operate at 11.5~FPS when implemented on the Xilinx Kria KV260 platform. These results demonstrate that our system is effective for real-time license plate recognition on an embedded device, even in complex traffic scenarios. The SL-LPR dataset is available for research use at: https://github.com/sl-lpr-uom/SL-LPR.git.
papers.comment: Accepted at IEEE Intelligent Transportation Systems Conference (ITSC) 2026

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个针对发展中国家复杂交通场景的嵌入式实时车牌识别系统。该系统使用轻量级卷积神经网络进行车牌检测和字符识别，并在Xilinx Kria KV260平台上通过低比特量化（Brevitas）和FPGA加速（FINN）实现实时运行（11.5 FPS）。作者还发布了SL-LPR数据集（斯里兰卡道路图像），在该数据集上检测和识别分别达到93.6% mAP和87.88%准确率。
Motivation: 现有车牌识别系统大多针对发达国家结构化场景设计，难以处理发展中国家车辆类型多样、交通场景复杂的非结构化环境；同时需要在低成本嵌入式平台上实现实时性能。
Method: 采用两阶段流水线：先使用轻量级CNN检测多车辆图像中的车牌，再对检测到的车牌进行字符识别。模型通过Brevitas库进行低比特量化，并利用FINN框架实现FPGA加速，部署于Xilinx Kria KV260平台。
Result: 在自建SL-LPR数据集上，检测mAP为93.6%，字符识别准确率为87.88%；在多个公开数据集上与更大模型相比具有竞争力；端到端系统在嵌入式平台上达到11.5 FPS。
Conclusion: 该系统在发展中国家复杂交通场景下实现了低成本嵌入式实时车牌识别，表明轻量级模型结合量化与FPGA加速是有效途径。SL-LPR数据集已公开供研究使用。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: NormGuard: Reward-Preserving Norm Constraints in Flow-Matching Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning (RL) post-training improves the reward alignment of flow-based generators, but often degrades perceptual quality in ways that are not captured by the reward proxy. We identify a simple structural signature of this drift: across three post-training methods (NFT, AWM, DPO), RL fine-tuning inflates the per-step velocity norm $\|v_θ\|$ by $5\%$ to $15\%$ relative to the reference. A form of norm inflation has been studied in classifier-free guidance (CFG), where rescaling the velocity back to a reference norm at inference time can mitigate the resulting artifacts. However, this inference-time correction does not transfer cleanly to RL: rescaling $v_θ$ to match $\|v_{\text{ref}}\|$ at inference time neither improves reward nor fixes the quality degradation, because the inflation is co-adapted into the model weights. Furthermore, an adjoint sensitivity analysis shows that velocity magnitude rescaling carries no coherent first-order reward signal at the batch level, indicating that suppressing norm inflation is unlikely to remove a consistently reward-carrying component. Since inference-time renormalization fails while norm suppression carries no reward cost, training-time intervention is the appropriate strategy. Together, these findings motivate \methodname, a hinge penalty that activates only when $\|v_θ\|$ exceeds $\|v_{\text{ref}}\|$ and composes additively with any velocity-local base loss. Across two base models, three post-training methods, and two reward proxies, \methodname consistently improves MLLM-judged image quality and forensic realism while preserving reward, with gains that amplify under few-step inference and are not explained by early stopping.

TL;DR: 本文提出 NormGuard，一种在流式生成模型强化学习后训练中保持奖励的同时抑制速度范数膨胀的铰链惩罚。实验表明，RL 后训练会导致每步速度范数膨胀 5%-15%，降低感知质量，且推理时重缩放无效。NormGuard 在多个模型和奖励代理上一致改善图像质量和法医现实主义，同时保持奖励。
Motivation: RL 后训练会提升流式生成器的奖励对齐，但常导致速度范数膨胀，损害感知质量。推理时重缩放无法解决，因为膨胀已协适应到模型权重中。
Method: NormGuard 是一种铰链惩罚，仅在速度范数超过参考范数时激活，并可加性地与任何速度局部损失组合。
Result: 在两个基础模型、三种后训练方法（NFT, AWM, DPO）和两个奖励代理上，NormGuard 一致改善 MLLM 判断的图像质量和法医现实主义，同时保持奖励，且在少步推理下增益放大。
Conclusion: 训练时抑制范数膨胀是有效策略，且不损失奖励信号；推理时重缩放不传递奖励信号。

papers.title: Difference of Convex Programming in the Wasserstein Space with Applications to MMD Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Optimizing functionals over the space of probability measures is now ubiquitous in machine learning. A widely used approach is to perform the optimization directly over the Wasserstein space, but many objective functionals of practical interest are non-convex along Wasserstein geodesics, making the analysis of standard first-order methods challenging. In this work, we study a class of objectives over the Wasserstein space that admit a difference-of-convex (DC) decomposition and we lift the classical convex-concave procedure (CCCP) to this setting. Under smoothness and strong convexity assumptions on the convex components of the decomposition, we prove almost stationarity along the iterates of the resulting algorithm. Our main focus is on the Maximum Mean Discrepancy (MMD) and the Energy Distance (ED) functionals, for which we develop explicit Wasserstein DC decompositions, and establish local convergence of the scheme under mild assumptions. Empirically, we show that well-chosen DC decompositions yield faster and more stable convergence than Wasserstein gradient descent on these MMD objectives.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究Wasserstein空间上具有差凸分解的目标函数，将经典凸凹过程推广至该设定，并在光滑性和强凸性假设下证明算法迭代的几乎稳定性。重点针对最大平均差异和能量距离泛函给出显式Wasserstein DC分解，经验表明精心选择的DC分解比Wasserstein梯度下降收敛更快更稳定。
Motivation: Wasserstein空间上的许多目标函数沿测地线非凸，标准一阶方法分析困难，亟需适用于非凸目标的理论与算法。
Method: 提出Wasserstein空间中的差凸规划框架，将凸凹过程（CCCP）推广至概率测度空间，并针对MMD和ED泛函推导出显式DC分解。
Result: 在光滑性和强凸性假设下证明了算法迭代的几乎稳定性；实验表明所提DC分解相比Wasserstein梯度下降在MMD目标上收敛更快且更稳定。
Conclusion: 该工作为Wasserstein空间中的非凸优化提供了一种基于DC分解的有效方法，尤其适用于MMD和ED泛函的优化。

papers.title: RS-Diffuser: Risk-Sensitive Diffusion Planning with Distributional Value Guidance
papers.abstract_en: Offline reinforcement learning enables policy learning from fixed datasets without additional environment interaction, making it appealing for safety-critical applications where online exploration is costly or unsafe. Diffusion-based decision-making methods have recently achieved strong performance in offline RL by modeling rich, multimodal trajectory distributions. However, existing diffusion planners are typically risk-neutral and therefore may overlook rare but catastrophic outcomes that are crucial in real-world deployment. In this work, we propose RS-Diffuser, a risk-sensitive offline diffusion planning framework that combines diffusion-based trajectory generation with distributional value critics. RS-Diffuser learns a diffusion planner over future state trajectories, a separate inverse dynamics model for action decoding, and a Monte Carlo distributional critic that estimates the full return distribution of candidate plans through quantile regression. At sampling time, we incorporate a risk-sensitive guidance signal into the denoising process, using gradients computed from tail-aware objectives such as Conditional Value at Risk to steer generation toward desired risk profiles. As a result, a single trained model can flexibly produce risk-averse, risk-neutral, or risk-seeking behaviors by changing only the inference-time risk parameter. Extensive experiments on risk-sensitive D4RL and risky robot navigation benchmarks demonstrate that RS-Diffuser achieves state-of-the-art performance, improving both overall return and worst-case robustness while reducing safety violations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出RS-Diffuser，一种风险敏感的离线扩散规划框架，结合扩散轨迹生成与分布价值批评。通过尾部感知目标（如条件风险价值）引导去噪过程，灵活生成风险规避、中性或寻求行为。在风险敏感D4RL和机器人导航基准上达到SOTA，提升总回报和最坏情况鲁棒性，减少安全违规。
Motivation: 现有扩散规划器通常是风险中性的，可能忽略现实部署中罕见但灾难性的结果。
Method: 提出RS-Diffuser，学习扩散规划器（未来状态轨迹）、逆动力学模型（动作解码）和蒙特卡洛分布批评家（分位数回归估计完整回报分布）。采样时，使用尾部感知目标（如条件风险价值）的梯度作为风险敏感引导信号。
Result: 在风险敏感D4RL和风险机器人导航基准上达到SOTA，提升总回报和最坏情况鲁棒性，减少安全违规。
Conclusion: 一个训练好的模型可以通过改变推理时风险参数灵活产生不同风险偏好的行为。

papers.title: PixelU: A U-Shaped Transformer for Efficient End-to-End Pixel Diffusion
papers.abstract_en: End-to-end pixel-space diffusion models bypass the lossy compression of Latent Diffusion Models (LDMs) but struggle to jointly model low-frequency semantics and high-frequency signals in high-dimensional space. Existing works heavily rely on complex pixel decoders to alleviate this issue. In this paper, we challenge this trend by revealing that these decoders primarily compensate for the optimization difficulties inherent to velocity prediction ($v$-prediction). Under the clean data paradigm ($x$-prediction), they are redundant. Motivated by this insight, we advocate for simplicity over complexity and introduce PixelU, a minimalist, single-stage U-shaped Diffusion Transformer tailored for pixel space. PixelU abandons auxiliary decoders in favor of zero-cost skip connections, which provide an "information highway" that directly routes uncorrupted high-frequency spatial details from shallow to deep layers. To further enable the backbone to focus exclusively on modeling low-frequency semantics, we introduce a constant-channel spatial down-sampling mechanism as a natural low-pass filter, which compresses deep features into a compact, low-frequency semantic manifold. Extensive experiments demonstrate that this decoupling of frequencies could outperform the strong baseline (JiT-G) with only about 1/3 of its computation cost. On ImageNet 256$\times$256 and 512$\times$512, PixelU achieves FID of 1.63 and 1.92 respectively, surpassing recent pixel-space methods and establishing a simple yet powerful new paradigm for end-to-end diffusion models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PixelU 是一种面向像素空间的 U 形 Diffusion Transformer，通过零成本跳跃连接和恒通道空间下采样实现频率解耦，在 ImageNet 256×256 和 512×512 上分别取得 1.63 和 1.92 的 FID，计算成本仅为基线 JiT-G 的约 1/3。
Motivation: 现有端到端像素扩散模型在高维空间中难以联合建模低频语义和高频信号，通常依赖复杂的像素解码器；本文发现这些解码器主要是补偿速度预测（v-prediction）的优化困难，在干净的 x-prediction 范式下是冗余的。
Method: 提出 minimalist 单阶段 U 形 Diffusion Transformer：使用零成本跳跃连接直接传递未损坏的高频空间细节，并引入恒通道空间下采样作为自然低通滤波器，将深层特征压缩到低频频谱流形，使主干网络专注于低频语义建模。
Result: 在 ImageNet 256×256 和 512×512 上分别实现 FID 1.63 和 1.92，优于近期像素空间方法，计算成本仅为 JiT-G 的约 1/3。
Conclusion: 频率解耦策略为端到端扩散模型建立了简单而强大的新范式，表明在 x-prediction 下辅助解码器是冗余的。

papers.title: Layerwise Progressive Freezing: A Training Scaffold for Depth-Scalable Binary Networks
papers.abstract_en: Training binary neural networks (BNNs) from scratch is dominated by the straight-through estimator (STE), whose forward/backward mismatch produces severe accuracy degradation as networks deepen. We study an orthogonal axis: when and where binarization is enforced during training. We introduce StoMPP (Stochastic Masked Partial Progressive Binarization), which gradually replaces clipped weights and activations with their hard binary counterparts layer by layer from input to output, using stochastic partial masks with soft refresh. StoMPP delivers two complementary benefits. As a standalone training rule, it provides a fully STE-free procedure that improves over vanilla STE with gains that grow with depth (ResNet-50 BNN: +18.0/+13.5/+3.8 on CIFAR-10/100/ImageNet), and the pattern holds across ResNet-18/34/50, MobileNetV2, and BERT fine-tuning. Composed with surrogate gradients by applying STE only to frozen entries, it reaches +27.1/+19.8/+17.7 over vanilla STE on the same setting. Underlying both regimes is a single mechanistic finding: progression order is decisive. Forward layerwise progression prevents depth collapse, reverse progression collapses to near-chance, and binary-weight networks (without binary activations) are insensitive to order. We trace this asymmetry to activation-induced gradient blockades: a committed binary activation severs gradient flow upstream, and ordering controls when these blockades form. To isolate the progression's contribution from any benefit conferred by STE, we conduct all ablations in the STE-free regime; the resulting characterization (schedule, refresh, ordering, dynamics) thus reflects the progression itself rather than its interaction with surrogate gradients.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对二值神经网络（BNN）训练中直通估计器（STE）导致的精度下降问题，提出了一种名为StoMPP的逐层渐进式冻结训练方法。该方法通过从输入到输出逐层用硬二值替换裁剪的权重和激活，并采用随机部分掩码和软刷新，实现了完全无STE的训练过程。实验表明，该方法在CIFAR-10/100和ImageNet上对ResNet-50 BNN分别提升+18.0/+13.5/+3.8，且与STE结合后进一步提升。
Motivation: 现有BNN训练主要依赖STE，但其前向/反向不匹配导致网络深度增加时精度严重下降。论文旨在探索训练过程中何时何地施加二值化这一正交维度。
Method: 提出StoMPP（随机掩码部分渐进二值化），从输入层到输出层逐层用硬二值替换裁剪的权重和激活，使用随机部分掩码和软刷新。该方法完全无STE，也可与STE组合（仅对冻结条目使用STE）。
Result: 在无STE模式下，ResNet-50 BNN在CIFAR-10/100/ImageNet上分别提升+18.0/+13.5/+3.8；与STE组合后，提升达+27.1/+19.8/+17.7。该模式在多种架构上成立，且发现渐进顺序至关重要：从输入到输出的逐层顺序防止深度坍塌，反向顺序则导致接近随机。
Conclusion: 论文强调渐进顺序的决定性作用，并将其归因于激活诱导的梯度阻断：二值激活会切断上游梯度流，而控制顺序决定了这些阻断形成的时机。所有消融在无STE环境下进行，以隔离渐进本身的贡献。

papers.title: Towards Reliable and Robust LLM Planning: Symbolic Feedback-Driven Iterative Self-Refinement Framework
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) have attracted widespread attention from academia and industry, yet their deployment raises critical security concerns regarding robustness and reliability. Planning, a core component of intelligent behavior, remains challenging for LLMs, which often produce infeasible or incorrect solutions in long-horizon decision-making tasks due to inherent complexity. In this paper, we propose a symbolic feedback-driven iterative self-refinement framework to enhance the robustness and reliability of LLMs in long-horizon planning. Specifically, a natural language prompting mechanism is introduced to map logical symbols into natural language descriptions, enabling LLMs to better capture task constraints and semantics. We further design a symbolic verifier that identifies errors and converts them into corrective instructions interpretable by the LLM, thereby guiding self-refinement. In addition, we leverage a plan recognizer to infer goal reachability, facilitating more effective guidance toward desired goals. Empirical results demonstrate that the proposed framework consistently improves both feasibility and correctness in long-horizon planning tasks. This highlights its effectiveness in enhancing the reliability of LLM-based planning and potential to enable more trustworthy AI systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种符号反馈驱动的迭代自我精炼框架，用于提升大语言模型在长时域规划任务中的鲁棒性和可靠性。该方法通过自然语言提示将逻辑符号映射为描述，利用符号验证器识别错误并转化为修正指令，引导LLM自我精炼，同时使用规划识别器推断目标可达性。实验表明该框架持续提升了规划任务的可行性和正确性。
Motivation: 大语言模型在长时域规划中常生成不可行或错误方案，面临鲁棒性和可靠性挑战。
Method: 提出符号反馈驱动的迭代自我精炼框架，包括：自然语言提示机制将逻辑符号映射为自然语言描述；符号验证器识别错误并生成可解释的修正指令；规划识别器推断目标可达性以引导修正。
Result: 实验结果表明该框架在长时域规划任务中一致地提升了方案的可行性和正确性。
Conclusion: 该框架有效增强了基于LLM的规划的可靠性，有潜力支持更可信的AI系统。

summary_sections.method: 提出符号反馈驱动的迭代自我精炼框架，包括：自然语言提示机制将逻辑符号映射为自然语言描述；符号验证器识别错误并生成可解释的修正指令；规划识别器推断目标可达性以引导修正。
summary_sections.result: 实验结果表明该框架在长时域规划任务中一致地提升了方案的可行性和正确性。
summary_sections.conclusion: 该框架有效增强了基于LLM的规划的可靠性，有潜力支持更可信的AI系统。

papers.title: Drop-Then-Recovery: How Redundant Are Vision-Language-Action Models?
papers.abstract_en: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models enable instruction-driven robotic manipulation, but they inherit oversized language backbones from pretrained VLMs whose capacity far exceeds what is needed for short robotic instructions. This raises a basic question: how much of a VLA model is actually necessary for closed-loop control? In this work, we study architectural redundancy in VLA models by using transformer block removal as a controlled intervention. We introduce \textbf{Drop-Then-Recovery (DTR)}, an analysis protocol that removes selected blocks from a pretrained VLA model and then fine-tunes the resulting model to measure whether the removed capacity was necessary for downstream control. To make this intervention reliable, we propose \textbf{GateProbe}, a one-shot virtual-gate sensitivity metric that ranks blocks by their contribution to the downstream action loss. Across multiple VLA architectures, manipulation benchmarks and even real-robot industrial scenarios, we find a strong asymmetry in post-removal recoverability: \ul{\textit{language backbones are highly redundant for standard robotic manipulation tasks, whereas vision and action pathways are substantially less tolerant to removal}}. On LIBERO, removing half of the LLM blocks even improves OpenVLA-OFT from 95.0% to 98.3% under the same downstream fine-tuning budget, and retaining only two language blocks still recovers baseline-level performance. These results suggest that current VLA benchmarks may exert limited pressure on deep language grounding and compositional instruction understanding, and that future VLA architectures should allocate capacity more deliberately across language, vision, and action components. The code is available at https://github.com/s1ghhh/VLADrop.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Drop-Then-Recovery (DTR) 协议和 GateProbe 指标，系统性地分析了 Vision-Language-Action (VLA) 模型中的架构冗余性。实验发现，在标准机器人操作任务中，语言骨干（LLM 块）高度冗余，移除一半甚至只保留两个 LLM 块仍能恢复或提升性能（如在 LIBERO 上 OpenVLA-OFT 从 95.0% 提升至 98.3%），而视觉和动作路径则难以容忍移除。这表明当前 VLA 基准对语言深层理解和组合指令的压力不足。
Motivation: VLA 模型继承自预训练 VLM，其语言骨干容量远超短机器人指令的实际需求，引发冗余性问题：究竟有多大比例的模型真正用于闭环控制？
Method: 提出 DTR 协议：移除预训练 VLA 中的选定 transformer 块后微调，以测量移除容量是否必要；同时提出 GateProbe，一种基于虚拟门控灵敏度的单次度量，用于按贡献排序各块对动作损失的重要性。
Result: 在 LIBERO 基准上，移除一半 LLM 块后，OpenVLA-OFT 准确率从 95.0% 提升至 98.3%；保留仅两个语言块仍能恢复基线性能。视觉和动作路径移除后性能显著下降。
Conclusion: 当前 VLA 基准可能对语言深层理解和组合指令施加压力不足，未来 VLA 架构应更均衡地分配语言、视觉和动作组件的容量。

papers.title: PerturbCellRL: Verifier-Guided Reinforcement Learning for Single-Cell Perturbation Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Single-cell perturbation models can reduce costly wet-lab screening by predicting how cells respond transcriptionally to interventions. While recent generative models improve population-level prediction, individual generated cells are not explicitly checked for biological consistency. We introduce PerturbCellRL, a reinforcement learning (RL) framework that post-trains a pretrained single-cell transcriptomic generator using a suite of cell-level verifiers as rewards. These verifiers define four rewards: Pearson top-k similarity, RMSE top-k proximity, DE Spearman, and Pathway activity. The Pathway activity verifier rewards cells whose pathway responses match known perturbation biology. We evaluate PerturbCellRL on multiple genetic and chemical perturbation benchmarks. Across these benchmarks, PerturbCellRL improves over the pretrained flow-matching generator on reward-aligned evaluation metrics and a held-out evaluation metric. Moreover, PerturbCellRL remains competitive with state-of-the-art methods on population-level metrics. Together, these results frame trustworthy single-cell prediction as verifier-guided generative alignment, moving beyond matching expression distributions toward predictions whose single-cell perturbation effects are explicitly checked for biological consistency.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该论文提出 PerturbCellRL，一个通过强化学习后训练预训练单细胞转录组生成器的框架，利用细胞级验证器（如Pearson top-k相似度等）作为奖励，以提升生成细胞的生物一致性。在多个遗传和化学扰动基准上，该方法在奖励对齐指标和保留评估指标上优于预训练生成器，并在群体水平指标上与现有方法竞争力相当。
Motivation: 现有单细胞扰动模型主要优化群体水平的分布匹配，缺乏对每个生成细胞生物一致性的显式检查，导致预测可能不符合已知生物学。
Method: 提出强化学习框架，后训练预训练的流匹配生成器，使用四个细胞级验证器（Pearson top-k相似度、RMSE top-k邻近度、DE Spearman、通路活性）作为奖励信号，引导生成器产生更生物一致的细胞。
Result: 在多个遗传和化学扰动基准上，PerturbCellRL在奖励对齐指标和保留评估指标上优于预训练生成器，并与现有方法在群体水平指标上竞争力相当。
Conclusion: 该工作将可信赖的单细胞预测视为验证器引导的生成对齐，从匹配表达分布转向明确验证单细胞扰动效应的生物一致性。
