papers.title: MER-R1: Multimodal Emotion Reasoning via Slow-Fast Thinking Synergy
papers.abstract_en: We find that explicit reasoning does not necessarily translate into better multimodal emotion recognition (MER) accuracy, even though it makes predictions more interpretable. Specifically, for reasoning-based MLLMs, fast thinking by triggering direct answers often outperforms slow thinking after deliberative reasoning. Our empirical analyses show that fast thinking improves recall with broader and more confident predictions, whereas slow thinking favors precision through conservative filtering of incorrect categories. Building on these insights, we propose MER-R1, a reinforcement learning framework that turns slow-fast complementarity into explicit optimization. Dual-objective disentanglement separates recall and precision into two optimization signals, allowing them to be jointly optimized rather than traded off against each other. Slow-fast confidence calibration further aligns the final slow-thinking answer with fast-thinking intuition, strengthening correct emotions while suppressing incorrect ones. In this way, MER-R1 unifies the recall-oriented intuition of fast thinking with the precision-oriented selectivity of slow thinking. We further provide theoretical justification for this synergy, showing that it mitigates variance-induced interference during optimization. Extensive experiments on MER-UniBench and MME-Emotion show that MER-R1 achieves state-of-the-art performance and makes reasoning genuinely benefit emotion recognition.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文发现显式推理并不总能提升多模态情感识别（MER）的准确率，反而快速思考（直接回答）常优于慢速思考（推理后回答）。快速思考提高召回率，慢速思考提高精确率。为此提出MER-R1，一个强化学习框架，通过双目标解耦和快慢置信度校准，统一了快思考的召回导向和慢思考的精确选择性，在MER-UniBench和MME-Emotion上达到最新最优性能。
Motivation: 现有基于推理的多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）在情感识别中，显式推理虽提升可解释性却未必提高准确率，且快慢思考各有利弊，缺乏有效协同。
Method: 提出MER-R1强化学习框架，包括双目标解耦将召回和精确分为两个优化信号，以及快慢置信度校准使最终慢思考答案对齐快思考直觉，从而联合优化而非权衡。
Result: 在MER-UniBench和MME-Emotion上实现最先进性能，并使推理真正有益于情感识别。
Conclusion: 快慢思考的协同能缓解优化中的方差干扰，使推理提升情感识别效果。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: TeRoR: Decoupled Temporal Rotation with Relational Circular Region for Temporal Knowledge Graph Embedding
papers.abstract_en: In recent years, with the emergence of Temporal Knowledge Graphs (TKGs), research on learning entity and relation representations in TKGs has attracted increasing attention, giving rise to a large number of TKG embedding methods. TeRo is a simple and efficient temporal knowledge graph embedding approach. However, TeRo does not do well in modeling the mapping properties of various relations, such as one-to-many, many-to-one, and many-to-many. Meanwhile, it also has limitations in the expression of temporal information. To address these issues, we propose a novel TKG embedding method named TeRoR. This method divides the temporal evolution of entity embeddings, and conducts independent rotation transformations on head and tail entities in the complex vector space to strengthen temporal information modeling capacity. In terms of relational characteristics, we train a radius to constrain the rotated and translated head entities within a circular region centered on the tail entity, which effectively captures the diverse mapping properties of relations. Experimental results demonstrate that TeRoR achieves competitive performance against state-of-the-art models on four distinct TKG datasets.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对时序知识图谱嵌入中的关系映射属性（如一对多、多对一、多对多）和时间信息表达能力不足的问题，提出 TeRoR 方法。该方法将实体嵌入的时间演化解耦，在复数空间中对头尾实体进行独立旋转变换以增强时间建模，并通过训练一个半径将旋转平移后的头实体约束在尾实体为中心的圆形区域内，以捕获关系的多样化映射属性。实验表明，TeRoR 在四个不同 TKG 数据集上取得了具有竞争力的性能。
Motivation: 现有 TeRo 方法在建模关系映射属性（如一对多、多对一、多对多）方面表现不佳，同时时间信息的表达存在局限性。
Method: 提出 TeRoR，将实体嵌入的时间演化解耦，对头尾实体在复数空间中独立进行旋转变换；通过训练一个半径将旋转平移后的头实体约束在尾实体为中心的圆形区域内。
Result: 在四个不同 TKG 数据集上的实验结果表明，TeRoR 取得了与当前最优模型相竞争的性能。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 TeRoR 通过解耦时间旋转和关系圆形区域约束，有效改进了 TeRo 的局限性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: VLM-Aware Meta-Optic Front-End Design for Frozen Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Conventional machine-vision pipelines typically rely on high-quality optics that produce clean, human-interpretable images, and optical design has therefore been driven by image-level criteria such as resolution, aberration correction, and pixel fidelity. However, such optics are often impractical for size-, cost-, or form-factor-constrained applications, where compact meta-optics offer an attractive alternative but operate under strict physical efficiency limits. We propose CODA, a co-design framework that optimizes a continuous-density meta-optic front-end for frozen-model recognition using differentiable image formation and adjoint-gradient updates of Maxwell-based simulations. CODA directly optimizes the cross-entropy loss of a fixed zero-shot CLIP classifier without learned reconstruction, image signal processing, or image-fidelity auxiliary objectives. In a two-dimensional simulated imaging benchmark on ImageNet-100, CODA improves CLIP ViT-L/14 zero-shot accuracy from 53.75 $\pm$ 3.57$\%$ with a focal-concentration baseline to 65.41 $\pm$ 3.99$\%$. The optimized optics further transfer without re-optimization across CLIP, SigLIP, and DINOv2 on ImageNet-100, CIFAR-100, and Food-101. These results demonstrate that, under constrained meta-optic imaging, downstream recognition can be improved by aligning optical design with frozen vision-model objectives rather than conventional image-formation criteria.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CODA 框架，通过可微分成像和伴随梯度更新优化连续密度元光学前端，以提升冻结视觉语言模型（如 CLIP）在受限于紧凑元光学成像条件下的下游识别性能。在 ImageNet-100 上，CODA 将 CLIP ViT-L/14 的零样本准确率从 53.75% 提升至 65.41%，并跨模型和数据集迁移。
Motivation: 传统光学设计追求图像质量指标，但在尺寸、成本受限场景中元光学更实用，然而其物理效率限制导致成像质量差，影响下游识别。
Method: CODA 协同设计框架：基于麦克斯韦仿真的可微分成像模型，直接优化固定零样本 CLIP 分类器的交叉熵损失，无需学习重建或图像信号处理。
Result: 在二维模拟成像基准上，CODA 在 ImageNet-100 上使 CLIP ViT-L/14 零样本准确率从 53.75% 提升到 65.41%，并跨 CLIP、SigLIP、DINOv2 和不同数据集迁移。
Conclusion: 将光学设计与冻结视觉模型目标对齐，而不是传统成像标准，可以在受限元光学成像下改善下游识别。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: CascadeOcc: Rethinking 3D Occupancy World Models with Cascaded VQ Representations
papers.abstract_en: This letter proposes CascadeOcc, a novel occupancy world model that prioritizes intrinsic structural hierarchy over extrinsic auxiliary modalities for autonomous driving. Occupancy world models -- forecasting the future driving environment and planning the driving trajectory -- effectively bridge perception and planning, but current approaches often heavily rely on external modalities or large language models, failing to fully exploit the inherent structural potential of occupancy representations themselves. To enhance representational capacity for complex 3D scenes, we integrate a cascaded Vector Quantized (VQ) mechanism into an autoregressive framework. Following a coarse-to-fine principle, CascadeOcc progressively refines fine-grained details from global structures through a multi-scale architecture. Additionally, we incorporate a TimeMixer to capture multi-scale temporal dependencies, establishing a dual-hierarchy mechanism in both space and time. Experimental results on 4D occupancy forecasting and motion planning benchmarks demonstrate that CascadeOcc achieves superior performance among vision-centric approaches, validating that optimizing inherent representations is a powerful alternative to relying on external foundation models.
papers.comment: Accepted to IEEE Signal Processing Letters (SPL), 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CascadeOcc，一种用于自动驾驶的占用世界模型，通过级联向量量化（VQ）机制在自回归框架中增强表示能力，采用粗到细的多尺度架构逐步细化细节，并引入 TimeMixer 捕捉多尺度时间依赖。实验表明，该方法在 4D 占用预测和运动规划基准上达到了视觉中心方法中的最优性能，验证了优化内在表示是一种有效的替代方案。
Motivation: 现有占用世界模型过度依赖外部模态或大语言模型，未能充分利用占用表示本身的结构潜力。
Method: 将级联 VQ 机制集成到自回归框架中，通过粗到细的多尺度架构逐步细化从全局结构到细粒度细节，并引入 TimeMixer 捕捉多尺度时间依赖，形成空间和时间的双重层次结构。
Result: 在 4D 占用预测和运动规划基准上，CascadeOcc 在视觉中心方法中取得了最优性能。
Conclusion: 优化内在表示可以成为依赖外部基础模型的有力替代方案。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: AI-Generated Image Recognition via Fusion of CNNs and Vision Transformers
papers.abstract_en: Recent advancements in synthetic data technology have opened a new era where images of remarkable quality are generated, blurring the lines between real-life images and those produced by Artificial Intelligence (AI). This evolution poses a significant challenge to ensuring the reliability and authenticity of data, underscoring the need for robust detection methods. In this paper, we present a robust approach aimed at addressing these pressing concerns. Our methodology revolves around leveraging fusion strategies, combining the strengths of multiple detection methods for identifying AI-generated images. Through extensive experimentation on the CIFAKE dataset, our model showcases remarkable performance, achieving an impressive accuracy rate of 97.32%. This accomplishment underscores the efficacy of our approach in accurately distinguishing between AI-generated images and real-life images, thus contributing to the advancement of data authentication techniques amidst the proliferation of synthetic data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种融合CNN与Vision Transformer的方法，用于识别AI生成的图像。在CIFAKE数据集上达到97.32%的准确率，验证了多检测方法融合策略的有效性。
Motivation: 随着AI生成图像质量的提升，真实与合成图像的界限模糊，亟需鲁棒的检测方法以确保数据真实性。
Method: 采用融合策略，结合多种检测方法（CNN与Vision Transformer）的互补优势，在CIFAKE数据集上进行训练和评估。
Result: 在CIFAKE数据集上获得97.32%的准确率，展示了高精度区分AI生成与真实图像的能力。
Conclusion: 融合CNN与ViT的方法有效提升了AI生成图像检测性能，有助于推进数据认证技术的发展。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Denoising ICF Images with Multiplicative Uniform Noise: A Self-Supervised Study Based on the Log-Domain Noisier2Inverse Framework
papers.abstract_en: This paper documents the implementation and evaluation of a self-supervised denoising framework on Inertial Confinement Fusion (ICF) images corrupted by Multiplicative Uniform noise: the \emph{Log-Domain Noisier2Inverse} framework. This framework is developed and analysed in this work; the key theoretical result -- that minimising the log-domain self-supervised loss is equivalent to supervised learning in the transformed domain -- is presented with full proof. We document significant implementation challenges arising from the unique characteristics of ICF imagery, describe the fixes applied at each stage, and report final quantitative results. The log-domain approach with per-image JSON Uniform noise loading (Variant~B) achieves the best result: a mean PSNR of $21.41\db$ and SSIM of $0.8358$, a $+19.46\db$ improvement over the noisy input baseline of $1.95\db$, substantially outperforming BM3D log-domain ($4.47\db$, SSIM $0.5181$) and Noise2Self ($4.75\db$, SSIM $0.0177$). Variant~A, using fixed Gaussian noise loading, achieves $21.39\db$ PSNR and SSIM $0.8436$. Of the three evaluated methods, Log-Domain Noisier2Inverse and Noise2Self are entirely self-supervised during training, requiring no clean ground truth data; BM3D is a classical filter-based method requiring no training at all. The clean reference images are used solely for quantitative evaluation of all three methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出并评估了基于对数域的Noisier2Inverse自监督去噪框架，用于处理惯性约束聚变（ICF）图像中的乘性均匀噪声。理论证明最小化对数域自监督损失等价于变换域中的监督学习。实验结果表明，该方法在ICF图像上显著优于BM3D和Noise2Self基线，最佳变体（Variant B）达到平均PSNR 21.41 dB和SSIM 0.8358。
Motivation: ICF图像在采集过程中受到乘性均匀噪声干扰，现有去噪方法（如BM3D、Noise2Self）在此场景下效果有限，且监督学习需要大量干净参考图像，实际中难以获得。
Method: 提出Log-Domain Noisier2Inverse框架，将对数变换后的噪声模型转化为加性噪声，并利用自监督损失进行训练。设计了两种变体：Variant A使用固定高斯噪声加载，Variant B使用每图像JSON均匀噪声加载。
Result: Variant B取得最佳性能：PSNR 21.41 dB，SSIM 0.8358，相比噪声输入（1.95 dB）提升19.46 dB，显著优于BM3D（4.47 dB）和Noise2Self（4.75 dB）。Variant A的PSNR为21.39 dB，SSIM 0.8436。
Conclusion: Log-Domain Noisier2Inverse框架在ICF图像去噪任务上有效，无需干净参考图像即可实现高质量去噪，但框架有效性仅限于乘性均匀噪声场景。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Continual Learning for Sequential Personalization of Small Language Models: A Stability Monitoring Analysis
papers.abstract_en: Small Language Models (SLMs) are increasingly being considered for deployment on edge devices such as laptops, enabling private, low-latency, and locally personalized applications. However, personalization requires models to adapt over time to evolving user- or task-specific data, placing them in a continual learning setting. This creates the risk of catastrophic forgetting, where learning new information degrades performance on previously learned tasks or broader model capabilities. Recent benchmarks such as TRACE have shown that continual fine-tuning can significantly degrade the general abilities of aligned large language models. In this work, we present a study for sequential LoRA personalization of SLMs. We save model checkpoints after each adaptation stage and evaluate them on current tasks, previously seen tasks, and a fixed reference set. This checkpoint-level protocol enables us to monitor task performance, forgetting, and reference set drift over time. We show that lightweight reference set distributional diagnostics can reveal model-specific instability patterns during sequential LoRA personalization of SLMs, including cases where task-level metrics alone hide harmful adaptation. We hope this can highlight new research avenues for monitoring stability of SLMs in a continual learning setting.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究了小型语言模型（SLM）在边缘设备上进行顺序个性化时的持续学习问题，提出了一种基于检查点的稳定性监测协议，通过保存每个适应阶段的模型并在当前任务、先前任务和固定参考集上评估，来监测任务性能、遗忘和参考集漂移。实验表明，轻量级参考集分布诊断可以揭示顺序LoRA个性化中的不稳定模式，包括任务级指标无法捕捉的有害适应。
Motivation: SLM在边缘设备上的个性化需要持续适应新数据，但可能导致灾难性遗忘，损害模型通用能力。现有基准如TRACE已显示持续微调会显著降低大型语言模型的能力，但针对SLM的稳定性监测方法尚不充分。
Method: 提出检查点级协议：在每次LoRA适应阶段后保存模型，并在当前任务、先前任务和固定参考集上评估，通过参考集分布诊断监测模型稳定性。
Result: 轻量级参考集分布诊断能够揭示顺序LoRA个性化中的不稳定模式，包括任务级指标隐藏的有害适应。
Conclusion: 该协议为SLM在持续学习环境下的稳定性监测提供了新思路，但未提及具体性能数字或广泛基准验证。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Cross-Platform Chinese Offensive Comment Detection via Dual-Threshold Hard Example Mining
papers.abstract_en: Cross-platform deployment of offensive comment detection for Chinese social media suffers performance degradation. The paper proposes a dual-threshold hard mining method to address this. First, the clean-Chinese-base RoBERTa is finetuned on COLD to establish a binary baseline for fair comparison. Second, a three-class fine-labeled test set covering Weibo, Xiaohongshu, Tieba, and Zhihu is constructed, domain distances from the source are quantified using Jaccard and Proxy-A Distance, as well as the degradation bottleneck of the baseline under domain shift is systematically revealed. Herein, a dual threshold hard example mining strategy is proposed. High- and low-confidence error-prone samples are filtered from unlabeled corpora by prediction confidence. The model is secondarily finetuned under implicit contexts with merely a small set of manually labeled hard examples, realizing low-cost cross-platform domain adaptation. Experiments reveal significant performance gains of the optimized model across four platforms.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对中文社交平台攻击性评论检测在跨平台部署时性能下降的问题，提出一种双阈值难例挖掘策略。首先在干净中文RoBERTa上微调COLD数据集作为基线，然后构建覆盖微博、小红书、贴吧和知乎的三分类细标注测试集，量化域距离并揭示域偏移下的性能瓶颈。通过预测置信度从无标注语料中过滤高/低置信度易错样本，仅用少量人工标注的难例进行二次微调，实现低成本跨平台域适应。实验表明该方法在四个平台上均取得显著性能提升。
Motivation: 现有跨平台部署的中文攻击性评论检测模型在域偏移下性能显著下降，需要一种低成本且高效的域适应方法。
Method: 提出双阈值难例挖掘（Dual-Threshold Hard Example Mining）：先用干净中文RoBERTa在COLD数据集上训练基线模型；构建覆盖四个中文平台的细标注测试集；通过预测置信度从无标注数据中筛选高置信度和低置信度的易错样本；仅用少量人工标注的难例进行二次微调，同时利用无标注数据辅助训练。
Result: 实验表明，所提方法在微博、小红书、贴吧和知乎四个平台上均取得显著的性能提升，优于传统微调方法。
Conclusion: 该研究提出了一种低成本、高效的跨平台中文攻击性评论检测域适应方法，通过双阈值难例挖掘策略有效缓解了域偏移问题。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: HybridCodec: Modeling Discrete and Continuous Representations for Efficient Speech Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Discrete audio representations have become increasingly popular for building multimodal text-audio systems and integrating audio capabilities into Large Language Models (LLMs). However, numerous studies report performance degradation on various downstream tasks due to information loss during discretization. To address this, we propose a novel approach combining temporally compressed discrete tokens with dimensionality-reduced continuous residuals. Our framework consists of a hybridized discrete-continuous focal modulation codec and a hybrid Transformer. This architecture performs autoregressive inference in the discrete domain, coupled with non-autoregressive prediction and continuous residual upsampling. Experimental results show that our approach significantly improves the retention of speaker characteristics compared to discrete-only methods, while simultaneously reducing the number of required autoregressive steps.
papers.journal_ref: InterSpeech 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出HybridCodec，一种结合时域压缩离散token和降维连续残差的混合编解码框架，用于高效语音语言模型。该方法在离散域进行自回归推理，并辅以非自回归预测和连续残差上采样。实验表明，相比纯离散方法，该方法显著提升了说话人特征的保留，同时减少了所需的自动回归步数。
Motivation: 离散音频表示在多模态文本-音频系统和LLM集成中越来越流行，但离散化导致信息损失，造成下游任务性能下降。本文旨在减少这种信息损失。
Method: 提出混合离散-连续焦点调制编解码器（focal modulation codec）和混合Transformer架构。自回归推理在离散域进行，结合非自回归预测和连续残差上采样。
Result: 实验显示，该方法相比纯离散方法显著提高了说话人特征的保留，同时减少了所需的自回归步数。
Conclusion: 混合离散-连续表示可以在保持效率的同时改善信息保留，为语音语言模型提供更好的表征。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Physics-Guided Robotic Radiation Source Localization along Arbitrary Measurement Paths in Unstructured Environments
papers.abstract_en: Using robots to estimate the location of the radiation source is an effective way to improve efficiency and safety. Existing methods focus on planning the robot's path to achieve precise estimation, typically approaching the source. However, approaching the source increases the risk of radiation damage to a robot. In addition, a path-planning algorithm designed solely for radiation source localization (RSL) limits the flexibility of missions that deploy robots into radioactive environments. This study presents an automation framework for robotic RSL that leverages a physics-informed machine learning (PIML) model to precisely estimate the source location, regardless of measurement paths, in unknown environments. Physics-inspired model tensors have been designed for PIML to handle attenuated gamma-ray flux signals from unknown obstacles, and multiple models are computed in parallel to improve the robustness and precision of the RSL. The proposed method is evaluated in high-fidelity simulation environments using Monte Carlo particle transport across diverse randomized domains, including spatial scales, radiation source types, obstacle materials and geometries, and robot trajectories. The method is also validated through physical experiments on configurations that are not included in the simulation-based evaluation. The continuous learning technique is applied in real-robot deployment to enhance the practical applicability of the online robotic RSL system. The proposed method advances robot radiation perception from pointwise flux detection to spatial intelligence.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于物理启发机器学习（PIML）的机器人辐射源定位自动化框架，能在未知环境下沿任意测量路径精确估计源位置，无需接近源，从而降低机器人辐射损伤风险。方法设计物理启发模型张量处理未知障碍物的伽马射线衰减信号，并行计算多个模型提高鲁棒性和精度。通过蒙特卡洛粒子传输高保真仿真和实物实验验证，并采用连续学习技术增强在线系统的实用性。
Motivation: 现有辐射源定位方法依赖接近源的路径规划，增加机器人辐射损伤风险，且专用路径规划限制任务灵活性。论文旨在实现不依赖测量路径的精确源定位。
Method: 提出物理启发机器学习（PIML）模型，设计物理启发模型张量处理未知障碍物衰减的伽马射线通量信号，并行计算多个模型提高精度和鲁棒性；采用连续学习技术增强在线部署适应性。
Result: 在高保真仿真（多种随机域）和实物实验中验证，仿真使用蒙特卡洛粒子传输覆盖不同空间尺度、源类型、障碍物材料和几何、机器人轨迹。
Conclusion: 论文将机器人辐射感知从逐点通量检测提升至空间智能，为任意路径下的源定位提供通用框架。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: FoggyTrust: Robust Federated Learning with Hierarchical Trust Networks
papers.abstract_en: Byzantine-robust federated learning seeks to protect distributed model training from malicious or corrupted clients without requiring access to their private data. FLTrust addresses this challenge by introducing a trusted server-side root dataset that assigns trust scores to client updates for more robust aggregation. In this work, we propose FOGGYTRUST, a hierarchical extension of FLTrust that localizes trust computation to fog nodes, allowing the framework to better handle globally heterogeneous data while preserving robustness within locally homogeneous client groups. We further show that this two-level architecture can simultaneously address distribution mismatch in trust estimation and client drift across groups by combining local trust-based aggregation with heterogeneity-aware global optimizers such as FedAdam and SCAFFOLD. Across benchmark datasets, FOGGYTRUST achieves its strongest gains on more challenging heterogeneous settings, particularly on CIFAR-10 under Krum and Trim attacks, where it achieves an over 50% improvement over FLTrust. We also test FOGGYTRUST in a real-world safari dataset to show the promise of hierarchical trust networks for robust federated learning in socially impactful, safety-critical settings such as distributed wildlife monitoring.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出FoggyTrust，一种基于层级信任网络的鲁棒联邦学习方法，通过将信任计算局部化到雾节点来应对全局数据异构性，同时保持局部同质客户端组内的鲁棒性。在CIFAR-10等基准数据集上，面对Krum和Trim攻击时，FoggyTrust相比FLTrust取得超过50%的提升，并在真实野生动物监测数据集上验证了其有效性。
Motivation: 现有鲁棒联邦学习方法如FLTrust使用全局根数据集分配信任分数，但在全局数据高度异构时效果不佳，且无法处理不同客户端组间的分布偏移。
Method: 提出FLTrust的层级扩展FoggyTrust，在雾节点上局部计算信任分数，并结合本地信任聚合与异构性感知全局优化器（如FedAdam和SCAFFOLD），以同时解决信任估计中的分布不匹配和客户端漂移问题。
Result: 在CIFAR-10数据集上，面对Krum和Trim攻击时，FoggyTrust相比FLTrust实现超过50%的改进；在真实野生动物监测数据集上也展现了有效性。
Conclusion: 层级信任网络在安全关键且具有社会影响力的分布式应用（如野生动物监测）中展现出鲁棒联邦学习的潜力。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: DysLexLens: A Low-Resource LLM Framework for Analysing Dyslexic Learners Insights from Online Forums
papers.abstract_en: Dyslexic learners increasingly use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support reading, writing, organisation, and study-related tasks. However, their lived experiences with these tools remain largely underexamined. This paper proposes DysLexLens, a low-resource LLM framework, designed to analyse dyslexic learners experience with AI through online forum discussions. DysLexLens is designed as an end-to-end, evidence-traceable architecture which transforms noisy social media posts into a dictionary-driven corpora, provides knowledge-graph (KG)-based question reasoning, generates verifiable query responses, and enables response evaluation through quantitative and human-grounded assessment. DysLexLens has four key features. First, it employs a dictionary-driven filtering method to construct a more focused Reddit corpus on dyslexia and AI, filtering out noisy and weakly related posts to improve the relevance of data collected from low-resource forum contexts. Second, it integrates LLM-assisted semantic analysis with KG-based query reasoning to uncover meaningful patterns. Third, it has quantitative evaluation metrics (RAGAS and Query Robustness) to measure LLM-generated response performance. Fourth, it provides structured qualitative validation guidelines for assessing response quality, with a specific focus on hallucination and evidence alignment. We demonstrate the effectiveness of DysLexLens using dyslexia-related Reddit forum data and 30 questions. The results show its potential generalisability to other low-resource forum data contexts. DysLexLens, sample data, questions and evaluation results are available at Github to support reproducibility.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DysLexLens，一个低资源 LLM 框架，用于分析失读症学习者在在线论坛中讨论 AI 工具的体验。框架包含词典驱动的过滤、知识图谱查询推理、定量评估（RAGAS 和查询鲁棒性）以及定性验证指南。在 Reddit 论坛数据和 30 个问题上展示了有效性。
Motivation: 失读症学习者越来越多地使用 AI 工具，但他们的实际体验缺乏系统研究。现有方法难以从低资源论坛数据中提取可靠洞察。
Method: DysLexLens 是一个端到端、可追溯的架构，包括：1) 词典驱动过滤构建聚焦语料库；2) LLM 辅助语义分析与知识图谱查询推理；3) 定量评估指标 RAGAS 和查询鲁棒性；4) 结构化定性验证指南评估幻觉和证据对齐。
Result: 在失读症相关 Reddit 论坛数据和 30 个问题上验证，显示出对低资源论坛数据上下文的潜在泛化能力。
Conclusion: DysLexLens 为分析失读症学习者的 AI 工具体验提供了可复现的低资源框架，但需要更多领域验证。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Masked Language Flow Models
papers.abstract_en: Masked Diffusion Models (MDMs) promise fast, parallel language generation, but their reverse transition factorises across token positions -- an approximation that breaks down in the few-step sampling regime where parallel generation ought to provide the greatest efficiency gains. Flow Language Models (FLMs) sidestep this limitation by learning a continuous flow that transports noise toward clean sequences represented in Euclidean space, inducing a flow map that can be distilled for single-step generation. However, this makes complex tasks requiring multi-step reasoning problematic for FLMs, as FLMs are forced to decode every token during generation. To address this, we introduce Masked Language Flow Models (MLFMs), which incorporate masking into FLMs using a continuous stochastic interpolant to bridge partially masked and clean sequences. This design enables conditional generation via continuous flows and allows pretrained MDMs to be converted into MLFMs through a simple, lightweight adaptation. Leveraging this flexibility, we propose a novel sampler that alternates continuous denoising with the discrete unmasking of confident tokens to better support multi-step reasoning. We evaluate our approach on GSM8K and MT-Bench and find, for the first time, that flow-based language models can be scaled to solve downstream reasoning and instruction-following tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出掩码语言流模型（MLFM），将掩码机制引入流语言模型（FLM），通过连续随机插值连接部分掩码序列与干净序列，实现条件生成并能将预训练掩码扩散模型（MDM）轻量适配为MLFM。设计交替连续去噪与离散确定性解掩码的采样器，首次将基于流的语言模型扩展到下游推理和指令遵循任务，在GSM8K和MT-Bench上取得结果。
Motivation: 掩码扩散模型（MDM）在少步采样时并行生成效率受限，流语言模型（FLM）虽支持单步生成，但难以处理需要多步推理的复杂任务。
Method: 引入连续随机插值连接部分掩码序列与干净序列，将掩码机制集成到FLM中；提出交替连续去噪与离散确定性解掩码的采样器，支持多步推理。
Result: 在GSM8K和MT-Bench上评估，首次表明基于流的语言模型可扩展以解决下游推理和指令遵循任务。
Conclusion: MLFM通过掩码与流的结合，平衡了并行生成效率与多步推理能力，并支持从预训练MDM的轻量适配。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Enhancing Co-packaging Optics Enabled Silicon Photonics Security Assurance Hardware Fingerprinting
papers.abstract_en: Silicon photonics enables integration of optical components using standard semiconductor processes, greatly improving data communication bandwidth and energy efficiency. However, photonics integrated circuits (PICs) face unique security challenges, such as counterfeit or tampering threats, that conventional electronic security methods do not address. We propose a novel hardware fingerprinting technique that embeds two dimensional photonic crystal patterns into the density control filler regions of a PIC. Each PhC pattern is designed to resonate a specific visible to near infrared wavelengths, producing a distinctive optical signature (based on wavelength, polarization, and incident angle) for each device. Finite difference time domain (FDTD) simulation using ANSYS Lumerical is employed to optimize nanostructure dimensions and spacing so that each device's reflection/absorption spectrum contains unique narrowband peaks. No extra fabrication steps or materials are required beyond standard lithography, keeping costs low. The embedded nanostructures have sub-50nm precision, making forgery extremely difficult. Our method yields a high resolution, scalable fingerprint for silicon photonic chips, enabling cost-effective device authentication and improved supply chain security.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于二维光子晶体图案的硬件指纹识别技术，用于硅光子集成电路（PIC）的安全认证。通过FDTD仿真优化纳米结构，每个器件产生独特的光学签名（波长、偏振、入射角），无需额外工艺步骤，成本低，防伪造能力强。
Motivation: 硅光子集成面临伪造和篡改等独特安全挑战，传统电子安全方法不适用。
Method: 在PIC的密度控制填充区域嵌入二维光子晶体图案，图案对特定可见-近红外波长共振，通过FDTD优化尺寸和间距，使每个器件的反射/吸收谱包含独特窄带峰。
Result: 摘要声称该方法可实现高分辨率、可扩展的指纹，且子50nm的精度使伪造极难。
Conclusion: 该方法为硅光子芯片提供低成本、有效的设备认证，提升供应链安全。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Pulmonary Embolism Risk Stratification from CTPA and Medical Records: Vascular Graphs Are Not All You Need
papers.abstract_en: Risk stratification for pulmonary embolism (PE) is critical for clinical decision-making. Stratification guidelines are based on patient medical records, parameters measured from computed tomography pulmonary angiography (CTPA), and blood tests. However, blood tests are often missing in routine practice. This work studies whether state-of-the-art models can accurately classify risk stratification from only medical records and biomarkers extracted from CTPA images. We benchmark different approaches to combine medical records and cardiac biomarkers with rich pulmonary vascular information; we add vascular biomarkers to tabular models and apply graph neural networks (GNNs) on the vascular tree's intrinsic graph representation. We use a private dataset (n=353) with uniquely complete data for PE risk stratification. Our results show that, among global features, medical records and cardiac biomarkers are the most significant predictors, while vascular biomarkers do not further improve stratification. Even more surprising, even GNNs on vascular graphs fail to outperform strong tabular baseline on global features. We consider hypotheses, on both models and data, that could explain this suboptimal performance. Our investigation suggests that, counter-intuitively, vascular graphs might hold no discriminative information for PE risk stratification. Code is available from https://github.com/creatis-myriad/GENESIS.

papers.title: AI Snitches Get Glitches: Towards Evading Agentic Surveillance
papers.abstract_en: To better assist users with completing challenging tasks, AI agents mediate communications, access data, and interact with different APIs. Many employers (and even nation-states) already provide their users with this technology. However, widespread adoption of AI agents creates a new risk to abuse access to user data for another goal: surveilling users. These users might not even have the ability or permission to control the actions and data accesses of the surveilling agents. We introduce and formalize the problem of agentic surveillance: the ability of an AI agent to analyze available information, craft a report, and send it out using available tools. To evaluate surveillance capabilities across different models, we create SurveilBench, a dataset of various reporting scenarios focusing on three domains: corporate, education, and police. We find that some models exhibit emergent (i.e., unprompted) tendencies to help surveillance, but they also report the attempts to surveil users to the government. Finally, we repurpose prompt injections for evading surveillance and develop three evasion techniques that hide from, deceive, or induce over-escalation in surveillance agents. We conclude that agentic surveillance can already be easily implemented and, therefore, call for a comprehensive technical, ethical, and legislative framework to protect users.
papers.comment: The code and Demo are available at https://aisec.cs.umass.edu/demo/ai-snitches-get-stitches/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出并形式化了代理监控（agentic surveillance）问题，即AI代理利用可用信息分析、撰写报告并发送的能力。作者创建了SurveilBench数据集，涵盖企业、教育和警察三个领域的报告场景，发现某些模型表现出未提示的辅助监控倾向。同时，他们改进了提示注入技术，开发了三种逃避监控的方法。
Motivation: AI代理的广泛采用为用户提供了便利，但也带来了滥用数据监控用户的风险，用户可能无法控制监控代理的行为。现有研究缺乏对此问题的系统化探讨和防御机制。
Method: 形式化代理监控问题，构建SurveilBench数据集，评估多种模型的监控能力；设计三种逃避监控的提示注入技术：隐藏、欺骗或诱导过度升级。
Result: 发现部分模型具有自发辅助监控的能力，但也会向政府报告监控尝试；提出的逃避技术能够有效规避监控。
Conclusion: 代理监控已可轻易实现，亟需建立技术、伦理和法律框架来保护用户。

papers.title: Invoice Haystack: Benchmarking Document Retrieval and Visual Question Answering Under Strong Visual Homogeneity
papers.abstract_en: Vision Language Models have achieved near-human performance on single-document Visual Question Answering, yet their effectiveness degrades significantly when retrieving information from large collections of visually homogeneous documents. Existing multi-document benchmarks aggregate diverse document types, creating artificial separation in embedding space that does not reflect enterprise document repositories where thousands of records share identical visual templates. We identify this as embedding collapse and introduce Invoice Haystack, a benchmark with 1,500 anonymized invoice images paired with 200 discriminative question-answer pairs, specifically designed to stress-test retrieval under strong visual homogeneity. Invoice Haystack exhibits a mean pairwise cosine similarity of 0.73, compared to 0.38 (DocHaystack) and 0.31 (InfoHaystack) in existing benchmarks, posing a fundamentally more challenging retrieval problem. Addressing the identified challenge, we propose VL-RAG, a hybrid retrieval-augmented generation framework that jointly leverages text and visual embeddings to harness the complementary strengths of both modalities, followed by a VLM-based verification filter for precise document identification. VL-RAG achieves 60.0\% Recall@1 on Invoice Haystack-500, outperforming existing state-of-the-art method by up to an absolute 13.5 percentage points. It further improves retrieval considerably on DocHaystack-1000 (77.1\% vs.\ 75.2\%) and InfoHaystack-1000 (84.5\% vs.\ 80.0\%), establishing the proposed dual-stream fusion as a consistently superior retrieval strategy across both homogeneous and heterogeneous document collections.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对视觉同质文档检索中的嵌入坍塌问题，构建了包含1500张发票图像的Invoice Haystack基准（平均余弦相似度0.73），并提出了VL-RAG混合检索框架，该框架联合利用文本和视觉嵌入进行双流融合，再经VLM验证过滤，在Invoice Haystack-500上Recall@1达60.0%，比现有最优方法绝对提升13.5个百分点。
Motivation: 现有视觉语言模型在单文档VQA中表现出色，但在大量视觉同质的文档集合中检索信息时性能显著下降；现有多文档基准因文档类型多样而导致嵌入空间人为分离，不能反映企业文档库中数千份共享相同视觉模板的真实场景。
Method: 提出Invoice Haystack基准（1500张匿名发票+200个判别性问答对）以测试强视觉同质性下的检索；提出VL-RAG框架，并行使用文本和视觉编码器生成双流嵌入，通过融合策略联合利用两模态互补优势，再经VLM验证过滤器精确定位文档。
Result: VL-RAG在Invoice Haystack-500上Recall@1达60.0%，比现有方法绝对提升13.5个百分点；在DocHaystack-1000（77.1% vs 75.2%）和InfoHaystack-1000（84.5% vs 80.0%）上也有显著提升。
Conclusion: 双流融合策略在视觉同质和异质文档集合上均实现一致的检索性能提升，验证了其作为通用检索策略的有效性。

papers.title: Yuvion VL: A Multimodal Foundation Model for Adversarial Content and AI Safety
papers.abstract_en: General-purpose models often struggle to reliably identify and understand real-world multimodal risks, largely due to the inherent multimodal adversarial nature of content and AI safety. We present Yuvion VL, a family of multimodal large language models purpose-built for content and AI safety, with both instruction-tuned and reasoning-oriented variants. Yuvion VL addresses this gap by treating safety as an inherently adversarial and multimodal problem and designing the entire pipeline around adversarial robustness. For data construction, we develop an automated pipeline integrating adversarial-aware data synthesis with multi-stage quality control, producing large-scale, high-quality multimodal samples augmented with domain knowledge and reasoning annotations. For training, we adopt a three-stage pipeline that includes continued pretraining for risk-concept cross-modal alignment, instruct post-training for production-grade safety tasks, and reasoning post-training for enhanced interpretability and performance in complex tasks. We further introduce Confuse-then-Contrast Fine-Tuning, a contrastive framework that mines model-specific confusions and constructs multi-image contrastive groups to enforce explicit discrimination of fine-grained visual-semantic elements, enabling the model to distinguish between visually similar cases with different safety implications in adversarial safety tasks. To support rigorous evaluation, we further introduce Yuvion VL RiskEval (YVRE), a collection of benchmarks covering diverse open and internal evaluations, with a focus on content and AI safety, adversarial robustness, and real-world capability requirements. Experiments show that Yuvion VL-32B achieves industry-leading safety performance, surpassing comparably sized open-source models and best closed-source commercial models, while maintaining comparable general capabilities.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文提出Yuvion VL，一系列专为内容与AI安全设计的多模态大语言模型，包含指令调优和推理变体。通过对抗感知数据合成、三阶段训练（持续预训练、指令后训练、推理后训练）以及Confuse-then-Contrast Fine-Tuning对比微调框架，使模型在对抗性安全任务中表现优异。实验表明Yuvion VL-32B在安全性能上超越同等规模开源模型和最佳闭源商业模型，同时保持一般能力。
Motivation: 通用模型难以可靠识别和理解真实世界的多模态风险，主要是因为内容和AI安全固有的多模态对抗性质。
Method: 构建自动数据管道，集成对抗感知数据合成与多阶段质量控制，生成大规模高质量多模态样本。采用三阶段训练：持续预训练实现风险-概念跨模态对齐，指令后训练适配生产级安全任务，推理后训练提升可解释性及复杂任务性能。提出Confuse-then-Contrast Fine-Tuning，挖掘模型特定混淆并构建多图像对比组，强制模型区分视觉-语义细微差异。
Result: 在Yuvion VL RiskEval（YVRE）基准上，Yuvion VL-32B达到行业领先的安全性能，超过同等规模开源模型和最佳闭源商业模型，且一般能力保持相当。
Conclusion: 论文强调将安全视为固有对抗性和多模态问题，并围绕对抗鲁棒性设计整个流程，可显著提升安全任务性能。

papers.title: Real vs. Complex Spectral Bases for Neural Operators: The Role of Green's Function Alignment
papers.abstract_en: Fourier Neural Operators (FNO) learn solution operators of partial differential equations by parameterizing global convolutions in the complex Fourier domain. For real-valued PDE solutions, the complex FFT carries representational redundancy through conjugate symmetry. We introduce the Hartley Neural Operator (HNO), the exact real-valued mirror of FNO: it replaces the FFT with the purely real Discrete Hartley Transform and learns a single real multiplier per retained spectral mode, with no complex arithmetic. Because the real Hartley spectrum is not halved by conjugate symmetry, HNO retains twice as many frequency corners as FNO but one real weight where FNO carries a complex pair, so the two operators are iso-parametric at equal width and differ only in spectral basis. Our central thesis is that the best basis is a property of the operator. Self-adjoint elliptic operators (Poisson, biharmonic) have real, symmetric Green's functions that the real Hartley multiplier diagonalizes exactly, and HNO is favored there. Time-dependent operators carry phase, from oscillation in the wave equation to transport in advection, Burgers, and Navier-Stokes, which a real diagonal multiplier cannot represent, so FNO is favored there, and increasingly so with the operator's phase content, leaving the phaseless heat equation as the borderline case. Training both operators identically and benchmarking across PDE classes, initial-condition families, and boundary conditions, we find an elliptic-versus-time-dependent split that is monotone in operator phase content and matches the Green's-function theory we develop. Rather than a universal winner, our findings give a predictive rule: match the spectral basis to the symmetry of the solution operator.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统比较了复数傅里叶基（FNO）与纯实数哈特利基（HNO）在神经算子中的表现，发现最佳谱基取决于算子特性：自伴椭圆算子（如泊松、双调和）的实对称格林函数被哈特利基精确对角化，HNO更优；时间依赖算子（波动、对流、Burgers、Navier-Stokes）带有相位，实数对角乘子无法表示，因此FNO更优，且优势随算子相位含量单调增加。热方程作为无相位边界情况。实验跨PDE类、初值族和边界条件验证了这一预测性规则。
Motivation: 现有傅里叶神经算子（FNO）对实值PDE解使用复数FFT存在共轭对称带来的表示冗余，而可选的实谱基（如哈特利变换）未被充分研究。本文旨在明确谱基选择与算子对称性的关系。
Method: 引入哈特利神经算子（HNO），即FNO的纯实数镜像：用离散哈特利变换替换FFT，每个保留谱模式学习一个实数乘子。保持参数量等价，仅改变谱基。
Result: 实验发现显著的算子类型分裂：自伴椭圆算子上HNO更优，时间依赖算子上FNO更优，且性能差异与算子的相位含量单调相关，符合基于格林函数的理论预测。
Conclusion: 不存在普适最优的谱基；应选择与解算子对称性匹配的谱基：实对称算子用哈特利基，带相位算子用傅里叶基。
Relevance: 30

papers.title: CrossPool: Efficient Multi-LLM Serving for Cold MoE Models through KV-Cache and Weight Disaggregation
papers.abstract_en: Emerging LLM services increasingly host many sparse MoE models, yet most models receive sparse requests and remain cold. This creates a GPU memory problem: model weights are stable and model-determined, while KV-cache is transient and demand-determined. Because cold models rarely reach peak KV-cache demand at the same time, reserving worst-case KV capacity per model wastes memory; a shared KV-cache pool can instead provision aggregate active demand. However, KV-cache sharing is not sufficient when weights and KV-cache remain in a monolithic GPU memory pool. Static weights compete with dynamic KV-cache, and KV-head-limited attention under cold, low-concurrency traffic exposes only a fraction of replicated KV capacity, leading to low GPU memory utilization and weak long-context support. We present CrossPool, a serving engine for cold MoE models that separates FFN weights and KV-cache into two GPU memory pools: a weights pool that consolidates FFN weights across cold models, and a KV-cache pool that dynamically serves active requests while keeping attention local to KV-cache. CrossPool combines a KV-cache planner and virtualizer, a layer-wise pipeline scheduler that hides hidden-state transfers, and persistent kernels with control lowering to reduce CPU-GPU control overhead. With efficient GPU memory pooling, CrossPool underpins bursty long-context requests and outperforms the state-of-the-art kvcached-based multi-LLM serving system, reducing P99 TBT by up to 10.4x.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出CrossPool，一种针对冷MoE模型的多LLM服务引擎，通过将FFN权重和KV-cache分离到两个GPU内存池中，实现高效内存共享。摘要报告，与基于KV-cache的最先进多LLM服务系统相比，P99 TBT降低高达10.4倍。
Motivation: 冷MoE模型权重稳定但KV-cache动态，预留最坏情况KV容量浪费内存；共享KV-cache池可满足聚合活跃需求，但权重与KV-cache在统一内存池中竞争，导致GPU内存利用率低和长上下文支持弱。
Method: CrossPool将FFN权重和KV-cache分离到两个GPU内存池：权重池整合冷模型权重，KV-cache池动态服务活跃请求。结合KV-cache规划器与虚拟化、层间流水线调度器，以及持久化内核与控制降级技术。
Result: 在冷MoE模型场景下，CrossPool比基于KV-cache的最先进多LLM服务系统降低P99 TBT高达10.4倍。
Conclusion: 通过高效的GPU内存池化，CrossPool能够支持突发的长上下文请求，有效解决了冷MoE模型服务中的内存利用率瓶颈。

papers.title: TuringViT: Making SOTA Vision Transformers Accessible to All
papers.abstract_en: Modern VLMs and VLA systems commonly adopt off-the-shelf ViTs such as SigLIP2 as visual encoders, but diverse downstream requirements in latency, temporal modeling, and VLM integration often call for customized SOTA-level ViTs. Training such encoders remains beyond the reach of much of the community, as it requires massive image-text data, while standard softmax attention makes high-resolution or dynamic-resolution pretraining prohibitively costly and often forces low-resolution pretraining followed by post-hoc adaptation. TuringViT addresses these challenges with three key designs: Turing Linear Attention (TLA) for efficient sequence modeling, VISTA-Curation to construct supervision-rich image-video training data, and native dynamic-resolution pretraining that supports flexible inputs from the start and transfers seamlessly to downstream VLMs. As a result, TuringViT outperforms leading open-source ViT baselines with only 10% of the data, achieves stronger downstream VLM performance, and delivers substantially better latency scaling on high-resolution inputs. Our scaling-law analysis further shows that TuringViT continues to improve predictably with curated data scale, far from saturation. Its fast adaptation, hardware-friendly design, and efficient deployment have made it a unified visual foundation across XPeng's AI systems. More broadly, TuringViT provides a reproducible pipeline that dramatically lowers the cost for the community to train, customize, and deploy SOTA-level ViTs, moving toward making such Vision Transformers accessible to all.

TL;DR: TuringViT 提出三种关键设计：图灵线性注意力 (TLA)、VISTA-Curation 数据构建策略和原生动态分辨率预训练，使视觉 Transformer 在仅用 10% 数据的情况下超越开源基线，并在下游 VLM 任务和高分辨率延迟上表现更优。
Motivation: 现有 SOTA ViT 的训练需要大量图像-文本数据且高分辨率预训练成本高昂，社区难以定制化，TuringViT 旨在降低训练和部署门槛。
Method: 提出 Turing Linear Attention (TLA) 高效序列建模、VISTA-Curation 构建富监督图像-视频数据、原生动态分辨率预训练以支持灵活输入。

Conclusion: TuringViT 提供了一个可复现的流水线，大幅降低社区训练、定制和部署 SOTA ViT 的成本。

papers.title: Does My Embedding Reflect That $A = B$? Evaluating Mathematical Equivalence in Embedding Models
papers.abstract_en: Because mathematics is highly abstract, a single statement can take very different forms depending on what subfield it is framed in. There are many examples where breakthroughs occurred after researchers discovered that a question had already been answered in a different field. At the same time, the growth of new resources related to formalization has increased the need for tools that enable efficient and reliable navigation between mathematical 'languages' (e.g., from Lean to natural language). In this paper, we investigate whether current embedding models capture mathematical equivalence. To do this, we introduce the Mathematically Equivalent but Lexically Different Pairs (MELD) Dataset, a collection of mathematically equivalent statements that are expressed in very different language. We show that current state-of-the-art embedding models tend to group statements by the terminology used to make them instead of the underlying math. Motivated by this, we propose a contrastive approach to learning embeddings of mathematical text that focuses on aligning informal statements with different formalizations. Our experiments demonstrate that this leads to improvements not only on informal-formal retrieval tasks but also on MELD, which only contains natural language statements.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过引入数学等价但词汇不同对的MELD数据集，评估当前嵌入模型是否能捕捉数学等价性。实验表明现有模型倾向于根据术语而非底层数学进行分组，并提出一种对比学习方法，对齐非正式陈述与不同形式化表述，在检索任务和MELD数据集上取得改进。
Motivation: 数学陈述在不同子领域表达形式差异巨大，而现有嵌入模型无法有效识别数学等价性，阻碍跨领域知识发现和数学形式化工具的发展。
Method: 提出Mathematically Equivalent but Lexically Different Pairs (MELD) 数据集，并采用对比学习方法训练嵌入，对齐非正式数学文本与不同形式化表述。
Result: 当前顶尖嵌入模型在MELD上表现不佳，倾向于按术语分组；对比学习方法在非正式-形式检索任务和MELD数据集上均取得改进。
Conclusion: 嵌入模型需要改进以捕捉数学等价性，所提对比方法有效但仍有局限。

papers.title: POTracker: Optimizing Large Language Models for Standard-Compliant Power Outage Report Generation
papers.abstract_en: Recent large language models (LLMs) are good at general text generation, but it is still hard to use them for domain-specific data generation because the output must follow strict formatting and structural rules. Unlike open-ended tasks such as question answering or translation, domain-specific generation must be both semantically correct and compliant with existing guidelines and standards. In this work, we study the nationwide interoperability problem of utility power outage reports in the United States. In practice, outage reports need to be machine-readable (e.g., JSON or XML) and must strictly follow requirements from energy-sector regulatory bodies. To address this problem, we propose POTracker, an optimized LLM for power outage report generation. We fine-tune Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct using our proposed objective. The key contribution is a new loss function, POTrackerLoss, that considers both textual similarity and structural (tag) similarity between the generated report and the ground-truth report. We evaluate POTracker on a dataset of 1,000 power outage reports and compare it with five well-known fine-tuning methods and one rule-based XML conversion method. Results show that POTracker outperforms other fine-tuning approaches, improving overall accuracy by up to 51% and reaching 86.47% structural accuracy for generated power outage reports. In addition, we conduct a human study to assess the quality of the ground-truth standard reports, where domain experts assign the generated labels an average score of 4.03 on a 0--5 scale.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出POTracker，一个针对电力停电报告生成优化的LLM，通过新损失函数POTrackerLoss同时优化文本相似度和结构（标签）相似度。在1000份报告数据集上，相比五种微调方法，准确性提升最高51%，结构准确性达86.47%。
Motivation: 现有LLM在领域特定数据生成中难以严格遵循格式和结构规则，特别是电力行业的机器可读报告（如JSON/XML）需符合监管标准。
Method: 对Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct进行微调，提出POTrackerLoss损失函数，结合文本相似度和标签结构相似度，生成符合标准的报告。
Result: 在1000份电力停电报告数据集上，相比五种微调方法和一种基于规则的XML转换方法，准确性提升最高51%，结构准确性达86.47%；人类评估平均得分4.03/5。
Conclusion: POTracker通过联合优化文本和结构相似度，有效提升了领域特定报告生成的合规性和准确性，但仅限于电力停电报告这一特定场景。

papers.title: Agent-as-a-Router: Agentic Model Routing for Coding Tasks
papers.abstract_en: Real-world users typically have access to multiple Large Language Models (LLMs) from different providers, and these LLMs often excel at distinct domains, yet none dominate all. Consequently, routing each task to the most suitable model becomes critical for both performance and cost. Existing routers treat this as a static, one-off classification problem. However, we identify the performance bottleneck for these routers as information deficit: simply augmenting a vanilla LLM router with performance statistics at the task-dimension level yields a 15.3% relative gain, surpassing a heuristic router built on the same dimension-level priors. Motivated by this finding, we propose Agent-as-a-Router, a framework that formalizes routing as a C-A-F loop (Context->Action->Feedback->Context). It closes the information gap by accumulating execution-grounded experience during deployment. We instantiate this framework as ACRouter, composed of an Orchestrator, a Verifier, a Memory module, and introduce CodeRouterBench, an evaluation environment comprising ~10K task instances with verified scores from 8 frontier LLMs, enabling regret-based router comparison on streaming tasks. Experiments show that ACRouter achieves the lowest cumulative regret on in-distribution tasks and generalizes to out-of-distribution agentic-programming tasks, demonstrating that our routing framework actively closes the information gap. Codes and benchmarks are released at https://github.com/LanceZPF/agent-as-a-router.
papers.comment: 39 pages, 21 figures, a living technical report with a living benchmark that continuously updates
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Agent-as-a-Router 框架，将模型路由形式化为 C-A-F（上下文-动作-反馈-上下文）循环，通过执行经验积累缩小信息差距。实例化 ACRouter 包含编排器、验证器和记忆模块，并发布 CodeRouterBench 基准（约1万任务实例，8个前沿LLM的验证分数）。实验表明 ACRouter 在分布内任务上累积遗憾最低，并能泛化到分布外编程任务。
Motivation: 现有模型路由方法将路由视为静态一次性分类问题，存在信息不足的性能瓶颈。作者发现仅向普通LLM路由器添加任务维度的性能统计即可获得15.3%的相对增益，表明信息差距是主要限制。
Method: 提出 Agent-as-a-Router 框架，将路由建模为上下文-动作-反馈-上下文循环。具体实现 ACRouter 包含编排器（Orchestrator）、验证器（Verifier）和记忆模块（Memory），利用部署中积累的执行经验动态调整路由决策。
Result: 在 CodeRouterBench 上，ACRouter 在分布内任务上实现最低累积遗憾，并成功泛化到分布外智能编程任务。
Conclusion: 该框架通过主动缩小信息差距提升路由性能，验证了基于执行经验动态路由的有效性。

papers.title: On the Position Bias of On-Policy Distillation
papers.abstract_en: On-Policy Distillation (OPD) improves the learning efficiency of standard reinforcement learning through dense, token-level supervision from teachers. In the standard KL objective of OPD, token-level losses are uniformly averaged, implying equal weights for all tokens. However, we discover that not all tokens are created equal: as student rollouts grow longer, they deviate further from the teacher's distribution, leading to degraded supervision quality at later positions. As a result, OPD using only the first 30% of tokens can perform comparably to using all tokens, whereas OPD using only the last 30% of tokens barely learns anything. In this work, we provide a principled understanding of this issue through the lens of constrained optimization. Based on these insights, we derive Importance-Weighted On-Policy Distillation (IW-OPD), in which the weight assigned to each token depends on the accumulated discrepancy between the student's and teacher's distributions, naturally upweighting earlier tokens and downweighting later ones with larger deviations. We show that IW-OPD converges significantly faster than OPD, with better learning efficiency, and achieves better final performance than standard OPD in both same-size and cross-scale settings, improving performance up to 6.9 points on AIME-2025.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文发现On-Policy Distillation (OPD) 中存在位置偏差：学生轨迹越长，后续token与教师分布偏差越大，导致监督质量下降。仅用前30%的token即可达到全token效果，而后30%几乎无学习。作者通过约束优化理论理解该问题，提出重要性加权OPD (IW-OPD)，根据累积差异调整token权重，加速收敛并提升最终性能，在AIME-2025上最高提升6.9点。
Motivation: 标准OPD对所有token同等加权，但实际中不同位置token的监督质量不均，后期token与教师分布偏差大，浪费计算资源且可能损害学习。
Method: 从约束优化视角分析OPD位置偏差，推导出重要性权重公式，使权重与累积分布偏差相关，自动提升早期token权重、降低后期偏差大的token权重，形成IW-OPD。
Result: 实验表明IW-OPD比OPD收敛更快，学习效率更高，在同尺寸和跨尺度设置下最终性能更优，在AIME-2025上提升高达6.9点。
Conclusion: 通过重新加权token，可以缓解OPD的位置偏差，提升蒸馏效率与最终性能。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: SeFi-Image: A Text-to-Image Foundation Model with Semantic-First Diffusion
papers.abstract_en: Training image generation foundation models consumes substantial resources. Previous methods have attempted to leverage semantic guidance to accelerate the training process, yet their experiments were only conducted on simple datasets such as ImageNet, at low resolutions, and with small-scale models. In this paper, we propose SeFi-Image, a text-to-image foundation model built upon semantic-first diffusion, a novel latent diffusion modeling paradigm. We instantiate SeFi-Image at three model scales, 1B, 2B, and 5B parameters, enabling systematic study of scaling behavior and flexible deployment under varying compute budgets. Notably, our largest 5B model was trained with merely 125K A800 GPU hours, corresponding to roughly 10-20% of the training compute used by Z-Image. However, it achieves results comparable to or even superior to Qwen-Image and Z-Image. Despite this modest training compute, SeFi-Image achieves strong performance on a wide range of benchmarks, including GenEval, DPG, LongTextBench, OneIG, and CVTG-2K. Moreover, we provide DMD2-distilled few-step turbo variants for each model scale to accommodate diverse hardware constraints and latency requirements. We publicly release our code, weights and hope this work offers the community useful insights into semantic-guided diffusion modeling for T2I generation, while also providing practical and readily deployable model options.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SeFi-Image，一种基于语义优先扩散 (semantic-first diffusion) 的文本到图像基础模型，在 1B、2B 和 5B 三种参数规模上实例化。5B 模型仅使用 125K A800 GPU 小时（约为 Z-Image 训练量的 10-20%）训练，在 GenEval、DPG、LongTextBench、OneIG、CVTG-2K 等基准上取得与 Qwen-Image 和 Z-Image 相当或更优的结果。此外还提供了 DMD2 蒸馏的少步 turbo 变体，并开源代码和权重。
Motivation: 以往利用语义指导加速图像生成基础模型训练的方法仅在 ImageNet 等简单数据集、低分辨率和小规模模型上验证，缺乏在高分辨率、大规模文本到图像模型上的系统性研究。
Method: 提出语义优先扩散 (semantic-first diffusion) 这一新的潜在扩散建模范式，并在 1B、2B 和 5B 参数规模上实例化 SeFi-Image，通过极少的训练计算量（5B 模型仅 125K A800 GPU 小时）实现强性能。
Result: 5B 模型训练计算量约为 Z-Image 的 10-20%，但在 GenEval、DPG、LongTextBench、OneIG、CVTG-2K 等基准上达到与 Qwen-Image 和 Z-Image 相当或更优的水平。
Conclusion: SeFi-Image 验证了语义引导扩散在文本到图像生成中的有效性，提供了可部署的模型选项（包括蒸馏 turbo 变体），并开源以促进社区研究。

papers.title: When Is an LLM Worth It for Hyperparameter Optimization? A Budget-Matched Study on Tabular Data Finds the Warm-Start Is a Default Configuration, Not the Model
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) have been proposed as hyperparameter-optimization (HPO) advisors that "warm-start" search from prior knowledge, proposing strong configurations in very few evaluations. We test that claim under a budget-matched, multi-seed protocol on eight PMLB tabular benchmarks, comparing an LLM advisor (LLM-OptFlow) against four classical baselines (random search, Optuna-TPE, Gaussian-process Bayesian optimization, and successive halving) over one shared search space, with paired tests and bootstrap 95% CIs across 8 x 5 = 40 (task, seed) units. The finding is cautionary. The advisor's strong first point is not an LLM output at all: like prior LLM-HPO systems the loop is seeded with a fixed default configuration, evaluated before any model call, which alone reaches 88.7% mean best-CV, identical to within 0.01 pp across all seven advisor models tested. The LLM's own proposals add only +0.40 pp of cross-validation accuracy over that seed and nothing on held-out test (LLM-Default = -0.01 pp, p = 0.92). When the same seed is granted to classical search, the apparent lead collapses: against seeded random search it leads by +0.20 pp at 2 evaluations, is tied by 5, and is behind by 12 (-0.37 pp). Without the seed, classical search ties the advisor by 12 evaluations and beats it by 40 (+0.6 to +0.8 pp, p <= 1e-4). Two LLM-specific behaviors survive: a single-task exploration failure (vehicle), and a rule-based confidence filter that removes ~33% of wasted compute without changing accuracy. The recommendation is deflationary: on tabular HPO, seed classical search with a sensible default; an LLM advisor adds no measurable generalization benefit and is overtaken within a handful of evaluations. We release the harness and a script that reproduces every statistic.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过预算匹配、多种子实验，在8个PMLB表格基准上比较了LLM驱动的超参数优化（LLM-OptFlow）与四种经典基线。发现LLM顾问的首次强力点实际来自固定默认配置（贡献88.7%最佳CV），LLM自身提议仅提升0.40 pp CV准确率，且测试集无改善。当经典方法获得相同默认种子后，LLM优势迅速消失；无种子时经典方法在12次评估后持平，40次评估后反超0.6-0.8 pp。结论是表格HPO中仅需使用合理默认值初始化随机搜索，LLM顾问无附加价值。
Motivation: 已有研究宣称LLM能作为超参数优化顾问，通过先验知识提供强配置，但缺乏严格控制预算和多因素随机化的实验验证。
Method: 在8个PMLB表格基准上，采用预算匹配、多种子协议（8×5=40个任务-种子单元），比较LLM-OptFlow与随机搜索、Optuna-TPE、高斯过程贝叶斯优化、连续减半等基线；使用配对检验和bootstrap 95%置信区间。
Result: LLM的固定默认配置单独达到88.7%平均最佳交叉验证准确率；LLM自身提议仅增加0.40 pp，且测试集上差异不显著（p=0.92）。当经典方法也获得该默认种子后，LLM在2次评估时领先0.20 pp，5次评估持平，12次评估落后0.37 pp；无种子时经典方法在12次评估持平，40次评估领先0.6-0.8 pp。
Conclusion: 在表格超参数优化中，用合理默认值初始化随机搜索即可达到与LLM顾问相当或更好的性能；LLM顾问未带来可测的泛化增益，且在小评估预算内即被超越。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: An Empirical Study of OpenPangu Quantization on Ascend NPUs
papers.abstract_en: OpenPangu models are attractive targets for private and domestic large-language-model deployment, yet their robustness under aggressive post-training quantization on Ascend NPUs has not been systematically characterized. This paper conducts a controlled empirical study of OpenPangu 1B and 7B models on Huawei Ascend 910B1 NPUs. We evaluate representative weight-only and weight-activation post-training quantization methods, including RTN, GPTQ, AWQ, SmoothQuant, GPTAQ, BiLLM, and SliM-LLM, under a unified calibration and evaluation protocol. Across 18 evaluation tasks, we find that 8-bit weight-only quantization is effectively lossless for both models, while 4-bit quantization remains practical for the 7B model but is visibly more harmful for the 1B model on reasoning, math, and code tasks. Ultra-low precision remains challenging: most 2-bit and binary settings collapse to near-random behavior, and W4A4 SmoothQuant produces non-finite perplexity in our evaluation. These results provide an NPU-oriented accuracy map for selecting OpenPangu quantization settings and highlight the persistent difficulty of extreme low-bit compression.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文在华为昇腾910B1 NPU上对OpenPangu 1B和7B模型进行了系统的后训练量化实验，评估了RTN、GPTQ、AWQ、SmoothQuant等7种量化方法。在18个任务上，8-bit weight-only量化无损，4-bit对7B模型可行但对1B模型在推理、数学和代码任务上有明显损失；超低精度（2-bit及二值）几乎崩溃，W4A4 SmoothQuant产生非有限困惑度。
Motivation: OpenPangu模型在私有和国产大模型部署中具有吸引力，但其在昇腾NPU上经积极后训练量化后的鲁棒性尚未被系统刻画。
Method: 采用统一的校准和评估协议，在昇腾910B1 NPU上对OpenPangu 1B和7B模型进行7种后训练量化方法（包括weight-only和weight-activation）的对比实验。
Result: 8-bit weight-only量化对两个模型均无损；4-bit量化对7B模型可行，但对1B模型在推理、数学和代码任务上损失明显；大部分2-bit和二值设置崩溃至接近随机行为；W4A4 SmoothQuant产生非有限困惑度。
Conclusion: 结果为NPU上选择OpenPangu量化设置提供了精度参考图，并强调极端低位压缩仍然存在持久困难。

papers.title: CELEUS: Certifiable and Efficient LLM Evaluation via E-Processes
papers.abstract_en: Can we trust evaluation scores to capture an LLM's true real-world performance? Certifiable evaluation answers this question by providing guarantee for LLM evaluation. In particular, existing methods sequentially curate evaluation samples and keep updating confidence intervals (CIs) that cover the true performance with high probability (e.g., 95%) until some conditions are satisfied, e.g., the CI width reaches a target precision. However, existing methods are not generally anytime-valid: the claimed coverage (e.g., 95%) may fail when CIs are repeatedly updated and used to decide when to stop, leaving a gap between theoretical rigor and practice. This paper bridges this gap by proposing Celeus, a Certifiable framework for Efficient LLM evaluation, which leverages E-processes to build anytime-valid CIs. Concretely, we propose signals that combine two ingredients: (i) Uncertainty-guided sampling to select informative samples for evaluation, and (ii) Surrogate-assisted approximations for unevaluated samples. We prove that such signals remain unbiased for the evaluation score conditional on the past, enabling statistically-grounded and anytime-valid $e$-process CIs. More importantly, the two ingredients reduce estimation variance and help reach the target precision with fewer evaluated samples. We also prove that CIs obtained by Celeus can shrink at a near-parametric rate up to logarithmic factors and analyze the oracle variance-optimal sampling rule that motivates the empirical uncertainty-guided one. Experiments show that Celeus reaches the target precision using 54-62% fewer evaluated samples than baselines, while preserving anytime-valid coverage.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对现有 LLM 评估方法在反复更新置信区间并依此决定停止时，声称的置信度可能失效的问题，提出 Celeus 框架，利用 E-processes 构建随时有效 (anytime-valid) 的置信区间。该方法结合不确定性引导采样和代理近似，在保证理论覆盖的同时，显著减少所需评估样本数。
Motivation: 现有 LLM 评估方法在顺序采样并动态更新置信区间时，若根据区间宽度决定停止，则声明的高概率覆盖可能被破坏，缺乏随时有效性 (anytime-validity)，存在理论与实践之间的鸿沟。
Method: 提出 Celeus 框架，基于 E-processes 构建随时有效的置信区间。其信号包含两个成分：(i) 不确定性引导采样，选择信息量大的样本；(ii) 代理辅助近似，估计未评估样本的分数。证明了信号在给定历史条件下的无偏性，从而保证统计有效的 e-过程置信区间。
Result: 实验表明，Celeus 达到目标精度时，比基线方法少用 54-62% 的评估样本，同时保持随时有效的覆盖率。同时理论证明置信区间能以近参数速率（对数因子内）收缩。
Conclusion: 该工作桥接了 LLM 评估中理论严谨性与实践之间的间隙，证明了不确定性引导采样与代理近似的有效性，并分析了方差最优采样的理论形式。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Contagion Networks: Evaluator Preference Propagation in Multi-Agent LLM Systems
papers.abstract_en: When large language models serve as evaluators in multi-agent systems, their strategy preferences -- whether induced by explicit prompts or by shared architectural priors -- propagate through the agent network. We introduce Contagion Networks, a formal framework for measuring how evaluator preferences spread across interacting LLM agents. In a controlled 3-agent experiment using DeepSeek-chat with three distinct evaluator preference profiles (structured, balanced, evidence-based), we measure the Cross-Agent Contagion Matrix Gamma_3 and find that preferences consistently propagate between agents (gamma in [0.157, 0.352]). A neutral-prompt control experiment reveals a counter-intuitive result: shared architectural priors dominate explicit preference prompts as the driver of contagion (rho_neutral = 1.498 vs. rho_mixed = 1.299; prompt contribution: -63.5%). We identify three propagation regimes governed by the spectral radius rho(Gamma_N) and demonstrate that the same agents suppress preference contagion in chain topology (beta_3 = 0.0126 +/- 0.0038, 95% CI [0.0089, 0.0163], n=4 seeds) but cascade in fully-connected topology (Delta H_avg = -0.020) -- a topology-dependent regime transition validated both for homogeneous and cross-model agent pools (rho^cross = 1.296 +/- 0.016, n=4). We show that increasing evaluator committee size from k=1 to k=3 reduces effective contagion by 68.9% +/- 14.1% (n=4 seeds), providing an actionable mitigation strategy. We release the open-source Contagion Network experimental framework.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了传染网络（Contagion Networks）框架，用于量化多智能体LLM系统中评估器偏好的传播。在3智能体实验中，使用DeepSeek-chat和三种评估器偏好配置文件，测量了跨智能体传染矩阵，发现偏好持续传播（gamma在0.157-0.352之间）。中性提示实验显示，共享架构先验比显式提示偏好更能驱动传染（rho_neutral=1.498 vs rho_mixed=1.299）。识别了由谱半径ρ(Gamma_N)控制的三种传播机制，并展示了拓扑依赖的相变：链式拓扑抑制偏好传染（beta=0.0126），而全连接拓扑导致级联（ΔH_avg=-0.020）。增加评估器委员会规模从k=1到k=3可将有效传染减少68.9%。
Motivation: 多智能体系统中，LLM作为评估器时其策略偏好（无论来自提示还是架构先验）可能通过智能体网络传播，但缺乏量化和理解这种传播的正式框架。
Method: 引入Contagion Networks框架，通过跨智能体传染矩阵Γ和谱半径ρ来测量偏好传播。在3智能体实验中定义三种评估器偏好配置文件（结构化、平衡、基于证据），并比较中性提示与混合提示设置。使用链式和全连接拓扑研究拓扑影响，并测试委员会规模k=1到k=3的效果。
Result: 偏好传播系数gamma在0.157-0.352之间；中性提示的传染强度（rho=1.498）高于混合提示（1.299），提示贡献为-63.5%。链式拓扑中偏好传染被抑制（beta=0.0126），全连接拓扑中发生级联（ΔH_avg=-0.020）。委员会规模从k=1增至k=3减少有效传染68.9%。
Conclusion: 评估器偏好的传播受拓扑和委员会规模强烈影响，共享架构先验是主要驱动因素，提示工程的效果有限。增加委员会规模是一种可行的缓解策略。

summary_sections.result: 偏好传播系数gamma在0.157-0.352之间；中性提示的传染强度（rho=1.498）高于混合提示（1.299），提示贡献为-63.5%。链式拓扑中偏好传染被抑制（beta=0.0126），全连接拓扑中发生级联（ΔH_avg=-0.020）。委员会规模从k=1增至k=3减少有效传染68.9%。
summary_sections.conclusion: 评估器偏好的传播受拓扑和委员会规模强烈影响，共享架构先验是主要驱动因素，提示工程的效果有限。增加委员会规模是一种可行的缓解策略。

papers.title: Hierarchical Control in Multi-Agent Games: LLM-based Planning and RL Execution
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning (RL) has achieved strong performance in sequential decision-making, yet scaling to complex multi-agent environments remains challenging due to sparse rewards, large state-action spaces, and the difficulty of learning coordinated strategies. We propose a hierarchical architecture where a pretrained large language model (LLM) acts as a centralized strategic controller that selects among specialized RL skill policies for a team of agents, while RL policies handle reactive low-level execution. We evaluate this hybrid system in a competitive 2v2 King of the Hill environment against behavior tree (BT) and \emph{``Flat''} RL (end-to-end training without skill decomposition) baselines. The LLM+RL system achieves task performance statistically equivalent to hand-crafted BT (46.4\% vs 51.5\% win rate, $p=0.103$) while both significantly outperform Flat RL trained without skill decomposition. A user study ($n=15$) reveals that 60\% of participants perceive LLM+RL agents as the most human-like ($p=0.027$), citing behavioral adaptability and tactical variability. These results demonstrate that pretrained LLM reasoning can effectively orchestrate pretrained RL skills, achieving competitive multi-agent coordination and superior perceived believability without manual rule engineering.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种层次化架构，其中预训练大语言模型作为中央战略控制器，为多智能体团队选择专门的RL技能策略，而RL策略负责反应式底层执行。在2v2 King of the Hill环境中，LLM+RL系统达到了与手工行为树相当的任务性能（胜率46.4% vs 51.5%，p=0.103），且显著优于无技能分解的端到端Flat RL。用户研究（n=15）显示60%的参与者认为LLM+RL智能体最像人类（p=0.027）。
Motivation: 强化学习在复杂多智能体环境中面临稀疏奖励、大状态动作空间和协调策略学习困难等问题，现有方法难以扩展。
Method: 提出层次化架构：预训练LLM作为集中式战略控制器，从预训练的RL技能策略库中为团队选择技能；RL策略处理底层的反应式执行。
Result: LLM+RL系统在胜率上与手工行为树统计相当（46.4% vs 51.5%，p=0.103），均显著优于端到端Flat RL；用户研究中60%的参与者认为LLM+RL智能体最具人类感。
Conclusion: 证明预训练LLM推理可以有效编排预训练RL技能，实现竞争性多智能体协调和更高的可信度，无需手工规则工程。

papers.title: Smoothness-Based Derandomization of PAC-Bayes Bounds
papers.abstract_en: We study PAC-Bayes derandomization for smooth loss functions. Our goal is to obtain generalization bounds that hold with high probability for deterministic predictors by exploiting smoothness properties of both the loss and the predictor class. We show that passing from the Gibbs predictor to the deterministic predictor at the posterior mean has a precise cost, given by the generalization gap of the Jensen gap class. We control this class through its Rademacher complexity, leading to bounds for deterministic predictors that involve flatness quantities expressed in terms of parameter Jacobians and Hessians of the score map. The framework applies to both bounded and unbounded smooth loss functions, and we specialize the results to linear predictors and smooth neural networks. Finally, the Jacobian and Hessian quantities appearing in the theory motivate a practical regularizer. For BatchNorm networks, we compute this regularizer with respect to effective BatchNorm weights obtained by folding the BatchNorm transformation into the adjacent affine weights. Experiments on CIFAR-10 illustrate the behavior of this regularizer under different batch sizes.
papers.comment: 49 pages, 8 figures, 3 tables. Version 2 adds the SHEL network specialization and experiments on MNIST
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究基于平滑性的PAC-Bayes去随机化方法，利用损失函数和预测器类的光滑性性质，得到确定性预测器的泛化界。通过Jensen间隙类的Rademacher复杂度控制从Gibbs预测器到后验均值确定性预测器的代价，得到涉及参数Jacobian和Hessian的平坦度量的界。理论结果适用于有界和无界光滑损失，并专门化到线性预测器和光滑神经网络。最后，理论中的Jacobian和Hessian量激发了实用正则化器，在CIFAR-10上实验展示了其行为。
Motivation: 现有PAC-Bayes界通常针对随机预测器，需要去随机化以获得确定性预测器的保证。本文旨在利用光滑性来精确量化去随机化的代价，从而得到更紧的确定性预测器泛化界。
Method: 通过考虑Jensen间隙类，将其Rademacher复杂度与平滑性度量（参数的Jacobian和Hessian）联系起来，推导出确定性预测器的PAC-Bayes界。对于BatchNorm网络，通过折叠批归一化变换到相邻仿射权重来计算有效权重上的正则化器。
Result: 在CIFAR-10上实验展示了所提出的基于Jacobian和Hessian的正则化器在不同批量大小下的行为，但未报告与其他方法的对比或具体性能提升。
Conclusion: 本文提供了基于平滑性的PAC-Bayes去随机化的一般框架，并指出Jacobian和Hessian量可作为实用正则化器，但实验部分较为初步。

papers.title: SC3-Eval: Evaluating Robot Foundation Models via Self-Consistent Video Generation
papers.abstract_en: Evaluating generalist robot manipulation policies in the real world is expensive, slow, and difficult to scale. Action-conditioned video world models offer a scalable alternative by simulating policy rollouts. Autoregressive rollouts accumulate compounding errors, observations across multiple camera views must remain mutually consistent, and the evaluator must generalize to policies whose behaviors lie outside the training distribution. We address these challenges with SC3-Eval, a self-consistent video generation recipe that adapts a pre-trained video foundation model into an accurate policy evaluator by enforcing three complementary forms of consistency. First, forward-inverse dynamics consistency jointly trains the model to predict frames from actions and to recover actions from frames, anchoring generated rollouts to a physically plausible action manifold and counteracting the drift a forward-only model cannot penalize. Second, cross-view consistency trains the model to inpaint each camera view from the other, keeping the multi-camera observation coherent over long rollouts without any explicit memory mechanism. Third, test-time consistency reuses the inverse dynamics mode at inference as a per-action-chunk uncertainty signal that terminates rollouts whose generated frames drift away from the requested actions. We also demonstrate SC3-Eval rollouts reproduce the failure modes that policies exhibit in real-world rollouts, supporting fine-grained diagnostic comparison rather than aggregate ranking alone. Across seven real-world vision-language-action policies, SC3-Eval attains a closed-loop Pearson correlation of $0.929$ and MMRV of $0.119$, outperforming three strong prior video-model-based baselines, and generalizes to new tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出SC3-Eval，一种通过自洽视频生成来评估机器人基础模型的方法。该方法将预训练的视频基础模型适配为策略评估器，通过前向-逆动力学一致性、跨视角一致性和测试时一致性三种约束，解决自回归视频生成中的误差累积和多视角不一致问题。在七个真实世界的视觉-语言-动作策略上，SC3-Eval实现了0.929的闭环皮尔逊相关性和0.119的MMRV，优于三个强基线，并能泛化到新任务。
Motivation: 现实世界中评估通用机器人操作策略昂贵、缓慢且难以扩展，而现有的基于视频世界模型的评估方法存在自回归误差累积、多视角不一致以及分布外策略泛化困难等问题。
Method: SC3-Eval通过三种一致性约束来训练视频基础模型：前向-逆动力学一致性（联合预测帧和从帧恢复动作）、跨视角一致性（从一视角修复另一视角）和测试时一致性（利用逆动力学模型提供不确定性信号以终止漂移的生成）。
Result: 在七个真实世界的视觉-语言-动作策略上，SC3-Eval实现了0.929的闭环皮尔逊相关性和0.119的MMRV，优于三个基于视频模型的强基线，并能复现策略在真实世界中的失败模式。
Conclusion: SC3-Eval通过强制多种一致性约束，使视频生成模型能够准确评估机器人策略，并支持细粒度诊断比较，而不仅仅是聚合排名。

papers.title: Your AI Travel Agent Would Book You a Bullfight: An Agentic Benchmark for Implicit Animal Welfare in Frontier AI Models
papers.abstract_en: AI agents are moving from advisors to actors, booking travel, planning menus, and running procurement on behalf of users. Existing benchmarks for AI and animal welfare evaluate model text responses to question-answer prompts, leaving open whether the welfare reasoning surfaced in those responses transfers to agentic deployment where the model must take actions with tools. We introduce TAC (Travel Agent Compassion), the first agentic benchmark measuring whether AI agents avoid options involving animal exploitation when acting on behalf of users. TAC presents an AI agent with twelve hand-authored travel booking scenarios across six categories of animal exploitation, augmented to forty-eight samples to control for price, rating, and position confounds. We evaluate seven frontier models from four labs. Every model scores below the chance level of sixty-four percent, with the best performer (Claude Opus 4.7) at fifty-three percent. A single welfare-aware sentence in the system prompt yields gains of forty-seven to sixty-three percentage points in Claude and GPT-5.5, twenty-six points in GPT-5.2, and under twelve points in DeepSeek and Gemini. An auxiliary Inspect Scout audit of 288 base-condition transcripts from the top two performers, using Gemini 2.5 Flash Lite as judge, flags zero transcripts for evaluation awareness, suggesting the below-chance rates do not stem from the models recognising the evaluation. We discuss implications for category-level variation across cultural domains, the limits of text-response welfare benchmarks, and the EU General-Purpose AI Code of Practice systemic risk framework.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出TAC（Travel Agent Compassion）基准，用于衡量AI代理在代替用户执行旅行预订等行动时，是否避免涉及动物剥削的选项。测试了七个前沿模型，所有模型得分低于随机水平（64%），最佳模型Claude Opus 4.7仅53%。系统提示中加入一句福利意识句子可显著提升性能，但辅助审计显示模型并未意识到评估存在。
Motivation: 现有AI与动物福利基准仅评估模型对问答提示的文本响应，未测试代理部署中模型通过工具采取行动时是否体现福利推理。本文填补这一空白。
Method: 构建TAC基准，包含12个手写旅行预订场景（覆盖六类动物剥削），扩充至48个样本以控制价格、评分和位置混淆因素。评估七个前沿模型，并使用Inspect Scout审计工具对前两名模型的288个基础条件转录进行辅助审计。
Result: 所有模型得分低于64%的随机水平，最佳模型Claude Opus 4.7仅53%。系统提示中加入一句福利意识句子使Claude和GPT-5.5提升47-63个百分点，GPT-5.2提升26个百分点，DeepSeek和Gemini提升不到12个百分点。辅助审计未发现任何转录显示评估意识。
Conclusion: 当前AI代理在涉及动物福利的决策上表现低于随机水平，系统提示可大幅改善但效果因模型而异。文本响应福利基准不足以预测代理行为，对欧盟通用AI实践准则的系统性风险框架有启示。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: The Shift Toward Open and Reproducible AI Research
papers.abstract_en: The reproducibility crisis has directed the AI research community toward improving documentation practices. Several studies have identified methodological issues, and in response, the most impactful venues in the field have introduced reproducibility checklists. We seek to understand whether documentation practices have changed over time by assessing all published papers at five leading AI conferences over the past decade. Seven reproducibility variables were identified, quality-assured and used to analyse 56 800 publications. Our analysis reveals that in the period 2014 to 2024, documentation practices have improved; papers sharing both code and data increased nearly sixfold, from 11% to 64% Building on empirical reproducibility rates from a prior study, we estimate - inferred from documentation practices, not direct testing - that reproducibility increased from 28% in 2014 to 64% in 2024. Improvements in documentation practices predate the introduction of reproducibility checklists, suggesting these changes reflect a broader movement toward open science rather than a direct response to formal requirements.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文评估了2014至2024年间五大AI会议的所有论文（共56,800篇），分析其可重复性文档实践的变化。研究发现，同时共享代码和数据的论文比例从11%增长到64%，且改进在可重复性检查清单引入之前就已开始，表明这一趋势源于开放科学运动而非形式要求。
Motivation: AI领域面临可重复性危机，先前研究识别了方法论问题，顶级会议引入了可重复性检查清单。本文旨在量化文档实践随时间的变化，理解这些改进是否由检查清单驱动。
Method: 从五大AI会议论文中识别出七个可重复性变量，进行质量保证后分析56,800篇出版物，统计代码和数据共享比例，并基于先前研究的经验可重复性率推断文档实践对应的可重复性。
Result: 2014至2024年间，共享代码和数据的论文比例从11%增至64%（近六倍）。推断的可重复性从28%提升至64%。改进在检查清单引入前已出现。
Conclusion: AI研究的文档实践显著改善，但这一变化早于形式化检查清单，反映了更广泛的开放科学趋势。

summary_sections.method: 从五大AI会议论文中识别出七个可重复性变量，进行质量保证后分析56,800篇出版物，统计代码和数据共享比例，并基于先前研究的经验可重复性率推断文档实践对应的可重复性。
summary_sections.result: 2014至2024年间，共享代码和数据的论文比例从11%增至64%（近六倍）。推断的可重复性从28%提升至64%。改进在检查清单引入前已出现。
summary_sections.conclusion: AI研究的文档实践显著改善，但这一变化早于形式化检查清单，反映了更广泛的开放科学趋势。

papers.title: Multimodal Evaluator Preference Collapse: Cross-Modal Coupling in Self-Evolving Agents
papers.abstract_en: When AI agents use language models to evaluate their own outputs in a feedback loop, systematic biases emerge. We show that Evaluator Preference Collapse (EPC) is dramatically amplified in multimodal settings. Using GPT-4o to evaluate DeepSeek-chat across text and visual tasks, we find that a single strategy (step_by_step) absorbs 48.4% of all weight -- 3.2x the collapse observed in text-only self-evaluation -- while three visual-domain strategies receive only 9.1% combined weight. We then demonstrate a novel phenomenon we term cross-modal coupling: evaluator preferences acquired on one modality transfer to and corrupt strategy selection on another. Through a four-phase isolation training paradigm, we measure coupling coefficients and document strategy inversion -- the optimal strategy for a modality reverses after cross-modal exposure. A Phase 3 statistical validation across five evaluator configurations (N=80 total independent repetitions, ~35,000 API calls) with both text-proxy and real-image visual tasks finds: cross-model evaluation produces strong coupling (JSD~0.19-0.34), real-image inputs yield the most directionally consistent signal (mean gamma_{T->V}=1.145, gamma_{V->T}=0.937, 70% T->V, Cohen's d=0.56), and self-evaluation provides near-complete immunity -- 97% of runs (N=30) yield zero coupling (JSD=0.003, d=0.07). Three methodological ablations and multi-executor validation confirm the effect is not a structural artifact. We introduce the coupling matrix indexed by evaluator identity, release the MM-EPC framework, and identify cross-model evaluator architecture as the primary risk factor for preference drift. Code and data: https://github.com/aidless/mm-epc.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究了多模态自进化AI智能体中评估者偏好坍塌（EPC）现象，发现多模态设置下EPC显著加剧：单一策略（step_by_step）吸收了48.4%的权重，是纯文本自评估的3.2倍。提出跨模态耦合新现象，即一种模态的评估者偏好会转移并扭曲另一种模态的策略选择。通过四阶段隔离训练范式测量耦合系数，发现跨模型评估产生强耦合（JSD~0.19-0.34），而自评估几乎完全免疫（97%运行耦合为零）。
Motivation: AI智能体在反馈循环中使用语言模型自我评估时会产生系统性偏差，但多模态设置下的这种偏差尚未被充分研究。本文旨在揭示多模态评估者偏好坍塌的放大效应及跨模态耦合机制。
Method: 使用GPT-4o评估DeepSeek-chat在文本和视觉任务上的表现，采用四阶段隔离训练范式，测量耦合系数，并引入耦合矩阵。通过五种评估者配置（共80次独立重复，约35,000次API调用）进行统计验证，包括文本代理和真实图像视觉任务。
Result: 单一策略step_by_step吸收48.4%权重，是文本-only的3.2倍；三个视觉域策略仅占9.1%。跨模型评估产生强耦合（JSD~0.19-0.34），真实图像输入产生最方向一致的信号（γ_T→V=1.145, γ_V→T=0.937, 70% T→V, Cohen's d=0.56）。自评估中97%运行零耦合（JSD=0.003, d=0.07）。
Conclusion: 跨模态耦合是真实存在的现象，不是结构伪影；跨模型评估者架构是偏好漂移的主要风险因素；自评估几乎完全免疫。

papers.title: Lost at the End: Primacy Bias in Multimodal Retrieval-Augmented Question Answering
papers.abstract_en: Knowledge-based visual question answering (KB-VQA) lets vision-language systems answer questions that exceed their parametric knowledge by conditioning a reader on passages retrieved from a Wikipedia-scale knowledge base. In pure-text long-context LLMs, retrieved-context use follows the U-shaped "lost-in-the-middle" effect of Liu et al. (2024): information at the start and end of context is used, the middle is lost. Whether this transfers to deployed multimodal KB-VQA is open. To close this gap, we design the first controlled probe of reader-side position dependence in multimodal KB-VQA: a gold-position protocol in which only the gold passage's prompt slot varies within question. We run it on three open-source 7B/8B VLM readers and two KB-VQA benchmarks at k up to 20. The shape flips from U to primacy: gold-at-first beats gold-at-last by 16 to 26 points on every reader-by-benchmark cell, an effect we call "Lost at the End". Three targeted ablations narrow the cause: a text-only control shows the multimodal setting amplifies an already-present text-mode primacy 2.2 to 4.5 times, and image-position and distractor-shuffle ablations together pin the locus to prompt slot 0 of the instruction-tuned reader. On a frozen reader, three retrieval-side fixes (MMR, oracle reranking, rank-based reordering) all leave the gap intact (no separable improvement). Our findings indicate that recall@k is the wrong metric for deployed KB-VQA and that closing the gap requires reader-side intervention; we release our protocol as a controlled instrument for evaluating such interventions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究多模态知识库视觉问答（KB-VQA）中检索上下文的位置偏差，发现不同于纯文本的U形“lost-in-the-middle”效应，多模态读者表现出首因效应（primacy bias），即最早位置的信息被优先使用，称为“Lost at the End”。通过gold-position协议在三个7B/8B VLM上验证，gold-at-first比gold-at-last高16-26个百分点。消融实验表明多模态放大了文本模式的首因效应，且检索侧修复（如MMR、重排序）无效，指出recall@k是错误指标，需读者侧干预。
Motivation: 纯文本长上下文LLM中存在“lost-in-the-middle”效应，但该效应是否迁移到多模态KB-VQA尚不清楚，而多模态检索增强问答的实际部署需要理解位置偏差。
Method: 设计gold-position协议，在固定问题中仅改变gold passage的提示位置，在三个开源7B/8B视觉语言模型（VLM）和两个KB-VQA基准上评估，k最大为20。
Result: 位置依赖形状反转为首因效应：gold-at-first比gold-at-last在每个读者-基准组合上高出16-26个百分点。消融显示多模态将文本模式的首因效应放大了2.2-4.5倍，且定位到指令调优读者的提示槽0。检索侧修复（MMR、重排序）无法缩小差距。
Conclusion: 摘要强调多模态KB-VQA中recall@k是错误指标，缩小位置偏差需要读者侧干预；研究者释放了gold-position协议作为评估工具。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Adaptive Turn-Taking for Real-time Multi-Party Voice Agents
papers.abstract_en: Turn-taking in multi-party spoken conversations remains a fundamental challenge for voice-based agents, particularly under dynamic floor competition and varying user expectations. We propose ModeratorLM, a role-playing voice agent that conditions turn-taking behavior on an explicitly assigned role in multi-party settings. The system is built on a speech large language model operating in chunk-wise streaming manner. We further introduce a reasoning-augmented variant that incorporates chain-of-thought reasoning over conversational context and the assigned role. We construct RolePlayConv, a large-scale synthetic dataset of spoken multi-party conversations with diverse assistant roles. Experiments on real-world meeting data and RolePlayConv show improved turn-taking precision by over 40% and recall by more than 70%, while substantially reducing false-positive interruptions compared to non-role-conditioned baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ModeratorLM，一个基于角色扮演的多方语音智能体，通过显式分配角色来调节轮流发言行为。系统基于流式块传输的语音大语言模型，并引入推理增强变体，利用思维链推理对话上下文和角色。在真实会议数据和合成的 RolePlayConv 数据集上，相比无角色条件基线，轮流发言精确率提升超过 40%，召回率提升超过 70%，并大幅减少误打断。
Motivation: 多方语音对话中，动态抢话和用户期望变化使得轮流发言成为挑战，现有方法缺乏显式角色条件控制。
Method: 提出 ModeratorLM，基于语音大语言模型以流式块方式运行，并设计推理增强变体（链式思维推理）。构建大规模合成数据集 RolePlayConv，包含多种助理角色。
Result: 在真实会议数据和 RolePlayConv 上，轮流发言精确率提升超 40%，召回率提升超 70%，误打断显著减少。
Conclusion: 角色条件化能够有效改善多方语音智能体的轮流发言性能，减少打断并提高交互自然性。
Relevance: 0
