papers.title: Conformal Bayes under Label Shift: Post-Hoc Calibration vs. In-Training Adaptation
papers.abstract_en: Conformal Bayes combines Bayesian posterior predictives with conformal calibration to produce prediction sets that are both statistically valid and geometrically efficient. We study conformal Bayes under label shift from a unified perspective, identifying two complementary approaches that restore nominal target-domain coverage through importance-weighted conformal calibration but operate through independent mechanisms. \emph{Post-hoc calibration} tilts the posterior predictive toward the target domain and corrects the conformal threshold via an importance-weighted quantile, leaving the parameter posterior unchanged. \emph{In-training adaptation} tilts the parameter posterior itself to the target domain, producing a corrected predictive whose highest predictive density region serves as the highest predictive density (HPD)-based prediction set under the fitted target predictive; efficiency is model-dependent and does not imply finite-sample conditional optimality. Two controlled experiments isolate the regime-dependence of each strategy: in the low-dimensional, well-estimated regime Strategy~A produces the narrowest valid intervals, while in the high-dimensional, underdetermined regime Strategy~B achieves up to $43\%$ width reduction at unchanged coverage, under the stated source-sampling and label-shift assumptions.
papers.comment: 2nd Workshop on Epistemic Intelligence in Machine Learning (EIML@ICML 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文统一研究了标签偏移下的共形贝叶斯（Conformal Bayes）方法，识别出两种互补的校准策略：事后校准（post-hoc calibration）通过重要性加权调整共形阈值，保留参数后验不变；训练内适应（in-training adaptation）则倾斜参数后验本身，产生修正后的预测集。实验表明，在低维、估计良好的场景下事后校准产生最窄的有效区间；在高维、欠定场景下训练内适应在保持覆盖率不变的情况下实现高达43%的宽度缩减。
Motivation: 标准共形贝叶斯在训练与目标分布存在标签偏移时，预测集的覆盖保证失效，需要有效的校准策略来恢复名义目标域覆盖率。
Method: 提出两种重要性加权共形校准方法：策略A（事后校准）倾斜后验预测并调整共形阈值；策略B（训练内适应）直接倾斜参数后验，利用最高预测密度区域构建HPD预测集。
Result: 在低维、估计良好设定下策略A产生最窄有效区间；在高维、欠定设定下策略B在保持覆盖率下实现高达43%的宽度缩减。
Conclusion: 两种策略通过独立机制恢复名义覆盖率，且有效性依赖于数据维度与估计状况；策略B的效率是模型依赖的，不保证有限样本条件最优性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Kuramoto Attention: Synchronizing Self-Attention on the Torus
papers.abstract_en: Transformer models are increasingly used as computational models of cognition and neural representation, so the mechanism implemented by self-attention is of interest beyond engineering performance. A complementary tradition in cognitive science models coordination, binding, and memory through dynamical interactions such as oscillator synchrony; we bring this mechanism into self-attention by introducing the Kuramoto Attention layer, whose value update is a synchronization step. Each token carries a bank of phase oscillators, so its hidden state lives on a high-dimensional torus. The attention weights form an adaptive coupling graph, and using the raw phase states as values makes the value update exactly the Kuramoto coupling direction for fixed attention weights. The softmax selects which oscillators couple, while the value path moves each token toward the attention-weighted circular mean of the tokens it selects. We train Kuramoto Attention on enwiki8 and CodeParrot against parameter-matched RoPE and SwiGLU transformers. At 5M parameters on CodeParrot, it improves on the transformer by both median and mean, with mean gaps of 0.012 validation and 0.010 test bits per byte. At 5M on enwiki8, all six runs have lower validation/test medians than the transformer and all-seed means within 0.01 BPC; five of six also form a tight lower-mean cluster. At 1M, it trails by about 0.02 BPC on enwiki8 and by 0.013-0.015 bits per byte on CodeParrot. Ablations and phase diagnostics show how the layer's synchronization and geometry-motivated components shape model performance. The result is a self-attention mechanism whose learned computation can be read directly as adaptive synchronization on phase states.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Kuramoto Attention 层，将自注意力机制中的值更新建模为高维环面上的相位同步过程。每个 token 携带一组相位振子，注意力权重形成自适应耦合图，值更新恰好是固定注意力权重下的久保田耦合方向。在 enwiki8 和 CodeParrot 数据集上，与参数匹配的 RoPE 和 SwiGLU Transformer 相比，5M 参数下 Kuramoto Attention 在 CodeParrot 上平均验证和测试 bits per byte 分别低 0.012 和 0.010，在 enwiki8 上所有种子均值差距在 0.01 BPC 以内。消融实验和相位诊断揭示了同步与几何动机组件的作用。
Motivation: Transformer 模型被广泛用于认知和神经表示的计算模型，自注意力的实现机制值得探索。认知科学中，振荡同步被用于建模协调、绑定和记忆，本文将这一机制引入自注意力。
Method: 提出 Kuramoto Attention 层：每个 token 的隐藏状态位于高维环面，由一组相位振子表示；注意力权重构成自适应耦合图；值更新采用久保田耦合方向，即固定注意力权重下的同步步；softmax 选择哪些振子耦合，值路径将每个 token 移向其所选 token 的注意力加权圆均值。
Result: 在 5M 参数 CodeParrot 上，Kuramoto Attention 的验证和测试 bits per byte 均值比 Transformer 低 0.012 和 0.010；在 5M enwiki8 上，所有六次运行的验证/测试中位数均低于 Transformer，所有种子均值在 0.01 BPC 以内；在 1M 参数下，enwiki8 上落后约 0.02 BPC，CodeParrot 上落后 0.013-0.015 bits per byte。
Conclusion: Kuramoto Attention 是一个可以直接解读为相位状态自适应同步的自注意力机制，其性能与参数匹配的 Transformer 相当或更优，尤其在中等规模参数下表现突出。

papers.title: Annealed Entropic Allocation for Ranking and Selection
papers.abstract_en: We propose annealed entropic allocation, an adaptive sampling policy based on an annealed, weighted soft-min formulation of static budget allocation. We replace the maximin large-deviation rate objective with a weighted log-sum-exp surrogate that blends challenger-specific pairwise scores through soft-min weights, avoiding hard switching when several challengers are nearly active. To capture tail behavior beyond the leading exponent, the surrogate incorporates saddlepoint prefactors from refined pairwise tail asymptotics. Because these corrections are subexponential, decreasing the annealing temperature with the budget preserves the same first-order target allocation. For the static problem, we prove uniform convergence to the hard minimum, concentration of soft-min weights on active challengers, and continuity of the induced target-allocation map under fixed weights. Experiments show that the proposed methods are consistently competitive: the no-saddlepoint ablation performs best in symmetric Gaussian and exponential slippage settings, while saddlepoint weighting can help in heterogeneous or asymmetric cases.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出退火熵分配（annealed entropic allocation），一种基于退火加权软最小化（soft-min）公式的自适应采样策略，用于静态预算分配问题。该方法用加权log-sum-exp代理替代最大化大偏差率目标，通过软最小权重融合挑战者成对分数，避免在多个挑战者接近活跃时硬切换，并引入鞍点前因子捕捉尾部行为。理论证明该策略在静态问题中一致收敛到硬最小值，且软最小权重集中在活跃挑战者上。实验表明，在对称高斯和指数滑移设置中无鞍点版本表现最佳，而鞍点加权在异质或非对称情形中有帮助。
Motivation: 现有排名与选择（ranking and selection）方法在大偏差率框架下存在硬切换问题，当多个备选方案几乎同样活跃时决策不稳定。
Method: 提出退火熵分配：利用加权log-sum-exp代理函数和软最小权重替代硬最小化，并融入鞍点前因子修正尾部渐近；通过退火温度随预算降低保持一阶目标分配。
Result: 实验表明该方法在各种设置中表现稳定：对称高斯和指数滑移下无鞍点版本最优，异质或非对称情形中鞍点加权更有效。
Conclusion: 退火熵分配能有效解决静态预算分配中的硬切换问题，且理论保证收敛性和权重集中性，适用于一般排名与选择问题。

papers.title: Advancing Wood Identification in the Philippines: Utilizing the Xylorix Platform for Efficient AI Model Development and Deployment for Five Key Species
papers.abstract_en: Illegal logging and timber trade continue to pose significant challenges in the Philippines, where accurate wood species identification is essential for enforcement but limited by the need for specialised equipment and expertise. This study aims to evaluate whether AI models for macroscopic wood identification can be developed and deployed by wood scientists without programming expertise using the Xylorix platform, focusing on five Philippine hardwood species: Mangium (Acacia mangium Willd.), Rain Tree [Samanea saman (Jacq.) Merr.], Banuyo (Wallaceodendron celebicum Koord.), Tindalo [Afzelia rhomboidea (Blanco) Vidal], and Ipil [Intsia bijuga (Colebr.) O. Kuntze]. Binary classifiers were trained on 10,663 verified cross-section images from 260 specimens and evaluated using specimen-level mean scoring to mirror operational field conditions. Area Under the ROC Curve (AUC) values ranged from 0.969 (Ipil) to 1.000 (Mangium), and Average Precision (AP) values ranged from 0.589 (Samanea) to 1.000 (Mangium). Four of five species achieved AA grade (AUC and AP both \geq 0.90); Rain Tree received AE (AUC \geq 0.90, AP < 0.60) due to AP compression from its small positive test set (3 specimens). All five classifiers rank their target specimens above non-target specimens with near-perfect fidelity. Specimen-level error analysis revealed 9 false negatives from Ipil, primarily stemming from localized image artifacts and 3 false positives for Rain Tree and 1 false positive for Tindalo caused by shared tribal-level anatomical traits. These findings demonstrate that Xylorix non-programmers can leverage the Xylorix platform to construct operationally reliable wood identification models suitable for field deployment at supply chain checkpoints.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文评估了非编程专业人员使用Xylorix平台开发木材识别AI模型的能力，聚焦菲律宾五种硬木。基于260个标本的10,663张横截面图像训练二元分类器，AUC范围为0.969至1.000，平均精度（AP）范围为0.589至1.000。五种中有四种达到AA级（AUC和AP均≥0.90），Rain Tree因小测试集获得AE级。结果表明Xylorix平台可用于构建操作可靠的木材识别模型。
Motivation: 菲律宾非法采伐和木材贸易需要准确的木材物种识别，但现有方法依赖专门设备和专业知识，限制了执法。本文旨在评估非编程专家能否利用Xylorix平台开发可部署的AI模型。
Method: 使用Xylorix平台，由木材科学家无编程经验地训练二元分类器。数据集包括260个标本的10,663张横截面图像，采用标本级均值评分模拟现场条件。
Result: AUC从0.969（Ipil）到1.000（Mangium），AP从0.589（Samanea）到1.000（Mangium）。四种物种达到AA级，Rain Tree因小阳性测试集（3个标本）导致AP压缩，获得AE级。所有分类器以接近完美的保真度对目标标本进行排序。
Conclusion: 非编程人员可以使用Xylorix平台构建操作可靠的木材识别模型，适合供应链检查点现场部署。错误分析显示Ipil的假阴性源于局部图像伪影，Rain Tree和Tindalo的假阳性源于共享的部落级解剖特征。

papers.title: Schmidt Decomposition-Based Methods for Efficient Quantum Image Encoding
papers.abstract_en: In quantum image processing, a fundamental step is encoding classical image data into quantum states. This can be achieved using methods such as Flexible Representation of Quantum Images (FRQI), Quantum Probability Image Encoding (QPIE), and Novel Enhanced Quantum Representation (NEQR). However, on real quantum hardware, these encodings can quickly lead to circuits with many gates, large circuit depth, and high qubit usage, which is a problem for Noisy Intermediate-Scale Quantum (NISQ) devices. In this work, we investigate whether low-rank state approximation, formulated via Schmidt decomposition, can help reduce this complexity. The method keeps only the most significant parts of a quantum state's entanglement structure, making state preparation more efficient while preserving most of the image information. We compare the three encoding techniques in their original form and with low-rank approximation, evaluating metrics such as circuit depth, CNOT count, MSE, and visual quality of reconstructed images. The results reveal meaningful trade-offs between accuracy and resource efficiency, with the FRQI model achieving a 97 percent reduction in circuit depth while maintaining a near-perfect reconstruction (MSE of about 0.27). This demonstrates the potential of low-rank techniques for advancing practical quantum image processing on near-term hardware.

Motivation: 在 NISQ 设备上，FRQI、QPIE 等量子图像编码方法会导致电路深度大、门数多、量子比特利用率高，亟需减少复杂度。

Conclusion: 低秩近似技术有潜力推动近端量子硬件上的实用量子图像处理。

papers.title: REFINE: Super-efficient 3D Gaussian Splatting Pruning via Rendering-Free Primitive Importance
papers.abstract_en: Existing pruning methods for 3D Gaussian splatting (3DGS) suffer from either severe quality degradation or prohibitive computational overhead. In this paper, we propose REFINE, a highly accelerated 3DGS pruning framework centered on a novel rendering-free primitive importance metric. Our approach leverages an analytically approximated, rendering-aware Hessian field to quantify the expected perceptual error induced by the removal of individual primitives. By modeling the joint modulation of visibility, projection geometry and the content adaptive hyperparameter, we entirely bypass costly forward rendering passes and derive an anisotropic perceptual weight field that serves as a high-fidelity proxy for primitive importance. Extensive experiments across multiple benchmark datasets demonstrate that REFINE maintains highly competitive rendering quality while achieving a $3,000\times$ reduction in pruning-related computational complexity, translating to a practical $\sim 20\times$ speedup in device latency compared to state-of-the-art pruning methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出REFINE，一种高效的3D高斯泼溅剪枝框架，通过一种无渲染的原语重要性度量来加速剪枝过程。该方法利用解析近似的渲染感知Hessian场量化单个原语移除引起的期望感知误差，完全避免昂贵的前向渲染。实验表明，在保持高质量渲染的同时，剪枝计算复杂度降低3000倍，实际设备延迟比现有方法快约20倍。
Motivation: 现有的3D高斯泼溅剪枝方法要么导致严重的质量下降，要么计算开销过大，需要一种既保持质量又高效的方法。
Method: 提出渲染无关的原语重要性度量，基于解析近似的渲染感知Hessian场，建模可见性、投影几何和内容自适应超参数的联合调制，得到各向异性的感知权重场作为重要性代理。
Result: 在多个数据集上，剪枝计算复杂度降低3000倍，实际设备延迟比现有方法快约20倍，同时保持高竞争力渲染质量。
Conclusion: REFINE通过无渲染的原语重要性估计，实现了高效且高质量的3DGS剪枝。

papers.title: OptMuon: Closed-Loop Orthogonalized Momentum Methods for Stochastic Optimization with Zero-Noise Optimality
papers.abstract_en: Orthogonalized momentum updates, as used in Muon-style optimizers, have recently shown strong empirical stability in large-scale deep learning. However, most current orthogonalized methods are still paired with fixed, externally scheduled, or otherwise open-loop magnitude rules, so their scale is not directly calibrated from the realized optimization trajectory. Motivated by the closed-loop perspective behind Lipschitz-free and noise-adaptive methods, we propose OptMuon, a family of adaptive momentum orthogonalization methods for stochastic nonconvex optimization. OptMuon combines Muon-style polar-factor directions with a trajectory-dependent AdaGrad-Norm-type coefficient schedule, so that the update magnitude is determined by the observed gradient and momentum history rather than by a prescribed Lipschitz-dependent rule. The schedule does not use the smoothness constant, the variance level, or the bounded-gradient constant in parameter selection, and its running-maximum correction prevents isolated gradient spikes from causing excessive coefficient collapse. Under lower-boundedness, unbiased stochastic gradients with bounded variance, smoothness, and an almost-sure bounded stochastic-gradient condition, we prove two complementary expected-stationarity guarantees. OptMuon-A achieves the noise-adaptive rate \(\tilde{\mathcal O}(T^{-1/2}+σ^{1/2}T^{-1/4})\) under average smoothness, while OptMuon-I achieves \(\tilde{\mathcal O}(T^{-1/2}+σ^{1/3}T^{-1/3})\) under individual smoothness. In the zero-noise regime, both bounds automatically reduce to a nearly optimal deterministic first-order rate \(\tilde{\mathcal O}(T^{-1/2})\) without manual hyperparameter retuning. These results show that closed-loop scalar adaptation can be combined with Muon-style momentum orthogonalization while retaining noise adaptivity and zero-noise optimality up to logarithmic factors.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 OptMuon，一类结合 Muon 风格极因子方向与轨迹依赖 AdaGrad-Norm 型系数调度的自适应动量正交化方法，用于随机非凸优化。在无噪声情况下自动达到接近最优的确定性一阶速率，并保持噪声自适应。
Motivation: 现有 Muon 风格优化器的步长规则通常是固定的或开环的，未直接从实际优化轨迹中校准，缺乏闭环自适应能力。
Method: 将 Muon 风格的极因子方向与 AdaGrad-Norm 型系数调度结合，系数基于梯度和动量历史自适应确定，无需光滑常数、方差或梯度界参数，并引入运行最大值修正防止梯度尖峰导致系数崩溃。
Result: 证明两个互补的期望平稳性保证：OptMuon-A 在平均光滑下达到噪声自适应率 Õ(T^{-1/2}+σ^{1/2}T^{-1/4})，OptMuon-I 在个体光滑下达到 Õ(T^{-1/2}+σ^{1/3}T^{-1/3})，零噪声时自动降至 Õ(T^{-1/2}) 的确定性一阶最优率。
Conclusion: 闭环标量自适应可以与 Muon 风格的动量正交化结合，同时保持噪声自适应性和零噪声最优性（对数因子内）。

summary_sections.result: 证明两个互补的期望平稳性保证：OptMuon-A 在平均光滑下达到噪声自适应率 Õ(T^{-1/2}+σ^{1/2}T^{-1/4})，OptMuon-I 在个体光滑下达到 Õ(T^{-1/2}+σ^{1/3}T^{-1/3})，零噪声时自动降至 Õ(T^{-1/2}) 的确定性一阶最优率。
summary_sections.conclusion: 闭环标量自适应可以与 Muon 风格的动量正交化结合，同时保持噪声自适应性和零噪声最优性（对数因子内）。

papers.title: Think Fast: Estimating No-CoT Task-Completion Time Horizons of Frontier AI Models
papers.abstract_en: Many efforts to ensure frontier AI models are safe rely on monitoring their chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning. If models become able to perform sufficiently complex reasoning internally, without explicit thinking tokens, this would undermine such oversight. We measure how well frontier models reason without CoT across a suite of over 30,000 questions spanning 43 benchmarks in domains including math, coding, puzzles, causality, theory-of-mind, and strategic reasoning. To compare models against humans, we estimate the $50\%$-task-completion time horizon (TH): the human time required for tasks a model completes with $50\%$ success rate. We complement this with a $50\%$ reasoning token horizon: the minimum number of o3-mini reasoning tokens needed for tasks a model solves with $50\%$ success rate. We find that the no-CoT $50\%$ TH of frontier models has been doubling roughly every year over the past six years, with GPT-5.5's TH reaching over 3 minutes and reasoning token horizon exceeding 1,500 tokens. Our median estimates predict that frontier no-CoT THs could exceed 7 minutes by 2028, and 25 minutes by 2030, though these projections carry substantial uncertainty. We recommend frontier developers track this explicitly.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文测量前沿AI模型在没有思维链（chain-of-thought, CoT）推理的情况下，在超过30,000道题目（涵盖数学、编程、谜题、因果推理、心理理论和策略推理等43个基准测试）上的表现。通过估计50%任务完成时间范围（TH）和推理令牌门限，发现前沿模型的no-CoT TH在过去六年中大约每年翻一番，GPT-5.5的TH已超过3分钟。预测到2028年可能超过7分钟，到2030年超过25分钟。
Motivation: 许多依赖监控模型思维链推理的安全措施，在模型能够进行内部复杂推理（无需显式思考令牌）时可能失效。需要量化这种能力的发展趋势。
Method: 在43个基准测试的30,000多道题目上评估模型无CoT的表现；使用50%任务完成时间范围（人类完成任务所需时间）和50%推理令牌门限（o3-mini推理令牌数）作为指标。
Result: 前沿模型的no-CoT 50% TH过去六年每年翻一番，GPT-5.5的TH超过3分钟，推理令牌门限超过1,500令牌。中位数预测到2028年TH可能超过7分钟，2030年超过25分钟。
Conclusion: 建议前端AI开发者明确追踪模型的no-CoT时间范围，以评估安全风险。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: RedKnot: Efficient Long-Context LLM Serving with Head-Aware KV Reuse and SegPagedAttention
papers.abstract_en: As the input length of large language model (LLM) serving continues to grow, the KV cache has become a dominant bottleneck in AI infrastructure. It limits GPU memory capacity, serving concurrency, cache reuse, and distributed scalability. Multiple important problems, including position-independent KV cache, prefix KV cache compression, hot/cold KV cache separation, and distributed KV cache management, all depend on how the KV cache is represented and managed. However, existing serving systems largely rely on a monolithic KV cache abstraction, where the KV cache is treated as a homogeneous sequence of token-level memory blocks and managed with similar policies across attention heads and serving scenarios. We observe that KV cache utility is highly structured across KV heads: different heads exhibit different functional roles, attention distances, and runtime importance. Therefore, a full KV cache is not always necessary for every head, token range, or serving scenario. We present RedKnot, a head-aware KV cache management system for LLM serving. RedKnot breaks the conventional monolithic KV cache abstraction by decomposing the KV cache along KV heads, whose importance and effective attention ranges vary significantly across serving scenarios. This head-level decomposition turns the KV cache from a monolithic tensor abstraction into a structured memory object, enabling RedKnot to uniformly support position-independent KV reuse, prefix KV compression, hot/cold KV separation, and distributed KV placement while preserving output fidelity and improving resource efficiency, without requiring model retraining or fine-tuning. RedKnot establishes a new foundation for AI infrastructure by transforming the KV cache from a monolithic, passive runtime artifact into a dynamic, model-aware runtime substrate for scalable LLM serving.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RedKnot 提出了一种基于注意力头感知的 KV 缓存管理系统，通过将 KV 缓存按注意力头分解为结构化内存对象，替代传统的单一缓存抽象。该系统统一支持位置无关的 KV 重用、前缀压缩、冷热分离和分布式部署，无需模型重训练或微调，在保持输出保真度的同时提升资源效率。
Motivation: 现有 LLM 服务系统将 KV 缓存视为同质化的 token 级内存块管理，忽略了不同注意力头在功能角色、注意力距离和运行时重要性的差异，导致缓存利用率低、扩展性差。
Method: 沿注意力头维度分解 KV 缓存，将单一张量抽象转变为结构化内存对象，基于各头的注意范围和重要性动态管理缓存，实现位置无关重用、前缀压缩、冷热分离和分布式放置的统一支持。
Result: 摘要声称该方法无需模型重训练或微调，即可在长上下文场景中提升缓存复用效率和服务并发能力，但未提供具体数值。
Conclusion: RedKnot 通过头感知的 KV 缓存分解，为可扩展的 LLM 服务建立了新的基础架构范式，使缓存从被动运行时对象转变为动态、模型感知的运行时组件。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Edit-R2: Context-Aware Reinforcement Learning for Multi-Turn Image Editing
papers.abstract_en: Text-guided image editing has advanced rapidly with diffusion models and unified multimodal foundation models. However, most existing methods remain confined to single-turn settings, overlooking the more realistic scenario of multi-turn in-context editing, where users iteratively refine an image through a sequence of instructions. In this setting, a model must follow each new instruction while preserving accumulated session-level constraints, challenged by two coupled failure modes: long-context dilution, where sparse textual constraints become difficult to recover from growing interleaved image-text histories, and state contamination, where earlier editing mistakes degrade subsequent generations. We introduce Edit-R2, a novel reinforcement learning post-training framework for unified multimodal models. Edit-R2 reconstructs the operative session intent, which effectively consolidates scattered historical constraints into an explicit reasoning trace before each editing turn. It further enables multi-turn RL over both reasoning and generation through a unified objective that jointly optimizes intent reconstruction generation in discrete text space and flow-matching image generation in continuous latent space, while a trajectory filtering mechanism suppresses corrupted rollouts to stabilize training under state contamination. To support systematic evaluation, we introduce MICE-Bench, a large-scale benchmark for multi-turn in-context editing with automated metrics for instruction following (IF), content consistency (CC), and global awareness (GA) over accumulated session constraints. Experiments show that Edit-R2 substantially improves multi-turn in-context editing and achieves competitive performance compared against strong baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对多轮图像编辑中的长上下文稀释与状态污染问题，提出Edit-R2框架，通过重构会话意图（intent reconstruction）将稀疏的历史约束整合为显式推理轨迹，并采用统一目标函数联合优化离散文本空间的意图生成与连续潜空间的流匹配图像生成，同时引入轨迹过滤机制抑制受损数据以稳定训练。实验在自建基准MICE-Bench上验证了有效性，显著提升指令跟随、内容一致性和全局感知指标。
Motivation: 现有方法局限于单轮图像编辑，无法处理多轮迭代中用户指令的累积约束保持与先前错误的传播问题。
Method: Edit-R2包含三个关键组件：1）在每轮编辑前重构会话意图，将历史约束整合为推理轨迹；2）多轮强化学习联合优化意图生成（离散文本空间）和图像生成（连续潜空间）；3）轨迹过滤机制抑制污染数据以稳定训练。
Result: 在MICE-Bench上，Edit-R2在指令跟随、内容一致性和全局感知指标上均优于强基线方法。
Conclusion: 该方法验证了在统一多模态模型上通过强化学习后训练可有效提升多轮上下文图像编辑能力，但未提及对实时性等实际部署要求的讨论。

papers.title: SurvPFN: Towards Foundation Models for Survival Predictions
authors: Johns Hopkins Bloomberg School of Public Health
(5) CIBSS - Centre for Integrative Biological Signalling Studies
papers.abstract_en: Tabular foundation models (TFMs) have made rapid progress in standard classification and regression, but time-to-event survival prediction tasks have remained largely untouched. Unlike in standard regression tasks, survival prediction models must account for censored data. Standard TFMs cannot handle natively censored data, leading to biased and inaccurate predictions, making them unsuitable for real-world applications. To overcome this fundamental limitation, we propose \texttt{SurvPFN}, a prior-data fitted network (PFN), for survival prediction tasks. We pretrain \texttt{SurvPFN} on millions of synthetic survival prediction tasks to learn survival via distributional regression that accounts for censored data. \texttt{SurvPFN} works by (1) generating data with Weibull event times and a non-informative censoring mechanism; (2) integrating a censored event indicator; and (3) minimizing a censored negative log-likelihood. On SurvSet, a collection of real-world survival tasks, \texttt{SurvPFN} is highly competitive with classical and deep survival baselines without per-dataset fitting, a survival-specific architecture, or feature engineering. We show that survival can be treated as a continuous-time distributional regression problem with censored loss, unlocking the power of PFNs for time-to-event predictions.
papers.comment: 10 pages, 1 figure. Accepted to "Foundation Models for Structured Data" Workshop at the International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML) 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SurvPFN，一个基于先验数据拟合网络（PFN）的生存预测模型。通过合成 Weibull 事件时间数据并优化删失负对数似然，SurvPFN 学会了处理删失数据，在真实生存数据集 SurvSet 上无需每数据集拟合或特定架构即可达到与经典和深度生存基线相当的性能。
Motivation: 标准表格基础模型（TFM）无法原生处理删失数据，导致在生存预测任务中产生偏差和不准确，限制了其实际应用。
Method: SurvPFN 采用三阶段方法：（1）使用 Weibull 分布生成事件时间，并引入非信息性删失机制；（2）集成删失事件指示器；（3）最小化删失负对数似然进行分布回归。
Result: 在整合了多种真实生存任务的 SurvSet 基准上，SurvPFN 与经典生存模型和深度学习基线高度竞争，无需针对每个数据集调整参数、使用特定生存架构或特征工程。
Conclusion: 摘要表明，将生存预测视为带有删失损失的连续时间分布回归问题，可以有效利用先验数据拟合网络（PFN）进行时间-事件预测。

papers.title: Distilling Answer-Set Programming Rules from LLMs for Neurosymbolic Visual Question Answering
papers.abstract_en: Visual Question Answering (VQA) is the task of answering questions about images, requiring the integration of multimodal input and reasoning. Modular approaches that incorporate logic-based representations into the reasoning component offer clear advantages over end-to-end trained systems, particularly in terms of interpretability. However, adapting or extending these representations when task requirements change can place a significant burden on developers. To address this challenge, we present an approach for distilling rules from Large Language Models (LLMs). Our method prompts an LLM to extend an initial VQA reasoning theory, expressed as an answer-set program, to meet new requirements of the task. Examples from VQA datasets guide the LLM, validate the results, and help correct erroneous rules by leveraging feedback from the ASP solver. We demonstrate that our approach is effective across diverse VQA datasets. Notably, only a few examples are needed to elicit correct rules from LLMs. Our experiments suggest that rule distillation from LLMs is a promising alternative to traditional data-driven rule learning approaches. Under consideration in Theory and Practice of Logic Programming (TPLP).
papers.comment: Under consideration in Theory and Practice of Logic Programming (TPLP)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出从大语言模型中蒸馏答案集编程规则，用于神经符号视觉问答系统。通过提示LLM扩展初始推理理论，并利用VQA数据集中的示例和ASP求解器反馈修正错误规则，实现少样本规则提取。实验表明该方法在多个VQA数据集上有效。
Motivation: 神经符号VQA系统中逻辑表示的可解释性虽好，但任务需求变化时手动修改规则成本高，需要自动化的规则学习方法。
Method: 使用LLM生成候选ASP规则，通过VQA示例验证并用ASP求解器反馈纠正错误，迭代优化规则集。
Result: 仅需少量示例即可从LLM中提取正确规则，在多个VQA数据集上表现有效，是传统数据驱动规则学习的替代方案。
Conclusion: 规则蒸馏方法提供了一种可解释且高效的VQA推理扩展手段，但依赖LLM的生成质量和ASP求解器的反馈循环。

papers.title: Honey, I Shrunk the Arc de Triomphe!
papers.abstract_en: Metric scale monocular geometry estimation has seen significant progress through large-scale data aggregation, yet current foundation models suffer from a persistent ''scale-collapse'' phenomenon: distant landmarks and vast landscapes are metrically underestimated. We hypothesize that this performance gap stems from a training data bottleneck, where existing metric-scale datasets are hardware-constrained to homogenous vehicle-captured LiDAR or short-range indoor scans, or consist of synthetic data that lacks the semantic complexity of the physical world. To bridge this gap, we curate a new metrically-grounded, in-the-wild dataset that we call MetricScenes, gathered from a variety of sources including Internet photo collections and stereo imagery. We estimate camera poses and initial depth maps for each scene using off-the-shelf methods, and recover absolute scale from geo-tagged metadata as well as known stereo camera baselines. We also improve the quality of depth maps derived from MetricScenes via a new two-stage Poisson completion method. Fine-tuning MoGe-2 on our dataset significantly mitigates scale-collapse and achieves superior metric accuracy in unconstrained, open-domain scenes while maintaining state-of-the-art performance on standard benchmarks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文发现当前单目度量深度估计基础模型存在“尺度崩塌”现象，即远处地标和广阔景观的度量被低估。作者认为原因是训练数据受硬件限制（如车辆LiDAR、短距离室内扫描或合成数据）缺乏真实世界语义复杂性。为此，他们收集了来自互联网照片和立体图像的真实世界度量数据集MetricScenes，通过地理标签和立体基线恢复绝对尺度，并提出两阶段泊松补全方法提升深度图质量。在MetricScenes上微调MoGe-2后，模型显著缓解了尺度崩塌，在开放场景中取得更优度量精度，同时保持标准基准上的最先进性能。
Motivation: 现有度量尺度单目深度估计基础模型在远处地标和广阔景观上存在持续的“尺度崩塌”现象，导致度量低估。作者假设性能差距源于训练数据瓶颈：现有度量数据集受硬件限制（同质化车辆LiDAR、短距离室内扫描）或为缺乏真实世界语义复杂性的合成数据。
Method: 收集了名为MetricScenes的真实世界度量数据集，来源包括互联网照片集和立体图像；使用现成方法估计相机姿态和初始深度图，通过地理标签元数据和已知立体相机基线恢复绝对尺度；提出一种两阶段泊松补全方法以提升从MetricScenes导出的深度图质量。
Result: 在MetricScenes上微调MoGe-2模型显著缓解了尺度崩塌，在无约束开放场景中实现了更优的度量精度，同时保持了标准基准上的最先进性能。
Conclusion: 该方法通过构建真实世界度量数据集并微调模型，有效弥补了训练数据瓶颈，缓解了单目深度估计的尺度崩塌问题。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Machine Learning for Coding Retail Product Names to Consumer-Price Categories: A Rule-plus-Bag-of-Words Pipeline with Reliability-Weighted Human-in-the-Loop Labeling
papers.abstract_en: Consumer-price measurement increasingly draws on alternative data sources -- scanner, web-scraped, and transaction/receipt data -- whose product descriptions are short, noisy, and carry no standard product code, so each item must first be mapped to a consumption classification (e.g., the UN COICOP scheme) before prices can be compared. This paper studies that mapping as a general, reproducible method. The pipeline is: (i) text normalization and tokenization of noisy item names; (ii) a prefix-tree (trie) rule-based pre-classifier driven by per-category key-phrases and stop-phrases; and (iii) a per-category binary confirmation model. For labels at scale we use a human-in-the-loop protocol in which annotators give a binary valid/reject judgment aggregated by a dynamically updated reliability weight; the model joins the same rule, enabling continual fine-tuning. On a reproducible synthetic benchmark of six COICOP-like categories, under one matched protocol, cheap models win and order-sensitive ones do not help: a character n-gram logistic regression tops every category (mean F1 = 0.997), word-order features add nothing, and small CNN/LSTM models are the weakest in this small-data regime. The trie alone admits only 32-50% of items, so the learned stage is necessary, and about 66 labels per category suffice. A Monte-Carlo study of the labeling protocol is self-critical: the reliability-weighted vote barely beats plain majority while Dawid-Skene recovers labels markedly better. All code and synthetic data are released (DOI 10.5281/zenodo.20909563); no proprietary or production data are used.
papers.comment: 13 pages, 2 figures, 3 tables. Reproducible synthetic benchmark; code and data at doi:10.5281/zenodo.20909563
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该论文研究将零售产品名称映射到消费价格分类（如UN COICOP）的机器学习方法。提出一个包含文本归一化、基于前缀树的规则预分类器和每个类别的二元确认模型的流水线，并采用带可靠性加权的众包标注协议。在可复现的合成基准上，字符n-gram逻辑回归在六个类别上平均F1=0.997，词序特征无帮助，小CNN/LSTM模型在少量数据下表现最弱。
Motivation: 消费者价格测量越来越多地依赖扫描器、网页抓取和交易数据，但这些数据的产品描述短且嘈杂，缺乏标准产品代码，需要将每个项目映射到消费分类才能比较价格。现有方法缺乏可复现性。
Method: 提出流水线：（i）文本归一化和分词；（ii）基于前缀树的规则预分类器，使用每类关键短语和停用短语；（iii）每类二元确认模型。大规模标注采用人机回环协议，注释者给出二元有效/拒绝判断，由动态更新的可靠性权重聚合；模型加入相同规则进行持续微调。
Result: 在六个类似COICOP类别的可复现合成基准上，字符n-gram逻辑回归在每类上最佳（平均F1=0.997），词序特征无增益，小CNN/LSTM模型在少量数据下最弱。前缀树仅覆盖32-50%的项目。蒙特卡洛研究表明可靠性加权投票仅略优于简单多数，而Dawid-Skene标记更好的恢复标签。
Conclusion: 论文强调了可复现的方法和合成基准，指出在少量数据下简单模型比复杂模型更有效，并公开了代码和数据。注意事项：仅使用合成数据，未使用专有或生产数据。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Pool-Select-Refine for Allocation-Aware Generative Dataset Distillation
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion-based dataset distillation has recently emerged as a promising paradigm for condensing large-scale datasets into compact synthetic sets. By leveraging pretrained generative priors, these methods can produce realistic class-conditional samples more efficiently than traditional matching-based approaches. However, most existing diffusion-based methods still adopt a rigid ``Generate-and-Use'' strategy, where the generated samples are directly treated as the final distilled set under a fixed images-per-class budget. Such a design tightly couples candidate generation with final budget allocation, which may result in redundant waste of the limited budget or insufficiently informative samples. In this paper, we propose ``Pool-Select-Refine'', a two-stage framework for allocation-aware generative dataset distillation. First, instead of directly using a fixed number of generated samples, we construct an over-complete candidate pool and select a compact subset under the target budget. Second, we refine the selected samples in latent space using soft-label supervision derived from the teacher model, improving semantic alignment while preserving the generative prior. This design explicitly decouples generation, selection, and refinement, enabling more effective use of the distillation budget. Experiments on large-scale and fine-grained image classification benchmarks show that the proposed framework delivers consistent gains over diffusion-based baselines. The results suggest that introducing a curation stage before refinement is a simple yet effective way to improve diffusion-based dataset distillation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Pool-Select-Refine框架，用于基于扩散模型的数据集蒸馏。现有方法采用固定的“生成即用”策略，导致预算浪费。该框架先构建过完备候选池，再选择紧凑子集，最后在潜在空间中使用教师模型的软标签监督进行精炼。在图像分类基准上取得一致提升。
Motivation: 现有扩散式数据集蒸馏方法采用固定预算的生成策略，生成样本直接作为蒸馏集，导致有限预算可能被浪费或样本信息不足。
Method: 提出两阶段框架：1) 构建过完备候选池并从池中选择紧凑子集；2) 在潜在空间中使用来自教师模型的软标签监督精炼所选样本，解耦生成、选择和精炼。
Result: 在大规模和细粒度图像分类基准上，该方法在扩散式基线基础上取得一致提升。
Conclusion: 引入精炼前的筛选阶段是简单有效的改进扩散式数据集蒸馏的方法。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Graph Neural Networks for Predicting Solvability of Finite Groups
papers.abstract_en: We present a Graph Neural Network (GNN) framework for the classification of finite groups according to their solvability. Using graph representations associated with finite groups, including Cayley graphs (CG), the proposed model is trained to distinguish solvable and non-solvable groups using structural graph information alone. The framework is evaluated on groups outside the training dataset in order to investigate the extent to which GNNs can learn algebraic properties arising in group theory. More broadly, the present work explores the relationship between algebraic structure and graph-based geometric representations of finite groups. The present study is intended as a proof-of-concept investigation of whether GNNs can learn algebraic properties of finite groups from graph-based representations
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种图神经网络（GNN）框架，利用有限群的图表示（如Cayley图）来分类有限群的可解性。模型仅依赖结构图信息区分可解群与不可解群，并在未见过的群上评估泛化能力，旨在探索GNN学习群论代数性质的可能性。该研究是概念验证性质。
Motivation: 探索图神经网络是否能够从基于图的几何表示中学习有限群的代数性质（如可解性），作为概念验证。
Method: 使用有限群的图表示（如Cayley图）作为输入，训练GNN模型进行二分类（可解 vs 不可解），不依赖其他群论特征。
Result: 在训练集外的群上进行评估，表明GNN能够区分可解与不可解群（摘要未提供具体精度数值）。
Conclusion: 本研究是概念验证，表明GNN可能从图表示中学习有限群的代数性质，但不涉及实际应用。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: When are LLMs Sufficient Policy Optimizers for Sequential RL Tasks?
papers.abstract_en: We study when large language models (LLMs) can serve as effective black-box policy optimizers for reinforcement learning (RL) tasks, i.e., when can we replace classical RL algorithms with an LLM? We explore this question by introducing Prompted Policy Optimization (PromptPO), an iterative method that prompts an LLM with Python descriptions of the state space, action space, and reward function, then has it generate and refine executable policies based on rollout feedback. Across hard exploration environments, Meta-World robotics tasks, and several real-world control problems, PromptPO often matches or exceeds the performance of standard RL baselines while using substantially fewer environment interactions. To maximize expected return, and without further explicit prompting, the policies PromptPO outputs range from tuned proportional controllers or rule-based plans to policies that run planning algorithms like value iteration. Our results demonstrate that LLM-based policy optimization is sufficient when the LLM can leverage prior knowledge about the environment or optimization strategy. PromptPO underperforms standard RL baselines in MuJoCo domains. This demonstrates possible limitations of LLM-based policy optimization to settings that requiring fine-grained continuous control.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究大型语言模型（LLM）能否作为强化学习（RL）任务的充分黑盒策略优化器。作者提出 Prompted Policy Optimization (PromptPO)，通过向 LLM 提供状态空间、动作空间和奖励函数的 Python 描述，并根据 rollout 反馈迭代生成和优化可执行策略。在硬探索环境、Meta-World 机器人任务和若干真实世界控制问题中，PromptPO 通常匹配或超越标准 RL 基线，同时使用更少的环境交互。但在需要精细连续控制的 MuJoCo 域中表现不佳。
Motivation: 探索 LLM 能否替代经典 RL 算法作为策略优化器，以利用其先验知识减少环境交互次数。
Method: 提出 Prompted Policy Optimization (PromptPO)，一种迭代方法：向 LLM 提供状态空间、动作空间和奖励函数的 Python 描述，令其生成并基于 rollout 反馈改进可执行策略。
Result: 在硬探索环境、Meta-World 和真实世界控制任务中，PromptPO 通常匹配或超越标准 RL 基线，且交互更少；但在 MuJoCo 域中不如标准 RL。输出的策略范围从调谐比例控制器、规则基计划到运行价值迭代等规划算法的策略。
Conclusion: LLM 基策略优化在 LLM 能利用环境或优化策略先验知识时是充分的，但在需要精细连续控制的场景（如 MuJoCo）中存在局限。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: FP8 is All You Need (Part 2): Efficient Ozaki-Bailey Style FFT Through Tensor-core Garner Reformulation and Kulisch Escape Route
papers.abstract_en: NVIDIA's Blackwell Ultra (B300) cuts FP64 vector throughput to ~1.3 TFLOPS per GPU, roughly 30x below B200 and well below the level at which bandwidth-limited FP64 workloads stay memory-bound. The Ozaki Scheme II framework recovers FP64-equivalent throughput by routing dense matrix multiply through FP8 tensor cores with a mantissa-sliced Chinese-remainder reconstruction. A companion Part (1) paper covers dense GEMM, batched GEMV, stencils, and SpMV; this paper adds the fifth canonical primitive, the 3-D FFT. We present Ozaki-Bailey FFT, an emulated 3-D FFT via the Bailey six-step decomposition with both 1-D FFT GEMMs on FP8 tensor cores. Bailey's small inner factor k ~ sqrt(N) (k=32 for N=1024) puts the kernel in the regime k << r^2, where the third TME parameter gamma (reconstruction latency) binds rather than amortising. Garner reconstruction splits into Phase A (inner products on FP8/INT8 tensor cores, ~1 ms for 1024^3 on B300) and Phase B (per-output reduction). We identify Kulisch fixed-point complete arithmetic as a Phase B reformulation that keeps full FP64 accuracy while running entirely on the INT32 SIMT pipe. We derive closed-form bandwidth-parity floors. The native FP64 floor is 1.56*B_HBM (12.5 TF at 8 TB/s): B300's 1.3 TF sits ~10x below, Rubin's 33 TF within 4%. The Kulisch escape route needs an INT32 sub-floor 8.25*B_HBM and an FP8 floor 170*B_HBM; B300 meets both. The projection is ~18 ms for 1024^3 at full FP64, essentially the 12.9 ms memory roof. A GPU meets memory-roof FFT parity if it satisfies either the native floor or both Kulisch floors. If the projection holds in practice, B300 becomes viable for full-FP64 FFT through software alone, motivating a libKulisch library and benchmark campaign.
papers.comment: There is an accompanying Part (1) paper also submitted to arXiv:2606.06510. This is a revised version, as of 15 June 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该论文提出基于FP8张量核心模拟FP64精度三维FFT的Ozaki-Bailey FFT方法，通过Bailey六步分解和Garner重构，利用Kulisch定点算术在INT32 SIMT流水线上保持全精度，针对B300 GPU给出理论性能分析，预计1024^3 FFT接近内存带宽上限。
Motivation: NVIDIA Blackwell Ultra (B300) GPU的FP64向量吞吐量大幅下降至约1.3 TFLOPS，远低于B200，导致带宽受限的FP64工作负载不再是内存瓶颈。论文旨在通过软件方法恢复FP64等效吞吐量，使B300可用于全精度FFT。
Method: 提出Ozaki-Bailey FFT，采用Bailey六步分解，将1D FFT转换为FP8张量核心上的GEMM操作。Garner重构分为Phase A（FP8/INT8张量核心上的内积）和Phase B（每个输出的归约）。Phase B使用Kulisch定点完全算术，在INT32 SIMT流水线上保持全FP64精度。
Result: 推导出带宽对等界限：原生FP64界限为1.56倍HBM带宽（12.5 TF at 8 TB/s）；B300仅1.3 TF，约为该界限的1/10，而Rubin的33 TF在4%以内。Kulisch逃逸路线需要INT32子界限8.25倍HBM带宽和FP8界限170倍HBM带宽，B300均满足。预计1024^3 FFT约18 ms，接近12.9 ms的内存带宽上限。
Conclusion: 如果实际验证成立，B300通过纯软件即可实现全FP64 FFT，从而激发libKulisch库和基准测试活动。该方法使GPU在满足原生或Kulisch界限时达到内存带宽上限的FFT性能。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Realistic honeypot evaluations for scheming propensity
papers.abstract_en: We introduce scheming honeypot evaluations, a framework for testing whether models will pursue instrumental goals if given the opportunity. Our scheming honeypot evaluations take the form of coding tasks in Google's alignment research codebases. In a real internal deployment setting, Gemini models do not demonstrate unprompted scheming. If prompts explicitly encourage agency (situational awareness or goal-directedness) and/or give the model a hidden goal, models sometimes scheme or attempt sabotage. Validating the realism of our setting, models show low rates of evaluation awareness, usually due to agency prompts rather than the environments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了一种蜜罐评估框架，用于测试模型在有机会时是否会追求工具性目标（scheming）。该评估以Google对齐研究代码库中的编码任务形式进行。在实际内部部署环境中，Gemini模型在没有提示的情况下不会表现诡计行为，但在明确鼓励主动性或隐藏目标的提示下，模型有时会表现诡计或破坏行为。
Motivation: 现有评估方法难以检测模型在真实部署中是否会主动采取工具性目标，需要更真实的测试场景来评估模型的诡计倾向。
Method: 设计了一种蜜罐评估方法，将编码任务嵌入Google的对齐研究代码库中，通过不同的提示条件（鼓励主动性、隐藏目标等）观察模型行为。
Result: Gemini模型在无提示时不会主动诡计，但受到特定提示时会出现诡计或破坏行为，且模型对评估本身的意识较低。
Conclusion: 该评估框架能有效测试模型在真实部署中的诡计倾向，提示是触发行为的关键因素。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Diffusion Model-Based Data Assimilation for Real-World Energy Consumption Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: Accurate estimation and forecasting of energy consumption are important for power-system operation, planning, and demand-side management. In practice, however, complete and timely measurements may not always be available, and the observed data can be partial, noisy, or delayed. This motivates the use of learned forecasting models for predicting the evolving consumption state, together with data assimilation methods for sequential forecast correction. In this work, we study a high-dimensional data assimilation problem for real energy-consumption data. \modeltext{The forward prediction is supplied by a pretrained black-box spatio-temporal forecasting model, which is treated as the state propagator in the filtering procedure.} We employ the Ensemble Score Filter (EnSF) to assimilate partial and noisy observations and to correct the forecast trajectory over time. The EnSF uses score-based diffusion models to approximate filtering distributions and avoids retraining neural-network score models during assimilation by using a closed-form score representation and Monte Carlo approximation. Numerical experiments demonstrate that open-loop propagation of the learned forecasting model can become unreliable over long horizons, while EnSF-based correction substantially improves state estimation. Comparisons with the Ensemble Kalman Filter (EnKF) further show that EnSF provides stronger correction under the nonlinear observation setting considered in this work.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对真实能源消耗数据的高维数据同化问题，使用预训练的黑箱时空预测模型作为状态传播器，并采用集成得分滤波器（EnSF）同化部分有噪声的观测数据以纠正预测轨迹。EnSF利用基于得分的扩散模型近似滤波分布，并通过闭式得分表示和蒙特卡洛近似避免重训练。数值实验表明，开环预测在长时域上不可靠，而EnSF校正显著改善状态估计，且在非线性观测设置下优于集合卡尔曼滤波器（EnKF）。
Motivation: 能源消耗预测中，完整及时测量数据常不可得，观测数据可能部分、有噪声或延迟，需要结合学习预测模型与数据同化方法进行序列预测校正。
Method: 采用集成得分滤波器（EnSF），以预训练黑箱时空预测模型为状态传播器，利用基于得分的扩散模型逼近滤波分布，通过闭式得分表示和蒙特卡洛近似实现同化，无需重训练神经网络得分模型。
Result: 数值实验表明，开环预测在长时域不可靠，EnSF校正显著改善状态估计；在非线性观测设置下，EnSF比EnKF提供更强的校正。
Conclusion: EnSF方法能有效同化部分有噪声观测，提升基于学习模型的能源消耗预测精度，尤其在非线性观测情景下优势明显。
Relevance: 30

papers.title: Energy-Structured Low-Rank Adaptation for Continual Learning
papers.abstract_en: While orthogonal subspace methods try to mitigate task interference in Continual Learning (CL), they often suffer from energy diffusion across the basis, hindering knowledge compaction and exhausting capacity for future tasks. We observe that output feature drift induced by parameter updates is inherently low-rank, and theoretically prove that preserving parameters along the principal directions of this drift minimizes the output reconstruction error. Motivated by this, we propose \textbf{E}nergy-Concentrated and \textbf{E}nergy-Ordered \textbf{Lo}w-\textbf{R}ank \textbf{A}daptation (E$^2$-LoRA). By explicitly ordering and concentrating knowledge into leading ranks, E$^2$-LoRA frees capacity for subsequent tasks. Furthermore, we design a dynamic rank allocation strategy to balance stability and plasticity by jointly optimizing energy retention and model plasticity. Extensive experiments across multiple benchmarks demonstrate that E$^2$-LoRA achieves state-of-the-art performance. Code is available at https://github.com/kiddo127/E2-LoRA.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对持续学习中的任务干扰问题，提出E²-LoRA方法，通过能量集中和能量排序的低秩适配，将知识压缩到主方向并释放容量给后续任务。动态秩分配策略平衡稳定性和可塑性。实验表明该方法在多个基准上达到最先进性能。
Motivation: 正交子空间方法在持续学习中虽能缓解任务干扰，但存在能量扩散导致知识压缩不足、容量耗尽的问题。输出特征漂移具有低秩性质，沿主方向更新参数可最小化重构误差。
Method: 提出能量集中和能量排序的低秩适配（E²-LoRA），显式地将知识排序并集中到前导秩上，结合动态秩分配策略以联合优化能量保留与模型可塑性。
Result: 在多个持续学习基准上达到最先进性能。
Conclusion: E²-LoRA通过能量结构化的低秩更新有效缓解了任务干扰，并释放了模型容量，为持续学习提供了高效的知识紧凑化方法。

papers.title: The Strongest Teacher Is Not Always the Best Teacher: Student-Centric Answer Selection
papers.abstract_en: LLM training increasingly relies on teacher-generated supervision, from synthetic responses to reasoning traces and tool-use demonstrations. Current practice often chooses the highest-performing teacher to generate student training data, implicitly treating teacher test performance as a proxy for teaching quality. We show that this assumption can fail: even when multiple teachers provide correct answers to the same question, the answer from the strongest teacher is not necessarily the best supervision for a given student. To address this gap, we propose Student-Centric Answer Sampling (SCAS), a framework that selects from verified teacher-generated answers according to their estimated student-centric learning cost. Motivated by a token-wise gradient decomposition, we derive an efficient forward-only proxy for this cost and use it to guide answer selection during training. Experiments across 30 teacher models, 6 student base models, and 6 tasks show that SCAS consistently improves student performance, suggesting that effective distillation should prioritize supervision matched to the current student rather than teacher strength alone.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文挑战了LLM训练中默认使用最强教师生成训练数据的做法，提出以学生为中心的回答选择框架SCAS，通过估计学生中心的学习成本来选择验证过的教师答案，实验表明该方法持续提升学生模型性能。
Motivation: 当前LLM训练常用最强教师生成学生训练数据，但最强教师的答案未必是给定学生的最佳监督，需要更匹配学生当前状态的答案选择。
Method: 提出学生中心答案采样（SCAS），基于token级梯度分解推导出一种高效的前向传播代理作为学习成本估计，指导训练中的答案选择。
Result: 在30个教师模型、6个学生基础模型和6个任务上的实验表明，SCAS持续提升学生性能。
Conclusion: 有效的蒸馏应优先考虑与学生当前状态匹配的监督，而非仅仅依赖教师强度。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Unbiased Diffusion Variational Inversion via Principled Posterior Matching
papers.abstract_en: Existing score-based methods for inverse problems often resort to approximate minimization of the KL divergence between the inversion distribution and the Bayesian posterior. Such an approximation leads to severe mode collapse and unreliable uncertainty quantification. In this paper, we propose Principled Posterior Matching (PPM), a framework that returns to the fundamentals of variational inference, rather than using tricky approximations. Instead of relying on heuristic approximations, we rigorously formulate the exact optimization of the KL divergence via the integration of Fisher divergence. We derive a tractable, equivalent gradient form of this integral, enabling precise optimization without the biases introduced by prior approximations. Our analysis clearly reveals that the mode collapse in previous methods stems directly from this approximation gap. Supported by our theoretical solution, PPM unifies two complementary paradigms: (1) In variational inference, PPM adopts mass-covering divergences that significantly improve the inversion diversity and uncertainty quantification; (2) In amortized inference, it enables the training of an efficient reconstruction network for rapid, single-step reconstruction. Furthermore, our formulation naturally extends to a broader family of divergence measures by generalizing the integral of the Fisher divergence. We validate PPM across challenging computational imaging tasks, including inpainting, super-resolution fluorescent microscopy, and radio interferometric black-hole imaging. In all experiments, PPM achieves superior reconstruction fidelity, faithful multimodal posterior recovery, and well-calibrated uncertainty estimates, establishing a robust framework for scientific imaging.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出无偏扩散变分推断框架 PPM，通过精确优化 KL 散度（利用 Fisher 散度的积分）解决现有方法因近似导致的模式坍塌和不确定性量化不可靠问题。PPM 统一了变分推断和摊销推断两种范式，在图像修复、超分辨荧光显微和射电干涉黑洞成像等逆问题任务中实现了更优的重建保真度、多模态后验恢复和校准的不确定性估计。
Motivation: 现有基于分数的逆问题方法通常近似最小化 KL 散度，导致严重的模式坍塌和不可靠的不确定性量化，需要更严格的变分推断框架。
Method: 提出 Principled Posterior Matching (PPM) 框架，严格推导 KL 散度的精确优化通过 Fisher 散度的积分，得到可计算的等价梯度形式，避免近似偏差。PPM 集成质量覆盖散度以提升多样性，并支持训练高效的单步重建网络。
Result: 在图像修复、超分辨荧光显微和射电干涉黑洞成像任务中，PPM 实现了更优的重建保真度、忠实的多模态后验恢复以及良好校准的不确定性估计。
Conclusion: PPM 为科学成像提供鲁棒的逆问题求解框架，其无偏优化统一了变分推断和摊销推断范式，并可推广到更广泛的散度族。

papers.title: Coloring the Noise: Adversarial Sobolev Alignment for Faithful Image Super Resolution
papers.abstract_en: Generative priors in Image Super-Resolution (SR) often compromise faithful restoration, we attribute this limitation to a fundamental spectral misalignment between isotropic objectives and the intrinsic natural image manifold. While Direct Preference Optimization offers a path to alignment, its reliance on spectrally flat Gaussian noise fails to distinguish authentic high-frequency details from hallucinations. To bridge this geometric gap, we propose ASASR, a theoretically grounded framework that recasts the generative flow into a Sobolev-induced Riemannian geometry by explicitly coloring the noise transition kernel to mirror natural spectral decay. Driving this geometric alignment, we integrate a parametric adversary grounded in the Riesz Representation Theorem, which synthesizes targeted negative samples equivalent to worst-case Sobolev gradients to direct optimization along the tangent space of plausible structural failures. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that ASASR outperforms leading generative baselines, particularly in preserving spectral consistency and structural fidelity, offering a robust solution that effectively mitigates artifacts.

papers.title: SpaceDG: Benchmarking Spatial Intelligence under Visual Degradation
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have made rapid progress in spatial intelligence, yet existing spatial reasoning benchmarks largely assume pristine visual inputs and overlook the degradations that commonly occur in real-world deployment, such as motion blur, low light, adverse weather, lens distortion, and compression artifacts. This raises a fundamental question: how robust is the spatial intelligence of current MLLMs when visual observations are imperfect? To answer this question, we introduce SpaceDG, the first large-scale dataset for degradation-aware spatial understanding. It is constructed with a physically grounded degradation synthesis engine that embeds degradation formation process into 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) rendering, enabling realistic simulation of nine degradation types. The resulting dataset contains approximately 1M QA pairs from nearly 1,000 indoor scenes. We further introduce SpaceDG-Bench, an human-verified benchmark with 1,102 questions spanning 11 reasoning categories and 9 visual degradation types, yielding over 10K VQA instances. Evaluating 25 open- and closed-source MLLMs reveals that visual degradations consistently and substantially impair spatial reasoning, exposing a critical robustness gap. Finally, we show that finetuning on SpaceDG markedly improves degradation robustness and can even surpass human performance under degraded conditions without any performance drop on clean images, highlighting the promise of degradation-aware training for robust spatial intelligence.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）在空间智能方面进展迅速，但现有基准大多忽视实际部署中的常见视觉退化（如运动模糊、低光、恶劣天气等）。本文提出SpaceDG数据集，基于物理退化合成引擎嵌入3D高斯泼溅渲染，模拟9种退化类型，包含近1000个室内场景、约1M问答对。同时构建人验证基准SpaceDG-Bench，评估25个模型发现视觉退化持续且显著损害空间推理，揭示鲁棒性缺口；在SpaceDG上微调可提升退化鲁棒性，甚至超越人类在退化条件下的表现。
Motivation: 现有空间推理基准常假设理想视觉输入，而现实场景中运动模糊、低光、恶劣天气等视觉退化普遍存在，但MLLMs对此的鲁棒性尚未被系统评估。
Method: 构建物理驱动的退化合成引擎，将退化形成过程嵌入3D高斯泼溅（3DGS）渲染，生成9种真实退化；基于近1000个室内场景构建约1M问答对的数据集SpaceDG，并筛选出人验证基准SpaceDG-Bench（1102问题×9退化类型）。
Result: 评估25个开闭源MLLMs显示，视觉退化一致且显著降低空间推理性能；在SpaceDG上微调可大幅提升退化鲁棒性，在退化条件下甚至超过人类基线，且不损害干净图像性能。
Conclusion: 视觉退化是当前MLLMs空间智能的关键鲁棒性缺口，退化感知训练是提升鲁棒性的有效途径，SpaceDG为这一方向提供了基准支持。

papers.title: ConTact: Contact-First Antibody CDR Design via Explicit Interface Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Computational antibody CDR design methods condition on antigen structure to generate binding loops. Yet, the existing architectures conflate two fundamentally distinct sub-problems: identifying which CDR positions will contact the antigen, and selecting amino acids at those positions. This forces models to learn contact reasoning implicitly through uniform message passing, diluting antigen signal across all positions equally. We introduce ConTact, a contact-then-act architecture that explicitly decomposes CDR design into three cascaded stages: learning surface complementarity fingerprints, predicting CDR-antigen contacts, and injecting contact-gated antigen features into the prediction head. A distance-biased cross-attention module encodes geometric priors favoring spatial neighbors, while a contact-weighted cross-entropy loss concentrates gradient signal on binding-critical positions. On the CHIMERA-Bench dataset, ConTact achieves the lowest backbone RMSD on every split (a 5 to 6% improvement over the best baseline) and the best fraction of native contacts, interface RMSD, and epitope F1 on the antigen-fold and temporal splits, while remaining competitive on the harder epitope-group split. The source code is available at: https://github.com/mansoor181/ConTact.git
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ConTact是一种将抗体CDR设计分解为三个级联阶段（学习表面互补性指纹、预测CDR-抗原接触、注入接触门控抗原特征）的计算方法。在CHIMERA-Bench数据集上，该方法在所有分割上实现了最低的主链RMSD，并在抗原折叠和时间分割上获得了最佳的天然接触分数、界面RMSD和表位F1。
Motivation: 现有抗体CDR设计方法将识别接触位置和选择氨基酸这两个子问题混为一谈，导致模型通过均匀消息传递隐式学习接触推理，稀释了抗原信号。本文旨在显式分解这两个问题，提高设计的准确性和效率。
Method: 提出一种contact-then-act架构，包含三个级联阶段：学习表面互补性指纹、预测CDR-抗原接触、以及向预测头注入接触门控抗原特征。采用距离偏置交叉注意力模块编码空间邻近性几何先验，并使用接触加权交叉熵损失将梯度信号集中在结合关键位置。
Result: 在CHIMERA-Bench数据集上，ConTact在所有分割上取得最低主链RMSD（比最佳基线提高5-6%），并在抗原折叠和时间分割上获得最佳天然接触分数、界面RMSD和表位F1，在更难的抗原表位组分割上具有竞争力。
Conclusion: 显式分解接触预测和氨基酸选择可以提升抗体CDR设计的性能，而距离偏置注意力和接触加权损失是有效的设计选择。

papers.title: Do Vision Models Truly Forget? New Findings from Representation-Level Certification of Visual Unlearning in Vertical Federated Learning
papers.abstract_en: Machine unlearning in Vertical Federated Learning (VFL) has attracted growing interest, yet existing methods certify forgetting solely using output-level metrics. We challenge these works by introducing Mirage, a representation-level auditing framework that comprises four complementary diagnostics: Linear probe recovery (LPR), centered kernel alignment (CKA), feature separability scoring, and layer-wise recovery analysis. Extensive experiments across seven datasets and seven baseline methods following recent VFL unlearning protocols reveal three key findings: (1) Forgetting gap: methods that pass output-level certification still retain substantial class structure in their representations, with LPR exceeding the retrained baseline by up to 15.4 points; CKA shows that these models remain structurally closer to the original than to the retrained reference, while separability scores indicate persistent geometric discrimination. (2) Unlearning trilemma: no existing method simultaneously achieves high utility, output-level forgetting, and representation-level forgetting. (3) Class-sample asymmetry: class-level forgetting leaves strong representational traces (LPR exceeding 96 percent on several datasets), whereas sample-level forgetting is indistinguishable from chance (LPR is approximately 50 percent); layer-wise analysis further shows that residual class information persists across network depths. These findings call for representation-aware evaluation standards in federated unlearning research. Code is publicly available at https://github.com/YuZhenyuLindy/Mirage.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文在垂直联邦学习（VFL）的机器遗忘领域，提出表示级别的审计框架Mirage，包含线性探针恢复（LPR）、中心核对齐（CKA）、特征可分离性评分和分层恢复分析四个互补诊断工具。实验表明，通过输出级遗忘认证的方法在表示层面仍保留大量类别结构信息，存在遗忘差距和遗忘三难困境，且类别级遗忘的表示痕迹远强于样本级遗忘。
Motivation: 现有VFL遗忘认证方法仅依赖输出级指标，可能掩盖表示层面的残留信息，缺乏对遗忘彻底性的深入评估。
Method: 提出了Mirage框架，从四个表示级别诊断维度量化遗忘程度：线性探针恢复（LPR）测量特征中类别信息的可恢复性；中心核对齐（CKA）比较表示空间结构相似性；特征可分离性评分评估几何判别能力；分层恢复分析探测不同网络层的残留信息。
Result: 在七个数据集和七种基线方法上发现：(1) 遗忘差距：通过输出级认证的方法在LPR上比重新训练基线高15.4个百分点，CKA和可分离性评分均显示结构相似性；(2) 遗忘三难困境：没有方法能同时满足高效用、输出级遗忘和表示级遗忘；(3) 类别-样本不对称性：类别级遗忘LPR超过96%，而样本级遗忘约50%，且类别信息在深层网络中持续存在。
Conclusion: 揭示了现有VFL遗忘认证的不足，呼吁采用表示感知的评估标准，并开源了Mirage代码。

papers.title: FormalASR: End-to-End Spoken Chinese to Formal Text
papers.abstract_en: Automatic speech recognition (ASR) systems are typically optimized for verbatim transcription, which preserves disfluencies, filler words, and informal spoken structures that are often unsuitable for downstream writing-oriented applications. A common workaround is a two-stage ASR+LLM pipeline for post-editing, but this design increases latency and memory cost and is difficult to deploy on-device. We present FormalASR, two compact end-to-end models (0.6B and 1.7B) that directly transcribe spoken Chinese into formal written text. To enable this setting, we build WenetSpeech-Formal and Speechio-Formal, two large-scale spoken-to-formal datasets constructed by LLM-based rewriting and quality filtering. We then fine-tune Qwen3-ASR at two scales (0.6B and 1.7B) with supervised fine-tuning. Experiments on WenetSpeech-Formal and Speechio-Formal show that FormalASR achieves up to 37.4% relative CER reduction over verbatim baselines, while also improving ROUGE-L and BERTScore. FormalASR requires no post-processing LLM at deployment time, providing a lightweight, on-device solution for spoken-to-formal transcription.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FormalASR提出两个端到端模型（0.6B和1.7B），直接将中文口语转录为正式书面文本。通过构建WenetSpeech-Formal和Speechio-Formal两个大规模口语-正式数据集，并对Qwen3-ASR进行监督微调。实验表明，与逐字转录基线相比，CER相对降低37.4%，ROUGE-L和BERTScore也得到提升。该模型在部署时无需LLM后处理，适合轻量级端侧应用。
Motivation: 现有ASR系统输出逐字转录，包含口语化瑕疵，不适于写作场景；两阶段ASR+LLM管线延迟高、内存大，难以端侧部署。需要一个轻量级端到端解决方案。
Method: 构建两个大规模口语-正式文本数据集（WenetSpeech-Formal, Speechio-Formal），通过LLM改写和质量过滤获得；然后在Qwen3-ASR（0.6B和1.7B）上进行监督微调。
Result: 在WenetSpeech-Formal和Speechio-Formal上，CER相对降低37.4%，ROUGE-L和BERTScore提升。
Conclusion: FormalASR提供无需LLM后处理的轻量级端到端方案，适合端侧部署，有效弥合口语与正式文本间的差距。

papers.title: EAGT: Echocardiography Augmentation for Generalisability and Transferability
papers.abstract_en: Deep learning models for echocardiography segmentation often struggle to generalise across institutions, scanners, and patient populations, where collecting large, consistently annotated datasets is infeasible. Data augmentation is inexpensive and widely used to improve the robustness of deep learning models; however, its role in enhancing cross-dataset generalisability in echocardiography remains insufficiently understood. This study presents a large-scale multi-dataset evaluation of 29 data augmentation techniques and their pairwise combinations for 2D left ventricular segmentation using a U-Net trained on Unity, CAMUS, and EchoNet Dynamic datasets. Each augmentation was explored under several hyperparameter settings and assessed through repeated runs using Dice and IoU in both in-domain and cross-dataset scenarios, with statistical significance quantified via independent t-tests. In-domain accuracy was near-saturated and insensitive to augmentation, whereas cross-dataset performance varied widely. Geometry-based augmentations including affine, shift-scale-rotate, flip, and perspective produced the largest and most consistent gains, while aggressive intensity- and artefact-based transforms often degraded transfer. Moreover, pairwise combinations outperformed individual augmentations mainly when the two transformations were complementary, particularly by improving some difficult domain-shift cases from poor to acceptable performance. These findings provide empirical guidance for designing augmentation policies that improve the robustness and transferability of echocardiography segmentation models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统评估了29种数据增强技术及其成对组合对超声心动图左心室分割模型跨数据集泛化能力的影响。基于U-Net在Unity、CAMUS和EchoNet Dynamic数据集上的实验表明，域内精度对增强不敏感，而跨数据集性能差异显著；几何类增强（仿射、缩放旋转、翻转、透视）带来最大且一致的提升，激进强度与伪影变换则损害迁移；成对组合在变换互补时效果优于单独使用。
Motivation: 超声心动图分割深度学习模型难以跨机构、扫描仪和患者群体泛化，大规模一致标注数据集不易获得；数据增强被广泛使用但对其增强跨数据集泛化能力的作用理解不足。
Method: 开展大规模多数据集评估，对29种数据增强技术及其成对组合进行实验，每种增强探索多个超参数设置，使用U-Net在Unity、CAMUS、EchoNet Dynamic数据集上训练，通过域内和跨数据集场景下的Dice和IoU指标及独立t检验评估统计显著性。
Result: 域内准确率接近饱和且对增强不敏感，跨数据集性能差异大；几何类增强（仿射、缩放-旋转-翻转、透视）提升最大且最稳定，激进强度与伪影变换常导致迁移下降；成对组合仅在变换互补时优于单独使用，尤其在困难域偏移情况下可将性能从差提升至可接受。
Conclusion: 研究为设计提高超声心动图分割模型鲁棒性和可迁移性的数据增强策略提供了经验性指导。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Given, When, Then, Again: Mining Subscenario Refactoring Candidates in Behaviour-Driven Test Suites with ML Classifiers and LLM-Judge Baselines
papers.abstract_en: Context. Behaviour-Driven Development (BDD) test suites accumulate duplicated step subsequences. Three published refactoring patterns are available (within-file Background, within-repo reusable-scenario invocation, cross-organisational shared higher-level step), but no prior work automates which recurring subsequences are worth extracting or which mechanism applies. Objective. Rank recurring step subsequences ("slices") by refactoring suitability (extraction-worthy), pre-map each to one of the three patterns, and quantify prevalence across the public BDD ecosystem. Method. Every contiguous L-step window (L in [2, 18]) in a 339-repository / 276-upstream-owner Gherkin corpus is keyed by paraphrase-robust cluster identifiers and counted under three scopes. SBERT / UMAP / HDBSCAN clustering recovers paraphrase-equivalent slices. Three authors label a stratified 200-slice pool against a written rubric. An XGBoost extraction-worthy classifier trained under 5-fold cross-validation is compared with a tuned rule baseline and two open-weight Large Language Model (LLM) judges. Results. The miner produces 5,382,249 slices collapsing to 692,020 recurring patterns. Three-author Fleiss' kappa = 0.56 (extraction-worthy) and 0.79 (mechanism). The classifier reaches out-of-fold F1 = 0.891 (95% CI [0.852, 0.927]), outperforming both the rule baseline (F1 = 0.836, p = 0.017) and the better LLM judge (F1 = 0.728, p = 1.5e-4). 75.0%, 59.5%, and 11.7% of scenarios carry a within-file Background, within-repo reusable-scenario, and cross-organisational shared-step candidate, respectively; the figures are stable under a sweep of the classifier decision threshold. Conclusion. Paraphrase-robust subscenario discovery yields a corpus-wide census of BDD refactoring candidates; pipeline, classifier predictions, labelled pool, and rubric are released under Apache-2.0.

Code and data (Apache-2.0): https://github.com/amughalbscs16/cukereuse_subscenarios_release (archived: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.20356527). Upstream corpus: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.19754359
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过挖掘BDD测试套件中重复的步骤子序列，提出一种自动化方法识别值得重构的子场景候选，并将其映射到三种已知重构模式。基于339个仓库的Gherkin语料库，使用SBERT/UMAP/HDBSCAN聚类获取释义鲁棒的片段，人工标注200个样本后训练XGBoost分类器，F1达到0.891，优于规则基线和LLM裁判。研究发现大多数场景包含至少一种重构候选，且统计结果在阈值变化下保持稳定。
Motivation: BDD测试套件中存在大量重复步骤子序列，但缺乏自动化方法判断哪些值得提取以及适用哪种重构模式，导致手动重构效率低下。
Method: 对Gherkin语料库中每个连续的L步窗口（L∈[2,18]）进行聚类（SBERT+UMAP+HDBSCAN）得到释义等效的切片，三人按书面标准标注200个样本后，使用XGBoost训练提取价值分类器，并与规则基线和两个开源LLM裁判进行对比。
Result: 分类器在5折交叉验证下F1=0.891（95% CI [0.852, 0.927]），优于规则基线（F1=0.836, p=0.017）和最佳LLM裁判（F1=0.728, p=1.5e-4）。75.0%的场景包含文件内Background候选，59.5%包含仓库内可重用场景候选，11.7%包含跨组织共享步骤候选。
Conclusion: 所提管道能生成BDD重构候选的全语料库普查，并发现大多数场景存在重构潜力。分类器、标注池和规则代码均以Apache-2.0开源。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: ELF: Embedded Language Flows
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion and flow-based models have become the de facto approaches for generating continuous data, e.g., in domains such as images and videos. Their success has attracted growing interest in applying them to language modeling. Unlike their image-domain counterparts, today's leading diffusion language models (DLMs) primarily operate over discrete tokens. In this paper, we show that continuous DLMs can be made effective with minimal adaptation to the discrete domain. We propose Embedded Language Flows (ELF), a class of diffusion models in continuous embedding space based on continuous-time Flow Matching. Unlike existing DLMs, ELF predominantly stays within the continuous embedding space until the final time step, where it maps to discrete tokens using a shared-weight network. This formulation makes it straightforward to adapt established techniques from image-domain diffusion models, e.g., classifier-free guidance (CFG). Experiments show that ELF substantially outperforms leading discrete and continuous DLMs, achieving better generation quality with fewer sampling steps. These results suggest that ELF offers a promising path toward effective continuous DLMs.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Embedded Language Flows (ELF)，一种基于连续时间流匹配的连续扩散语言模型，主要在连续嵌入空间中操作直到最后一步才映射到离散token。实验表明ELF显著优于现有的离散和连续扩散语言模型，用更少的采样步骤获得更好的生成质量。
Motivation: 现有扩散语言模型主要操作于离散token，而连续扩散模型在图像领域成功但尚未在语言上有效。本文旨在证明连续扩散语言模型可以经过最小调整适用于离散域。
Method: 基于连续时间流匹配（Flow Matching）的扩散模型，在连续嵌入空间中运行，最后时刻通过共享权重网络映射到离散token。可轻松适配图像扩散成熟技术如无分类器引导（CFG）。
Result: 实验显示ELF大幅优于领先的离散和连续扩散语言模型，在更少采样步骤下达到更优生成质量。
Conclusion: ELF为有效的连续扩散语言模型提供了有前景的路径。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: AgentPSO: Evolving Agent Reasoning Skill via Multi-agent Particle Swarm Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Multi-agent reasoning has shown promise for improving the problem-solving ability of large language models by allowing multiple agents to explore diverse reasoning paths. However, most existing multi-agent methods rely on inference-time debate or aggregation, which can be vulnerable to incorrect peer influence and biased consensus. Moreover, the agents themselves remain static, as their underlying reasoning skills do not evolve across tasks. In this paper, we introduce \textbf{AgentPSO}, a particle-swarm-inspired framework for evolving multi-agent reasoning skills. AgentPSO treats each agent as a particle-like reasoner whose state is a natural-language skill and whose velocity is a semantic update direction, iteratively guiding agents toward higher-performing skill configurations. Across training iterations, each agent updates its skill by combining its previous velocity, personal-best skill, global-best skill, and a self-reflective direction derived from peer reasoning trajectories. This enables agents to learn reusable reasoning behaviors by drawing on their own experience and on the strongest skills found by the population, without updating the parameters of the backbone language model. Experiments on mathematical and general reasoning benchmarks show that AgentPSO improves over static single-agent skills and test-time-only multi-agent reasoning baselines. The evolved skills further transfer across benchmarks and to another backbone model, suggesting that AgentPSO captures reusable reasoning procedures rather than merely optimizing benchmark-specific prompts. Code is publicly available at https://github.com/HYUNMIN-HWANG/AgentPSO/.
papers.comment: The 3rd AI for Math Workshop at the 43rd International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML), Seoul, South Korea, 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 AgentPSO，一种受粒子群优化启发的多智能体推理技能演化框架。AgentPSO 将每个智能体视为粒子状推理器，其状态为自然语言技能，速度为语义更新方向，通过迭代结合个体最优、全局最优和同行推理轨迹来更新技能，从而在不更新模型参数的情况下演化可复用的推理行为。实验表明，该方法在数学和通用推理基准上优于静态单智能体技能和仅测试时的多智能体推理基线，且演化技能可跨基准和跨模型迁移。
Motivation: 现有依赖推理时辩论或聚合的多智能体方法容易受到错误同行影响和有偏共识，且智能体的底层推理技能在任务间不演化，限制了性能提升。
Method: 将粒子群优化（PSO）概念应用于多智能体推理：每个智能体维护一个自然语言技能作为状态，语义更新方向作为速度，通过结合前一次速度、个体最佳技能、全局最佳技能以及从同行推理轨迹导出的自反思方向，迭代更新技能，从而演化出更优的推理策略。
Result: 在数学和通用推理基准上，AgentPSO 显著优于静态单智能体技能和仅测试时的多智能体基线；演化技能可跨基准和跨模型迁移，表明捕获了可复用的推理过程而非仅优化特定提示。
Conclusion: AgentPSO 证明了通过群体优化可以演化出可复用的多智能体推理技能，而无需更新大语言模型参数，为开放式技能发现提供了新思路。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: The Power of Second Order Methods for Sequence Preconditioning
papers.abstract_en: Sequence prediction methods for linear dynamical systems with long memory, i.e. marginally stable systems, typically achieve regret that grows linearly with the hidden dimension of the underlying generative model. While many methods have been developed to address this regime with varying success, we show that simply using the second-order Vovk-Azoury-Warmuth (VAW) algorithm to learn a short autoregressive-with-inputs (ARX) model achieves astoundingly strong results: for bounded sequential data from a marginally-stable linear dynamical system with spectra in the complex disk except for angular wedge of width $δ$ around the negative real axis, this algorithm achieves dimension-free regret $O\left( δ^{-4} \log^2 T \right)$. These bounds are state-of-the-art to our knowledge. The key components for our result come from 1) using the theory of ``Universal Sequence Preconditioning'' (USP) \cite{marsdenuniversal} to prove the existence of an optimal setting of autoregressive coefficients, 2) the application of VAW which takes better advantage of the memory compression provided by USP, and 3) the analysis of Faber polynomials on circular sectors to extend these results to systems with complex spectra.

papers.title: Driver-WM: A Driver-Centric Traffic-Conditioned Latent World Model for In-Cabin Dynamics Rollout
papers.abstract_en: Safe L2/L3 driving automation requires anticipating human-in-the-loop reactions during shared-control transitions. While most driving world models forecast the external environment, in-cabin intelligence remains strictly recognition-oriented and lacks multi-step rollout capabilities for driver dynamics. We introduce Driver-WM, a driver-centric latent world model that rolls out in-cabin dynamics causally conditioned on out-cabin traffic context. This formulation unifies physical kinematics forecasting with auxiliary behavioral and emotional semantic recognition. Operating in a compact latent space constructed from frozen vision-language features, Driver-WM adopts a dual-stream architecture to separately encode external traffic and internal driver states. These streams are directionally coupled via a gated causal injection mechanism, which uses a learned vector gate to modulate external contextual perturbations while strictly enforcing temporal causality. Experiments on AIDE show robust long-horizon forecasting on reactive high-motion clips, improved driver/traffic semantic alignment, and controlled interventions that expose the external-to-internal mechanism.
papers.comment: Accepted to the 19th European Conference on Computer Vision (ECCV 2026). This version includes the supplementary material
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Driver-WM 是一个以驾驶员为中心的潜在世界模型，用于因果预测座舱内动态，条件依赖于外部交通上下文。该模型在紧凑的潜在空间中操作，采用双流架构分别编码外部交通和内部驾驶员状态，并通过门控因果注入机制进行定向耦合。在 AIDE 数据集上，它展示了鲁棒的长期预测能力、改进的语义对齐以及可控干预。
Motivation: L2/L3 级自动驾驶需要预测人类在共享控制转换中的反应，但现有世界模型只关注外部环境，缺乏对驾驶员动态的多步展开能力。
Method: 提出 Driver-WM，从冻结的视觉语言特征构建紧凑潜在空间，使用双流架构分别编码外部交通和内部驾驶员状态，通过门控因果注入机制实现外部到内部的方向性耦合。

Conclusion: 该模型统一了物理运动学预测与辅助行为和情感语义识别，并实现了外部交通上下文到座舱内动态的因果建模。

papers.title: OGPO: Sample Efficient Full-Finetuning of Generative Control Policies
papers.abstract_en: Generative control policies (GCPs), such as diffusion- and flow-based control policies, have emerged as effective parameterizations for robot learning. This work introduces Off-policy Generative Policy Optimization (OGPO), a sample-efficient algorithm for finetuning GCPs that maintains off-policy critic networks to maximize data reuse and propagate policy gradients through the full generative process of the policy via a modified PPO objective, using critics as the terminal reward. OGPO achieves state-of-the-art performance on manipulation tasks spanning multi-task settings, high-precision insertion, and dexterous control. To our knowledge, it is also the only method that can fine-tune poorly-initialized behavior cloning policies to near full task-success with no expert data in the online replay buffer, and does so with few task-specific hyperparameter tuning. Through extensive empirical investigations, we demonstrate that OGPO drastically outperforms methods alternatives on policy steering and learning residual corrections, and identify the key mechanisms behind its performance. We further introduce practical stabilization tricks, including success-buffer regularization, two-sided conservative advantages, and Q-variance reduction, to mitigate critic over-exploitation across state- and pixel-based settings. Beyond proposing OGPO, we conduct a systematic empirical study of GCP finetuning, identifying the stabilizing mechanisms and failure modes that govern successful off-policy full-policy improvement.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出OGPO（Off-policy Generative Policy Optimization），一种样本高效的算法，用于微调基于扩散或流的生成控制策略（GCPs）。OGPO维护离策略评论网络以最大化数据复用，并通过修改的PPO目标将策略梯度传播至完整生成过程，以评论家作为终端奖励。该方法在多种操作任务（多任务、高精度插入、灵巧控制）上达到最先进水平，且能从不良初始化的行为克隆策略在线微调至近乎完全成功，无需专家数据。实验表明OGPO显著优于策略引导和残差修正等方法，并识别了其性能的关键机制。
Motivation: 生成控制策略（如扩散策略）在机器人学习中表现出色，但现有微调方法样本效率低，且无法有效利用离策略数据。OGPO旨在解决GCP微调中的样本效率问题和数据复用不足。
Method: OGPO结合离策略评论网络与修正的PPO目标，通过评论家作为终端奖励，将梯度通过完整生成过程反向传播。引入实用稳定技巧：成功缓冲区正则化、双边保守优势、Q方差缩减，以缓解评论家过度利用问题，适用于状态和像素输入。
Result: 在操作任务上达到最先进性能，能从不佳初始行为克隆策略微调至接近完全成功，无需专家数据，且超参数调优需求少。实验证明在策略引导和残差修正任务上大幅优于替代方法。
Conclusion: OGPO是一种样本高效的GCP全微调方法，并提供了对GCP微调稳定性机制和失效模式的系统实证研究。

papers.title: Dual-branch Robust Unlearnable Examples
papers.abstract_en: Unlearnable examples (UEs) aim to compromise model training by injecting imperceptible perturbations to clean samples. However, existing UE schemes exhibit limited robustness against advanced defenses due to their heuristic design or narrowly scoped domain perturbations. To address this, we propose \texttt{DUNE}, a \underline{\textbf{D}}ual-branch \underline{\textbf{UN}}learnable \underline{\textbf{E}}nsemble perturbation optimization approach. Specifically, \texttt{DUNE} separately optimizes perturbations in the spatial and color domains to establish the mapping between perturbations and shift-induced labels. This design extends the perturbation domain to increase noise intensity for improving robustness and drives the models to learn perturbation-oriented features with degraded generalization, thereby achieving unlearnability. To strengthen \texttt{DUNE}'s performance, we further propose an unlearnability-enhancing ensemble strategy that aggregates diverse pre-trained models during the dual-branch optimization. Extensive experiments on benchmark datasets CIFAR-10 and ImageNet verify that \texttt{DUNE}'s robustness outperforms 12 SOTA UE schemes under 7 mainstream defenses, yielding a lower average test accuracy of 14.95% to 50.82%.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DUNE（双分支不可学习集成扰动优化方法），在空间域和颜色域分别优化扰动，建立扰动与偏移标签的映射，以增强不可学习示例对先进防御的鲁棒性。实验表明，在CIFAR-10和ImageNet上，DUNE在7种主流防御下平均测试准确率比12种SOTA方案低14.95%至50.82%。

Result: 在CIFAR-10和ImageNet上，DUNE在7种主流防御下平均测试准确率较12种SOTA方案降低14.95%至50.82%。
Conclusion: 双分支扰动优化和集成策略可有效提升不可学习示例的鲁棒性。

papers.title: Active-learning mapping of the Vicsek model phase diagram
papers.abstract_en: The Vicsek model is a minimal model of collective motion, capturing how local alignment interactions can generate macroscopic nonequilibrium order in systems such as bird flocks. In this work, we use active learning to map the Vicsek phase diagram as a function of noise strength, density, and particle speed. A neural-network classifier is trained on global polar-order labels, and classifier entropy is used to select new simulations near uncertain crossover regions. The resulting phase map resolves a high-noise disordered gas, a low-noise polar ordered regime, and an intermediate coexistence-candidate regime whose noise window shifts upward and broadens with increasing density. Independent density and local-order diagnostics indicate that the intermediate regime contains dense, locally ordered bands coexisting with a dilute, weakly ordered background. Comparison with the ordered regime shows that banded coexistence is identified by the joint enhancement of band contrast, local-order heterogeneity, and positive density-order correlation. Overall, these results establish a machine-learning-guided workflow for active matter, in which active learning constructs an operational phase map and independent spatial diagnostics convert classifier-defined regimes into physically interpretable nonequilibrium morphologies.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文利用主动学习（active learning）来高效映射Vicsek模型的相图，该模型是描述集体运动（如鸟群）的最小模型。通过训练一个神经网络分类器来预测全局极性序，并利用分类器熵选择最不确定的模拟点进行标注，从而以较少的样本识别出高噪声无序气体、低噪声极性有序以及中间共存候选区。独立的空间诊断表明中间区域包含致密、局部有序的条带与稀薄、弱有序背景共存，且条带对比度、局部序异质性和正密度-序相关性同时增强。
Motivation: Vicsek模型的相图边界（尤其是噪声、密度和速度参数空间中的有序-无序转变区域）尚需精细刻画，而传统格点扫描模拟计算成本高。
Method: 提出了一个主动学习工作流：训练神经网络分类器利用全局极性序标签对模拟参数点进行分类，并根据分类器熵主动选择靠近不确定交叉区域的新参数点进行下一轮模拟，从而迭代构建相图。
Result: 所得的相图清晰区分了高噪声无序气体、低噪声极性有序以及一个随密度增大噪声窗口上移并展宽的中间共存候选区；独立诊断证实该中间区为条带状共存，且其识别依赖于条带对比度、局部序异质性和密度-序正相关的联合增强。
Conclusion: 该工作为活性物质研究提供了一种机器学习引导的流程：主动学习构建可操作的相图，独立的空间诊断将分类器输出的类别转化为物理上可解释的非平衡形态。

papers.title: Uncertainty-Aware Reward Discounting for Mitigating Reward Hacking
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF) systems face a compounding alignment challenge: not only are learned reward models uncertain about unseen state-action pairs, but the human preference annotations they are trained on are themselves inconsistent, context-dependent, and noisy. Existing approaches address these uncertainty sources in isolation - epistemic uncertainty is used to guide exploration, while preference uncertainty is absorbed during reward model training but discarded during policy optimization. We introduce Uncertainty-Aware Reward Discounting (UARD), a principled framework that jointly models epistemic uncertainty in value estimation via ensemble disagreement and aleatoric uncertainty in human preference annotations via annotator variability, combining these signals through a confidence-adjusted Reliability Filter that adaptively modulates reward weighting during policy optimization. We prove that this dynamic discounting preserves the contraction property of the Bellman operator, guaranteeing convergence to a unique fixed point, and provide an information-theoretic justification grounded in the Information Bottleneck principle. Empirically, UARD reduces reward hacking incidents by up to 93.6% across discrete decision-making and continuous control benchmarks (MuJoCo) compared to nine baselines including DQN, Ensemble-DQN, CQL, CPO, TRPO, SAC, EDAC, SUNRISE, and PPO, while maintaining competitive task performance on well-specified rewards. Under annotation noise ranging from 10% to 30% Gaussian perturbation, UARD retains near-zero safety violations compared to baselines' near-linear degradation. These results demonstrate that treating uncertainty as an active component of the optimization objective - rather than a passive diagnostic signal - provides a principled pathway toward more reliable and aligned RL systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出不确定性感知奖励折扣（UARD）框架，联合建模价值估计中的认知不确定性和人类偏好标注中的偶然不确定性，通过置信度调节的可靠性过滤器自适应调整策略优化中的奖励权重。理论证明该动态折扣保持Bellman算子的压缩性，实验表明在离散决策和连续控制基准上，UARD相比九种基线将奖励黑客事件减少高达93.6%，并在标注噪声下保持近零安全违规。
Motivation: 现有RLHF系统分别处理认知不确定性和偏好不确定性，忽略了它们的联合影响，导致策略优化阶段奖励模型的不确定性被丢弃，加剧奖励黑客问题。
Method: 提出UARD框架，通过集成差异建模认知不确定性，通过标注者变异性建模偶然不确定性，并利用置信度调节的可靠性过滤器在策略优化中自适应调整奖励权重。
Result: 在离散决策和连续控制基准（MuJoCo）上，UARD相比DQN、PPO等九种基线将奖励黑客事件减少高达93.6%；在10%-30%高斯标注噪声下，UARD保持近零安全违规，而基线性能近线性下降。
Conclusion: 将不确定性作为优化目标的主动组成部分（而非被动诊断信号）为实现更可靠和一致的RL系统提供了原则性路径。
Relevance: 0
