papers.title: Categorical Optimization with Bayesian Anchored Latent Trust Regions for Structural Design under High-Dimensional Uncertainty
papers.abstract_en: Categorical structural optimization under aleatoric uncertainty is challenging because each design variable must be selected from a finite catalog of admissible instances, while each candidate design may require expensive stochastic finite-element evaluations. Existing latent-space optimization strategies can reduce the dimensionality of catalog attributes, but they often treat the reduced space as a continuous search domain. The resulting continuous optimum must then be rounded off to a nearby catalog instance, which may alter the objective value, constraint status, or physical interpretation of the design. To address this issue, this paper proposes the \textbf{C}ategorical \textbf{O}ptimization with \textbf{B}ayesian \textbf{A}nchored \textbf{L}atent \textbf{T}rust Regions (\textbf{COBALT}) framework for high-dimensional categorical Optimization Under Uncertainty. COBALT first embeds the physical catalog into a low-dimensional latent representation and locks the mapped instances as a discrete anchored graph. A data-independent random tree decomposition is then used to provide bounded-complexity additive modeling over high-dimensional categorical variables. On this anchored domain, an additive SAAS-GP surrogate is fitted to heteroscedastic MC-FEA observations, and a trust-region discrete graph acquisition search selects the next admissible catalog configuration without continuous relaxation or rounding-off. The proposed strategy is applied to robust design optimization of complex bar structures, considering structural weight, strain energy, and local buckling performance. By evaluating only valid catalog designs through the MC-FEA oracle, COBALT preserves physical admissibility throughout the active learning loop and improves the efficiency of robust categorical structural optimization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出COBALT框架，用于高维分类不确定性下的结构优化，通过贝叶斯锚定潜在信任区域避免连续松弛后的舍入误差，在MC-FEA评估下只搜索有效设计，提升鲁棒优化效率。
Motivation: 现有潜在空间优化方法将离散变量视为连续域，优化后需要舍入到邻近实例，可能改变目标值或约束状态，尤其在分类变量维度高时问题更突出。
Method: COBALT将物理目录嵌入低维潜在表示并锁定为离散锚点图，采用数据无关随机树分解实现高维分类变量的有界复杂性加性建模，基于异方差MC-FEA观测拟合加性SAAS-GP代理，并通过信任域离散图采集搜索选择下一个可接受配置，无需连续松弛或舍入。
Result: 在复杂杆系结构的鲁棒设计中，考虑重量、应变能和局部屈曲性能，COBALT通过仅评估有效设计保持物理可行性，提升鲁棒分类结构优化的效率。

papers.title: The Alignment Target Problem: Divergent Moral Judgments of Humans, AI Systems, and Their Designers
papers.abstract_en: The project of aligning machine behavior with human values raises a basic problem: whose moral expectations should guide AI decision-making? Much alignment research assumes that the appropriate benchmark is how humans themselves would act in a given situation. Studies of agent-type value forks challenge this assumption by showing that people do not always judge humans and AI systems identically.This paper extends that challenge by examining two further possibilities: first, that evaluations of AI behavior change when its human origins are made visible; and second, that people judge the humans who program AI systems differently from either the machines or the human actors they are compared against. An experiment with 1,002 U.S. adults measured moral judgments in a runaway mine train scenario, varying the subject of evaluation across four conditions: a repairman, a repair robot, a repair robot programmed by company engineers, and company engineers programming a repair robot. We find no significant difference in evaluations of the repairman and the robot. However, judgments shifted substantially when the robot's actions were described as the product of human design. Participants exhibited markedly more deontological, rule-based reasoning when evaluating either the programmed robot or the engineers who programmed it, suggesting that rendering human agency visible activates heightened moral constraints. These findings indicate that people may evaluate humans, AI systems acting in the same situation, and the humans who design them in meaningfully different ways. The fact that these evaluations do not necessarily converge gives rise to the alignment target problem: which normative target should guide the development of artificial moral agents in high-stakes domains, and whether these plural judgments can be reconciled within a coherent account of value alignment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文探讨AI对齐中一个基本问题：应以谁的道德期望指导AI决策？实验发现，当机器人行为被描述为人类设计产物时，人们的道德判断会转向更强烈的义务论（规则性）推理。这表明人类、AI系统及其设计者可能受到不同的评价标准，产生“对齐目标问题”。
Motivation: 现有对齐研究常默认以人类自身行为作为基准，但研究表明人们对人类和AI的判断并不一致。本文进一步探究当AI的人类起源可见时，以及当评判对象是编程者时，道德判断如何变化。
Method: 通过在线实验（1002名美国成年人），在失控矿车情境中操纵评价对象（修理工、修理机器人、由公司工程师编程的机器人、编程工程师），测量道德判断。
Result: 修理工与机器人之间评价无显著差异；但当机器人行为被描述为人类设计时，评价显著转向更义务论（规则依赖）的推理，且对编程机器人或工程师的评价类似。
Conclusion: 人们可能对人类、AI系统及其设计者采用不同的规范性标准，这给价值对齐带来“对齐目标问题”：在高风险领域应以哪个目标指导人工道德智能体的发展？

papers.title: GenMatter: Perceiving Physical Objects with Generative Matter Models
papers.abstract_en: Human visual perception offers valuable insights for understanding computational principles of motion-based scene interpretation. Humans robustly detect and segment moving entities that constitute independently moveable chunks of matter, whether observing sparse moving dots, textured surfaces, or naturalistic scenes. In contrast, existing computer vision systems lack a unified approach that works across these diverse settings. Inspired by principles of human perception, we propose a generative model that hierarchically groups low-level motion cues and high-level appearance features into particles (small Gaussians representing local matter), and groups particles into clusters capturing coherently and independently moveable physical entities. We develop a hardware-accelerated inference algorithm based on parallelized block Gibbs sampling to recover stable particle motion and groupings. Our model operates on different kinds of inputs (random dots, stylized textures, or naturalistic RGB video), enabling it to work across settings where biological vision succeeds but existing computer vision approaches do not. We validate this unified framework across three domains: on 2D random dot kinematograms, our approach captures human object perception including graded uncertainty across ambiguous conditions; on a Gestalt-inspired dataset of camouflaged rotating objects, our approach recovers correct 3D structure from motion and thereby accurate 2D object segmentation; and on naturalistic RGB videos, our model tracks the moving 3D matter that makes up deforming objects, enabling robust object-level scene understanding. This work thus establishes a general framework for motion-based perception grounded in principles of human vision.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文受人类视觉感知启发，提出一种生成模型（GenMatter），通过层次化地将低层运动线索和高层外观特征分组为高斯粒子（particles），再将粒子聚类为独立移动的物理实体。采用并行化块吉布斯采样（block Gibbs sampling）进行推理，适用于随机点、纹理和自然RGB视频等多种输入。实验表明，该模型在随机点运动图（random dot kinematograms）上能复现人类感知的不确定性，在伪装旋转物体数据集上恢复3D结构并实现2D分割，在自然视频中追踪变形物体的3D物质，从而建立统一的运动感知框架。
Motivation: 现有计算机视觉系统缺乏统一的方法来处理从稀疏运动点到自然场景的多种运动输入，而人类视觉能稳健地检测和分割独立移动的物质。
Method: 提出层次化生成模型，将图像区域表示为小高斯粒子（表示局部物质），并通过并行化块吉布斯采样算法推断粒子的稳定运动及其分组，最终聚类为独立的物理实体。模型统一处理随机点、纹理和RGB视频。
Result: 在随机点运动图上匹配人类感知的渐变不确定性；在伪装旋转物体数据集上从运动恢复正确3D结构并得到精确2D分割；在自然RGB视频中跟踪变形物体的3D物质，实现物体级场景理解。
Conclusion: 该工作建立了一个基于人类视觉原理的运动感知通用框架，能够处理多种视觉输入，并复现生物视觉的关键能力。

papers.title: RateQuant: Optimal Mixed-Precision KV Cache Quantization via Rate-Distortion Theory
papers.abstract_en: Large language models cache all previously computed key-value (KV) pairs during generation, and this KV cache grows linearly with sequence length, making it a primary memory bottleneck for serving. Quantizing the KV cache to fewer bits reduces this cost, yet all current quantizers assign the same bit-width to every attention head, ignoring the large variation in head importance. A natural idea is to allocate more bits to important heads and fewer to the rest. We show, however, that such mixed-precision allocation has a hidden pitfall: each quantizer follows a different distortion curve D(b)=alpha*beta^{-b}, and the decay rate beta varies from 3.6 to 5.3 across quantizer designs. Applying one quantizer's distortion model to another inverts the allocation order and makes performance worse than uniform quantization. We call this failure mode distortion model mismatch and propose RateQuant to resolve it. RateQuant fits a per-quantizer distortion model from a small calibration set, then solves the resulting bit-allocation problem in closed form via reverse waterfilling from rate-distortion theory. On Qwen3-8B at 2.5 average bits, calibrated RateQuant reduces KIVI's perplexity from 49.3 to 14.9 (70% reduction) and improves QuaRot by 6.6 PPL. The entire calibration takes 1.6 s on a single GPU and adds zero overhead at inference time.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文发现混合精度KV缓存量化中，不同量化器的失真曲线差异（beta从3.6到5.3）会导致分配顺序反转，称为失真模型失配。提出RateQuant，通过小校准集拟合每个量化器的失真模型，并利用率失真理论中的反向注水法闭式求解比特分配。在Qwen3-8B上，平均2.5比特时，RateQuant将KIVI的困惑度从49.3降至14.9（降低70%），并提升QuaRot 6.6 PPL。
Motivation: 现有KV缓存量化对所有注意力头使用相同比特数，忽略头重要性差异。混合精度分配本应更优，但不同量化器的失真曲线差异会导致分配顺序反转，性能甚至差于均匀量化。
Method: 提出RateQuant框架：首先从小校准集拟合每个量化器的失真模型D(b)=alpha*beta^{-b}，然后通过率失真理论中的反向注水法（reverse waterfilling）闭式求解最优比特分配。
Result: 在Qwen3-8B模型上，平均2.5比特时，RateQuant使KIVI的困惑度从49.3降至14.9（70%减少），并提升QuaRot 6.6 PPL。校准仅需1.6秒，推理零开销。
Conclusion: 失真模型失配是混合精度KV缓存量化的关键陷阱，通过每量化器独立建模和率失真分配可显著提升性能。

papers.title: Simplified Sparse Attention via Gist Tokens
papers.abstract_en: Sparse attention can reduce the cost of long-context inference, but most variants introduce new architectural components. We introduce Simplified Sparse Attention (SSA), a simpler approach to sparse attention that requires no architectural changes. Concretely, we first perform continued pretraining on sequences interleaved with gist tokens. We optimize the standard next-token loss as usual, but the gist tokens use an attention mask to restrict what parts of the context the language model can attend to; this teaches the model to pack each chunk's important information into the gist tokens. At inference time, SSA scores chunks via attention between the current query and the small set of gist tokens, selectively unfolding the top-k chunks by reintroducing their corresponding raw tokens. Since the query is scored only against the gist tokens, we avoid the memory-bandwidth cost associated with naive scoring against the full KV cache, without requiring the auxiliary KV cache approach used by sparse attention methods. On LongBench, SSA consistently outperforms compression and inference-time sparse-attention baselines under the same compression ratio. More strikingly, in retrieval-augmented generation, SSA can even outperform full attention after continued pretraining by over 5.7 points. We attribute this to the ability of SSA's selective unfolding, which concentrates attention on the query-relevant chunks and effectively filters out noise. SSA further extends to a hierarchical gist-of-gist variant (H-SSA) that achieves log-linear decoding complexity while maintaining or improving accuracy at high compression ratios up to 32x. The code is available at https://github.com/yuzhenmao/simplified-sparse-attention/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出简化稀疏注意力（SSA），通过在预训练时插入gist标记并限制其注意力范围，使模型将每个块的重要信息压缩到gist标记中。推理时，仅对gist标记评分并选择性地展开top-k块，避免了全KV缓存的带宽开销。在LongBench上，SSA在相同压缩比下优于压缩和推理时稀疏注意力基线；在检索增强生成中甚至超过全注意力5.7个百分点。进一步提出层次化变体H-SSA，实现log-linear解码复杂度并在32倍压缩下保持或提升精度。
Motivation: 现有稀疏注意力方法大多引入新的架构组件，复杂且可能带来额外开销，SSA旨在以更简单的方式实现稀疏注意力，无需修改模型架构。
Method: 在预训练阶段将序列与gist标记交错，gist标记通过注意力掩码限制只能关注所在块，迫使模型将块信息压缩到gist中。推理时，当前查询仅与gist标记计算注意力得分，选择得分最高的top-k块，然后展开这些块的原始标记参与后续注意力计算。
Result: 在LongBench上，SSA在相同压缩比下一致优于压缩方法和推理时稀疏注意力基线；在检索增强生成任务中，经过继续预训练后，SSA甚至比全注意力高出5.7个百分点。层次化变体H-SSA在32倍压缩比下保持或提升精度，并实现log-linear解码复杂度。
Conclusion: SSA的选择性展开机制能够聚焦于查询相关块并有效过滤噪声，且无需辅助KV缓存，是一种简洁有效的稀疏注意力方案。

papers.title: HyLaR: Hybrid Latent Reasoning with Decoupled Policy Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning significantly elevates the complex problem-solving capabilities of multimodal large language models (MLLMs). However, adapting CoT to vision typically discretizes signals to fit LLM inputs, causing early semantic collapse and discarding fine-grained details. While external tools can mitigate this, they introduce a rigid bottleneck, confining reasoning to predefined operations. Although recent latent reasoning paradigms internalize visual states to overcome these limitations, optimizing the resulting hybrid discrete-continuous action space remains challenging. In this work, we propose HyLaR (Hybrid Latent Reasoning), a framework that seamlessly interleaves discrete text generation with continuous visual latent representations. Specifically, following an initial cold-start supervised fine-tuning (SFT), we introduce DePO (Decoupled Policy Optimization) to enable effective reinforcement learning within this hybrid space. DePO decomposes the policy gradient objective, applying independent trust-region constraints to the textual and latent components, alongside an exact closed-form von Mises-Fisher (vMF) KL regularizer. Extensive experiments demonstrate that HyLaR outperforms standard MLLMs and state-of-the-art latent reasoning approaches across fine-grained perception and general multimodal understanding benchmarks. Code is available at https://github.com/EthenCheng/HyLaR.
papers.journal_ref: ECCV 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 HyLaR 框架，将离散文本生成与连续视觉潜在表示交错，解决链式思维推理在多模态大语言模型中离散化导致的语义崩溃和细节丢失问题。引入解耦策略优化 (DePO) 对文本和潜在成分分别施加信任区域约束和精确闭式 vMF KL 正则化，实现混合空间的强化学习。实验表明 HyLaR 在细粒度感知和通用多模态理解基准上优于标准 MLLM 及最新潜在推理方法。
Motivation: 现有链式思维推理适应视觉时需离散化信号，导致早期语义崩溃并丢弃细粒度细节；外部工具引入刚性瓶颈限制推理；优化混合离散-连续动作空间具有挑战性。
Method: HyLaR 框架先进行冷启动监督微调，再提出解耦策略优化 (DePO)，将策略梯度目标分解，对文本和潜在成分应用独立信任区域约束及精确闭式 von Mises-Fisher KL 正则化。
Result: 在细粒度感知和通用多模态理解基准上，HyLaR 优于标准 MLLM 和现有潜在推理方法。

papers.title: From Synchrony to Sequence: Exo-to-Ego Generation via Interpolation
papers.abstract_en: Exo-to-Ego video generation aims to synthesize a first-person video from a synchronized third-person view and corresponding camera poses. While paired supervision is available, synchronized exo-ego data inherently introduces substantial spatio-temporal and geometric discontinuities, violating the smooth-motion assumptions of standard video generation benchmarks. We identify this synchronization-induced jump as the central challenge and propose Syn2Seq-Forcing, a sequential formulation that interpolates between the source and target videos to form a single continuous signal. By reframing Exo2Ego as sequential signal modeling rather than a conventional condition-output task, our approach enables diffusion-based sequence models, e.g. Diffusion Forcing Transformers (DFoT), to capture coherent transitions across frames more effectively. Empirically, we show that interpolating only the videos, without performing pose interpolation already produces significant improvements, emphasizing that the dominant difficulty arises from spatio-temporal discontinuities. Beyond immediate performance gains, this formulation establishes a general and flexible framework capable of unifying both Exo2Ego and Ego2Exo generation within a single continuous sequence model, providing a principled foundation for future research in cross-view video synthesis.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对Exo-to-Ego视频生成中同步数据带来的时空不连续性问题，提出Syn2Seq-Forcing方法，通过插值源和目标视频形成连续信号，将任务重构为序列建模。实验表明仅视频插值即可显著提升生成质量，并统一了Exo2Ego和Ego2Exo两种生成方向。
Motivation: 同步的exo-ego数据存在显著时空与几何跳跃，违反标准视频生成中的平滑运动假设，导致常规条件生成方法效果不佳。
Method: 提出Syn2Seq-Forcing，在源视频与目标视频之间进行插值，形成单一连续信号，并利用扩散力变压器（DFoT）等序列模型建模连贯帧间过渡。
Result: 仅对视频进行插值（无需位姿插值）即可显著改善生成结果，验证了主要障碍在于不连续性。
Conclusion: 该序列化框架为跨视角视频合成提供了统一且灵活的范式，可同时处理Exo2Ego与Ego2Exo任务，为后续研究奠定基础。

papers.title: High-dimensional inference for the $γ$-ray sky with differentiable programming
papers.abstract_en: We motivate the use of differentiable probabilistic programming techniques in order to account for the large model-space inherent to astrophysical $γ$-ray analyses. Targeting the longstanding Galactic Center $γ$-ray Excess (GCE) puzzle, we construct differentiable forward model and likelihood that make liberal use of GPU acceleration and vectorization in order to simultaneously account for a continuum of possible spatial morphologies consistent with the GCE emission in a fully probabilistic manner. Our setup allows for efficient inference over the large model space using variational methods. Beyond application to $γ$-ray data, a goal of this work is to showcase how differentiable probabilistic programming can be used as a tool to enable flexible analyses of astrophysical datasets.
papers.comment: 20 pages, 16 figures. Code available at https://github.com/smsharma/fermi-prob-prog. V2: Updated with a more complete set of coverge tests
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出利用可微概率编程（differentiable probabilistic programming）技术处理γ射线天文分析中的大模型空间问题。针对银河系中心γ射线过剩（GCE）这一长期未解之谜，作者构建了可微前向模型和似然函数，充分利用GPU加速和向量化，以完全概率化的方式同时考虑与GCE发射一致的连续空间形态。该方法通过变分推断实现对大模型空间的高效推断，并展示了可微概率编程在灵活分析天体物理数据集中的潜力。
Motivation: 传统γ射线分析受限于模型空间过大，难以同时考虑多种空间形态。银河系中心γ射线过剩（GCE）的具体起源尚不明确，需要一种能够灵活处理高维参数空间的方法。
Method: 构建可微前向模型和似然函数，使用GPU加速和向量化计算，通过变分方法（variational methods）在大模型空间中进行高效推断。
Result: 该方法能够以概率方式同时处理与GCE发射一致的大量可能空间形态，实现对大模型空间的高效推断。
Conclusion: 本文展示了可微概率编程作为通用工具在灵活分析天体物理数据集方面的潜力，并不仅限于γ射线数据。

papers.title: Can LLMs Reason About Attention? Towards Zero-Shot Analysis of Multimodal Classroom Behavior
papers.abstract_en: Understanding student engagement usually requires time-consuming manual observation or invasive recording that raises privacy concerns. We present a privacy-preserving pipeline that analyzes classroom videos to extract insights about student attention, without storing any identifiable footage. Our system runs on a single GPU, using OpenPose for skeletal extraction and Gaze-LLE for visual attention estimation. Original video frames are deleted immediately after pose extraction, thus only geometric coordinates (stored as JSON) are retained, ensuring compliance with FERPA. The extracted pose and gaze data is processed by QwQ-32B-Reasoning, which performs zero-shot analysis of student behavior across lecture segments. Instructors access results through a web dashboard featuring attention heatmaps and behavioral summaries. Our preliminary findings suggest that LLMs may show promise for multimodal behavior understanding, although they still struggle with spatial reasoning about classroom layouts. We discuss these limitations and outline directions for improving LLM spatial comprehension in educational analytics contexts.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种隐私保护的课堂视频分析管道，使用OpenPose提取骨骼、Gaze-LLE估计视线，并利用QwQ-32B-Reasoning进行零样本学生行为分析。系统在单GPU上运行，视频帧在姿态提取后立即删除，仅保留几何坐标以确保FERPA合规。初步发现表明，LLM在多模态行为理解上展现出潜力，但在课堂布局空间推理方面仍存在困难。
Motivation: 传统学生参与度分析依赖耗时的手动观察或侵入性录制，存在隐私问题。本文旨在构建不存储可识别视频的隐私保护管道，同时利用LLM实现自动行为分析。
Method: 管道包括以下步骤：OpenPose提取骨骼关键点、Gaze-LLE估计视觉注意力、原始帧立即删除仅保留JSON坐标、QwQ-32B-Reasoning对姿势和注视数据进行零样本行为分析。结果通过带有注意力热图和摘要的网络仪表盘呈现。
Result: 初步结果表明LLM在理解多模态行为上显示出潜力，但在推断教室布局中的空间关系时仍然表现不佳。
Conclusion: 本文讨论了LLM在空间推理上的局限性，并提出了改进教育分析中LLM空间理解能力的方向。

papers.title: Contrastive Language-Colored Pointmap Pretraining for Unified 3D Scene Understanding
papers.abstract_en: Pretraining 3D encoders by aligning with Contrastive Language Image Pretraining (CLIP) has emerged as a promising direction to learn generalizable representations for 3D scene understanding. In this paper, we propose UniScene3D, a transformer-based encoder that learns unified scene representations from multi-view colored pointmaps, jointly modeling image appearance and geometry. For robust colored pointmap representation learning, we introduce novel cross-view geometric alignment and grounded view alignment to enforce cross-view geometry and semantic consistency. Extensive low-shot and task-specific fine-tuning evaluations on viewpoint grounding, scene retrieval, scene type classification, and 3D VQA demonstrate our state-of-the-art performance. These results highlight the effectiveness of our approach for unified 3D scene understanding. https://yebulabula.github.io/UniScene3D/
papers.comment: This paper requires substantial refinement for the camera-ready version, including revisions to the title, experimental results, and discussion
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出UniScene3D，一种基于Transformer的编码器，通过对比语言-彩色点图预训练（CLIP）学习统一的3D场景表示。方法利用多视图彩色点图联合建模图像外观和几何，并引入跨视图几何对齐和接地视图对齐以增强一致性。在视角接地、场景检索、场景类型分类和3D VQA等任务上取得了最先进性能。
Motivation: 现有3D场景理解方法通常需要任务特定的设计，缺乏统一表示。利用CLIP对齐进行预训练是一个有希望的方向，但需要更好地融合外观和几何信息。
Method: 提出UniScene3D，使用Transformer编码器处理多视图彩色点图；采用对比学习与CLIP对齐；引入跨视图几何对齐和接地视图对齐来强制几何和语义一致性。
Result: 在低样本和任务特定微调设置下，在视角接地、场景检索、场景类型分类和3D VQA任务上达到最先进性能。
Conclusion: 该方法展示了在统一3D场景理解中的有效性，通过联合建模外观和几何以及跨视图对齐实现。

papers.title: An Approach to Enriching Surgical Video Datasets for Fine-Grained Spatial-Temporal Understanding of Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Surgical video understanding is a crucial prerequisite for advancing Computer-Assisted Surgery. While vision-language models (VLMs) have recently been applied to the surgical domain, existing surgical vision-language datasets lack in capturing and evaluating complex, interleaved spatial-temporal dynamics. Creating large scale datasets that accurately represent fine-grained spatial-temporal relationships in surgical videos is challenging due to costly manual annotations or error-prone generation using large language models. To address this gap, we introduce the SurgSTU-Pipeline, a deterministic generation pipeline featuring temporal and spatial continuity filtering to reliably create surgical datasets for fine-grained spatial-temporal multimodal understanding. Applying this pipeline to publicly available surgical datasets, we create the SurgSTU dataset, comprising 6711 video clips densely extended with 150k fine-grained spatial-temporal question-answer samples. Our comprehensive evaluation shows that while state-of-the-art generalist VLMs struggle in zero-shot settings, their spatial-temporal capabilities can be improved through in-context learning. A fine-tuned VLM on the SurgSTU training dataset achieves highest performance among all spatial-temporal tasks, validating the dataset's efficacy to improve spatial-temporal understanding of VLMs in surgical videos. The project is available here: https://lennart-maack.github.io/SurgSTU-project
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SurgSTU-Pipeline，一个确定性生成流程，用于创建细粒度时空多模态理解的手术视频数据集 SurgSTU（6711个视频片段，150k问答对）。评估表明通用VLM在零样本下表现挣扎，而通过上下文学习或微调可提升时空理解能力。
Motivation: 现有手术视觉-语言数据集缺乏对复杂交织的时空动态的捕捉和评估，手动标注昂贵，大模型生成易错。
Method: 提出 SurgSTU-Pipeline，包含时空连续性过滤的确定性生成流程，基于公开手术数据集生成 SurgSTU 数据集。
Result: 重建并评估了多种 VLM，零样本表现差，但通过上下文学习可提升；在 SurgSTU 上微调的 VLM 在所有时空任务上取得最高性能。
Conclusion: 该数据集有效提升了 VLM 在手术视频中的时空理解能力。

papers.title: IWP: Token Pruning as Implicit Weight Pruning in Large Vision Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Large Vision Language Models show impressive performance across image and video understanding tasks, yet their computational cost grows rapidly with the number of visual tokens. Existing token pruning methods mitigate this issue through empirical approaches while overlooking the internal mechanism of attention. In this paper, we propose a novel training free token pruning framework grounded in the dual form perspective of attention. We reformulate attention as an implicit linear layer whose weight matrix is the sum of rank 1 outer products, each generated by a single token's key value pair. Token pruning thus reduces to selecting an optimal subset of these rank 1 updates that best approximates the original dual weight matrix. Extending this perspective to standard softmax attention in LVLMs, we derive a novel metric quantifying both a token's information magnitude and information duplication. To efficiently select the subset with the proposed metric, we introduce Progressive Chunked Maximal Marginal Relevance. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method achieves a better trade off between performance and efficiency, while providing another perspective on existing pruning approaches.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种无需训练的token剪枝框架，基于注意力的对偶形式视角，将注意力重写为隐式线性层，其权重矩阵由每个token的键值对产生的秩1外积之和构成。剪枝转化为选择最优子集来近似原始对偶权重矩阵。作者推导出新的度量，量化token的信息幅度和信息重复，并提出渐进分块最大边际相关性（Progressive Chunked Maximal Marginal Relevance）来高效选择子集。实验表明在性能和效率之间取得了更好的权衡。
Motivation: 现有token剪枝方法基于经验方法，忽视了注意力内部机制，且计算成本随视觉token数量快速增长。
Method: 基于注意力的对偶形式，将注意力视为隐式线性层，权重矩阵由所有token的秩1外积和组成。剪枝目标是最优子集选择，以近似原始权重矩阵。引入度量同时考虑信息幅度和信息重复，并提出渐进分块最大边际相关性算法高效选取子集。
Result: 实验表明该方法在性能和效率之间取得了更好的权衡，并为现有剪枝方法提供了新视角。
Conclusion: 提供了一个无需训练的剪枝框架，基于注意力的对偶形式，为理解token剪枝提供了新视角。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.method: 基于注意力的对偶形式，将注意力视为隐式线性层，权重矩阵由所有token的秩1外积和组成。剪枝目标是最优子集选择，以近似原始权重矩阵。引入度量同时考虑信息幅度和信息重复，并提出渐进分块最大边际相关性算法高效选取子集。
summary_sections.result: 实验表明该方法在性能和效率之间取得了更好的权衡，并为现有剪枝方法提供了新视角。
summary_sections.conclusion: 提供了一个无需训练的剪枝框架，基于注意力的对偶形式，为理解token剪枝提供了新视角。

papers.title: From Dispersion to Attraction: Spectral Dynamics of Hallucination Across Whisper Model Scales
papers.abstract_en: Hallucinations in large ASR models present a critical safety risk. In this work, we propose the \textit{Spectral Sensitivity Theorem}, which predicts a phase transition in deep networks from a dispersive regime (signal decay) to an attractor regime (rank-1 collapse) governed by layer-wise gain and alignment. We validate this theory by analyzing the eigenspectra of activation graphs in Whisper models (Tiny to Large-v3-Turbo) under adversarial stress. Our results confirm the theoretical prediction: intermediate models exhibit \textit{Structural Disintegration} (Regime I), characterized by a $13.4\%$ collapse in Cross-Attention rank. Conversely, large models enter a \textit{Compression-Seeking Attractor} state (Regime II), where Self-Attention actively compresses rank ($-2.34\%$) and hardens the spectral slope, decoupling the model from acoustic evidence.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出频谱敏感性定理（Spectral Sensitivity Theorem），预测深度网络从色散（信号衰减）到吸引子（秩1坍缩）的相变，并通过Whisper模型（Tiny到Large-v3-Turbo）在对抗压力下的激活图谱特征谱验证理论。中间模型出现结构解体（Regime I），交叉注意力秩坍缩13.4%；大型模型进入压缩寻求吸引子状态（Regime II），自注意力主动压缩秩（-2.34%）并硬化谱斜率，使模型与声学证据解耦。
Motivation: 大型ASR模型中的幻觉构成严重安全风险，现有研究缺乏对幻觉背后网络动力学机制的理论理解。
Method: 提出频谱敏感性定理，分析层间增益和对齐导致相变；通过Whisper模型不同规模的激活图特征谱进行实证验证。
Result: 中间模型（Regime I）交叉注意力秩坍缩13.4%；大型模型（Regime II）自注意力秩压缩-2.34%，谱斜率增加，模型与声学证据解耦。
Conclusion: 验证了深度网络中存在从色散到吸引子的相变，为理解ASR幻觉提供理论框架，但未涉及具体缓解方法。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Context-specific Credibility-aware Multimodal Fusion with Conditional Probabilistic Circuits
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal fusion requires integrating information from multiple sources that may conflict depending on context. Existing fusion approaches typically rely on static assumptions about source reliability, limiting their ability to resolve conflicts when a modality becomes unreliable due to situational factors such as sensor degradation or class-specific corruption. We introduce C$^2$MF, a context-specfic credibility-aware multimodal fusion framework that models per-instance source reliability using a Conditional Probabilistic Circuit (CPC). We formalize instance-level reliability through Context-Specific Information Credibility (CSIC), a KL-divergence-based measure computed exactly from the CPC. CSIC generalizes conventional static credibility estimates as a special case, enabling principled and adaptive reliability assessment. To evaluate robustness under cross-modal conflicts, we propose the Conflict benchmark, in which class-specific corruptions deliberately induce discrepancies between different modalities. Experimental results show that C$^2$MF improves predictive accuracy by up to 29% over static-reliability baselines in high-noise settings, while preserving the interpretability advantages of probabilistic circuit-based fusion.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出上下文特定的可信感知多模态融合框架 C²MF，利用条件概率电路 (CPC) 建模每实例的源可靠性，并基于 KL 散度定义上下文特定信息可信度 (CSIC)。在跨模态冲突的 Conflict 基准上，C²MF 在高噪声设置下相比静态可靠性基线提升了高达 29% 的预测精度，同时保持了概率电路融合的可解释性。
Motivation: 现有多模态融合方法通常假设源可靠性静态不变，无法应对因情境因素（如传感器退化或类别特定损坏）导致模态不可靠时的冲突。
Method: 引入条件概率电路 (CPC) 来学习上下文相关的模态可靠性，并通过 KL 散度计算实例级别的上下文特定信息可信度 (CSIC)，作为自适应融合权重。
Result: 在 Conflict 基准上，C²MF 在高噪声条件下将预测准确率比静态可靠性基线提高最多 29%。
Conclusion: C²MF 实现了自适应、可解释的多模态融合，在跨模态冲突场景下显著优于静态方法，但未在气象或降水领域验证。

papers.title: ET-SAM: Efficient Point Prompt Prediction in SAM for Unified Scene Text Detection and Layout Analysis
papers.abstract_en: Previous works based on Segment Anything Model (SAM) have achieved promising performance in unified scene text detection and layout analysis. However, the typical reliance on pixel-level text segmentation for sampling thousands of foreground points as prompts leads to unsatisfied inference latency and limited data utilization. To address above issues, we propose ET-SAM, an Efficient framework with two decoders for unified scene Text detection and layout analysis based on SAM. Technically, we customize a lightweight point decoder that produces word heatmaps for achieving a few foreground points, thereby eliminating excessive point prompts and accelerating inference. Without the dependence on pixel-level segmentation, we further design a joint training strategy to leverage existing data with heterogeneous text-level annotations. Specifically, the datasets with multi-level, word-level only, and line-level only annotations are combined in parallel as a unified training set. For these datasets, we introduce three corresponding sets of learnable task prompts in both the point decoder and hierarchical mask decoder to mitigate discrepancies across datasets.Extensive experiments demonstrate that, compared to the previous SAM-based architecture, ET-SAM achieves about 3$\times$ inference acceleration while obtaining competitive performance on HierText, and improves an average of 11.0% F-score on Total-Text, CTW1500, and ICDAR15.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ET-SAM 基于 Segment Anything Model (SAM) 提出高效统一场景文本检测与布局分析框架。通过轻量级点解码器预测单词热图，减少前景点提示数量，实现约3倍推理加速。联合训练策略整合多层级、词级和行级标注数据，并引入可学习任务提示消除数据集差异。在 HierText、Total-Text、CTW1500 和 ICDAR15 上取得竞争性能。
Motivation: 现有 SAM 方法依赖像素级文本分割采样数千前景点作为提示，导致推理延迟高、数据利用率低。
Method: 定制轻量级点解码器生成单词热图以获取少量前景点，避免大量点提示；设计联合训练策略，利用多层级、词级、行级异构标注，并引入三组可学习任务提示缓解数据集差异。
Result: 相比先前 SAM 架构，ET-SAM 在 HierText 上实现约3倍推理加速，性能持平；在 Total-Text、CTW1500 和 ICDAR15 上平均 F-score 提升11.0%。
Conclusion: ET-SAM 通过高效点提示预测和异构数据训练，兼顾速度与精度，为场景文本检测与布局分析提供统一方案。

papers.title: ProactiveBench: Benchmarking Proactiveness in Multimodal Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Effective collaboration begins with knowing when to ask for help. For example, when trying to identify an occluded object, a human would ask someone to remove the obstruction. Can MLLMs exhibit a similar "proactive" behavior by requesting simple user interventions? To investigate this, we introduce ProactiveBench, a benchmark built from seven repurposed datasets that tests proactiveness across different tasks such as recognizing occluded objects, enhancing image quality, and interpreting coarse sketches. We evaluate 22 MLLMs on ProactiveBench, showing that (i) they generally lack proactiveness; (ii) proactiveness does not correlate with model capacity; (iii) "hinting" at proactiveness yields only marginal gains. Surprisingly, we found that conversation histories and in-context learning introduce negative biases, hindering performance. Finally, we explore a simple fine-tuning strategy based on reinforcement learning: its results suggest that proactiveness can be learned, even generalizing to unseen scenarios. We publicly release ProactiveBench as a first step toward building proactive multimodal models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ProactiveBench，一个从七个现有数据集构建的基准，用于评估多模态大语言模型（MLLM）的主动性（即主动请求用户干预的能力）。在22个MLLM上的实验显示，模型普遍缺乏主动性，且主动性不随模型容量增加而提升；对话历史和上下文学习甚至引入负面偏见。基于强化学习的简单微调策略表明主动性可以被学习并泛化到未见场景。
Motivation: 现有研究关注MLLM的响应能力，但缺乏对模型是否能在遇到困难时主动请求用户帮助（例如识别遮挡物体、提升图像质量）的评估。本文旨在系统性地衡量这种“主动性”行为。
Method: 构建ProactiveBench基准，覆盖遮挡物体识别、图像质量增强、粗略草图解读等任务；评估22个MLLM的主动性，并探索基于强化学习的微调策略。
Result: 模型普遍缺乏主动性；主动性不与模型参数量相关；提供提示仅带来边际提升；对话历史和上下文学习反而引入负面偏差；强化学习微调可学习主动性并泛化。
Conclusion: 多模态大模型在主动请求用户干预方面存在明显不足，但通过强化学习可以习得这一能力。ProactiveBench作为首个主动性基准，为未来研究提供基础。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: HiMu: Hierarchical Multimodal Frame Selection for Long Video Question Answering
papers.abstract_en: Long-form video question answering requires reasoning over extended temporal contexts, making frame selection a critical bottleneck for multi-modal large language models (MLLMs) bound by finite context windows. Within the controlled frame-budget regime that governs practical deployment, prior selectors score frames against a single global query embedding; as a result, compositional multimodal questions that involve temporal ordering or cross-modal cues such as ``what happens on screen right after the narrator mentions the reaction?'' are flattened into a representation that loses sub-event ordering and modality bindings. We introduce \textbf{HiMu}, a training-free framework for compositional multimodal frame selection. A single text-only LLM call decomposes the query into a hierarchical logic tree whose leaves are atomic predicates, each routed to a lightweight expert spanning vision (CLIP, open-vocabulary detection, OCR) and audio (speech recognition and non-speech sound matching). Expert signals are normalized, smoothed to align across modalities, and composed bottom-up through fuzzy-logic operators that enforce temporal sequencing and adjacency, yielding a continuous per-frame satisfaction curve. Under the standard 16-frame budget on Video-MME, LongVideoBench, and HERBench-Lite, HiMu achieves state-of-the-art accuracy among frame selection methods and improves over uniform sampling across seven diverse MLLMs as a drop-in module, matching the accuracy of uniform sampling at $4\times$ its frame budget, without retraining and without multiple iterative MLLM calls during selection.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 HiMu，一种无需训练的分层多模态帧选择框架，用于长视频问答。该方法通过单一 LLM 调用将问题分解为逻辑树，叶子节点由轻量级视觉和音频专家处理，并通过模糊逻辑算子组合得到逐帧满意度曲线。在标准 16 帧预算下，HiMu 在 Video-MME、LongVideoBench 和 HERBench-Lite 上达到帧选择方法中的最高准确率，并作为即插即用模块提升多种 MLLM 的性能，匹配均匀采样在 4 倍帧预算下的准确率。
Motivation: 多模态大模型受限于有限上下文窗口，帧选择成为长视频问答的关键瓶颈。现有方法使用单一全局查询嵌入评分，丢失了子事件顺序和模态绑定，无法处理涉及时间顺序或跨模态线索的组合性问题。
Method: HiMu 是无训练框架：用文本 LLM 将问题分解为层次逻辑树，叶子节点为原子谓词，分配给视觉（CLIP、开放词汇检测、OCR）和音频（语音识别、非语音声音匹配）的轻量级专家。专家信号经过归一化和跨模态平滑，通过模糊逻辑算子自底向上组合，强制时序和邻接关系，生成连续逐帧满意度曲线。
Result: 在标准 16 帧预算下，HiMu 在 Video-MME、LongVideoBench 和 HERBench-Lite 上达到帧选择方法中的最高准确率，作为即插即用模块在七种不同 MLLM 上优于均匀采样，且匹配均匀采样在 4 倍帧预算下的准确率。
Conclusion: HiMu 无需训练和多次迭代 MLLM 调用即可实现高效的组合式帧选择。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: SHIFT: Motion Alignment in Video Diffusion Models with Adversarial Hybrid Fine-Tuning
papers.abstract_en: Image-conditioned video diffusion models achieve impressive visual realism but often suffer from weakened motion fidelity, e.g., reduced motion dynamics or degraded long-term temporal coherence, especially after fine-tuning. We study motion alignment in video diffusion models post-training. To address this, we introduce pixel-motion rewards based on pixel flux dynamics, capturing both instantaneous and long-term motion consistency. We further propose \underline{S}mooth \underline{H}ybr\underline{i}d \underline{F}ine-\underline{t}uning (SHIFT), a scalable reward-driven framework that unifies supervised fine-tuning and advantage-weighted fine-tuning. Benefiting from novel adversarial advantages, SHIFT improves convergence speed and mitigates reward hacking. Experiments show that our approach efficiently resolves dynamic-degree collapse in modern video diffusion models supervised fine-tuning. Project page: https://xiye20.github.io/projects/SHIFT/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对图像条件视频扩散模型在微调后运动保真度下降的问题（包括动态度减弱和长期时间一致性退化），提出基于像素通量动力学（pixel flux dynamics）的像素运动奖励，并设计了SHIFT框架（Smooth Hybrid Fine-Tuning），统一了监督微调与优势加权微调，利用对抗性优势加速收敛并缓解奖励黑客（reward hacking）。实验表明该方法能有效解决现代视频扩散模型监督微调中的动态度坍塌问题。
Motivation: 图像条件视频扩散模型在微调后运动动态减弱、长期时间一致性退化，现有方法难以同时保持运动真实性和视觉质量。
Method: 提出像素运动奖励（基于瞬时和长期像素通量一致性），以及SHIFT框架——结合监督微调与优势加权微调，并引入对抗性优势（adversarial advantages）以改善收敛和抑制奖励黑客。
Result: 实验证明该方法能够高效解决视频扩散模型微调中的动态度坍塌问题（dynamic-degree collapse）。
Conclusion: SHIFT通过对抗性优势统一监督微调和优势加权微调，为视频扩散模型的运动对齐提供了一种可扩展的奖励驱动方案。

papers.title: An Auditable AI Agent Loop for Empirical Economics: A Case Study in Forecast Combination
papers.abstract_en: AI coding agents, general purpose assistants that write and execute code, make empirical specification search fast and cheap, but they also widen hidden researcher degrees of freedom. This paper adapts an open-source agent-loop architecture to an empirical economics workflow and adds a post-search holdout evaluation. In a forecast-combination illustration, independent agent searches find methods that improve on benchmarks from the original study. Logged search and holdout evaluation together make adaptive specification search more transparent and help distinguish robust improvements from sample-specific discoveries.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文为实证经济学中的规范搜索问题提出一种可审计的AI代理循环架构，并在预测组合的案例中展示其有效性。通过将开源agent-loop适配到经济学工作流并引入搜索后保留评估，独立代理搜索找到了优于原始研究基准的方法。日志记录与保留评估共同提高了自适应规范搜索的透明度，有助于区分稳健改进与样本特定发现。
Motivation: AI编码代理使实证规范搜索变得快速廉价，但同时也扩大了隐藏的研究者自由度，导致结果可能不可靠。
Method: 将开源agent-loop架构适配到实证经济学工作流，增加搜索后的保留评估环节；在预测组合案例中，让独立代理搜索寻找改进方法。
Result: 独立代理搜索找到了比原始研究更好的预测组合方法，且日志与保留评估使搜索过程透明化。
Conclusion: 该方法有助于区分稳健改进与样本特有发现，提升实证规范搜索的可审计性。

papers.title: Scene Generation at Absolute Scale: Utilizing Semantic and Geometric Guidance From Text for Accurate and Interpretable 3D Indoor Scene Generation
papers.abstract_en: We present GuidedSceneGen, a text-to-3D generation framework that produces metrically accurate, globally consistent, and semantically interpretable indoor scenes. Unlike prior text-driven methods that often suffer from geometric drift or scale ambiguity, our approach maintains an absolute world coordinate frame throughout the entire generation process. Starting from a textual scene description, we predict a global 3D layout encoding both semantic and geometric structure, which serves as a guiding proxy for downstream stages. A semantics- and depth-conditioned panoramic diffusion model then synthesizes 360° imagery aligned with the global layout, substantially improving spatial coherence. To explore unobserved regions, we employ a video diffusion model guided by optimized camera trajectories that balances coverage and collision avoidance, achieving up to 10x faster sampling compared to exhaustive path exploration. The generated views are fused using 3D Gaussian Splatting, yielding a consistent and fully navigable 3D scene in absolute scale. GuidedSceneGen enables accurate transfer of object poses and semantic labels from layout to reconstruction, and supports progressive scene expansion without re-alignment. Quantitative results and a user study demonstrate greater 3D consistency and layout plausibility compared to recent panoramic text-to-3D baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GuidedSceneGen是一个文本到3D室内场景生成框架，通过保持绝对世界坐标、预测全局布局、使用全景扩散和视频扩散模型，结合3D高斯泼溅，生成度量准确、全局一致且可导航的室内场景。定量结果和用户研究表明，该方法在3D一致性和布局合理性上优于现有基线。
Motivation: 现有文本到3D的室内场景生成方法常受几何漂移和尺度模糊困扰，难以生成度量准确和全局一致的场景。
Method: 从文本描述预测全局3D布局作为语义和几何引导；利用语义和深度条件的全景扩散模型合成对齐的360°图像；通过优化的相机轨迹引导视频扩散模型探索未观察区域，实现比穷举路径快10倍的采样；最后使用3D高斯泼溅融合所有视图，得到绝对尺度的连续可导航场景。
Result: 定量评估和用户研究表明，与最近的全景文本到3D基线相比，GuidedSceneGen在3D一致性和布局合理性上更优。
Conclusion: 该方法支持准确传递物体姿态和语义标签，并允许渐进式场景扩展而无需重新对齐。

papers.title: Decentralized Orchestration Architecture for Fluid Computing: A Secure Distributed AI Use Case
papers.abstract_en: Distributed AI and IoT applications increasingly execute across heterogeneous resources spanning end devices, edge/fog infrastructure, and cloud platforms, often under different administrative domains. Fluid Computing has emerged as a promising paradigm for enhancing massive resource management across the computing continuum by treating such resources as a unified fabric, enabling optimal service-agnostic deployments driven by application requirements. However, existing solutions remain largely centralized and often do not explicitly address multi-domain considerations. This paper proposes an agnostic multi-domain orchestration architecture for fluid computing environments. The orchestration plane enables decentralized coordination among domains that maintain local autonomy while jointly realizing intent-based deployment requests from tenants, ensuring end-to-end placement and execution. To this end, the architecture elevates domain-side control services as first-class capabilities to support application-level enhancement at runtime. As a representative proof of concept, we instantiate the architecture through a distributed AI use case; specifically, we consider a multi-domain Decentralized Federated Learning (DFL) deployment under Byzantine threats. Under this setting, we leverage domain-side capabilities to enhance Byzantine security by introducing FU-HST, an SDN-enabled multi-domain anomaly detection mechanism that complements Byzantine-robust aggregation. We validate the use-case workflow via simulation in single- and multi-domain settings, evaluating anomaly detection, DFL performance, and computation/communication overhead.
papers.journal_ref: Computer Networks, Volume 284 (2026) 112369
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种面向流体计算（Fluid Computing）的不可知多域编排架构，实现去中心化协调，支持域间合作完成基于意图的部署请求。通过分布式联邦学习（DFL）用例验证，引入FU-HST机制增强拜占庭安全性，在单/多域模拟中评估了异常检测、DFL性能和开销。
Motivation: 现有流体计算解决方案多为中心化且未显式处理多域问题，难以满足跨域异构资源统一管理与安全需求。
Method: 提出可扩展的多域编排架构，将域侧控制服务提升为一等能力以支持运行时应用增强，并实例化为多层域DFL场景，集成FU-HST（SDN使能的多域异常检测）以增强拜占庭鲁棒聚合。
Result: 通过模拟在单域和多域设置下验证了工作流，评估异常检测、DFL性能和计算/通信开销。
Conclusion: 该架构能有效支持多域流体计算环境下的去中心化协调与安全增强，但尚需进一步验证实际部署。

papers.title: Trustworthy Predictive Distributions for Tail Events with Semiparametric Diagnostic Transport Maps
papers.abstract_en: Machine learning forecast systems are moving beyond point predictions to full predictive distributions for future outcomes y conditional on complex inputs x. However, these distributions are often locally miscalibrated, especially for high-stakes tail events where accurate uncertainty quantification is most needed to establish trust in models. Local miscalibration occurs because training data often lack examples of low-frequency events. The goal of this paper is to describe a simple, yet flexible framework that produces interpretable and robust predictive distributions that are easy to fit and may outperform high-complexity forecasting systems when train examples are limited. With this goal in mind, we introduce a semiparametric version of the Local Amortized Diagnostic and Reshaping (LADaR) framework that posits a covariate-dependent parametric model for a diagnostic transport map regressed nonparametrically on inputs to describe how to correct tail probabilities across the feature space to match calibration data. These maps provide the user with local, real-time diagnostics and a recalibrated predictive distribution through an interpretable composition with the base model. We apply these semiparametric diagnostic transport maps to short-term tropical cyclone intensity forecasting to detect evolutionary modes linked to local miscalibration in the National Hurricane Center's forecasts and improve predictions for severe weather hazards.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出半参数诊断传输图（semiparametric diagnostic transport maps）框架，用于修正机器学习预测分布在尾部事件上的局部失校准，尤其针对训练数据中低频事件缺乏导致的高风险区间。该方法将协变量依赖的参数模型与非参数回归结合，通过可解释的组成方式对基础模型进行重新校准。应用于美国国家飓风中心的热带气旋强度短期预报，检测局部失校准模式并改进极端天气预测。
Motivation: 现有预测分布常用于局部失校准，尤其在尾部事件（如极端天气）中，因训练数据低频导致不确定性量化不可靠，影响模型信任度。
Method: 提出半参数局部摊销诊断和重塑（LADaR）框架：假设协变量依赖的参数模型用于诊断传输图，通过非参数回归将输入映射到校准数据的尾部概率修正，生成可解释的再校准分布。
Result: 在热带气旋强度预报中，该方法能检测国家飓风中心预报中的局部失校准演化模式，并改善强天气灾害的预测性能。
Conclusion: 该框架简单灵活，在训练样本有限时可能优于高复杂度预报系统，提供可解释的实时诊断和再校准分布。
Relevance: 55

papers.title: Beyond Sequential Distance: Inter-Modal Distance Invariant Position Encoding
papers.abstract_en: Despite the remarkable capabilities of Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs), they still suffer from visual fading in long-context scenarios. Specifically, the attention to visual tokens diminishes as the text sequence lengthens, leading to text generation detached from visual constraints. We attribute this degradation to the inherent inductive bias of Multimodal RoPE, which penalizes inter-modal attention as the distance between visual and text tokens increases. To address this, we propose inter-modal Distance Invariant Position Encoding (DIPE), a simple but effective mechanism that disentangles position encoding based on modality interactions. DIPE retains the natural relative positioning for intra-modal interactions to preserve local structure, while enforcing an anchored perceptual proximity for inter-modal interactions. This strategy effectively mitigates the inter-modal distance-based penalty, ensuring that visual signals remain perceptually consistent regardless of the context length. Experimental results demonstrate that by integrating DIPE with Multimodal RoPE, the model maintains stable visual grounding in long-context scenarios, significantly alleviating visual fading while preserving performance on standard short-context benchmarks. Code is available at https://github.com/lchen1019/DIPE.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文指出多模态大语言模型在长上下文中存在视觉注意力衰减问题，归因于多模态RoPE对跨模态注意力随距离增加而惩罚。提出跨模态距离不变位置编码（DIPE），对模态内交互保留相对位置，对模态间交互施加锚定感知邻近性，从而缓解跨模态距离惩罚。实验表明DIPE结合多模态RoPE能稳定长上下文中的视觉基础，减轻视觉衰减，同时保持短上下文基准性能。
Motivation: 多模态大语言模型在长上下文场景中视觉令牌注意力随文本序列增长而衰减，导致生成文本脱离视觉约束。作者将退化归因于多模态RoPE的归纳偏置，即视觉与文本令牌距离增加时惩罚跨模态注意力。
Method: 提出跨模态距离不变位置编码（DIPE），对模态内交互保留自然相对定位以保持局部结构，对模态间交互施加锚定感知邻近性，从而消除跨模态距离惩罚。
Result: 实验表明，将DIPE与多模态RoPE集成后，模型在长上下文中保持稳定的视觉基础，显著缓解视觉衰减，同时不损害标准短上下文基准性能。代码已开源。
Conclusion: DIPE通过解耦模态交互的位置编码，有效解决多模态长上下文中的视觉注意力衰减问题。

papers.title: Estimating condition number with Graph Neural Networks
papers.abstract_en: In this paper, we propose a fast method for estimating the condition number of sparse matrices using graph neural networks (GNNs). For efficient deployment of GNNs, we introduce a graph feature construction with $\mathrm{O}(\mathrm{nnz} + n)$ complexity, where $\mathrm{nnz}$ is the number of non-zero elements in the matrix and $n$ denotes the matrix dimension. We propose two schemes for estimating the matrix condition number using GNNs; one follows by decomposing the condition number and predicts the relatively more computationally intensive part $\|\mathbf{A}^{-1}\|$, without explicitly forming the inverse, while the other is to predict the whole condition number $κ$. Our approach can be extended to an arbitrary norm. Extensive experiments are conducted for the estimation of the 1-norm and 2-norm condition numbers, which show that our method achieves a significant speedup over the traditional numerical estimation methods. Our software for GNN condition number estimator is made publicly available at https://github.com/inEXASCALE/sparse-kappa.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出使用图神经网络（GNN）快速估计稀疏矩阵条件数的方法。通过构建具有 O(nnz+n) 复杂度的图特征，并设计两种方案：一种分解条件数预测较难的 ||A^{-1}|| 部分，另一种直接预测整个条件数 κ。实验表明在1-范数和2-范数条件数估计上显著加速传统数值方法。
Motivation: 传统条件数估计方法计算成本高，尤其对于大规模稀疏矩阵，需要一种快速替代方案。
Method: 利用GNN处理稀疏矩阵的图结构，构造线性复杂度的图特征，并提出两种预测策略：分解预测和直接预测，可扩展到任意范数。
Result: 在1-范数和2-范数条件数估计上，该方法相比传统数值方法实现显著加速。
Conclusion: 提出的GNN方法能高效估计稀疏矩阵条件数，代码已开源。

papers.title: EXPLORE-Bench: Egocentric Scene Prediction with Long-Horizon Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) are increasingly considered as a foundation for embodied agents, yet it remains unclear whether they can reliably reason about the long-term physical consequences of actions from an egocentric viewpoint. We study this gap through a new task, Egocentric Scene Prediction with LOng-horizon REasoning: given an initial-scene image and a sequence of atomic action descriptions, a model is asked to predict the final scene after all actions are executed. To enable systematic evaluation, we introduce EXPLORE-Bench, a benchmark curated from real first-person videos spanning diverse scenarios. Each instance pairs long action sequences with structured final-scene annotations, including object categories, visual attributes, and inter-object relations, which supports fine-grained, quantitative assessment. Experiments on a range of proprietary and open-source MLLMs reveal a significant performance gap to humans, indicating that long-horizon egocentric reasoning remains a major challenge. We further analyze test-time scaling via stepwise reasoning and show that decomposing long action sequences can improve performance to some extent, while incurring non-trivial computational overhead. Overall, EXPLORE-Bench provides a principled testbed for measuring and advancing long-horizon reasoning for egocentric embodied perception.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出自我中心场景预测的新任务，要求MLLM根据初始场景图像和一系列原子动作描述预测最终场景。构建了EXPLORE-Bench基准，包含真实第一人称视频，带有结构化标注。实验发现现有MLLM与人类存在显著差距，逐步推理可部分提升性能但计算开销大。
Motivation: 现有MLLM在自我中心视角下长期物理后果推理能力尚不明确，缺乏系统评估基准。
Method: 定义Egocentric Scene Prediction with Long-horizon Reasoning任务，从真实第一人称视频中构建EXPLORE-Bench基准，提供动作序列与最终场景的结构化标注。
Result: 多种开源和闭源MLLM在该基准上表现远低于人类，逐步推理策略可提升一定性能但计算成本高昂。
Conclusion: 长期自我中心推理仍是重大挑战，EXPLORE-Bench为衡量和推动该方向提供了系统测试平台。

papers.title: RAE-NWM: Navigation World Model in Dense Visual Representation Space
papers.abstract_en: Visual navigation requires agents to reach goals in complex environments through perception and planning. World models address this task by simulating action-conditioned state transitions to predict future observations. Current navigation world models typically learn state evolution under actions within the compressed latent space of a Variational Autoencoder, where spatial compression often discards fine-grained structural information and hinders precise control. To better understand the propagation characteristics of different representations, we conduct a linear dynamics probe and observe that dense DINOv2 features exhibit stronger linear predictability for action-conditioned transitions. Motivated by this observation, we propose the Representation Autoencoder-based Navigation World Model (RAE-NWM), which models navigation dynamics in a dense visual representation space. We employ a Conditional Diffusion Transformer with Decoupled Diffusion Transformer head (CDiT-DH) to model continuous transitions, and introduce a separate time-driven gating module for dynamics conditioning to regulate action injection strength during generation. Extensive evaluations show that modeling sequential rollouts in this space improves structural stability and action accuracy, benefiting downstream planning and navigation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出RAE-NWM，一种在密集视觉表示空间中建模导航动态的世界模型。观察到DINOv2特征对动作条件转移具有线性可预测性，采用条件扩散Transformer（CDiT-DH）和独立的时间驱动门控模块来建模连续状态转移。实验表明该方法提高了结构稳定性和动作精度，有利于下游规划与导航。
Motivation: 现有导航世界模型通常在压缩潜空间中学习状态演化，空间压缩会丢失细粒度结构信息，限制精确控制。需要一种能保留更多结构信息的表示空间来提升导航动态建模。
Method: 使用表征自编码器（Representation Autoencoder）将密集的DINOv2特征映射到潜在空间，采用条件扩散Transformer（CDiT-DH）建模连续转移，并引入时间驱动门控模块动态调节动作注入强度。
Result: 通过线性动力学探针发现DINOv2特征对动作条件转移具有较强线性可预测性；在导航相关评估中，该方法在结构稳定性和动作准确性上优于基线，有利于下游规划和导航任务。
Conclusion: 在密集视觉表示空间中建模导航动态可保留更多结构信息，提升世界模型的预测精度和规划性能。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Rheos: Modelling Continuous Motion Dynamics in Hierarchical 3D Scene Graphs
papers.abstract_en: 3D Scene Graphs (3DSGs) provide hierarchical, multi-resolution abstractions that encode the geometric and semantic structure of an environment, yet their treatment of dynamics remains limited to tracking individual agents. Maps of Dynamics (MoDs) complement this by modeling aggregate motion patterns, but rely on uniform grid discretizations that lack semantic grounding and scale poorly. We present Rheos, a framework that explicitly embeds continuous directional motion models into an additional dynamics layer of a hierarchical 3DSG that enhances the navigational properties of the graph. Each dynamics node maintains a semi-wrapped Gaussian mixture model that captures multimodal directional flow as a principled probability distribution with explicit uncertainty, replacing the discrete histograms used in prior work. To enable online operation, Rheos employs reservoir sampling for bounded-memory observation buffers, parallel per-cell model updates and a principled Bayesian Information Criterion (BIC) sweep that selects the optimal number of mixture components, reducing per-update initialization cost from quadratic to linear in the number of samples. Evaluated across four spatial resolutions in a simulated pedestrian environment, Rheos consistently outperforms the discrete baseline under continuous as well as unfavorable discrete metrics. We release our implementation as open source.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Rheos框架，将连续方向运动模型嵌入分层3D场景图（3DSG）的动力学层，利用半包裹高斯混合模型捕获多模态方向流，并采用水库采样、并行更新和贝叶斯信息准则（BIC）实现在线操作。在模拟行人环境中，Rheos在多个空间分辨率上持续优于离散基线。
Motivation: 现有3D场景图对动态的处理局限于跟踪个体，而动力学地图（MoD）依赖均匀网格离散化，缺乏语义基础且可扩展性差。
Method: 在3DSG中新增动力学层，每个节点维护一个半包裹高斯混合模型；使用水库采样管理有限内存观测缓冲，并行更新每单元模型，并通过BIC扫描选择最优分量数，使每次更新的初始化成本从二次降至线性。
Result: 在模拟行人环境中，Rheos在四种空间分辨率下均优于离散基线，包括连续和不连续的离散指标。
Conclusion: Rheos明确嵌入不确定性建模的连续运动模型，提升了3DSG的导航特性，并实现了在线高效更新。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Keeping the Evidence Chain: Semantic Evidence Allocation for Training-Free Token Pruning in Video Temporal Grounding
papers.abstract_en: Video Temporal Grounding (VTG) localizes the temporal boundaries of query-relevant moments in long, untrimmed videos, making video-language-model prohibitively expensive. While recent training-free token pruning has shown success in video question answering, naively applying these objectives to VTG causes drastic degradation, as VTG crucially depends on boundary-sensitive evidence and cross-frame reasoning chains. We therefore identify two VTG-specific pruning principles: evidence retention, which keeps query-critical patches especially around event boundaries, and connectivity strength, which preserves cross-frame connectivity for long-range evidence aggregation. Building on these insights, we propose SemVID, a training-free pruning framework that constructs a compact yet coherent token subset with complementary semantic roles. SemVID first allocates per-frame budgets by balancing query relevance and inter-frame variation to avoid over-pruned segments, and then selects three types of tokens: object tokens for diverse query-critical evidence, motion tokens to capture meaningful transitions and serve as cross-frame relays, and context tokens for scene continuity. Extensive experiments show that SemVID achieves a strong accuracy-efficiency trade-off, retaining up to 95.4% mIoU with only 12.5% visual tokens and delivering up to a 5.8x prefill speedup, consistently outperforming prior methods under the same budgets. Our code is available at https://github.com/JiaqiLi404/SemVID
papers.journal_ref: The 19th European Conference on Computer Vision (ECCV 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对视频时间定位（VTG）中视频-语言模型计算成本过高的问题，提出一种无需训练的词元剪枝框架SemVID。该框架基于证据保留和跨帧连接强度两个原则，通过分配每帧预算并选择对象、运动和上下文三类语义互补的词元，构建紧凑且连贯的词元子集。实验表明，SemVID仅使用12.5%的视觉词元即可保留95.4%的mIoU，实现最高5.8倍的预填充加速，优于同等预算下的现有方法。
Motivation: 视频时间定位（VTG）依赖边界敏感证据和跨帧推理链，直接应用现有的无训练词元剪枝方法会导致性能严重下降。
Method: 提出了SemVID，一种无训练剪枝框架：首先通过平衡查询相关性和帧间变化来分配每帧预算，然后选择三类词元——对象词元（捕获查询关键证据）、运动词元（捕捉有意义的变化并作为跨帧中继）和上下文词元（保持场景连续性）。
Result: 在多个基准上，SemVID仅保留12.5%的视觉词元即可达到95.4%的mIoU，预填充速度提升5.8倍，优于同预算下的其他方法。
Conclusion: SemVID通过证据链保持和跨帧连接性，实现了VTG中准确性与效率的强权衡。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: Measuring the Redundancy of Decoder Layers in SpeechLLMs
papers.abstract_en: Speech Large Language Models route speech encoder representations into an LLM decoder that typically accounts for over 90% of total parameters. We study how much of this decoder capacity is actually needed for speech tasks. Across two LLM families and three scales (1-8B), we show that decoder redundancy is largely inherited from the pretrained LLM: text and speech inputs yield similar redundant blocks. We then measure excess capacity by pruning decoder layers and analysing post-pruning healing to increase robustness. Our findings show that 7-8B models retain good ASR performance with only 60% of decoder layers, and the same trend extends to smaller scales with reduced pruning tolerance. We then generalise to speech translation, and show that the same blocks of layers are redundant across speech encoders, tasks and languages, indicating that a more global redundancy structure exists, enabling a single pruned and multi-tasks SpeechLLM backbone to be deployed.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究语音大语言模型（SpeechLLM）中解码器层的冗余性。实验表明，解码器冗余主要继承自预训练LLM，且在不同语音编码器、任务和语言中具有一致的结构。7-8B模型仅需60%的解码器层即可保持优秀的ASR性能，剪枝后可通过修复（healing）提高鲁棒性。
Motivation: 语音LLM中的解码器占总参数量90%以上，但大量容量是否真正用于语音任务尚不明确，识别冗余层可促进模型压缩和部署。
Method: 通过剪枝解码器层并分析剪枝后的修复能力来度量冗余容量，在两种LLM家族和1-8B三个规模上进行实验，并泛化到语音翻译任务。
Result: 7-8B模型保留60%解码器层即可维持ASR性能；较小模型对剪枝的容忍度降低。冗余结构跨语音编码器、任务和语言全局一致。
Conclusion: 语音LLM的解码器存在全局冗余结构，支持单个剪枝后的多任务骨干网络部署。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: SEA-TS: Self-Evolving Agent for Autonomous Code Generation of Time Series Forecasting Algorithms
papers.abstract_en: Accurate time series forecasting underpins decision-making in many domains, yetconventional ML development often faces data scarcity, distribution shift, anddiminishing returns from manual iteration. We propose Self-Evolving Agent forTime Series Algorithms (SEATS), a framework that autonomously generates, val-idates, and optimizes forecasting algorithm code through an iterative self-evolutionloop. Our design combines three mechanisms: (1) Metric-Advantage MCTS(MA-MCTS), which replaces fixed rewards with a statistically normalized advan-tage score for search guidance, (2) code review with running prompt refinement,so every successfully executed solution is reviewed and the running prompt encodescorrective patterns for later iterations, and (3) global steerable reasoning, whichcompares each evaluated node to global best- and worst-performing solutions forcross-trajectory transfer. A MAP-Elites archive maintains architectural diversity.Across four datasets and two metrics, SEATS wins seven of eight comparisonsagainst strong baselines TimeMixer, Timer, and SEMixer

TL;DR: 本文提出SEA-TS，一个自主生成、验证和优化时间序列预测算法代码的框架，采用迭代自进化循环。框架结合了三种机制：基于统计归一化优势分数的MA-MCTS搜索、带运行提示精炼的代码审查、以及全局可引导推理。在四个数据集和两个指标上，SEA-TS在八项比较中赢得七项，优于TimeMixer、Timer和SEMixer等强基线。
Motivation: 传统机器学习开发面临数据稀缺、分布偏移和手动迭代收益递减的问题，尤其在时间序列预测领域，需要更自主的算法生成方法。

Conclusion: SEA-TS通过自进化循环有效提升了时间序列预测算法的自动生成效果，但需要进一步在更广泛的任务和数据集上验证其泛化性。

papers.title: MPFlow: Multi-modal Posterior-Guided Flow Matching for Zero-Shot MRI Reconstruction
papers.abstract_en: Zero-shot MRI reconstruction relies on generative priors, but single-modality unconditional priors produce hallucinations under severe ill-posedness. In many clinical workflows, complementary MRI acquisitions (e.g. high-quality structural scans) are routinely available, yet existing reconstruction methods lack mechanisms to leverage this additional information. We propose MPFlow, a zero-shot multi-modal reconstruction framework built on rectified flow that incorporates auxiliary MRI modalities at inference time without retraining the generative prior to improve anatomical fidelity. Cross-modal guidance is enabled by our proposed self-supervised pretraining strategy, Patch-level Multi-modal MR Image Pretraining (PAMRI), which learns shared representations across modalities. Sampling is jointly guided by data consistency and cross-modal feature alignment using pre-trained PAMRI, systematically suppressing intrinsic and extrinsic hallucinations. Extensive experiments on HCP and BraTS show that MPFlow matches diffusion baselines on image quality using only 20% of sampling steps while reducing tumor hallucinations by more than 15% (segmentation dice score). This demonstrates that cross-modal guidance enables more reliable and efficient zero-shot MRI reconstruction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出MPFlow，一种基于整流流（rectified flow）的零样本多模态MRI重建框架。该框架利用自监督预训练策略PAMRI学习跨模态共享表示，在推理时通过数据一致性和跨模态特征对齐引导采样，无需重新训练生成先验即可利用辅助MRI模态（如高质量结构扫描）提高解剖保真度。在HCP和BraTS数据集上的实验表明，MPFlow仅用20%的采样步数即可匹配扩散基线的图像质量，并将肿瘤幻觉减少15%以上（分割Dice分数）。
Motivation: 现有零样本MRI重建依赖单模态无条件先验，在严重病态条件下易产生幻觉；而临床工作中常存在互补的MRI采集（如高质量结构扫描），但现有方法缺乏利用这些额外信息的机制。
Method: 提出MPFlow，一种零样本多模态MRI重建框架，核心包括：基于整流流的生成先验、自监督预训练策略PAMRI（学习跨模态共享表示），以及推理时结合数据一致性和PAMRI特征对齐的联合引导采样。
Result: 在HCP和BraTS数据集上，MPFlow仅用20%的采样步数即可达到与扩散基线相当的图像质量，并将肿瘤幻觉减少超过15%（以分割Dice分数衡量）。
Conclusion: 跨模态引导能有效提升零样本MRI重建的可靠性和效率，降低幻觉，且无需重新训练模型。

papers.title: An Interpretable, Controllable Time-Varying IIR Denoiser for On-Device Assistive Hearing
papers.abstract_en: We present TVF (Time-Varying Filtering), an interpretable, low-latency speech enhancement model for real-time, on-device assistive hearing. A lightweight neural controller predicts, in real time, the coefficients of a differentiable cascade of 35 second-order IIR filters (biquads), so the model tracks non-stationary noise while keeping a fully interpretable processing chain: every spectral modification is an explicit, adjustable equalizer curve rather than an opaque `black-box' transform. Because the biquad cascade carries the signal processing, the controller can be made very small, driving the cascade with only 24k parameters at a 10.7ms algorithmic latency, within hearing-aid budgets, and running entirely on-device so that audio never leaves the device. We also expose the suppression-versus-preservation trade-off as an explicit control: it can be set during training through the loss weighting, and adjusted at inference, with no retraining, by mixing the noisy input with the denoised output. On hearing-aid metrics (HASPI/HASQI) the 24k model stays within about 0.02 of DFNet3 (2.3M parameters, almost two orders of magnitude larger) while using about 29X fewer multiply-accumulates, although larger black-box models still lead on reference metrics such as PESQ. We present TVF as a proof of concept for a compact, interpretable, and controllable denoiser for on-device assistive hearing.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TVF是一种轻量级、可解释的语音增强模型，通过可微分的级联二阶IIR滤波器实时降噪，适用于设备端辅助听力。模型仅有24k参数，10.7ms延迟，在HASPI/HASQI指标上与大型模型DFNet3接近，但计算量少29倍。
Motivation: 现有语音增强模型通常为黑盒，缺乏可解释性和可控性，且计算量大，难以在资源受限的助听设备上实时运行。
Method: 提出TVF模型，含一个轻量级神经网络控制器，实时预测35个二阶IIR滤波器系数，形成可解释的均衡器曲线。通过训练损失权重和推理时混合噪声与去噪输出来控制抑制与保留的权衡。
Result: 24k参数的模型在助听指标HASPI/HASQI上仅比2.3M参数的DFNet3差约0.02，计算量减少29倍，但PESQ等指标上仍落后于更大黑盒模型。
Conclusion: TVF作为紧凑、可解释、可控的降噪器概念验证，适合设备端辅助听力，但性能在参考指标上不如更大的黑盒模型。

papers.title: Neural Image Space Tessellation effect
authors: (2) Mohamed bin Zayed University of Artificial Intelligence
papers.abstract_en: We present Neural Image Space Tessellation effect (NIST), a lightweight screen-space post-processing approach for reducing the faceted silhouettes of low-poly renderings. Instead of tessellating primitives, creating new geometry, or modifying the underlying mesh, NIST uses the low-poly rendering result together with simple auxiliary G-buffer attributes to learn geometry-guided smoothing of object contours in image space. At its core, NIST first deforms image-space contours implicitly and then learns to reassign appearance in the whole image-space, including the deformed regions, preserving texture continuity and avoiding seam artifacts. Experiments show that NIST reduces visually apparent geometric faceting and produces smooth, coherent silhouettes close to tessellation-based smoothing references, with a nearly constant per-frame cost in our tested settings. To the best of our knowledge, NIST is the first work to move the solution of low-poly silhouette faceting from the pre-rendering geometry stage to a post-rendering screen-space stage.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Neural Image Space Tessellation effect (NIST)，一种轻量级的屏幕空间后处理方法，用于减少低多边形渲染中出现的面状轮廓。NIST 利用低多边形渲染结果和辅助 G-buffer 属性，在图像空间中学习几何指导的物体轮廓平滑，无需对原始网格进行几何细分。实验表明，NIST 能产生接近细分参考的平滑轮廓，且每帧计算成本几乎恒定。据作者所知，这是首个将低多边形轮廓面网格问题从渲染前几何阶段转移到渲染后屏幕空间阶段的工作。
Motivation: 低多边形渲染的轮廓常呈现可见的面状锯齿，传统方法需要对几何体进行细分，增加计算开销。
Method: NIST 首先在图像空间中隐式变形轮廓，然后学习在整个图像空间中重新分配外观，包括变形区域，从而保持纹理连续性并避免接缝伪影。
Result: 实验显示 NIST 能有效减少视觉上的几何面状，产生接近细分参考的平滑连贯轮廓，且在测试设置下每帧成本近乎恒定。
Conclusion: NIST 将低多边形轮廓锯齿问题从几何处理阶段转移到后处理阶段，为实时渲染提供了一种轻量替代方案。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: MeDUET: Disentangled Unified Pretraining for 3D Medical Image Synthesis and Analysis
papers.abstract_en: Self-supervised learning (SSL) and diffusion models have respectively advanced representation learning and generative modeling for high-dimensional 3D visual data, yet they are often developed as separate paradigms. Their unification remains challenging under multi-source heterogeneity, as anatomical content must be preserved for analysis while acquisition-related style varies across centers and affects synthesis. In this paper, we propose MeDUET, a 3D Medical image Disentangled UnifiEd PreTraining framework in the variational autoencoder latent space. MeDUET formulates unified pretraining as an empirical factor identifiability problem, aiming to learn domain-invariant content factors for anatomy and domain-specific style factors for appearance. To improve factor separation, MeDUET first uses token demixing with a standard adversarial domain regularizer to establish basic content-style specialization, and further introduces Mixed Factor Token Distillation and Swap-invariance Quadruplet Contrast to reduce mixed-region factor leakage and organize factor spaces with factor-wise invariance and discriminability. With these learned factors, MeDUET transfers effectively to both synthesis and analysis, yielding higher fidelity, faster convergence, and better controllability for synthesis, while achieving competitive or superior domain generalization and label efficiency on diverse datasets, tasks, and modalities. Overall, MeDUET shows that multi-source heterogeneity can serve as useful supervision, with disentanglement providing an effective interface for unifying 3D medical image synthesis and analysis. Our code is available at https://github.com/JK-Liu7/MeDUET.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MeDUET，一个在变分自编码器（VAE）潜在空间中对3D医学图像进行解耦统一预训练的框架。它通过解缠内容因子（解剖学）和风格因子（外观）来解决多源异质性问题，并引入混合因子token蒸馏和交换不变性四元组对比来改善因子分离。预训练后的模型可有效迁移到合成与分析任务，提升合成质量、收敛速度和域泛化能力。
Motivation: 现有的自监督学习和扩散模型在3D医学图像中分别擅长表征学习和生成建模，但两者常被独立开发，且多源异质性（不同中心的扫描风格差异）导致解剖内容与风格混淆，使得统一两种范式具有挑战性。
Method: 将统一预训练建模为经验因子可识别性问题，学习域不变的内容因子和域特定的风格因子。通过因子token分离对抗域正则化建立基础分离，进一步引入混合因子token蒸馏和交换不变性四元组对比减少因子泄漏并组织因子空间。
Result: 摘要报告该方法在合成任务上实现更高保真度、更快收敛和更好可控性，在分析任务上达到具有竞争力或更优的域泛化和标签效率，并在多个数据集、任务和模态上得到验证。
Conclusion: MeDUET表明多源异质性可作为有效监督，解缠为统一3D医学图像合成与分析提供了有效接口。

papers.title: Can Generative Artificial Intelligence Survive Data Contamination? Theoretical Guarantees under Contaminated Recursive Training
papers.abstract_en: As artificial intelligence (AI)-generated content proliferates, models are increasingly trained on their own outputs, risking progressive degradation or collapse. In this article, we provide the first positive, rigorous theoretical results, to the best of our knowledge, showing that under model-agnostic mild conditions, the model converges to the true data-generating distribution. The convergence rate is the minimum of the model's intrinsic rate and the fraction of real data at each training iteration, revealing a phase transition between data-limited and model-limited regimes. We further show that, for biased real data, correcting the bias prevents the persistence and amplification of early bias over training iteration. Extensive experiments across simulations, real images and texts validate our theoretical framework, establishing quantitative conditions for long-term AI stability in contaminated environments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文首次在理论上证明，在温和条件下，即使模型反复在其自身生成的数据上训练，仍然可以收敛到真实数据分布。收敛速度取决于模型固有速率和每次迭代中真实数据比例的最小值，揭示了数据受限与模型受限之间的相变。实验验证了理论框架。
Motivation: 生成式AI内容泛滥导致模型可能因其自身输出而退化甚至崩溃，现有理论缺乏正向保证。
Method: 提出一个模型无关的理论框架，分析污染递归训练中的收敛性，并研究偏置数据的偏差校正。
Result: 理论表明模型收敛到真实分布，收敛速率由模型固有速率和真实数据比例决定；偏差校正可防止早期偏差放大。实验支持理论。
Conclusion: 论文提供了生成式AI在污染环境中长期稳定性的定量条件，但仅适用于模型无关的温和假设。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.result: 理论表明模型收敛到真实分布，收敛速率由模型固有速率和真实数据比例决定；偏差校正可防止早期偏差放大。实验支持理论。
summary_sections.conclusion: 论文提供了生成式AI在污染环境中长期稳定性的定量条件，但仅适用于模型无关的温和假设。

papers.title: Event-Grounded Question Answering over Long Audio via Structured Retrieval
papers.abstract_en: Answering natural-language questions over multi-hour audio requires both event recognition and temporal grounding. Current large audio-language models perform well on short clips, but are limited by context length, query-time cost, and weak temporal localization. We present LA-RAG (Long Audio-Retrieval Augmented Generation), a structured framework that converts continuous audio into timestamped event records using an open-vocabulary Audio Grounding Model (AGM), stores them in a SQL event database, and answers queries through intent-aware retrieval followed by LLM-based generation. LA-RAG supports offline grounding mode, where long recordings are pre-indexed for low-latency QA, and inference-time grounding mode, where query-conditioned grounding is performed for shorter open-ended clips. We create 24-hour Home-IoT and Industrial-IoT audio benchmarks and augment CASTELLA, a real-world audio moment retrieval dataset with QA pairs. In offline grounding mode, LA-RAG achieves 76.88% overall accuracy on Home-IoT and 71.10% on Industrial-IoT, with average query latencies below 0.6 seconds. In inference-time grounding mode, state-of-the-art LALMs achieve competitive event-detection accuracy on CASTELLA-QA but low temporal detection F1. We further show that LALMs augmented with our structured retrieval metadata achieve consistent temporal detection improvements, with F1 gains of 11-17% across baseline models with improved latency. These results show that explicit timestamped grounding and structured retrieval provide a practical complement to generative audio-language models for deployment-oriented long-audio QA.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 LA-RAG 框架，将长音频转写为带时间戳的事件记录并存入 SQL 数据库，通过意图感知检索和 LLM 生成回答自然语言问题。在自建 24 小时 Home-IoT 和 Industrial-IoT 基准上，离线模式准确率达 76.88% 和 71.10%，查询延迟低于 0.6 秒；推理时模式中，LALM 结合结构化检索元数据可将时间检测 F1 提升 11-17%。
Motivation: 现有大型音频语言模型在长音频上受限于上下文长度、查询时成本和弱时间定位能力，无法高效处理多小时的连续音频问答。
Method: 提出 LA-RAG 框架，包含开放词汇音频接地模型 (AGM) 将音频转为事件记录，SQL 数据库存储，以及意图感知检索和 LLM 生成。支持离线接地（预索引长录音）和推理时接地（查询条件接地）两种模式。
Result: 在 Home-IoT 和 Industrial-IoT 基准上离线模式准确率分别为 76.88% 和 71.10%，延迟低于 0.6 秒。推理时模式下，LALM 结合结构化检索后 F1 提升 11-17%。
Conclusion: 显式时间戳接地和结构化检索是生成式音频语言模型在部署场景下长音频问答的有效补充。

papers.title: A Non-asymptotic Analysis for Learning and Applying a Preconditioner in MCMC
papers.abstract_en: Preconditioning is a common method applied to modify Markov chain Monte Carlo algorithms with the goal of making them more efficient. In practice it is often extremely effective, even when the preconditioner is learned from the chain. We analyse and compare the finite-time computational costs of schemes which learn a preconditioner based on the target covariance or the expected Hessian of the target potential with that of a corresponding scheme that does not use preconditioning. We apply our results to various algorithms including the Unadjusted Langevin Algorithm (ULA) and the proximal sampler for an appropriately regular target, establishing non-asymptotic guarantees for versions of these algorithms that learn and use preconditioners. To do so, we establish non-asymptotic guarantees on the time taken to collect $N$ approximately independent samples from the target for schemes that learn their preconditioners under the assumption that the underlying Markov chain satisfies a contraction condition in the Wasserstein-2 distance. This approximate independence condition, that we formalize, allows us to bridge the non-asymptotic bounds of modern MCMC theory and classical heuristics of effective sample size and mixing time, and is needed to amortise the costs of learning a preconditioner across the many samples it will be used to produce.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对MCMC算法中学习并使用预条件子（preconditioner）的有限时间计算代价进行非渐近分析，比较基于目标协方差或目标势能期望Hessian学习的预条件方案与无预条件方案。结果应用于ULA和邻近采样器，在目标满足正则性条件下给出非渐近保证。文中形式化了近似独立条件，用于连接现代MCMC非渐近界与有效样本量、混合时间的经典启发式，并摊销学习预条件子的成本。
Motivation: 预条件子在实践中能显著提升MCMC效率，但学习预条件子的计算开销缺乏严格的有限时间理论分析，难以在不同算法间系统比较。
Method: 假设底层马尔可夫链在Wasserstein-2距离下满足收缩条件，建立收集N个近似独立样本所需时间的非渐近上界，并形式化近似独立条件以摊销学习成本。
Result: 对ULA和邻近采样器给出学习并使用预条件子版本的非渐近收敛保证，比较了有/无预条件方案的有限时间计算复杂度。
Conclusion: 该分析为在MCMC中动态学习预条件子提供了理论支撑，并展示了如何将非渐近界与有效样本量等经典概念桥接。

papers.title: Learning to Evict from Key-Value Cache
papers.abstract_en: The growing size of Large Language Models (LLMs) makes efficient inference challenging, primarily due to the memory demands of the autoregressive Key-Value (KV) cache. Existing eviction or compression methods reduce cost but rely on heuristics, such as recency or past attention scores, which serve only as indirect proxies for a token's future utility and introduce computational overhead. We reframe KV cache eviction as a reinforcement learning (RL) problem: learning to rank tokens by their predicted usefulness for future decoding. To this end, we introduce KV Policy (KVP), a framework of lightweight per-head RL agents trained on pre-computed generation traces using only key and value vectors. Each agent learns a specialized eviction policy guided by a holistic reward, derived from future utility, that evaluates the quality of the ranking across all cache budgets, requiring no modifications to the underlying LLM or additional inference. Evaluated across two model families on the long-context benchmark RULER (up to 128K tokens) and the multi-turn dialogue benchmark OASST2-4k, KVP significantly outperforms strong baselines. Zero-shot tests on standard downstream tasks (BoolQ, LongBench passage retrieval, GovReport) further show that KVP generalizes beyond its training distribution and to considerably longer sequence lengths. These results demonstrate that learning to predict future token utility is a powerful and scalable paradigm for adaptive KV cache management.
papers.comment: Accepted to ICML 2026. Code available at: https://github.com/apple/ml-learning-to-evict
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文将大型语言模型（LLM）自回归解码中的键值（KV）缓存驱逐问题重构为强化学习（RL）任务，提出KV Policy（KVP）框架。KVP为每个注意力头训练轻量级RL代理，基于预计算生成轨迹学习根据未来效用对token排序，从而自适应管理缓存。在长上下文基准RULER（至128K tokens）和多轮对话基准OASST2-4k上，KVP显著优于强基线，并在零样本下游任务上展示出泛化能力。
Motivation: 现有KV缓存驱逐/压缩方法依赖启发式规则（如最近性、历史注意力分数），这些规则仅是未来token效用的间接代理，且引入额外计算开销。
Method: 提出KVP框架，为每个注意力头训练一个轻量级RL代理，代理在预计算的生成轨迹上仅使用key和value向量学习排名策略，通过一个考虑未来效用的整体奖励函数指导训练，无需修改底层LLM或增加推理开销。
Result: 在RULER（至128K tokens）和OASST2-4k上，KVP显著优于强基线；零样本测试在BoolQ、LongBench passage retrieval、GovReport上表现优于基线，表明泛化到更长序列。
Conclusion: 学习预测未来token效用是一种高效且可扩展的自适应KV缓存管理范式。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: When the Prompt Becomes Visual: Vision-Centric Jailbreak Attacks for Large Image Editing Models
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in large image editing models have shifted the paradigm from text-driven instructions to vision-prompt editing, where user intent is inferred directly from visual inputs such as marks, arrows, and visual-text prompts. While this paradigm greatly expands usability, it also introduces a critical and underexplored safety risk: the attack surface itself becomes visual. In this work, we propose Vision-Centric Jailbreak Attack (VJA), the first visual-to-visual jailbreak attack that conveys malicious instructions purely through visual inputs. To systematically study this emerging threat, we introduce IESBench, a safety-oriented benchmark for image editing models. Extensive experiments on IESBench demonstrate that VJA effectively compromises state-of-the-art commercial models, achieving attack success rates of up to 80.9% on Nano Banana Pro and 70.1% on GPT-Image-1.5. To mitigate this vulnerability, we propose a training-free defense based on introspective multimodal reasoning, which substantially improves the safety of poorly aligned models to a level comparable with commercial systems, without auxiliary guard models and with negligible computational overhead. Our findings expose new vulnerabilities, provide both a benchmark and practical defense to advance safe and trustworthy modern image editing systems. Warning: This paper contains offensive images created by large image editing models.
papers.comment: Accepted for spotlight and oral presentation at ICML 2026 (Project: https://csu-jpg.github.io/vja.github.io/)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出首个视觉到视觉的越狱攻击VJA，针对大型图像编辑模型中视觉提示（如标记、箭头、视觉文本）的安全漏洞，通过纯视觉输入传递恶意指令。引入IESBench基准评估，在商业模型Nano Banana Pro和GPT-Image-1.5上分别达到80.9%和70.1%的攻击成功率，并提出基于内省多模态推理的无训练防御方法，将模型安全性提升至商业系统水平。
Motivation: 大型图像编辑模型从文本驱动转向视觉提示编辑，但视觉输入本身可能成为攻击面，现有研究未充分探索这一安全风险。
Method: 提出VJA（Vision-Centric Jailbreak Attack），通过视觉输入（如图像中的文字标记）直接嵌入恶意指令，实现视觉到视觉的越狱攻击；并构建IESBench安全基准数据集。
Result: 在IESBench上，VJA对Nano Banana Pro和GPT-Image-1.5的攻击成功率分别为80.9%和70.1%。所提无训练防御方法能有效修复模型安全性，且计算开销可忽略。
Conclusion: 揭示了视觉提示编辑模型的新漏洞，提供了基准和实用防御，有助于推动安全可信的图像编辑系统发展。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Spectral Text Fusion: A Frequency-Aware Approach to Multimodal Time-Series Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal time series forecasting is crucial in real-world applications, where decisions depend on both numerical data and contextual signals. The core challenge is to effectively combine temporal numerical patterns with the context embedded in other modalities, such as text. While most existing methods align textual features with time-series patterns one step at a time, they neglect the multiscale temporal influences of contextual information such as time-series cycles and dynamic shifts. This mismatch between local alignment and global textual context can be addressed by spectral decomposition, which separates time series into frequency components capturing both short-term changes and long-term trends. In this paper, we propose SpecTF, a simple yet effective framework that integrates the effect of textual data on time series in the frequency domain. Our method extracts textual embeddings, projects them into the frequency domain, and fuses them with the time series' spectral components using a lightweight cross-attention mechanism. This adaptively reweights frequency bands based on textual relevance before mapping the results back to the temporal domain for predictions. Experimental results demonstrate that SpecTF significantly outperforms state-of-the-art models across diverse multi-modal time series datasets while utilizing considerably fewer parameters. Code is available at https://github.com/hiepnh137/SpecTF.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SpecTF，一种用于多模态时间序列预测的轻量级框架，通过在频域融合文本嵌入与时序频谱成分，利用交叉注意力机制根据文本相关性自适应调整频带权重。在多个多模态数据集上，SpecTF 以更少的参数显著超越现有方法。
Motivation: 现有方法逐时间步对齐文本特征与时序模式，忽略了文本上下文在多尺度时间上的影响（如周期和动态变化），导致局部对齐与全局文本上下文不匹配。
Method: 提取文本嵌入并投影到频域，通过轻量级交叉注意力将文本频谱与时序频谱成分融合，自适应重加权频带，再映射回时域进行预测。
Result: 在多个多模态时间序列数据集上，SpecTF 以更少的参数显著优于现有最先进方法。
Conclusion: 频域融合文本信息能有效利用多尺度上下文，为多模态时序预测提供简洁高效的方案。
