papers.title: Adaptive Momentum and Nonlinear Damping for Neural Network Training
papers.abstract_en: Momentum Stochastic Gradient Descent (mSGD) relies on a fixed momentum coefficient shared across all parameters, failing to account for the heterogeneous structure of modern loss landscapes. In this work, we adopt a continuous-time formulation to introduce individual, adaptive momentum coefficients regulated by the kinetic energy of each model parameter. This mechanism automatically adjusts to evolving training dynamics to maintain stability without sacrificing convergence speed. We demonstrate that this adaptive friction is inextricably linked to cubic damping, a suppression mechanism from structural dynamics. We additionally introduce two optimization schemes by augmenting the continuous dynamics of mSGD and Adam with a cubic damping term. Empirically, our methods demonstrate robustness and match or outperform Adam on training ViT, BERT, and GPT2 tasks where mSGD typically struggles. We further provide theoretical results establishing the exponential convergence of the proposed schemes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种自适应动量方法，通过连续时间形式为每个参数独立调节动量系数，并与立方阻尼（cubic damping）结合，用于改进神经网络训练。实验表明该方法在ViT、BERT、GPT2等任务上匹配或优于Adam，理论证明了指数收敛。
Motivation: 标准动量SGD（mSGD）使用固定动量系数，无法适应损失景观的异质性，导致训练不稳定或收敛慢。
Method: 采用连续时间形式，引入由每个参数动能调控的自适应动量系数，并进一步在mSGD和Adam的连续动力学中添加立方阻尼项。
Result: 在ViT、BERT、GPT2训练任务上，该方法鲁棒性强，匹配或优于Adam，而mSGD通常表现不佳；理论证明了指数收敛。
Conclusion: 自适应动量与立方阻尼的结合能自动适应训练动态，保持稳定性同时不牺牲收敛速度，为优化器设计提供新思路。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.tldr: 本文提出一种自适应动量方法，通过连续时间形式为每个参数独立调节动量系数，并与立方阻尼（cubic damping）结合，用于改进神经网络训练。实验表明该方法在ViT、BERT、GPT2等任务上匹配或优于Adam，理论证明了指数收敛。

papers.title: Gated Relational Alignment via Confidence-based Distillation for Efficient VLMs
papers.abstract_en: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) achieve strong multimodal performance but are costly to deploy, and post-training quantization often causes significant accuracy loss. Despite its potential, quantization-aware training for VLMs remains underexplored. We propose GRACE, a framework unifying knowledge distillation and QAT under the Information Bottleneck principle: quantization constrains information capacity while distillation guides what to preserve within this budget. Treating the teacher as a proxy for task-relevant information, we introduce confidence-gated decoupled distillation to filter unreliable supervision, relational centered kernel alignment to transfer visual token structures, and an adaptive controller via Lagrangian relaxation to balance fidelity against capacity constraints. Across extensive benchmarks on LLaVA and Qwen families, our INT4 models consistently outperform FP16 baselines (e.g., LLaVA-1.5-7B: 70.1 vs. 66.8 on SQA; Qwen2-VL-2B: 76.9 vs. 72.6 on MMBench), nearly matching teacher performance. Using real INT4 kernel, we achieve 3$\times$ throughput with 54% memory reduction. This principled framework significantly outperforms existing quantization methods, making GRACE a compelling solution for resource-constrained deployment. Code and data are available at: https://github.com/ForeverBlue816/GRACE.
papers.comment: Accepted to the International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML 2026)

Conclusion: 该框架显著优于现有量化方法，为资源受限部署提供了有效方案。

papers.title: Just Ask: Curious Code Agents Reveal System Prompts in Frontier LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Autonomous code agents built on large language models are reshaping software and AI development through tool use, long-horizon reasoning, and self-directed interaction. However, this autonomy introduces a previously unrecognized security risk: agentic interaction fundamentally expands the LLM attack surface, enabling systematic probing and recovery of hidden system prompts that guide model behavior. We identify system prompt extraction as an emergent vulnerability intrinsic to code agents and present \textbf{\textsc{JustAsk}}, a self-evolving framework that autonomously discovers effective extraction strategies through interaction alone. Unlike prior prompt-engineering or dataset-based attacks, \textsc{JustAsk} requires no handcrafted prompts, labeled supervision, or privileged access beyond standard user interaction. It formulates extraction as an online exploration problem, using Upper Confidence Bound-based strategy selection and a hierarchical skill space spanning atomic probes and high-level orchestration. These skills exploit imperfect system-instruction generalization and inherent tensions between helpfulness and safety. Evaluated on \textbf{41} black-box commercial models across multiple providers, \textsc{JustAsk} consistently achieves full or near-complete system prompt recovery, revealing recurring design- and architecture-level vulnerabilities. Our results expose system prompts as a critical yet largely unprotected attack surface in modern agent systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文发现基于大语言模型的自主代码代理存在系统提示提取漏洞，并提出JustAsk框架，通过交互自动探索提取策略，无需手工提示或监督。在41个黑盒商业模型上实现了完全或接近完全的系统提示恢复，揭示了设计级和架构级漏洞。
Motivation: 自主代码代理的交互性扩大了LLM的攻击面，使得隐藏的系统提示可被系统性地探测和恢复，而现有攻击方法需要手工提示或数据集。
Method: JustAsk将系统提示提取建模为在线探索问题，采用基于UCB的策略选择以及分层技能空间（包括原子探测和高层编排），利用系统指令泛化不完善和帮助性与安全性之间的固有张力。
Result: 在来自多个提供商的41个黑盒商业模型上，JustAsk一致地实现了完全或接近完全的系统提示恢复，揭示了设计级和架构级漏洞。
Conclusion: 系统提示是现代代理系统中一个关键但未充分保护的攻击面，本文方法暴露了其脆弱性。

papers.title: Robustness of Constraint Automata for Description Logics with Concrete Domains
papers.abstract_en: Decidability or complexity issues about the consistency problem for description logics with concrete domains have already been analysed with tableaux-based or type elimination methods. Concrete domains in ontologies are essential to consider concrete objects and predefined relations. In this work, we expose an automata-based approach leading to the optimal upper bound EXPTIME, that is designed by enriching the transitions with symbolic constraints. We show that the nonemptiness problem for such automata belongs to EXPTIME if the concrete domains satisfy a few simple properties. Then, we provide a reduction from the consistency problem for ontologies, yielding EXPTIME-membership. Thanks to the expressivity of constraint automata, the results are extended to additional ingredients such as inverse roles, functional role names and constraint assertions, while maintaining EXPTIME-membership, which illustrates the robustness of the approach
papers.comment: Extended version of a paper accepted at CSL'26, Paris
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于约束自动机的方法，用于处理带有具体域的描述逻辑，并证明本体一致性问题属于EXPTIME。该方法通过符号约束丰富自动机转移，实现了最优上界，并展示了在逆角色、功能角色名等扩展下的鲁棒性。
Motivation: 以往描述逻辑与具体域的一致性问题主要通过tableaux或类型消除方法分析，本文旨在提供一种自动机方法以获得最优EXPTIME复杂度上界。
Method: 提出约束自动机（constraint automata），在转移中加入符号约束，证明其非空问题在具体域满足简单性质时属于EXPTIME，并将本体一致性问题归约到该非空问题。
Result: 达到EXPTIME最优上界，并扩展到逆角色、功能角色名和约束断言，仍保持EXPTIME成员资格。
Conclusion: 约束自动机方法对于描述逻辑与具体域具有鲁棒性，能够处理多种扩展而保持复杂度上界。

papers.title: GAIA: A Data Flywheel System for Training GUI Test-Time Scaling Critic Models
papers.abstract_en: While Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) have significantly advanced GUI agents' capabilities in parsing textual instructions, interpreting screen content, and executing tasks, a critical challenge persists: the irreversibility of agent operations-where a single erroneous action can trigger catastrophic deviations. To address this, we propose the \textbf{G}UI \textbf{A}ction Cr\textbf{i}tic's Dat\textbf{a} Flywheel System (GAIA), a training framework that enables the models to have iterative critic capabilities, which are used to improve the Test-Time Scaling (TTS) of basic GUI agents' performance. Specifically, we train an \textbf{Intuitive Critic Model} (ICM) using positive and negative action examples from a base agent first. This critic evaluates the immediate correctness of the agent's intended actions, thereby selecting operations with higher success probability. Then, the initial critic guides agent actions to collect refined positive/negative samples, initiating the self-improving cycle. The augmented data then trains a second-round critic with enhanced discernment capability. We conduct experiments on various datasets and demonstrate that the proposed ICM can improve the test-time performance of various closed-source and open-source models, and the performance can be gradually improved as the data is recycled. The code, dataset, and accompanying datasheet will be publicly released at https://github.com/SeerRay-Lab/GAIA.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出GAIA系统，通过训练直觉批评模型（ICM）来提升GUI代理在测试时的缩放性能。ICM利用基础代理的正负动作样例进行训练，评估代理预期动作的正确性，并选择成功率更高的操作。通过自改进循环，第二轮批评模型具有更强的辨别能力。实验表明，该方法能提升多种闭源和开源模型的测试时性能，且性能随数据循环而逐步提升。
Motivation: GUI代理操作具有不可逆性，单个错误动作可能导致灾难性偏差，现有模型缺乏迭代批评能力来缓解这一问题。
Method: 提出GAIA数据飞轮系统，首先用基础代理的正负动作样例训练直觉批评模型（ICM），ICM评估即时动作正确性并筛选高成功概率操作；然后利用ICM指导代理动作收集精炼样本，启动自改进循环，再用增强数据训练第二轮批评模型。
Result: 在多种数据集上，所提ICM能提升闭源和开源模型的测试时性能，且性能随数据循环而逐步改善。
Conclusion: GAIA系统通过迭代批评和自改进循环，有效提升了GUI代理的可靠性，代码和数据将公开。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Health-ORSC-Bench: A Benchmark for Measuring Over-Refusal and Safety Completion in Health Context
papers.abstract_en: Safety alignment in Large Language Models is critical for healthcare; however, reliance on binary refusal boundaries often results in over-refusal of benign queries or unsafe compliance with harmful ones. While existing benchmarks measure these extremes, they fail to evaluate Safe Completion: the model's ability to maximise helpfulness on dual-use or borderline queries by providing safe, high-level guidance without crossing into actionable harm. We introduce Health-ORSC-Bench, the first large-scale benchmark designed to systematically measure Over-Refusal and Safe Completion quality in healthcare. Comprising 31,920 benign boundary prompts across seven health categories (e.g., self-harm, medical misinformation), our framework uses an automated pipeline with human validation to test models at varying levels of intent ambiguity. We evaluate 30 state-of-the-art LLMs, including GPT-5 and Claude-4, revealing a significant tension: safety-optimised models frequently refuse up to 80% of "Hard" benign prompts, while domain-specific models often sacrifice safety for utility. Our findings demonstrate that model family and size significantly influence calibration: larger frontier models (e.g., GPT-5, Llama-4) exhibit "safety-pessimism" and higher over-refusal than smaller or MoE-based counterparts (e.g., Qwen-3-Next), highlighting that current LLMs struggle to balance refusal and compliance. Health-ORSC-Bench provides a rigorous standard for calibrating the next generation of medical AI assistants toward nuanced, safe, and helpful completions. Furthermore, our benchmark facilitates reproducible evaluation, encourages safety calibration, and supports development of clinically reliable, context-aware, human-aligned medical AI systems. Our code and data are available at: https://github.com/ZhihaoZhang97/Health-ORSC-Bench. Warning: Some contents may include toxic or undesired contents.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Health-ORSC-Bench，首个大规模基准测试，用于系统评估大语言模型在健康语境中的过度拒绝（Over-Refusal）和安全完成（Safe Completion）能力。基准包含31,920条边界提示，覆盖七类健康主题，并测试30个先进LLM，发现安全优化模型在“硬”良性提示上拒绝率高达80%，而领域专用模型常牺牲安全性。
Motivation: 现有安全对齐基准只测试极端拒绝或合规，无法评估模型在双用途或边界查询上提供安全有益引导的能力，特别是在健康领域。
Method: 构建含31,920条边界提示的基准，覆盖自伤、医疗错误信息等七类健康主题，通过自动管道加人工验证，在不同意图模糊度级别上测试模型。
Result: 评估30个LLM（包括GPT-5、Claude-4），发现安全优化模型对“硬”良性提示拒绝率达80%，而更大模型（如GPT-5、Llama-4）表现出“安全悲观”和更高过度拒绝，较小或MoE模型（如Qwen-3-Next）相对较低。
Conclusion: Health-ORSC-Bench为校准下一代医疗AI助手提供严格标准，促进可重复评估和安全性校准，但需注意其中可能包含有害内容。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Reasoning-Enhanced Rare-Event Prediction with Balanced Outcome Correction
papers.abstract_en: Rare-event prediction is critical in domains such as healthcare, finance, reliability engineering, customer support, aviation safety, where positive outcomes are infrequent yet potentially catastrophic. Extreme class imbalance biases conventional models toward majority-class predictions, limiting recall, calibration, and operational usefulness. We propose LPCORP (Low-Prevalence CORrector for Prediction)*, a two-stage framework that combines reasoning-enhanced prediction with confidence-based outcome correction. A reasoning model first produces enriched predictions from narrative inputs, after which a lightweight classifier evaluates and selectively corrects these outputs to mitigate prevalence-driven bias. In this study we used Logistic-Regression (LR) and a simple Multilayer Perceptron (MLP) classifiers for this purpose. We evaluate LPCORP on real-world datasets from medical and consumer service domains. The results show that this method transforms the original rare-event prediction problem into a more balanced supervised correction task without discarding or resampling observations. Test-set evaluation demonstrates substantially improved performance, particularly in precision, which is a known weakness in low-prevalence data. We further provide a cost-reduction analysis comparing the expenses associated with rare-event damage control without preventive measures to those incurred when low-cost, prediction-based preventive interventions are applied that showed up to 40+% reduction in some cases.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出LPCORP（Low-Prevalence CORrector for Prediction）两阶段框架，用于罕见事件预测。该框架首先利用推理模型从叙述性输入生成增强预测，然后通过轻量级分类器（如逻辑回归或MLP）基于置信度选择性纠正预测，以缓解类别不平衡带来的偏差。在医疗和消费者服务领域的真实数据集上，该方法在不丢弃或重采样数据的情况下显著提升了精确率，并实现了最高40%以上的成本降低。
Motivation: 罕见事件预测中极端类别不平衡导致传统模型偏向多数类，召回率低、校准差且实用性不足，需要一种无需重采样或丢弃样本的纠正方法。
Method: 提出LPCORF两阶段框架：第一阶段使用推理模型从叙事输入产生增强预测；第二阶段用一个轻量级分类器（如逻辑回归或MLP）评估第一阶段的输出，并基于置信度进行选择性纠正，将原始罕见事件预测转化为更平衡的监督校正任务。
Result: 在医疗和消费者服务数据集的测试集上，方法显著提升了精确率（低患病率数据中已知的弱点），并在成本降低分析中显示某些情况下可减少40%以上的罕见事件损害成本。
Conclusion: LPCORF通过将预测问题转化为平衡的校正任务，有效改善了低患病率数据的预测性能，无需重采样，具有实际成本和性能优势。

papers.title: A Gaussian Perspective for Distributional Discrepancy in Generative Diffusion Models
papers.abstract_en: This paper introduces an analytical approach to quantifying and optimizing the distributional discrepancy in generative diffusion models. For a multivariate Gaussian source, we explicitly derive the closed-form evolution trajectory and the resulting Kullback-Leibler (KL) divergence between the distributions of the source data and the reversely sampled data. Asymptotic analysis via the Euler-Maclaurin expansion characterizes the convergence behavior of this KL divergence, extracting its dominant term as an explicit functional of the noise schedule. Minimizing this dominant term via the calculus of variations yields a noise schedule described by a tangent law, inherently determined by the source covariance spectrum. We further prove that the Gaussian source exhibits an extremal property for the KL divergence among general source distributions with a given covariance. We also utilize the analytical KL divergence as a principled metric to identify efficient time discretization strategies for pretrained diffusion models, and demonstrate via experiments over diverse datasets that the identified strategies consistently outperform established baselines, particularly under constrained function evaluation budgets.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从多元高斯源出发，解析推导了生成扩散模型中源数据与反向采样数据之间的KL散度闭式解，并通过渐近分析提取主导项作为噪声调度的显式泛函，利用变分法得到切线律噪声调度。进一步证明了高斯源在给定协方差下对KL散度具有极值性质，并利用解析KL散度作为指标设计高效时间离散化策略，在多个数据集上优于基线。
Motivation: 现有扩散模型的分布差异度量缺乏解析分析，噪声调度设计多依赖经验或启发式方法。
Method: 针对多元高斯源解析推导KL散度闭式解，利用欧拉-麦克劳林展开提取主导项，通过变分法最小化主导项得到切线律噪声调度；将该KL散度作为度量指导时间离散化。
Result: 导出切线律噪声调度，证明高斯源的极值性质，所提离散化策略在有限评估预算下优于已有基线。
Conclusion: 高斯视角为扩散模型的分布差异提供了精确刻画和优化框架，所提指标可用于提升采样效率。

papers.title: DDSA: Dual-Domain Strategic Attack for Spatial-Temporal Efficiency in Adversarial Robustness Testing
papers.abstract_en: Image transmission and processing systems in resource-critical applications face significant challenges from adversarial perturbations that compromise mission-specific object classification. Current robustness testing methods require excessive computational resources through exhaustive frame-by-frame processing and full-image perturbations, proving impractical for large-scale deployments where massive image streams demand immediate processing. This paper presents DDSA (Dual-Domain Strategic Attack), a resource-efficient adversarial robustness testing framework that optimizes testing through temporal selectivity and spatial precision. We introduce a scenario-aware trigger function that identifies critical frames requiring robustness evaluation based on class priority and model uncertainty, and employ explainable AI techniques to locate influential pixel regions for targeted perturbation. Our dual-domain approach achieves substantial temporal-spatial resource conservation while maintaining attack effectiveness. The framework enables practical deployment of comprehensive adversarial robustness testing in resource-constrained real-time applications where computational efficiency directly impacts mission success.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出DDSA（双域策略攻击），一个资源高效的对抗鲁棒性测试框架，通过时间选择性（场景感知触发函数识别关键帧）和空间精度（可解释AI定位关键像素区域）优化测试效率，在保持攻击效果的同时节省大量时空资源，适用于资源受限的实时应用。
Motivation: 现有对抗鲁棒性测试方法需要逐帧处理和全图像扰动，计算资源消耗过大，难以部署在大规模图像流处理系统中，影响实时任务的效率。
Method: 引入场景感知触发函数，基于类别优先级和模型不确定性识别关键评估帧；并利用可解释AI技术定位有影响力的像素区域，实现有针对性的扰动。
Result: 摘要表明该方法在保持攻击有效性的同时，实现了显著的时空资源节省。
Conclusion: 该框架使资源受限的实时应用能够实际部署全面的对抗鲁棒性测试，从而提升任务成功率。

papers.title: Learning Stochastic Bridges for Video Object Removal via Video-to-Video Translation
papers.abstract_en: Existing video object removal methods predominantly rely on diffusion models following a noise-to-data paradigm, where generation starts from uninformative Gaussian noise. This approach discards the rich structural and contextual priors present in the original input video. Consequently, such methods often lack sufficient guidance, leading to incomplete object erasure or the synthesis of implausible content that conflicts with the scene's physical logic. In this paper, we reformulate video object removal as a video-to-video translation task via a stochastic bridge model. Unlike noise-initialized methods, our framework establishes a direct stochastic path from the source video (with objects) to the target video (objects removed). This bridge formulation effectively leverages the input video as a strong structural prior, guiding the model to perform precise removal while ensuring that the filled regions are logically consistent with the surrounding environment. To address the trade-off where strong bridge priors hinder the removal of large objects, we propose a novel adaptive mask modulation strategy. This mechanism dynamically modulates input embeddings based on mask characteristics, balancing background fidelity with generative flexibility. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our approach significantly outperforms existing methods in both visual quality and temporal consistency. The project page is https://bridgeremoval.github.io/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于随机桥模型（stochastic bridge model）的视频对象去除方法，将视频对象去除重新定义为视频到视频的翻译任务。与噪声初始化的扩散模型不同，该方法直接从源视频（有物体）建立到目标视频（物体去除）的随机路径，利用输入视频的结构先验，并引入自适应掩码调制策略以平衡背景保真度和生成灵活性。实验表明，该方法在视觉质量和时间一致性上显著优于现有方法。
Motivation: 现有噪声初始化扩散模型舍弃了输入视频的结构先验，导致物体擦除不彻底或合成内容与场景物理逻辑冲突。
Method: 将视频对象去除重新定义为视频到视频的翻译任务，使用随机桥模型建立从源视频到目标视频的直接随机路径；提出自适应掩码调制机制，根据掩码特性动态调节输入嵌入，平衡背景保真度和生成灵活性。
Result: 摘要报告在视觉质量和时间一致性方面显著优于现有方法，未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 随机桥模型结合自适应掩码调制可以有效利用输入视频的结构先验，实现精确且逻辑一致的视频对象去除。

papers.title: Safe Language Generation in the Limit
papers.abstract_en: Recent results in learning a language in the limit have shown that, although language identification is impossible, language generation is tractable. As this foundational area expands, we need to consider the implications of language generation in real-world settings. This work offers the first theoretical treatment of safe language generation. Building on the computational paradigm of learning in the limit, we formalize the tasks of safe language identification and generation. We prove that under this model, safe language identification is impossible, and that safe language generation is at least as hard as (vanilla) language identification, which is also impossible. Last, we discuss several intractable and tractable cases.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文在语言学习极限的计算范式下，首次对安全语言生成进行理论处理。形式化了安全语言识别和生成的任务，证明安全语言识别不可能，安全语言生成至少与（普通）语言识别一样困难（即也不可能）。最后讨论了一些可处理与不可处理的情况。

Result: 证明安全语言识别不可能，安全语言生成至少与普通语言识别一样困难（也不可能）。

papers.title: Bridging Mechanistic Interpretability and Prompt Engineering with Gradient Ascent for Interpretable Persona Control
papers.abstract_en: Controlling emergent behavioral personas (e.g., sycophancy, hallucination) in Large Language Models (LLMs) is critical for AI safety, yet remains a persistent challenge. Existing solutions face a dilemma: manual prompt engineering is intuitive but unscalable and imprecise, while automatic optimization methods are effective but operate as "black boxes" with no interpretable connection to model internals. We propose a novel framework that adapts gradient ascent to LLMs, enabling targeted prompt discovery. In specific, we propose two methods, RESGA and SAEGA, that both optimize randomly initialized prompts to achieve better aligned representation with an identified persona direction. We introduce fluent gradient ascent to control the fluency of discovered persona steering prompts. We demonstrate RESGA and SAEGA's effectiveness across Llama 3.1, Qwen 2.5, and Gemma 3 for steering three different personas, sycophancy, hallucination, and myopic reward. Crucially, on sycophancy, our automatically discovered prompts achieve significant improvement (49.90% compared with 79.24%). By grounding prompt discovery in mechanistically meaningful features, our method offers a new paradigm for controllable and interpretable behavior modification. We release our scripts for RESGA and SAEGA in this github repo: https://github.com/HarshSaini10/RESGA_SAEGA.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种将梯度上升法应用于大型语言模型的新框架，通过RESGA和SAEGA两种方法优化随机初始化的提示，实现对模型行为的可解释控制。在Llama 3.1、Qwen 2.5和Gemma 3上验证了对谄媚、幻觉和短视奖励三种人格的操控效果，其中谄媚方向从79.24%提升至49.90%（原文如此，可能指错误率下降）。
Motivation: 现有提示工程要么依赖人工手动调整，不精确且不可扩展；要么使用自动优化方法但缺乏可解释性。本文旨在填补这一空白，提供一种既有效又机制可理解的提示发现方法。
Method: 提出RESGA和SAEGA两种方法，通过梯度上升法优化随机初始化的提示，使其与模型内部已识别的人格方向对齐，并引入流畅性梯度上升控制提示的流畅性。
Result: 在三个模型和三种人格上验证有效性，其中谄媚方向上的表现显著提升（从79.24%降至49.90%的错误率）。
Conclusion: 通过将提示发现与机制可解释特征结合，为可控且可解释的行为修改提供了新范式。代码已开源。

papers.title: Trust Region Masking for Long-Horizon LLM Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Policy gradient methods for Large Language Models optimize a policy $π_θ$ via a surrogate objective computed from samples of a rollout policy $π_{\text{roll}}$. However, modern LLM-RL pipelines suffer from unavoidable implementation divergences -- backend discrepancies, Mixture-of-Experts routing discontinuities, and distributed training staleness -- causing off-policy mismatch ($π_{\text{roll}} \neq π_θ$) and approximation errors between the surrogate and the true objective. We demonstrate that classical trust region bounds on this error scale as $O(T^2)$ with sequence length $T$, rendering them vacuous for long-horizon tasks. To address this, we derive a family of bounds -- both KL-based and TV-based -- including a Pinsker-Marginal bound ($O(T^{3/2})$), a Mixed bound ($O(T)$), and an Adaptive bound that strictly generalizes the Pinsker-Marginal bound via per-position importance-ratio decomposition. Taking the minimum over all bounds yields the tightest known guarantee across all divergence regimes. Crucially, all bounds depend on the maximum token-level divergence $D_{\mathrm{KL}}^{\mathrm{tok,max}}$ (or $D_{\mathrm{TV}}^{\mathrm{tok,max}}$), a sequence-level quantity that cannot be controlled by token-independent methods like PPO clipping. We propose Trust Region Masking (TRM), which masks entire sequences violating the trust region, enabling the first non-vacuous monotonic improvement guarantees for long-horizon LLM-RL.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对长程LLM强化学习中off-policy不匹配导致的信任区域边界膨胀问题，推导了多种改进的边界（KL和TV基），并提出信任区域掩码（TRM）方法，通过掩码违反信任区域的整个序列，首次实现了非真空的单调改进保证。
Motivation: 现有信任区域边界随序列长度T二次增长，对长程任务无效；LLM-RL管道中的实现差异导致off-policy不匹配和近似误差。
Method: 推导了基于KL和TV的边界族，包括Pinsker-Marginal边界（O(T^{3/2})）、Mixed边界（O(T)）和自适应边界（通过逐位置重要性比分解推广Pinsker-Marginal边界），取最小值得到最紧保证。提出信任区域掩码（TRM），掩码违反信任区域的整个序列。
Result: 摘要声称该方法首次实现非真空的单调改进保证，但未给出具体数值结果。
Conclusion: 所有边界依赖于最大token级散度，无法通过PPO裁剪等token无关方法控制；TRM通过掩码序列来保证信任区域，从而提供改进保证。

summary_sections.conclusion: 所有边界依赖于最大token级散度，无法通过PPO裁剪等token无关方法控制；TRM通过掩码序列来保证信任区域，从而提供改进保证。

papers.title: Psychometric Comparability of LLM-Based Digital Twins
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) act as digital twins for human respondents, yet their psychometric comparability remains uncertain. We propose a construct validity framework spanning construct representation and the nomothetic span, benchmarking models against human gold standards. Across studies, digital twins achieved high aggregate-level accuracy and profile correlations, but showed attenuated item-level correlations. In word association tests, LLM networks exhibited humanlike small-world structure and theory-consistent communities, yet diverged lexically and in local structure. In decision-making and contextualized tasks, they under-reproduced heuristic biases, demonstrating normative rationality, compressed variance, and limited temporal sensitivity. Feature-rich and trait relevant conditioning improved Big Five personality prediction and nomothetic-span alignment, but network invariance remained limited, with partial configural solutions and persistent loading differences. In cross-language free-text tasks in English and Chinese, feature-rich digital twins better approximated construct-level narrative content, but linguistic and idiographic differences persisted. These findings clarify that digital twins are most useful within validated boundaries, where the construct, task and level of inference align with evidence from human data.
papers.comment: Also available as a preprint on OSF Preprints https://osf.io/preprints/psyarxiv/965yg_v2
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究基于大语言模型（LLM）的数字孪生（digital twins）在心理测量学上的可比性，通过构建包含构念表征和法则跨度（nomothetic span）的效度框架，以人类数据为黄金标准进行基准测试。结果表明，数字孪生在聚合层面准确率高且剖面相关性强，但项目层面相关减弱；在词汇联想测试中网络具有类人大世界结构，但词汇和局部结构存在差异；决策任务中未能充分复现启发式偏差，呈现规范性理性、压缩方差和有限时间敏感性。特征丰富且特质相关的条件化改善了人格预测和法则跨度对齐，但网络不变性仍然有限，存在部分配置解和持续载荷差异。跨语言自由文本任务中，特征丰富的数字孪生更好逼近构念级叙事内容，但语言和个体差异依然存在。
Motivation: LLM作为人类受访者的数字孪生被广泛应用，但其心理测量学可比性尚未明确评估，缺乏系统的效度验证框架。
Method: 提出一个包含构念代表性和法则跨度的构念效度框架，将LLM数字孪生的响应与人类黄金标准数据进行多层面比较，包括聚合水平、项目水平、网络结构、决策偏差等。
Result: 数字孪生在聚合水平准确率高（如B5人格预测），但项目水平相关衰减；词汇联想网络呈现类人小世界结构但词汇和局部结构不同；决策任务中未能复现启发式偏差，呈现理性、压缩方差；特征丰富的条件化提升人格预测，但网络不变性有限；跨语言任务中内容近似但语言和个体差异持续存在。
Conclusion: 数字孪生在经过验证的边界内最有用，即当构念、任务和推断水平与人类数据证据一致时。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Adaptive Probability Flow Residual Minimization for High-Dimensional Fokker-Planck Equations
papers.abstract_en: Solving high-dimensional Fokker-Planck (FP) equations remains a challenging problem in computational physics and stochastic dynamics, due to the curse of dimensionality, unbounded domains, and complex probability landscapes. In this work, we propose an adaptive probability flow residual minimization (A-PFRM) method for this problem. The second-order FP equation is reformulated as an equivalent first-order continuity equation associated with the probability flow ordinary differential equation, based on which a loss function is constructed to train neural network approximations without Hessian computation. To further improve the computational efficiency, the Hutchinson trace estimator is applied to compute the divergence in the corresponding score function, such that the training time can be dimension-independent on GPUs. Adaptive sampling strategies are employed to generate the collocation points, and our analysis shows that the Kullback-Leibler divergence between our A-PFRM approximation and the exact solution is bounded by the residual loss weighted by the estimated density function. Numerical experiments are presented to demonstrate the performance of A-PFRM, which include Ornstein-Uhlenbeck (OU) processes problems, Brownian motions with time-varying diffusion, and Geometric OU processes featuring non-Gaussian solutions up to one hundred dimensions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出自适应概率流残差最小化（A-PFRM）方法求解高维Fokker-Planck方程，将二阶FP方程重新表述为一阶连续性方程，避免Hessian计算。利用Hutchinson迹估计计算散度，实现GPU上维度无关的训练时间，并采用自适应采样策略生成配点。数值实验包括OU过程、时变扩散布朗运动和几何OU过程，最高达100维。
Motivation: 高维Fokker-Planck方程因维数灾难、无界域和复杂概率景观而难以求解。
Method: 将FP方程转化为概率流ODE的一阶连续性方程，构造无Hessian的损失函数；使用Hutchinson迹估计高效计算散度，使训练时间在GPU上维度无关；采用自适应采样策略生成配点。
Result: 数值实验在OU过程、时变扩散布朗运动和几何OU过程（非高斯解）上验证了方法，最高维度为100。
Conclusion: 理论分析表明KL散度由残差损失加权密度函数界定，方法有效。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Instant Expressive Gaussian Head Avatars at Over 100 FPS
papers.abstract_en: Portrait animation has witnessed tremendous quality improvements thanks to recent advances in video diffusion models. However, these 2D methods often compromise 3D consistency and speed, limiting their applicability in real-world scenarios, such as digital twins or telepresence. In contrast, 3D-aware feedforward facial animation methods -- built upon 3D representations, such as neural radiance fields or Gaussian splatting -- ensure 3D consistency and achieve faster inference speed, but come with inferior expression details. In this paper, we address this portrait animation trilemma (speed, 3D consistency, and expressiveness) and propose a pipeline that instantly converts an in-the-wild single image into a 3D-consistent, fast yet expressive animatable representation via a feed-forward encoder. Unlike previous computationally intensive global fusion mechanisms (e.g., multiple attention layers) for fusing 3D structural and animation information, our design employs an efficient lightweight local fusion strategy to achieve high animation expressivity. Furthermore, our animation representation is decoupled from the face's 3D representation and learns motion implicitly from data, eliminating the dependency on pre-defined parametric models that often constrain animation capabilities. Our method runs at 107.31 FPS for animation and pose control, representing a 3-4 order of magnitude speedup versus the state of the art while achieving comparable animation quality, thus surpassing alternative designs that trade speed for quality or vice versa.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种前馈编码器，将单张野外图像即时转换为3D一致、快速且富有表现力的可动画高斯头像表示，通过轻量级局部融合策略实现高表达力，动画表示与3D表示解耦，避免依赖预定义参数模型，推理速度达107.31 FPS。
Motivation: 现有2D视频扩散方法虽提升了肖像动画质量，但牺牲了3D一致性和速度；3D感知前馈方法保证了3D一致性但缺乏表情细节，难以同时满足速度、3D一致性和表现力。
Method: 采用前馈编码器直接编码单张图像得到3D高斯头像表示；使用高效的轻量级局部融合策略替代全局融合机制；动画表示与3D表示解耦，从数据中隐式学习运动，无需预定义参数化模型。
Result: 动画和姿态控制达到107.31 FPS，比现有最优方法快3-4个数量级，同时保持可比的动画质量。
Conclusion: 该方法有效平衡了速度、3D一致性和表现力，且无需预定义参数模型，适用于数字孪生、远程呈现等实时场景。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: PhysChoreo: Physics-Controllable Video Generation with Part-Aware Semantic Grounding
papers.abstract_en: While recent video generation models have achieved significant visual fidelity, they often suffer from the lack of explicit physical controllability and plausibility. To address this, some recent studies attempted to guide the video generation with physics-based rendering. However, these methods face inherent challenges in accurately modeling complex physical properties and effectively control ling the resulting physical behavior over extended temporal sequences. In this work, we introduce PhysChoreo, a novel framework that can generate videos with diverse controllability and physical realism from a single image. Our method consists of two stages: first, it estimates the static initial physical properties of all objects in the image through part-aware physical property reconstruction. Then, through temporally instructed and physically editable simulation, it synthesizes high-quality videos with rich dynamic behaviors and physical realism. Experimental results show that PhysChoreo can generate videos with rich behaviors and physical realism, outperforming state-of-the-art methods on multiple evaluation metrics.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出PhysChoreo框架，从单张图像生成具有物理可控性和真实感的视频。方法分两阶段：首先通过部件感知的物理属性重建估计所有物体的静态初始物理属性，然后通过时间指导的可编辑物理模拟合成高质量视频。实验表明，PhysChoreo在多个评估指标上优于现有方法。
Motivation: 现有视频生成模型缺乏显式的物理可控性和真实性，基于物理渲染的方法难以准确建模复杂物理属性并有效控制长时间序列的物理行为。
Method: 两阶段框架：第一阶段通过部件感知的物理属性重建估计图像中所有物体的静态初始物理属性；第二阶段通过时间指导且可物理编辑的模拟合成具有丰富动态行为和物理真实感的视频。
Result: 在多个评估指标上优于现有方法，能够生成具有丰富行为和物理真实感的视频。
Conclusion: PhysChoreo能够从单张图像生成具有多样可控性和物理真实感的视频，有效解决了物理建模与长时间控制的问题。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Towards Benign Memory Forgetting for Selective Multimodal Large Language Model Unlearning
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) can inadvertently memorize privacy-sensitive information during training. While existing unlearning methods can remove such content, they often severely degrade the model's foundational capabilities, such as general image understanding. This critical shortfall motivates our investigation into benign memory forgetting, the precise removal of targeted, privacy-sensitive knowledge while rigorously preserving unrelated capabilities. To pioneer and evaluate progress toward this objective, we introduce S-MLLMUn Bench, the first benchmark designed to jointly and quantitatively assess an unlearning method's efficacy in knowledge erasure and the preservation of image understanding. Furthermore, we propose the Sculpted Memory Forgetting Adapter (SMFA), a new framework that enables benign memory forgetting. SMFA confines forgetting to designated memory regions, maintaining overall model performance. By initially fine-tuning the model to replace sensitive outputs with refusals, SMFA generates a memory forgetting adapter, followed by a retaining anchor-guided masking mechanism that safeguards unrelated knowledge. Extensive experiments on S-MLLMUn Bench demonstrate that existing methods fail to achieve benign forgetting, whereas our proposed SMFA serves as an effective baseline, successfully achieving targeted knowledge erasure without compromising the model's foundational visual capabilities. Code and data are available at https://github.com/zeng-zhen/S-MLLMUn.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对多模态大语言模型（MLLM）中的记忆遗忘问题，提出良性记忆遗忘（benign memory forgetting）概念，即精确移除隐私敏感知识而不损害模型基础能力。作者构建了首个联合评估遗忘效果与图像理解保持的基准 S-MLLMUn Bench，并提出了雕刻记忆遗忘适配器（SMFA），通过微调替换敏感输出为拒绝、并利用保留锚点引导的掩码机制保护无关知识。实验表明现有方法无法实现良性遗忘，而SMFA作为有效基线成功实现了目标知识擦除且不损害视觉能力。
Motivation: 现有MLLM遗忘方法在移除隐私信息时严重破坏了模型的基础图像理解能力，缺乏既能精确擦除目标知识又能保持通用能力的方案。
Method: 提出雕刻记忆遗忘适配器（SMFA）框架：先微调模型将敏感输出替换为拒绝回答，生成记忆遗忘适配器；再通过保留锚点引导的掩码机制，保护无关知识不受影响。
Result: 在S-MLLMUn Bench上，现有方法均无法实现良性遗忘，而SMFA成功实现了目标知识擦除，且不损害模型的基础视觉能力。
Conclusion: 本文证明了良性遗忘的可行性，SMFA可作为选择性MLLM遗忘的有力基线，但仅关注隐私敏感知识移除，未涉及其他遗忘场景。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Let Language Constrain Geometry: Vision-Language Models as Semantic and Spatial Critics for 3D Generation
papers.abstract_en: Text-to-3D generation has advanced rapidly, yet state-of-the-art models, encompassing both optimization-based and feed-forward architectures, still face two fundamental limitations. First, they struggle with coarse semantic alignment, often failing to capture fine-grained prompt details. Second, they lack robust 3D spatial understanding, leading to geometric inconsistencies and catastrophic failures in part assembly and spatial relationships. To address these challenges, we propose VLM3D, a general framework that repurposes large vision-language models (VLMs) as powerful, differentiable semantic and spatial critics. Our core contribution is a dual-query critic signal derived from the VLM's Yes or No log-odds, which assesses both semantic fidelity and geometric coherence. We demonstrate the generality of this guidance signal across two distinct paradigms: (1) As a reward objective for optimization-based pipelines, VLM3D significantly outperforms existing methods on standard benchmarks. (2) As a test-time guidance module for feed-forward pipelines, it actively steers the iterative sampling process of SOTA native 3D models to correct severe spatial errors. VLM3D establishes a principled and generalizable path to inject the VLM's rich, language-grounded understanding of both semantics and space into diverse 3D generative pipelines.
papers.comment: arXiv admin note: substantial text overlap with arXiv:2509.15772
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出VLM3D，一个通用框架，将大型视觉语言模型（VLM）重新用作可微分的语义和空间评论家。通过从VLM的“是/否”对数几率中提取双查询评论家信号，同时评估语义保真度和几何一致性。该信号可作为优化管道的奖励目标，显著优于现有基准；或作为前馈管道的测试时指导模块，纠正严重空间错误。VLM3D为将VLM丰富的语义和空间理解注入3D生成管道提供了原则性且可泛化的路径。
Motivation: 现有文本到3D模型（包括优化和前馈架构）存在两个基本限制：粗粒度的语义对齐（难以捕捉精细的提示细节）和缺乏鲁棒的3D空间理解（导致几何不一致和部分装配的灾难性失败）。
Method: 提出双查询评论家信号：从VLM的“是/否”分类对数几率中提取，同时评估语义保真度和几何一致性。该信号可分别作为优化管道的奖励目标或前馈管道的测试时指导模块。
Result: 作为奖励目标时，在标准基准上显著优于现有方法；作为测试时指导时，能主动引导SOTA原生3D模型的迭代采样过程，纠正严重空间错误。
Conclusion: VLM3D建立了一种原则性且可泛化的方法，将VLM基于语言的自然语义和空间理解注入多种3D生成管道。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Hyperellipsoid Density Sampling: Exploitative Sequences to Accelerate High-Dimensional Optimization
papers.abstract_en: The curse of dimensionality remains a persistent challenge in modern optimization problems. Expanding the search space into higher dimensions exponentiates the difficulty of finding optimal solutions, rendering traditional algorithms inefficient. An efficient sampling strategy is presented to accelerate high-dimensional optimization as an alternative to uniform quasi-Monte Carlo (QMC) methods. This method, referred to as Hyperellipsoid Density Sampling (HDS), generates its sequences by defining multiple hyperellipsoids throughout the search space. HDS utilizes three types of unsupervised learning algorithms to bypass high-dimensional geometric calculations, producing a non-uniform sample sequence that exploits statistically promising regions of the parameter space. The ability to influence its distribution towards regions of interest makes HDS versatile for applications beyond global optimization, where models benefit from samples focused in specific regions. HDS was evaluated against Sobol, a highly uniform QMC sampling method, using differential evolution (DE) on the challenging set of 29 CEC2017 benchmark test functions. The results show statistically significant improvements in final solution geometric mean error (p<0.05), with average performance gains ranging from 37% in 10-D to 11% in 100-D. This paper demonstrates the efficacy of HDS as a robust alternative to uniform QMC sampling in high-dimensional optimization.
papers.comment: 7 pages, 9 figures, 5 tables. For Python implementation, see: pip install hdim-opt, or https://github.com/jgsoltes/hdim-opt
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出超椭球密度采样（Hyperellipsoid Density Sampling, HDS），作为均匀拟蒙特卡洛（QMC）方法的替代，用于加速高维优化。HDS 通过定义多个超椭球并利用三种无监督学习算法生成非均匀样本序列，聚焦于统计上更有希望的区域。在 CEC2017 基准测试上使用差分进化（DE）评估，相比 Sobol 采样，HDS 在 10 维上平均性能提升 37%，在 100 维上提升 11%，且改进具有统计显著性（p<0.05）。
Motivation: 高维优化中维度诅咒使传统算法效率下降，均匀 QMC 采样无法集中资源于有希望的区域，导致搜索效率低下。
Method: 提出 Hyperellipsoid Density Sampling (HDS)，通过在搜索空间中定义多个超椭球，并利用无监督学习算法（如聚类）避免高维几何计算，生成偏向于统计优良区域的非均匀样本序列。
Result: 在 29 个 CEC2017 测试函数上，HDS 结合差分进化（DE）相比 Sobol 采样的几何平均误差显著降低（p<0.05），平均性能增益从 10 维的 37% 变化到 100 维的 11%。
Conclusion: HDS 可作为均匀 QMC 的鲁棒替代方案，有效加速高维优化，其可调节的分布特性也适用于需要区域聚焦的其他应用。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Hybrid Fact-Checking that Integrates Knowledge Graphs, Large Language Models, and Search-Based Retrieval Agents Improves Interpretable Claim Verification
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) excel in generating fluent utterances but can lack reliable grounding in verified information. At the same time, knowledge-graph-based fact-checkers deliver precise and interpretable evidence, yet suffer from limited coverage or latency. By integrating LLMs with knowledge graphs and real-time search agents, we introduce a hybrid fact-checking approach that leverages the individual strengths of each component. Our system comprises three autonomous steps: 1) a Knowledge Graph (KG) Retrieval for rapid one-hop lookups in DBpedia, 2) an LM-based classification guided by a task-specific labeling prompt, producing outputs with internal rule-based logic, and 3) a Web Search Agent invoked only when KG coverage is insufficient. Our pipeline achieves an F1 score of 0.93 on the FEVER benchmark on the Supported/Refuted split without task-specific fine-tuning. To address Not enough information cases, we conduct a targeted reannotation study showing that our approach frequently uncovers valid evidence for claims originally labeled as Not Enough Information (NEI), as confirmed by both expert annotators and LLM reviewers. With this paper, we present a modular, opensource fact-checking pipeline with fallback strategies and generalization across datasets.
papers.comment: Paper has been accepted at 9th wiNLP workshop at EMNLP
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种混合事实核查方法，结合知识图谱（DBpedia）、大语言模型（LLM）与基于搜索的检索代理。系统分三步：快速知识图谱查询、基于LLM的标注提示分类、以及当知识图谱覆盖不足时调用的Web搜索代理。在FEVER基准的Supported/Refuted子集上，无需任务特定微调即达到0.93的F1分数；对Not Enough Information案例的再标注研究表明，该方法能发现有效证据。
Motivation: 大语言模型生成流畅但缺乏可靠事实基础，而基于知识图谱的事实核查器精确但覆盖有限或延迟高；现有方法难以兼顾准确率、可解释性与覆盖范围。
Method: 构建三步骤流水线：1）在DBpedia中进行单跳知识图谱检索；2）使用任务特定提示驱动LM分类，结合内部规则逻辑；3）当知识图谱覆盖不足时，自动调用Web搜索代理作为后备。整个流程无需微调，模块化且开源。
Result: 在FEVER基准的Supported/Refuted子集上达到0.93的F1分数；再标注研究显示该方法能频繁为原始NEI（Not Enough Information）标签的声明找到有效证据，经专家和LLM评审确认。
Conclusion: 该方法通过模块化设计、后备策略和跨数据集泛化能力，在保持可解释性的同时提升了事实核查的覆盖率和准确性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Chronic Kidney Disease Prognosis Prediction Using Transformer
papers.abstract_en: Chronic Kidney Disease (CKD) affects nearly 10\% of the global population and often progresses to end-stage renal failure. Accurate prognosis prediction is vital for timely interventions and resource optimization. We present a transformer-based framework for predicting CKD progression using multi-modal electronic health records (EHR) from the Seoul National University Hospital OMOP Common Data Model. Our approach (\textbf{ProQ-BERT}) integrates demographic, clinical, and laboratory data, employing quantization-based tokenization for continuous lab values and attention mechanisms for interpretability. The model was pretrained with masked language modeling and fine-tuned for binary classification tasks predicting progression from stage 3a to stage 5 across varying follow-up and assessment periods. Evaluated on a cohort of 91,816 patients, our model consistently outperformed CEHR-BERT, achieving ROC-AUC up to 0.995 and PR-AUC up to 0.989 for short-term prediction. These results highlight the effectiveness of transformer architectures and temporal design choices in clinical prognosis modeling, offering a promising direction for personalized CKD care.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出基于 Transformer 的 ProQ-BERT 框架，利用多模态电子健康记录预测慢性肾病 (CKD) 进展。模型采用量化标记化处理连续实验室值，并通过注意力机制提供可解释性。在 91,816 名患者队列上，ProQ-BERT 在预测从 3a 期进展到 5 期时，短期预测的 ROC-AUC 达 0.995，PR-AUC 达 0.989，优于 CEHR-BERT。
Motivation: CKD 影响全球近 10% 人口，准确预后预测对于及时干预和资源优化至关重要，现有方法在多模态时序数据建模上存在不足。
Method: 提出 ProQ-BERT 框架，使用量化标记化对连续实验室值进行离散化，结合人口统计学和临床数据，采用掩码语言模型预训练和二进制分类微调，利用注意力机制增强可解释性。
Result: 在 91,816 例患者队列中，ProQ-BERT 预测 CKD 进展的 ROC-AUC 达 0.995，PR-AUC 达 0.989，全面超越 CEHR-BERT。
Conclusion: Transformer 架构与时序设计选择在临床预后建模中有效，为个性化 CKD 管理提供了有前景的方向。

papers.title: PreferThinker: Reasoning-based Personalized Image Preference Assessment
papers.abstract_en: Personalized image preference assessment aims to evaluate an individual user's image preferences by relying only on a small set of reference images as prior information. Existing methods mainly focus on general preference assessment, training models with large-scale data to tackle well-defined tasks such as text-image alignment. However, these approaches struggle to handle personalized preference because user-specific data are scarce and not easily scalable, and individual tastes are often diverse and complex. To overcome these challenges, we introduce a common preference profile that serves as a bridge across users, allowing large-scale user data to be leveraged for training profile prediction and capturing complex personalized preferences. Building on this idea, we propose a reasoning-based personalized image preference assessment framework that follows a \textit{predict-then-assess} paradigm: it first predicts a user's preference profile from reference images, and then provides interpretable, multi-dimensional scores and assessments of candidate images based on the predicted profile. To support this, we first construct a large-scale Chain-of-Thought (CoT)-style personalized assessment dataset annotated with diverse user preference profiles and high-quality CoT-style reasoning, enabling explicit supervision of structured reasoning. Next, we adopt a two-stage training strategy: a cold-start supervised fine-tuning phase to empower the model with structured reasoning capabilities, followed by reinforcement learning to incentivize the model to explore more reasonable assessment paths and enhance generalization. Furthermore, we propose a similarity-aware prediction reward to encourage better prediction of the user's preference profile, which facilitates more reasonable assessments exploration. Extensive experiments demonstrate the superiority of the proposed method.
papers.comment: This paper is accepted by ICLR 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出PreferThinker，一种基于推理的个性化图像偏好评估框架，采用“预测-评估”范式：先从少量参考图像预测用户的偏好概貌（preference profile），再基于概貌对候选图像输出可解释的多维评分。为支持该框架，作者构建了大规模CoT风格个性化评估数据集，并采用两阶段训练策略：冷启动监督微调赋予模型结构化推理能力，随后使用强化学习（带相似性感知预测奖励）提升泛化性。实验表明该方法优于现有基线。
Motivation: 现有通用偏好评估模型难以处理个性化偏好，因为用户数据稀缺、规模不易扩展，且个体品味多样复杂。
Method: 引入通用偏好概貌作为跨用户桥梁，使大规模用户数据可用于训练概貌预测；构建CoT风格数据集以监督结构化推理；采用两阶段训练：先冷启动监督微调，再通过强化学习（含相似性感知预测奖励）优化评估路径。
Result: 在个性化图像偏好评估任务上，PreferThinker优于现有方法（摘要未报告具体数值）。
Conclusion: 推理机制和两阶段训练有效提升了个性化偏好评估的可解释性与泛化能力。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Self-Concordant Perturbations for Linear Bandits
papers.abstract_en: We consider the adversarial linear bandits setting and present a unified algorithmic framework that bridges Follow-the-Regularized-Leader (FTRL) and Follow-the-Perturbed-Leader (FTPL) methods, extending the known connection between them from the full-information setting. Within this framework, we introduce self-concordant perturbations, a family of probability distributions that mirror the role of self-concordant barriers previously employed in the FTRL-based SCRiBLe algorithm. Using this idea, we design a novel FTPL-based algorithm that combines self-concordant regularization with efficient stochastic exploration. Our approach achieves a regret of $\mathcal{O}(d\sqrt{n \ln n})$ on both the $d$-dimensional hypercube and the $\ell_2$ ball. On the $\ell_2$ ball, this matches the rate attained by SCRiBLe. For the hypercube, this represents a $\sqrt{d}$ improvement over these methods and matches the optimal bound up to logarithmic factors.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对对抗性线性赌臂（adversarial linear bandits）提出一个统一算法框架，桥接了跟随正则化领导者（FTRL）与跟随扰动领导者（FTPL），并将二者在完全信息下的联系推广到该框架。通过引入自和谐扰动（self-concordant perturbations）这一概率分布族，设计了一种新型FTPL算法，在d维超立方体和ℓ2球上均达到O(d√(n ln n))的遗憾界。在超立方体上，该界相较于基于FTRL的SCRiBLe等方法有√d的改进，并接近最优界。
Motivation: 现有的FTRL和FTPL方法在对抗线性赌臂中缺乏统一理解，且超立方体上的遗憾界存在改进空间。
Method: 提出自和谐扰动，一种模仿自和谐障碍（self-concordant barriers）作用的概率分布，结合自和谐正则化与高效随机探索，设计基于FTPL的新算法。
Result: 算法在d维超立方体和ℓ2球上实现O(d√(n ln n))遗憾，在超立方体上较SCRiBLe等有√d的改进，匹配最优界至对数因子。
Conclusion: 自和谐扰动有效桥接了FTRL与FTPL，为对抗线性赌臂提供了新的理论工具和高效算法。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.tldr: 本文针对对抗性线性赌臂（adversarial linear bandits）提出一个统一算法框架，桥接了跟随正则化领导者（FTRL）与跟随扰动领导者（FTPL），并将二者在完全信息下的联系推广到该框架。通过引入自和谐扰动（self-concordant perturbations）这一概率分布族，设计了一种新型FTPL算法，在d维超立方体和ℓ2球上均达到O(d√(n ln n))的遗憾界。在超立方体上，该界相较于基于FTRL的SCRiBLe等方法有√d的改进，并接近最优界。
summary_sections.motivation: 现有的FTRL和FTPL方法在对抗线性赌臂中缺乏统一理解，且超立方体上的遗憾界存在改进空间。
summary_sections.method: 提出自和谐扰动，一种模仿自和谐障碍（self-concordant barriers）作用的概率分布，结合自和谐正则化与高效随机探索，设计基于FTPL的新算法。
summary_sections.result: 算法在d维超立方体和ℓ2球上实现O(d√(n ln n))遗憾，在超立方体上较SCRiBLe等有√d的改进，匹配最优界至对数因子。
summary_sections.conclusion: 自和谐扰动有效桥接了FTRL与FTPL，为对抗线性赌臂提供了新的理论工具和高效算法。

papers.title: Learning Peer Influence Probabilities with Linear Contextual Bandits
papers.abstract_en: In networked environments, it is common for users to share recommendations about content, products, services, and possible courses of action. Whether these recommendations are accepted and acted upon is highly context-dependent, influenced by the characteristics of the sender and recipient, the nature of their relationship, the attributes of the recommended item, and the communication context. Consequently, probabilities of peer influence exhibit substantial heterogeneity across individuals and settings. Accurate estimation of these probabilities is key to understanding information diffusion processes and to improving the effectiveness of viral marketing strategies. However, learning these probabilities from data is challenging; static data may capture correlations between peer recommendations and peer actions but fails to reveal influence relationships. Online learning algorithms can learn these probabilities from interventions but either waste resources by learning from random exploration or optimize for rewards, thus favoring exploration of the space with higher influence probabilities. In this work, we study learning peer influence probabilities under a contextual linear bandit framework. We show that a fundamental trade-off can arise between regret minimization and estimation error, characterize all achievable rate pairs, and propose an uncertainty-guided exploration algorithm that, by tuning a parameter, attains any pair within this trade-off. Our experiments on semi-synthetic network datasets show the advantages of our method over static methods and contextual bandits that ignore this trade-off.
papers.journal_ref: In Proceedings of the 32nd ACM SIGKDD Conference on Knowledge Discovery and Data Mining V.2 (KDD '26), August 09-13, 2026, Jeju Island, Republic of Korea. ACM, New York, NY, USA, 12 pages
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究在社交网络背景下，利用上下文线性bandit框架在线学习同伴影响概率。作者证明遗憾最小化与估计误差之间存在根本权衡，刻画了所有可达的速率对，并提出一种不确定性引导的探索算法，通过调节参数可以权衡两者。在半合成网络数据集上实验表明方法优于静态方法和忽视该权衡的上下文bandit。
Motivation: 准确估计同伴影响概率对于理解信息传播和优化病毒式营销至关重要，但静态数据无法揭示因果影响，在线学习方法要么浪费资源随机探索，要么偏向高影响概率空间。需要同时考虑遗憾和估计误差的权衡。
Method: 提出基于上下文线性bandit的框架，理论分析遗憾与估计误差的权衡边界，并设计一种不确定性引导的探索算法，通过调节参数实现权衡曲线上任意点。
Result: 在半合成网络数据集上，该方法优于忽视权衡的静态方法和上下文bandit，具体提升体现在估计误差和累计遗憾的权衡上。
Conclusion: 摘要强调存在遗憾-误差权衡，所提算法能灵活调节该权衡，并在实验中展示优势。

papers.title: Retaining by Doing: The Role of On-Policy Data in Mitigating Forgetting
papers.abstract_en: Adapting language models (LMs) to new tasks via post-training carries the risk of degrading existing capabilities -- a phenomenon classically known as catastrophic forgetting. In this paper, toward identifying guidelines for mitigating this phenomenon, we systematically compare the forgetting patterns of two widely adopted post-training methods: supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and reinforcement learning (RL). Our experiments reveal a consistent trend across LM families (Llama, Qwen) and tasks (instruction following, general knowledge, and arithmetic reasoning): RL leads to less forgetting than SFT while achieving comparable or higher target task performance. To investigate the cause for this difference, we consider a simplified setting in which the LM is modeled as a mixture of two distributions, one corresponding to prior knowledge and the other to the target task. We identify that the mode-seeking nature of RL, which stems from its use of on-policy data, enables keeping prior knowledge intact when learning the target task. We then verify this insight by demonstrating that the use on-policy data underlies the robustness of RL to forgetting in practical settings, as opposed to other algorithmic choices such as the KL regularization or advantage estimation. Lastly, as a practical implication, our results highlight the potential of mitigating forgetting using approximately on-policy data, which can be substantially more efficient to obtain than fully on-policy data.
papers.journal_ref: Proceedings of the 43rd International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML), 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统比较了监督微调（SFT）和强化学习（RL）在语言模型后训练中的遗忘模式，发现RL比SFT更少遗忘已有能力且目标任务性能相近或更优。通过理论分析，将这一差异归因于RL使用on-policy数据的模式寻求特性，并验证了on-policy数据是缓解遗忘的关键因素。
Motivation: 语言模型后训练新任务时可能遗忘已有能力（灾难性遗忘），而当前缺乏对SFT和RL遗忘模式的系统比较及其机理的理解。
Method: 在Llama和Qwen系列模型上，针对指令跟随、通用知识和算术推理等任务，比较SFT和RL的遗忘程度；通过将LM建模为两个分布的混合，从理论上分析RL的模式寻求特性（源自on-policy数据）如何保留先验知识。
Result: 实验显示RL比SFT遗忘更少，同时目标任务表现相当或更优；理论分析表明on-policy数据是RL抗遗忘的关键，而非KL正则化或优势估计等其他算法选择。
Conclusion: 使用近似on-policy数据可以有效缓解遗忘，且比完全on-policy数据更高效，为实际后训练提供指导。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: A Primer on SO(3) Action Representations in Deep Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Many robotic control tasks require policies to act on orientations, yet the geometry of SO(3) makes this nontrivial. Because SO(3) admits no global, smooth, minimal parameterization, common representations such as Euler angles, quaternions, rotation matrices, and Lie algebra coordinates introduce distinct constraints and failure modes. While these trade-offs are well studied for supervised learning, their implications for actions in reinforcement learning remain unclear. We systematically evaluate SO(3) action representations across three standard continuous control algorithms, PPO, SAC, and TD3, under dense and sparse rewards. We compare how representations shape exploration, interact with entropy regularization, and affect training stability through empirical studies and analyze the implications of different projections for obtaining valid rotations from Euclidean network outputs. Across a suite of robotics benchmarks, we quantify the practical impact of these choices and distill simple, implementation-ready guidelines for selecting and using rotation actions. Our results highlight that representation-induced geometry strongly influences exploration and optimization and show that representing actions as tangent vectors in the local frame yields the most reliable results across algorithms. The project webpage and code are available at amacati.github.io/so3_primer.
papers.comment: Published at The Fourteenth International Conference on Learning Representations (ICLR 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统评估了SO(3)旋转动作在深度强化学习中的不同表示（欧拉角、四元数、旋转矩阵、李代数坐标）对探索、熵正则化和训练稳定性的影响。使用PPO、SAC、TD3算法在密集和稀疏奖励下进行测试，发现将动作表示为局部坐标系中的切向量（tangent vectors）最可靠。
Motivation: 机器人控制任务需要处理旋转动作，但SO(3)没有全局平滑最小参数化，常见表示各有约束和失败模式，而它们在强化学习中作为动作的影响尚不明确。
Method: 系统评估了四种SO(3)动作表示在三种连续控制算法（PPO、SAC、TD3）和两种奖励设置下的表现，通过经验研究比较表示如何影响探索、与熵正则化的交互以及训练稳定性，并分析不同投影方法从欧几里得网络输出获得有效旋转的影响。
Result: 量化了表示选择对机器人基准测试的实际影响，发现将动作表示为局部坐标系中的切向量在所有算法中产生最可靠的结果。
Conclusion: 表示诱导的几何形状强烈影响探索和优化，论文提供了简单、可实现的旋转动作选择和使用指南。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: MetaBreak: Jailbreaking Online LLM Services via Special Token Manipulation
papers.abstract_en: Unlike regular tokens derived from existing text corpora, special tokens are artificially created to annotate structured conversations during the fine-tuning process of Large Language Models (LLMs). Serving as metadata of training data, these tokens play a crucial role in instructing LLMs to generate coherent and context-aware responses. We demonstrate that special tokens can be exploited to construct four attack primitives, with which malicious users can reliably bypass the internal safety alignment of online LLM services and circumvent state-of-the-art (SOTA) external content moderation systems simultaneously. Moreover, we found that addressing this threat is challenging, as aggressive defense mechanisms-such as input sanitization by removing special tokens entirely, as suggested in academia-are less effective than anticipated. This is because such defense can be evaded when the special tokens are replaced by regular ones with high semantic similarity within the tokenizer's embedding space. We systemically evaluated our method, named MetaBreak, on both lab environment and commercial LLM platforms. Our approach achieves jailbreak rates comparable to SOTA prompt-engineering-based solutions when no content moderation is deployed. However, when there is content moderation, MetaBreak outperforms SOTA solutions PAP and GPTFuzzer by 11.6% and 34.8%, respectively. Finally, since MetaBreak employs a fundamentally different strategy from prompt engineering, the two approaches can work synergistically. Notably, empowering MetaBreak on PAP and GPTFuzzer boosts jailbreak rates by 24.3% and 20.2%, respectively.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文发现大型语言模型中的特殊令牌（special tokens）可被利用构造四种攻击原语，绕过内部安全对齐和外部内容审核系统。作者提出MetaBreak方法，在实验室和商业LLM平台上评估，无内容审核时越狱率与SOTA提示工程方法相当，有审核时分别超越PAP和GPTFuzzer 11.6%和34.8%。MetaBreak可与提示工程协同，进一步提升越狱率。
Motivation: 现有防御（如移除特殊令牌）被认为有效，但本文发现攻击者可用嵌入空间中语义相似的正规令牌替换特殊令牌来规避，凸显特殊令牌安全风险被低估。
Method: 提出MetaBreak方法，利用特殊令牌构造四种攻击原语，绕过LLM内部安全对齐和外部内容审核系统，并在实验室和商业平台评估。
Result: 无内容审核时，MetaBreak越狱率与SOTA提示工程方法相当；有内容审核时，MetaBreak超越PAP 11.6%、GPTFuzzer 34.8%。与PAP和GPTFuzzer结合，越狱率分别提升24.3%和20.2%。
Conclusion: 特殊令牌威胁被低估，现有防御效果有限；MetaBreak提供新攻击方式并可与提示工程协同，需更有效防御。

papers.title: Taming Text-to-Sounding Video Generation via Advanced Modality Condition and Interaction
papers.abstract_en: This study focuses on a challenging yet promising task, Text-to-Sounding-Video (T2SV) generation, which aims to generate a video with synchronized audio from text conditions, meanwhile ensuring both modalities are aligned with text. Despite progress in joint audio-video training, two critical challenges still remain unaddressed: (1) a single, shared text caption where the text for video is equal to the text for audio often creates modal interference, confusing the pretrained backbones, and (2) the optimal mechanism for cross-modal feature interaction remains unclear. To address these challenges, we first propose the Hierarchical Visual-Grounded Captioning (HVGC) framework that generates pairs of disentangled captions, a video caption, and an audio caption, eliminating interference at the conditioning stage. Based on HVGC, we further introduce BridgeDiT, a novel dual-tower diffusion transformer, which employs a Dual CrossAttention (DCA) mechanism that acts as a robust ``bridge" to enable a symmetric, bidirectional exchange of information, achieving both semantic and temporal synchronization. Extensive experiments on three benchmark datasets, supported by human evaluations, demonstrate that our method achieves state-of-the-art results on most metrics. Comprehensive ablation studies further validate the effectiveness of our contributions, offering key insights for the future T2SV task. All the codes and checkpoints will be publicly released.
papers.comment: The 19th European Conference on Computer Vision -- ECCV 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对文本到同步音视频生成（T2SV）任务，提出分层视觉基础描述（HVGC）框架生成解耦的视频描述和音频描述，消除模态干扰，并进一步引入BridgeDiT双塔扩散Transformer，通过双交叉注意力（DCA）机制实现对称双向信息交互，达到语义和时序同步。在三个基准数据集上取得SOTA结果。
Motivation: 现有T2SV方法中共享文本描述导致模态干扰，且跨模态特征交互机制不明确，亟需解决这两个挑战。
Method: 提出HVGC框架生成解耦的视频和音频描述；基于此构建BridgeDiT，采用双塔扩散Transformer和双交叉注意力机制，作为桥接实现双向信息交换。
Result: 在三个基准数据集上，通过人类评估和大量实验，该方法在大多数指标上达到SOTA，消融研究验证了各贡献的有效性。
Conclusion: 该方法为未来T2SV任务提供了关键见解，代码和检查点将公开发布。

papers.title: Accelerating Attention with Basis Decomposition
papers.abstract_en: Attention is a core operation in large language models (LLMs). We present BD Attention (BDA), a lossless algorithmic reformulation of attention. BDA is enabled by a simple matrix identity from Basis Decomposition (BD), which restructures multi-head projections into a compact form while preserving exact outputs. Unlike I/O-aware system optimizations such as FlashAttention, BDA provides a mathematically guaranteed acceleration that is architecture-agnostic. On DeepSeek-V2-Lite (16B, FP16), BDA requires only 4s of offline preparation with no retraining required and, on modern GPUs, achieves 34% faster key/value projections and 25% smaller weights, while increasing perplexity (PPL) by just 0.02% (FP16) or 0.0004% (FP32), a negligible effect on model performance. These results position BDA as a theoretically exact method for lossless attention acceleration that is complementary to existing engineering-level optimizations. Our code is available at https://github.com/abcbdf/basis-decomposition-official.

TL;DR: 本文提出 BD Attention (BDA)，一种基于基分解 (Basis Decomposition) 的注意力机制无损算法重构。BDA 通过一个简单的矩阵恒等式将多头投影重组成紧凑形式，同时保持精确输出，与 FlashAttention 等 I/O 感知优化不同，BDA 提供数学上保证的加速且与架构无关。实验表明，在 DeepSeek-V2-Lite (16B, FP16) 上，仅需 4 秒离线准备，无需重新训练，即可实现键值投影加速 34%、权重减小 25%，而困惑度 (PPL) 仅增加 0.02% (FP16) 或 0.0004% (FP32)。
Motivation: 注意力机制是大语言模型的核心操作，现有系统级优化如 FlashAttention 依赖于硬件特性，而缺乏数学上保证的无损加速方法。
Method: 利用基分解的矩阵恒等式，将多头注意力中的投影矩阵重新参数化为更紧凑的形式，在不改变输出的情况下减少计算量和存储量。
Result: 在 DeepSeek-V2-Lite 模型上，键值投影速度提升 34%，权重大小减少 25%，模型困惑度仅略微增加（FP16 下 0.02%，FP32 下 0.0004%）。
Conclusion: BDA 是一种理论上精确的无损注意力加速方法，可补充现有的工程级优化，且无需重新训练。

papers.title: Foundation vs. Specialized Models: Evaluating Catastrophic Forgetting in Continual Time Series Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: While Time Series Foundation Models (TSFMs) excel in zero-shot tasks, their behavior under continual fine tuning is poorly understood. We present the first systematic study of catastrophic forgetting in TSFMs (TimesFM-2.0, Chronos-2) versus a specialized SamFormer model across synthetic and real-world energy forecasting benchmarks. Our results show that while fine-tuning improves new task accuracy, it consistently triggers forgetting, though larger models exhibit greater inherent robustness. Notably, employing forgetting mitigation techniques such as DER, levels the playing field: it provides disproportionate gains to smaller models, allowing them to match TSFM performance by the end of the continual learning sequence. These findings suggest that in realistic, non-stationary scenarios, the high computational cost of large foundation models may not be justified over smaller models equipped with effective mitigation strategies.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文首次系统研究时间序列基础模型（TSFM）在持续微调下的灾难性遗忘现象，对比TimesFM-2.0、Chronos-2与专用模型SamFormer在合成及真实能源预测任务上的表现。结果表明，微调提升新任务准确率但始终引发遗忘，大模型固有鲁棒性更强；使用遗忘缓解技术（如DER）后，小模型可匹配大模型性能，暗示现实非平稳场景中大型基础模型的高计算成本可能不具优势。
Motivation: 时间序列基础模型在零样本任务中表现优异，但其在持续微调下的行为（尤其是灾难性遗忘）尚未被系统研究。
Method: 在合成与真实能源预测基准上，对TSFM（TimesFM-2.0, Chronos-2）和专用SamFormer模型进行持续学习实验，并应用DER等遗忘缓解技术。
Result: 微调会引发灾难性遗忘，但大模型鲁棒性更强；DER等缓解技术对小模型增益更大，使其最终能匹配TSFM性能。
Conclusion: 在非平稳真实场景中，配备有效遗忘缓解策略的小模型可能比高成本大型基础模型更具性价比。
Relevance: 25

papers.title: Training-free Uncertainty Guidance for Complex Visual Tasks with MLLMs
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) often struggle with fine-grained perception, such as identifying small objects in high-resolution images or detecting key moments in long videos. Existing methods typically rely on complex, task-specific fine-tuning, which reduces generalizability and increases system complexity. In this work, we propose an effective, training-free framework that uses an MLLM's intrinsic uncertainty as proactive guidance. Our core insight is that a model's uncertainty decreases when provided with relevant visual information. We introduce a unified mechanism that scores candidate visual inputs by response uncertainty, enabling the model to autonomously focus on the most informative data. We apply this simple principle to three challenging visual tasks: Visual Search, Long Video Understanding, and Temporal Grounding, allowing off-the-shelf MLLMs to achieve performance competitive with specialized, fine-tuned systems. Our results demonstrate that leveraging intrinsic uncertainty is a powerful strategy for improving fine-grained multimodal performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个无需训练的框架，利用多模态大模型（MLLM）内在的不确定性作为主动引导，用于复杂视觉任务。核心思想是当提供相关视觉信息时模型不确定性降低，通过响应不确定性评分候选视觉输入，使模型自动聚焦于最有信息量的数据。在视觉搜索、长视频理解和时间定位任务上，现成MLLM取得了与专用微调系统竞争的性能。
Motivation: MLLMs在细粒度感知任务（如识别高分辨率图像中的小物体或检测长视频中的关键时刻）表现不佳，现有方法依赖复杂任务特定微调，降低泛化性并增加系统复杂度。
Method: 提出一个无需训练的框架，利用MLLM自身的不确定性作为主动引导，通过响应不确定性评分候选视觉输入，统一机制应用于三个视觉任务。
Result: 在视觉搜索、长视频理解和时间定位任务上，现成MLLM取得了与专用微调系统竞争的性能。
Conclusion: 利用内在不确定性是提升细粒度多模态性能的有效策略。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: HunyuanImage 3.0 Technical Report
papers.abstract_en: We present HunyuanImage 3.0, a native multimodal model that unifies multimodal understanding and generation within an autoregressive framework, with its image generation module publicly available. The achievement of HunyuanImage 3.0 relies on several key components, including meticulous data curation, advanced architecture design, a native Chain-of-Thoughts schema, progressive model pre-training, aggressive model post-training, and an efficient infrastructure that enables large-scale training and inference. With these advancements, we successfully trained a Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) model comprising over 80 billion parameters in total, with 13 billion parameters activated per token during inference, making it the largest and most powerful open-source image generative model to date. We conducted extensive experiments and the results of automatic and human evaluation of text-image alignment and visual quality demonstrate that HunyuanImage 3.0 rivals previous state-of-the-art models. By releasing the code and weights of HunyuanImage 3.0, we aim to enable the community to explore new ideas with a state-of-the-art foundation model, fostering a dynamic and vibrant multimodal ecosystem. All open source assets are publicly available at https://github.com/Tencent-Hunyuan/HunyuanImage-3.0
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍了HunyuanImage 3.0，一个原生多模态自回归模型，统一理解与生成。模型采用MoE架构，总参数量超800亿，每token激活130亿参数，是当前最大的开源图像生成模型。通过精心数据整理、架构设计、思维链、渐进预训练和激进后训练，模型在文本-图像对齐和视觉质量上达到SOTA水平。
Motivation: 现有开源图像生成模型在规模和能力上仍有不足，缺乏统一多模态理解与生成的框架。本文目标是构建最大最强开源图像生成模型，促进多模态生态。
Method: 提出HunyuanImage 3.0，基于自回归框架的原生多模态模型。关键技术包括：数据整理、MoE架构（总参80B，激活13B）、原生思维链机制、渐进式预训练和后训练，以及高效训练推理基础设施。
Result: 自动和人工评估显示，模型在文本-图像对齐和视觉质量上可与之前SOTA模型媲美。
Conclusion: 作者强调开源模型权重和代码，旨在为社区提供强大基础模型，推动多模态生态发展。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Unbiased Binning for Fairness-aware Attribute Representation
papers.abstract_en: Discretizing raw features into bucketized attribute representations is a popular step before sharing a dataset. It is, however, evident that this step can cause significant bias in data and amplify unfairness in downstream tasks. In this paper, we address this issue by introducing the unbiased binning problem that, given an attribute to bucketize, finds its closest discretization to equal-size binning that satisfies group parity across different buckets. Defining a small set of boundary candidates, we prove that unbiased binning must select its boundaries from this set. We then develop an efficient dynamic programming algorithm on top of the boundary candidates to solve the unbiased binning problem. Finding an unbiased binning may sometimes result in a high price of fairness, or it may not even exist, especially when group values follow different distributions. Considering that a small bias in the group ratios may be tolerable in such settings, we introduce the epsilon-biased binning problem that bounds the group disparities across buckets to a small value epsilon. We first develop a dynamic programming solution, DP, that finds the optimal binning in quadratic time. The DP algorithm, while polynomial, does not scale to very large settings. Therefore, we propose a practically scalable algorithm, based on local search (LS), for epsilon-biased binning. The key component of the LS algorithm is a divide-and-conquer (D&C) algorithm that finds a near-optimal solution for the problem in near-linear time. We prove that D&C finds a valid solution for the problem unless none exists. The LS algorithm then initiates a local search, using the D&C solution as the upper bound, to find the optimal solution.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究了数据预处理中特征离散化（分箱）步骤可能引入的偏差问题，提出无偏分箱（unbiased binning）问题，目标是找到与等宽分箱最接近且满足组间平等（group parity）的分箱方案。证明了边界候选集性质，并开发了动态规划和基于局部搜索的高效算法，同时扩展到允许小偏差的epsilon-有偏分箱。
Motivation: 现有数据分箱步骤可能引入显著偏差，进而放大下游任务中的不公平性，但针对分箱本身的公平性研究不足。
Method: 无偏分箱方面，定义小规模边界候选集并证明最优边界必在其中；开发动态规划算法求解。epsilon-有偏分箱方面，提出二次时间DP算法，以及基于分治和局部搜索的近似线性时间算法，分治算法保证解存在时找到有效解。
Result: 理论上证明了无偏分箱的边界候选集性质；算法上，分治算法在线性时间内找到可行解，局部搜索算法利用该解作为上界搜索最优解。
Conclusion: 本文为数据预处理中的公平性分箱问题提供了理论基础和可扩展算法，适用于需要控制组间偏差的数据发布场景。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Ranking Before Serving: Low-Latency LLM Serving via Pairwise Learning-to-Rank
papers.abstract_en: Efficient scheduling of large language model (LLM) inference tasks is critical for achieving low latency and high throughput, a challenge that is becoming increasingly acute with the rise of reasoning-capable LLMs whose generation lengths are highly variable. Traditional strategies like First Come, First-Serve (FCFS) often suffer from Head-of-Line (HOL) blocking, where long-running tasks delay shorter ones queued behind them. In this paper, we introduce PARS, a prompt-aware LLM task scheduler that mitigates HOL blocking by approximating shortest-job-first (SJF) scheduling through pairwise ranking with a margin ranking loss. PARS effectively predicts response-length-based task ordering directly from prompts, thereby optimizing scheduling decisions with minimal overhead. In addition, it integrates seamlessly with vLLM, a state-of-the-art LLM serving system, for the research community. Extensive experiments across multiple LLM models and real-world inference use cases, including chat, math, and code generation, demonstrate that PARS significantly reduces latency by up to 15.7x compared to the vLLM default scheduler. Cross-model evaluations demonstrate that our design generalizes effectively, allowing effective scheduling across diverse LLMs without requiring model-specific retraining.
papers.comment: 13 pages, 4 figures. Published in ISC High Performance 2026 Research Paper Proceedings (41st International Conference)
papers.journal_ref: ISC High Performance 2026 Research Paper Proceedings (41st International Conference), Hamburg, Germany, 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 PARS，一种提示感知的 LLM 推理任务调度器，通过成对排序（pairwise ranking）近似最短作业优先（SJF）调度，以减轻头部阻塞（HOL blocking）。PARS 能够直接从提示中预测响应长度排序，并兼容 vLLM 系统。实验表明，与 vLLM 默认调度器相比，PARS 在多个模型和真实场景中将延迟降低最多 15.7 倍，且跨模型泛化良好。
Motivation: 现有 LLM 推理调度策略（如先来先服务）易受头部阻塞影响，长任务阻塞短任务导致高延迟，尤其对于生成长度高度可变的推理模型。
Method: 提出 PARS 调度器，使用成对排序学习（pairwise learning-to-rank）从提示中预测任务相对长度排序，近似 SJF 调度，开销极小，并集成到 vLLM 系统中。
Result: 在聊天、数学、代码生成等基准上，PARS 相比 vLLM 默认调度器降低延迟最多 15.7 倍；跨模型评估显示无需重新训练即可泛化。
Conclusion: PARS 有效缓解头部阻塞，显著降低 LLM 推理延迟，且设计可推广至不同 LLM。

papers.title: Freshness and the Limits of Heuristic Trend Detection in Temporal RAG
papers.abstract_en: We present a lightweight, model-agnostic temporal layer for RAG and use cybersecurity data to separate two problems that are usually conflated. For freshness, a half-life recency prior surfaces the newest relevant item where a cosine-only baseline scores 0.00; on a hard NVD CVE test, where the freshest item is not the most similar, it reaches Latest@10 of 0.60 versus 0.20 for a semantic-then-newest baseline, but stays partial and parameter-sensitive. For topic evolution, a heuristic tracker's low 0.08 macro-F1 is driven by the labeling rule, not the clusterer (HDBSCAN: 0.10; fixing the rule alone reaches 0.49, and 0.96 without clustering noise). We contribute a reproducible decoupling of the two, with honest real-data scope and a reference implementation.

papers.title: Non-Linear Model-Based Sequential Decision-Making in Agriculture
papers.abstract_en: Agricultural decision-making faces a dual challenge: sustaining high yields to meet global food security needs while reducing the environmental impacts of input use, including fertilizer losses and other agrochemical applications such as herbicides, insecticides, and fungicides. Nitrogen inputs are central to this tension. They are indispensable for crop growth yet major drivers of greenhouse gas emissions, nutrient runoff, and escalating production costs. Addressing these intertwined pressures requires adaptive decision-support tools that are statistically principled, economically sustainable and interpretable for practitioners. We develop nonlinear model-based bandit algorithms as a framework for adaptive fertilizer management under uncertainty. Building on classical mechanistic yield-response models, our approach links algorithmic exploration-exploitation strategies directly to interpretable biological processes such as maximum yield and nutrient efficiency. This grounding makes recommendations transparent for practitioners while supporting cost-effective and sustainable input use. Methodologically, we establish regret and sample complexity results for the well-specified nonlinear case, examine robustness under misspecification, and evaluate the proposed methods through profit-oriented simulations and an offline replay case study on publicly available multi-site corn nitrogen field trials from the U.S. Midwest. The results show that incorporating biologically meaningful mechanistic structure enables faster learning and higher profit as evidence accumulates, with flexible nonparametric baselines providing a competitive alternative in pooled and heterogeneous settings. Our findings illustrate how interpretable, uncertainty-aware sequential decision rules can support economically sustainable fertilizer recommendations and contribute to more efficient agricultural input use.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对农业决策中高产与环保的矛盾，提出基于非线性模型（mechanistic yield-response models）的bandit算法，用于自适应肥料管理。该方法将探索-利用策略与生物过程（如最大产量和养分效率）直接关联，从而提供可解释的推荐。在理论层面建立了遗憾界和样本复杂度结果，并通过基于利润的仿真和美国中西部玉米田间试验数据验证，表明加入生物机制可加快学习并提高利润。
Motivation: 农业决策面临高产与减少环境影响的矛盾，尤其是氮肥的使用既是作物生长必需，也是温室气体排放和成本升高的主要原因。现有工具缺乏统计严谨性、经济可持续性和可解释性。
Method: 开发非线性模型驱动的bandit算法，以经典产量响应模型为基础，将探索-利用策略与可解释的生物过程（如最大产量和养分效率）结合，并考虑模型设定正确和错误设定下的理论性质。
Result: 在利润导向的仿真和离线重放案例（美国中西部多站点玉米氮田间试验）中，融入生物机制的结构化模型能更快学习并产生更高利润；灵活的基线方法在混合和异质设定中表现有竞争力。
Conclusion: 可解释、考虑不确定性的序贯决策规则能支持经济可持续的肥料推荐，促进农业投入更高效的使用。

papers.title: SRMA-Mamba: Spatial Reverse Mamba Attention Network for Pathological Liver Segmentation in MRI Volumes
papers.abstract_en: Liver cirrhosis plays a critical role in the prognosis of chronic liver disease. Early detection and timely intervention are essential for reducing mortality rates. However, the intricate anatomical architecture and diverse pathological changes of liver tissue complicate the accurate detection and characterization of pathological liver structures in clinical settings. Existing methods underutilize spatial anatomical details in volumetric MRI data, thereby hindering their clinical effectiveness and explainability. To address this challenge, we introduce a novel Mamba-based network, SRMA-Mamba, designed to model the spatial relationships within complex anatomical structures of MRI volumes. By integrating the Spatial Anatomy-Based Mamba module (SABMamba), SRMA-Mamba performs selective Mamba scans within pathological liver tissues and combines anatomical information from the sagittal, coronal, and axial planes to construct a global spatial context representation, enabling efficient volumetric segmentation of pathological liver structures. Furthermore, we introduce the Spatial Reverse Mamba Attention module (SRMA), designed to progressively refine boundary details in the segmentation map, utilizing both the coarse segmentation map and hierarchical encoding features. Extensive experiments demonstrate that SRMA-Mamba surpasses state-of-the-art methods, delivering exceptional performance in 3D pathological liver segmentation. The source code is available at https://github.com/JunZengz/SRMA-Mamba.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于Mamba的SRMA-Mamba网络，用于MRI体积中病理性肝脏的3D分割。通过集成空间解剖Mamba模块（SABMamba）从矢状面、冠状面和横断面构建全局空间上下文，并利用空间反向Mamba注意力模块（SRMA）逐步细化边界细节。实验表明该方法在3D病理性肝脏分割上超越了现有最先进技术。
Motivation: 现有方法在MRI体积数据中未能充分利用空间解剖细节，限制了临床有效性和可解释性。
Method: 提出SRMA-Mamba网络，包含两个核心模块：SABMamba对病理性肝脏组织进行选择性Mamba扫描并融合三平面解剖信息；SRMA利用粗分割图和层次编码特征逐步细化分割边界。
Result: 在3D病理性肝脏分割任务上，SRMA-Mamba超越了现有最先进方法，性能优异。
Conclusion: SRMA-Mamba通过建模MRI体积中复杂解剖结构的空间关系，实现了高效且准确的病理性肝脏分割。

papers.title: LinkAnchor: An Autonomous LLM-Based Agent for Issue-to-Commit Link Recovery
papers.abstract_en: Issue-to-commit link recovery in software repositories is fundamental to software traceability and project management, yet it remains a challenging task. Prior studies show that only about 42.2% of issues on GitHub are correctly linked to their commits, highlighting the need for more effective solutions. Existing work has explored a range of ML/DL approaches, and more recently, large language models (LLMs) have been applied to this problem. However, these methods face two major limitations. First, LLMs are restricted by limited context windows and cannot simultaneously process all available data sources, such as long commit histories, extensive issue discussions, and large code repositories. Second, most approaches operate on individual issue-commit pairs, where a model independently scores the relevance of a single commit to an issue. This pairwise formulation fails to account for the complex associativity of software fixes, where an issue is often resolved by an aggregate chain of commits rather than a single atomic change. By ignoring these temporal and parental dependencies, existing methods often fail to incorporate the complete resolution logic and might misidentify intermediate commits as final fixes. Furthermore, this strategy is computationally inefficient in large repositories, as it requires exhaustively evaluating an enormous number of candidate pairs. To address these challenges, we present LinkAnchor, the first autonomous LLM-based agent designed specifically for issue-to-commit link recovery. LinkAnchor introduces a lazy-access architecture that allows the underlying LLM to dynamically retrieve only the most relevant contextual data, such as commits, issue comments, and code files, without exceeding token limits.
papers.comment: Proceedings of the ACM International Conference on the Foundations of Software Engineering (FSE), Montreal, Canada, July 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出LinkAnchor，首个基于LLM的自主agent用于软件仓库中issue-to-commit链接恢复。该方法通过懒加载架构允许LLM动态检索最相关的上下文数据（如提交、问题评论、代码文件），避免超出token限制，并处理多个commit共同解决一个issue的复杂情况。
Motivation: 现有issue-to-commit链接恢复方法准确率低（仅约42.2%），LLM方法受限于上下文窗口无法同时处理所有数据源，且大多只考虑单一issue-commit对，忽略多commit间的依赖关系。
Method: LinkAnchor采用懒加载架构，LLM agent仅在需要时动态检索最相关的上下文数据，包括提交历史、问题讨论和代码文件，从而在token限制内处理完整信息。
Result: 摘要未报告具体实验结果，但声称该方法能够解决上下文窗口限制和多commit依赖问题，提高链接恢复的准确性和效率。
Conclusion: LinkAnchor作为首个自主LLM agent，为issue-to-commit链接恢复提供了新范例，有望改善软件可追溯性。

papers.title: Symmetry-Aware Transformer Training for Automated Planning
papers.abstract_en: While transformers excel in many settings, their application in the field of automated planning is limited. Prior work like PlanGPT, a state-of-the-art decoder-only transformer, struggles with extrapolation from easy to hard planning problems. This in turn stems from problem symmetries: planning tasks can be represented with arbitrary variable names that carry no meaning beyond being identifiers. This causes a combinatorial explosion of equivalent representations that pure transformers cannot efficiently learn from. We propose a novel contrastive learning objective to make transformers symmetry-aware and thereby compensate for their lack of inductive bias. Combining this with architectural improvements, we show that transformers can be efficiently trained for either plan-generation or heuristic-prediction. Our results across multiple planning domains demonstrate that our symmetry-aware training effectively and efficiently addresses the limitations of PlanGPT.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对自动化规划中变换器外推能力不足的问题，提出对称感知训练方法。通过对比学习目标使模型对变量名排列具有不变性，并改进架构，从而在规划生成和启发式预测任务上提升性能。实验表明该方法有效克服了PlanGPT在简单到困难规划问题上的外推缺陷。
Motivation: 现有变换器在自动化规划中外推能力差，原因在于规划任务中变量名仅作为标识符存在，导致等价表示的组合爆炸，纯变换器难以高效学习。
Method: 提出对称感知对比学习目标，使变换器对变量名排列不敏感；同时进行架构改进，结合该目标训练用于规划生成或启发式预测的模型。
Result: 在多个规划领域上，对称感知训练有效且高效地克服了PlanGPT的局限性。
Conclusion: 对称感知训练可以为变换器在自动化规划任务中提供所需的归纳偏置。
