papers.title: SynSeg: Feature Synergy for Multi-Category Contrastive Learning in End-to-End Open-Vocabulary Semantic Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Semantic segmentation in open-vocabulary scenarios presents significant challenges due to the wide range and granularity of semantic categories. Existing weakly-supervised methods often rely on category-specific supervision and ill-suited feature construction methods for contrastive learning, leading to semantic misalignment and poor performance. In this work, we introduce a novel weakly-supervised approach, SynSeg, to address the challenges. SynSeg performs Multi-Category Contrastive Learning (MCCL) as a stronger training signal which robustly injecting intra- and inter-category knowledge during training. We also propose a new feature reconstruction framework named Feature Synergy Structure (FSS). FSS reconstructs discriminative features for contrastive learning through prior fusion and semantic-activation-map enhancement, effectively avoiding the foreground bias introduced by the visual encoder. Furthermore, SynSeg is a lightweight end-to-end solution capable for real-time inference. In general, SynSeg effectively improves the abilities in semantic localization and discrimination under weak supervision in an efficient manner. Extensive experiments on benchmarks demonstrate that our method outperforms state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance, with mIoU score gains ranging from 0.6% up to 8.9% across all reported benchmarks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SynSeg，一种用于端到端开放词汇语义分割的弱监督方法。通过多类别对比学习（MCCL）和特征协同结构（FSS），该方法在弱监督下提升了语义定位和判别能力，并在多个基准上以 mIoU 提升 0.6% 至 8.9% 达到最先进水平。
Motivation: 现有弱监督开放词汇语义分割方法依赖类别特定监督和不合适的特征构建方式，导致语义对齐差和性能不佳。
Method: 提出多类别对比学习（MCCL）作为更强的训练信号，注入类别内和类别间知识；并设计特征协同结构（FSS），通过先验融合和语义激活图增强来重建判别性特征，避免视觉编码器引入的前景偏差。
Result: 在多个基准上，SynSeg 的 mIoU 相比现有最先进方法提升 0.6% 至 8.9%。
Conclusion: SynSeg 是一种轻量级端到端方案，能实时推理，有效提升弱监督下语义分割的定位和判别能力。

papers.title: Calibrating Biophysical Models for Grape Phenology Prediction via Multi-Task Learning
papers.abstract_en: Accurate prediction of grape phenology is essential for timely vineyard management decisions, such as scheduling irrigation and fertilization, to maximize crop yield and quality. While traditional biophysical models calibrated on historical field data can be used for season-long predictions, they lack the precision required for fine-grained vineyard management. Deep learning methods are a compelling alternative but their performance is hindered by sparse phenology datasets, particularly at the cultivar level. We propose a hybrid modeling approach that combines multi-task learning with a recurrent neural network to parameterize a differentiable biophysical model. By using multi-task learning to predict the parameters of the biophysical model, our approach enables shared learning across cultivars while preserving biological structure, thereby improving the robustness and accuracy of predictions. Empirical evaluation using real-world and synthetic datasets demonstrates that our method significantly outperforms both conventional biophysical models and baseline deep learning approaches in predicting phenological stages, as well as other crop state variables such as cold-hardiness and wheat yield.

TL;DR: 本文提出一种混合建模方法，结合多任务学习与循环神经网络来参数化可微分的葡萄物候生物物理模型。通过多任务学习共享不同品种间的信息，同时保留生物物理结构，在海量稀疏数据下提升预测精度。在真实和合成数据集上，该方法在预测物候阶段、冷硬度和小麦产量等作物状态变量上显著优于传统生物物理模型和纯深度学习方法。
Motivation: 传统的生物物理模型校准后精度不足，而深度学习方法受限于稀疏的物候数据集（尤其品种级别），难以用于精细葡萄园管理。
Method: 提出混合框架：使用多任务学习联合预测生物物理模型的参数，并以循环神经网络实现参数化，使模型可微分且能跨品种共享学习。
Result: 在真实和合成数据集上，该方法在物候阶段预测、冷硬度和小麦产量等任务上显著优于传统生物物理模型和基线深度学习方法。
Conclusion: 多任务学习与可微生物物理模型的结合能有效利用有限数据提升预测鲁棒性和精度，但论文已被后续工作取代（见注释）。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Quenched large deviations for Monte Carlo integration with Coulomb gases
papers.abstract_en: Gibbs measures, such as Coulomb gases, are popular in modelling systems of interacting particles. Recently, we proposed to use Gibbs measures as randomized numerical integration algorithms with respect to a target measure $π$ on $\mathbb R^d$, following the heuristics that repulsiveness between particles should help reduce integration errors. A major issue in this approach is to tune the interaction kernel and confining potential of the Gibbs measure, so that the equilibrium measure of the system is the target distribution $π$. Doing so usually requires another Monte Carlo approximation of the \emph{potential}, i.e. the integral of the interaction kernel with respect to $π$. Using the methodology of large deviations from Garcia--Zelada (2019), we show that a random approximation of the potential preserves the fast large deviation principle that guarantees the proposed integration algorithm to outperform independent or Markov quadratures. For non-singular interaction kernels, we make minimal assumptions on this random approximation, which can be the result of a computationally cheap Monte Carlo preprocessing. For the Coulomb interaction kernel, we need the approximation to be based on another Gibbs measure, and we prove in passing a control on the uniform convergence of the approximation of the potential.
papers.comment: 40 pages. Accepted for publication in Bernoulli
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对使用Coulomb气体作为蒙特卡洛积分随机化算法时的势函数近似问题，证明了随机近似势函数保持快速大偏差原理，从而保证积分算法优于独立或马尔可夫求积法。对于非奇异核，近似成本低；对于Coulomb核，需基于另一Gibbs测度的近似，并证明了其一致收敛性。
Motivation: 利用排斥粒子系统（如Coulomb气体）可降低积分误差，但需调整Gibbs测度使平衡分布等于目标分布，这通常需要另一个蒙特卡洛近似势函数。本文旨在证明该近似不会破坏算法的快速大偏差性质。
Method: 采用Garcia-Zelada (2019)的大偏差方法，分析随机近似势函数下的淬火大偏差；对非奇异核做最小假设，对Coulomb核要求基于另一Gibbs测度的近似，并证明其一致收敛。
Result: 随机近似势函数保持快速大偏差原理，确保积分算法在渐近意义下优于独立或马尔可夫求积法，且对非奇异核的近似计算廉价。
Conclusion: 本文从理论上放宽了对势函数精确计算的要求，拓展了基于Coulomb气体的Monte Carlo积分算法的实用性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: SIDA: Synthetic Image Driven Zero-shot Domain Adaptation
papers.abstract_en: Zero-shot domain adaptation is a method for adapting a model to a target domain without utilizing target domain image data. To enable adaptation without target images, existing studies utilize CLIP's embedding space and text description to simulate target-like style features. Despite the previous achievements in zero-shot domain adaptation, we observe that these text-driven methods struggle to capture complex real-world variations and significantly increase adaptation time due to their alignment process. Instead of relying on text descriptions, we explore solutions leveraging image data, which provides diverse and more fine-grained style cues. In this work, we propose SIDA, a novel and efficient zero-shot domain adaptation method leveraging synthetic images. To generate synthetic images, we first create detailed, source-like images and apply image translation to reflect the style of the target domain. We then utilize the style features of these synthetic images as a proxy for the target domain. Based on these features, we introduce Domain Mix and Patch Style Transfer modules, which enable effective modeling of real-world variations. In particular, Domain Mix blends multiple styles to expand the intra-domain representations, and Patch Style Transfer assigns different styles to individual patches. We demonstrate the effectiveness of our method by showing state-of-the-art performance in diverse zero-shot adaptation scenarios, particularly in challenging domains. Moreover, our approach achieves high efficiency by significantly reducing the overall adaptation time.
papers.comment: Accepted to ACM MM 2025, Code : https://github.com/766O/SIDA
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种零样本领域适应方法 SIDA，利用合成图像而非文本描述来模拟目标域风格。通过生成源域风格的图像并应用图像迁移反映目标域风格，结合 Domain Mix 和 Patch Style Transfer 模块建模真实世界变化，在多个零样本适应场景中取得最先进性能，同时显著减少适应时间。
Motivation: 现有零样本领域适应方法依赖文本描述和 CLIP 嵌入，难以捕捉复杂真实世界变化且适应时间长。作者探索利用图像数据提供更丰富、细粒度的风格线索，以解决这些局限。
Method: 提出 SIDA，首先生成详细的源域类似图像，通过图像迁移反映目标域风格；然后利用合成图像的风格特征作为目标域代理；引入 Domain Mix 混合多种风格以扩展域内表示，以及 Patch Style Transfer 为不同图像块分配不同风格。
Result: 在多种零样本适应场景中达到最先进性能，尤其在具有挑战性的域上表现突出；同时显著降低了整体适应时间，实现高效率。
Conclusion: SIDA 通过合成图像驱动的零样本领域适应，有效克服了文本驱动方法的不足，在性能和效率上均取得优势。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: VLM-Guided Visual Place Recognition for Planet-Scale Geo-Localization
papers.abstract_en: Geo-localization from a single image at planet scale (essentially an advanced or extreme version of the kidnapped robot problem) is a fundamental and challenging task in applications such as navigation, autonomous driving and disaster response due to the vast diversity of locations, environmental conditions, and scene variations. Traditional retrieval-based methods for geo-localization struggle with scalability and perceptual aliasing, while classification-based approaches lack generalization and require extensive training data. Recent advances in vision-language models (VLMs) offer a promising alternative by leveraging contextual understanding and reasoning. However, while VLMs achieve high accuracy, they are often prone to hallucinations and lack interpretability, making them unreliable as standalone solutions. In this work, we propose a novel hybrid geo-localization framework that combines the strengths of VLMs with retrieval-based visual place recognition (VPR) methods. Our approach first leverages a VLM to generate a prior, effectively guiding and constraining the retrieval search space. We then employ a retrieval step, followed by a re-ranking mechanism that selects the most geographically plausible matches based on feature similarity and proximity to the initially estimated coordinates. We evaluate our approach on multiple geo-localization benchmarks and show that it consistently outperforms prior state-of-the-art methods, particularly at street (up to 4.51%) and city level (up to 13.52%). Our results demonstrate that VLM-generated geographic priors in combination with VPR lead to scalable, robust, and accurate geo-localization systems.
papers.journal_ref: Proceedings of the Australasian Conference on Robotics and Automation (ACRA 2025)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出一种混合地理定位框架，结合视觉语言模型（VLM）与基于检索的视觉位置识别（VPR）。先由VLM生成地理先验，约束检索空间，再经检索和重排序得到匹配。在多个基准上超越先前方法，街道级别提升达4.51%，城市级别提升达13.52%。
Motivation: 传统检索方法难扩展且存在感知混淆，分类方法缺乏泛化且需大量训练数据。VLM虽有高精度但易产生幻觉且缺乏可解释性。
Method: 混合框架：先使用VLM生成地理先验，引导和约束检索空间；然后执行检索步骤，再通过重排序机制基于特征相似性和与初始估计坐标的接近度选择最合理的地理位置匹配。
Result: 在多个地理定位基准上，街道级别提升高达4.51%，城市级别提升高达13.52%，持续超越先前最先进方法。
Conclusion: VLM生成的地理先验与VPR结合可构建可扩展、鲁棒且准确的地理定位系统。

papers.title: On the Effect of Uncertainty on Layer-wise Inference Dynamics
papers.abstract_en: Understanding how large language models (LLMs) internally represent and process their predictions is central to detecting uncertainty and preventing hallucinations. While several studies have shown that models encode uncertainty in their hidden states, it is underexplored how this affects the way they process such hidden states. In this work, we demonstrate that the dynamics of output token probabilities across layers for certain and uncertain outputs are largely aligned, revealing that uncertainty does not seem to affect inference dynamics. Specifically, we use the Tuned Lens, a variant of the Logit Lens, to analyze the layer-wise probability trajectories of final prediction tokens across 11 datasets and 5 models. Using incorrect predictions as those with higher epistemic uncertainty, our results show aligned trajectories for certain and uncertain predictions that both observe abrupt increases in confidence at similar layers. We balance this finding by showing evidence that more competent models may learn to process uncertainty differently. Our findings challenge the feasibility of leveraging simplistic methods for detecting uncertainty at inference. More broadly, our work demonstrates how interpretability methods may be used to investigate the way uncertainty affects inference.
papers.comment: Accepted to Actionable Interpretability Workshop - ICML 2025
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过Tuned Lens方法分析大语言模型（LLMs）在逐层推理中，确定性与不确定性输出（以错误预测代表高认知不确定性）的token概率轨迹，发现两者高度对齐，均在相似层出现置信度跃升，表明不确定性似乎不影响推理动态。
Motivation: 已有研究表明模型在隐藏状态中编码不确定性，但对不确定性如何影响隐藏状态处理过程的研究不足。
Method: 使用Tuned Lens（Logit Lens变体）分析11个数据集和5个模型上最终预测token的逐层概率轨迹，以错误预测作为高认知不确定性的代理。
Result: 确定性预测和不确定性预测的概率轨迹高度对齐，均在相似层出现置信度突然增加，但更优模型可能以不同方式处理不确定性。
Conclusion: 挑战了利用简单方法在推理时检测不确定性的可行性，展示了可解释性方法如何用于研究不确定性对推理的影响。

papers.title: DIVER: Reinforced Diffusion Breaks Imitation Bottlenecks in End-to-End Autonomous Driving
papers.abstract_en: Most end-to-end autonomous driving methods rely on imitation learning from single expert demonstrations, often leading to conservative and homogeneous behaviors that limit generalization in complex real-world scenarios. In this work, we propose DIVER, an end-to-end driving framework that integrates reinforcement learning with diffusion-based generation to produce diverse and feasible trajectories. At the core of DIVER lies a reinforced diffusion-based generation mechanism. First, the model conditions on map elements and surrounding agents to generate multiple reference trajectories from a single ground-truth trajectory, alleviating the limitations of imitation learning that arise from relying solely on single expert demonstrations. Second, reinforcement learning is employed to guide the diffusion process, where reward-based supervision enforces safety and diversity constraints on the generated trajectories, thereby enhancing their practicality and generalization capability. Furthermore, to address the limitations of L2-based open-loop metrics in capturing trajectory diversity, we propose a novel Diversity metric to evaluate the diversity of multi-mode predictions.Extensive experiments on the closed-loop NAVSIM and Bench2Drive benchmarks, as well as the open-loop nuScenes dataset, demonstrate that DIVER significantly improves trajectory diversity, effectively addressing the mode collapse problem inherent in imitation learning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出DIVER，一种端到端自动驾驶框架，融合强化学习与扩散生成以产生多样且可行的轨迹。核心是强化扩散机制：基于地图与周围智能体从单条真值轨迹生成多条参考轨迹，并通过强化学习的奖励指导扩散过程，施加安全性与多样性约束。还提出了新的多样性度量。在闭环NAVSIM、Bench2Drive和开环nuScenes数据集上，DIVER显著提升轨迹多样性，缓解了模仿学习的模式崩塌问题。
Motivation: 现有端到端自动驾驶方法依赖单专家示教的模仿学习，导致行为保守单一，泛化能力不足。
Method: 提出强化扩散生成机制：以地图和周围智能体为条件，从单条真值轨迹生成多条参考轨迹；利用强化学习（奖励）引导扩散过程，施加安全性与多样性约束。另外提出新的多样性度量评估多模态预测的多样性。
Result: 在闭环NAVSIM和Bench2Drive以及开环nuScenes数据集上，DIVER显著提升轨迹多样性，有效解决了模仿学习中的模式崩塌问题。
Conclusion: 论文强调强化扩散生成可突破模仿学习的瓶颈，生成多样可行轨迹，提升泛化能力。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: PRISON: Unmasking the Criminal Potential of Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: As large language models (LLMs) advance, concerns about their misconduct in complex social contexts intensify. Existing research overlooked the systematic understanding and assessment of their criminal capability in realistic interactions. We propose a unified framework PRISON, to quantify LLMs' criminal potential across five traits: False Statements, Frame-Up, Psychological Manipulation, Emotional Disguise, and Moral Disengagement. Using structured crime scenarios adapted from classic films grounded in reality, we evaluate both criminal potential and anti-crime ability of LLMs. Results show that state-of-the-art LLMs frequently exhibit emergent criminal tendencies, such as proposing misleading statements or evasion tactics, even without explicit instructions. Moreover, when placed in a detective role, models recognize deceptive behavior with only 44% accuracy on average, revealing a striking mismatch between conducting and detecting criminal behavior. These findings underscore the urgent need for adversarial robustness, behavioral alignment, and safety mechanisms before broader LLM deployment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出PRISON框架，系统量化大型语言模型在五项犯罪特质（虚假陈述、陷害、心理操纵、情感伪装、道德脱离）上的潜在能力。基于经典电影改编的现实犯罪场景评估，发现最先进的LLM在无明确指令下频繁表现出犯罪倾向，而作为侦探识别欺骗行为的平均准确率仅44%，揭示了犯罪能力与反犯罪能力之间的显著不匹配。
Motivation: 现有研究忽略了对LLMs在现实交互中犯罪能力的系统理解和评估，亟需统一框架来量化其犯罪潜力。
Method: 提出PRISON框架，通过五项特质刻画LLMs的犯罪潜力，并基于结构化犯罪场景（改编自现实题材电影）进行多维度评估。
Result: 前沿LLMs在无明确指令下表现出误导性陈述或规避策略等犯罪倾向；在侦探角色中识别欺骗行为的平均准确率仅为44%，表明犯罪与反犯罪能力存在显著差距。
Conclusion: 研究强调了在LLM广泛部署前，必须加强对抗鲁棒性、行为对齐和安全机制，以防范潜在的犯罪能力利用。

papers.title: Random Matrix Theory for Deep Learning: Beyond Eigenvalues of Linear Models
papers.abstract_en: Modern Machine Learning (ML) and Deep Neural Networks (DNNs) often operate on high-dimensional data and rely on overparameterized models, where classical low-dimensional intuitions break down. In particular, the proportional regime where the data dimension, sample size, and number of model parameters are all large and comparable, gives rise to novel and sometimes counterintuitive behaviors. This paper extends traditional Random Matrix Theory (RMT) beyond eigenvalue-based analysis of linear models to address the challenges posed by nonlinear ML models such as DNNs in this regime. We introduce the concept of High-dimensional Equivalent, which unifies and generalizes both Deterministic Equivalent and Linear Equivalent, to systematically address three technical challenges: high dimensionality, nonlinearity, and the need to analyze generic eigenspectral functionals. Leveraging this framework, we provide precise characterizations of the training and generalization performance of linear models, nonlinear shallow networks, and deep networks. Our results capture rich phenomena, including scaling laws, double descent, and nonlinear learning dynamics, offering a unified perspective on the theoretical understanding of deep learning in high dimensions.
papers.comment: 30 pages, 6 figures; extended technical report version of the IEEE SPM article, with appendices, minor corrections, and clarified derivations

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本论文将随机矩阵理论（RMT）从线性模型的特征值分析扩展至非线性深度神经网络（DNNs），在高维比例极限框架下建立统一的高维等价（High-dimensional Equivalent）理论。摘要表明该框架能够精确刻画线性模型、浅层网络和深度网络的训练与泛化行为，并解释尺度定律、双重下降等复杂现象。
Motivation: 经典低维直觉在高维过参数化深度学习场景中失效，需要超越特征值分析的理论工具来理解非线性DNN的行为。
Method: 提出高维等价概念，统一并推广了确定等价和线性等价，用于处理高维性、非线性和一般谱函数分析三大挑战。
Result: 提供对线性模型、非线性浅层网络和深度网络训练与泛化性能的精确表征，捕捉尺度定律、双重下降和非线性学习动力学等现象。
Conclusion: 该框架为高维深度学习的理论理解提供了统一视角。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: TreeLoRA: Efficient Continual Learning via Layer-Wise LoRAs Guided by a Hierarchical Gradient-Similarity Tree
papers.abstract_en: Many real-world applications collect data in a streaming environment, where learning tasks are encountered sequentially. This necessitates continual learning (CL) to update models online, enabling adaptation to new tasks while preserving past knowledge to prevent catastrophic forgetting. Nowadays, with the flourish of large pre-trained models (LPMs), efficiency has become increasingly critical for CL, due to their substantial computational demands and growing parameter sizes. In this paper, we introduce TreeLoRA (K-D Tree of Low-Rank Adapters), a novel approach that constructs layer-wise adapters by leveraging hierarchical gradient similarity to enable efficient CL, particularly for LPMs. To reduce the computational burden of task similarity estimation, we employ bandit techniques to develop an algorithm based on lower confidence bounds to efficiently explore the task structure. Furthermore, we use sparse gradient updates to facilitate parameter optimization, making the approach better suited for LPMs. Theoretical analysis is provided to justify the rationale behind our approach, and experiments on both vision transformers (ViTs) and large language models (LLMs) demonstrate the effectiveness and efficiency of our approach across various domains, including vision and natural language processing tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 TreeLoRA，一种基于分层梯度相似性树的高效持续学习方法，通过构造层级的低秩适配器（LoRA）并利用 bandit 算法估计任务结构，结合稀疏梯度更新，适用于大型预训练模型。在视觉变换器和大语言模型上的实验验证了其有效性和效率。
Motivation: 现有持续学习方法在处理大规模预训练模型时面临计算成本高和参数规模大的挑战，需要一种高效且能避免灾难性遗忘的方法。
Method: 提出 TreeLoRA，使用 K-D 树结构组织低秩适配器，基于分层梯度相似性引导适配器的构建；采用 bandit 技术中的下置信界算法高效探索任务结构；并采用稀疏梯度更新优化参数。
Result: 在视觉变换器和大语言模型上的实验表明，TreeLoRA 在多个视觉和自然语言处理任务中表现高效且有效。
Conclusion: TreeLoRA 提供了一种针对大型预训练模型的高效持续学习方案，理论分析与实验支持其合理性。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: SIGNER: Temporally Grounded Sign Language Generation via Time-Resolved Conditioning
papers.abstract_en: Sign language generation (SLG), also known as text-to-sign generation, aims to bridge the communication gap between signers and non-signers. Unlike many other generative tasks, SLG must satisfy two fundamental linguistic constraints. First, sign language expresses meaning through a sequence of gestures aligned with word-like units called glosses, and therefore requires correct lexical ordering to preserve intended meaning. Second, each gesture should faithfully reflect the intended gloss (semantic accuracy). Despite recent progress, existing SLG methods frequently produce signs with incorrect lexical order and low semantic accuracy. A common limitation of prior approaches stems from globally fused conditioning strategies, which weaken temporal grounding, the temporal correspondence between glosses and their realized sign segments. This often leads to incorrect lexical order and semantically ambiguous signs. To address this limitation, we propose SIGNER, a SIGN language generation framework with timE-Resolved conditioning to ensure temporal grounding, leveraging a temporal-gloss condition and local temporal fusion (LTF). SIGNER constructs a temporal-gloss condition by estimating a gloss sequence and its durations from input text, and assigning gloss semantics across the temporal dimension. We then introduce LTF, a temporally grounded fusion module that integrates the temporal-gloss condition within a constrained temporal window during denoising. By enforcing temporal locality in condition fusion, LTF preserves temporal grounding, leading to correct lexical ordering and clearer per-gloss semantics. Experiments on Phoenix-2014T and CSL-Daily demonstrate state-of-the-art performance, further supported by motion-smoothness analysis. The project page is available here https://taeryunglee.github.io/projects/signer.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对手语生成中词汇顺序错误和语义准确性低的问题，提出SIGNER框架，通过时间解析的条件（temporal-gloss condition）和局部时间融合（LTF）确保时序对应关系。在Phoenix-2014T和CSL-Daily数据集上取得最优性能。
Motivation: 现有手语生成方法因全局融合策略削弱了时序基础，导致生成的符号序列词汇顺序错误且语义模糊。
Method: 提出SIGNER，包含时间-手势条件估计（从文本估计手势序列及其持续时间）和局部时间融合模块（在去噪过程中约束条件融合的时域窗口）。
Result: 在Phoenix-2014T和CSL-Daily上达到当前最优，并进行了运动平滑性分析支持。
Conclusion: 通过在条件融合中强制时域局部性，SIGNER保持了时序基础，实现了正确的词汇顺序和更清晰的手势语义。

papers.title: Agentic Episodic Control
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning (RL) remains fundamentally limited by poor data efficiency and weak generalization. Prior episodic RL methods attempt to alleviate this via external memory modules, yet they suffer from two key limitations: a representation bottleneck caused by shallow encoders, and a retrieval dilemma where episodic memory is accessed indiscriminately. To address these challenges, we propose Agentic Episodic Control (AEC), a novel architecture that integrates large language models (LLMs) into episodic RL. AEC uses an LLM-based semantic augmenter to generate semantic representations from raw observations, and a critical state recognizer to selectively retrieve valuable experiences. This transforms memory usage from passive similarity matching into strategic, context-aware recall. Across five BabyAI-Text environments, AEC achieves 2-6x higher data efficiency than baselines and is the only method to solve complex tasks like UnlockLocal with over 90% success. It further demonstrates strong cross-task and cross-environment generalization, maintaining performance even under distribution shifts. AEC shows that combining LLM-derived priors with reinforcement learning yields more sample-efficient and adaptable agents.
papers.comment: Accepted to Findings of the 64th Annual Meeting of the Association for Computational Linguistics (ACL 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Agentic Episodic Control (AEC)，将大语言模型 (LLM) 集成到情节强化学习中。AEC 使用 LLM 作为语义增强器从原始观测生成语义表示，并用关键状态识别器选择性检索有价值的经验，将记忆从被动相似匹配转变为策略性上下文感知召回。在五个 BabyAI-Text 环境中，AEC 的数据效率比基线高 2-6 倍，是唯一能解决 UnlockLocal 等复杂任务且成功率超过 90% 的方法，并展现出强跨任务和跨环境泛化能力。
Motivation: 现有情节强化学习方法受限于浅层编码器导致的表示瓶颈，以及无差别检索情节记忆的检索困境，导致数据效率低、泛化能力弱。
Method: 提出 AEC 架构，包含两个关键组件：基于 LLM 的语义增强器，用于将原始观测转化为语义表示；以及关键状态识别器，用于选择性检索有价值的经验，从而将记忆访问从被动相似匹配转变为策略性上下文感知召回。
Result: 在五个 BabyAI-Text 环境中，AEC 的数据效率比基线方法提升 2-6 倍，是唯一在复杂任务 UnlockLocal 上达到超过 90% 成功率的方法，且在跨任务和跨环境分布偏移下仍保持良好的性能。
Conclusion: AEC 表明，将 LLM 提供的先验知识与强化学习相结合，可以产生更样本高效和适应性更强的智能体。

papers.title: Seven Security Challenges That Must be Solved in Cross-domain Multi-agent LLM Systems
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are rapidly evolving into autonomous agents that cooperate across organizational boundaries, enabling joint disaster response, supply-chain optimization, and other tasks that demand decentralized expertise without surrendering data ownership. Yet, cross-domain collaboration shatters the unified trust assumptions behind current alignment and containment techniques. An agent benign in isolation may, when receiving messages from an untrusted peer, leak secrets or violate policy, producing risks driven by emergent multi-agent dynamics rather than classical software bugs. This position paper maps the security agenda for cross-domain multi-agent LLM systems. We introduce seven categories of novel security challenges, for each of which we also present plausible attacks, security evaluation metrics, and future research guidelines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文指出跨域多智能体LLM系统因打破统一信任假设而面临全新的安全挑战，并系统性地提出了七类安全挑战，包括具体攻击场景、评估指标和未来研究方向。
Motivation: 现有LLM对齐和隔离技术假设统一信任域，但跨组织协作中智能体可能因接收不可信消息而泄露秘密或违反策略，产生由紧急多智能体动态驱动的风险，而非传统软件漏洞。
Method: 作为立场论文，本文通过分析跨域多智能体系统的独特安全风险，归纳出七类新型安全挑战，并为每类挑战给出了潜在攻击示例、安全评估指标和未来研究指南。
Result: 论文未提供实验或量化结果，而是提出了一个研究议程，包括七类安全挑战及每类的攻击、评估和指南。
Conclusion: 跨域多智能体LLM系统的安全需要全新的思考框架，现有方法不足以应对这些由多智能体动态涌现的风险。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Temporal Convolutional Autoencoder for Interference Mitigation in FMCW Radar Altimeters
papers.abstract_en: Reliable altitude estimation with frequency-modulated continuous wave (FMCW) radar altimeters is increasingly a challenge due to in-band interference from modern communication systems. In this paper, we present a temporal convolutional autoencoder (TCAE) that directly processes in-phase and quadrature (IQ) samples to suppress structured interference while preserving signal phase and frequency content for range estimation. The model is trained and initially evaluated within a full radar altimeter simulation chain, then further validated via over-the-air (OTA) experiments using a universal software radio peripheral (USRP)-based testbed. Results show that the TCAE reduces altitude estimation error by more than 85% compared to least mean squares (LMS) adaptive filtering under severe interference conditions, including low signal-to-interference-plus-noise ratio (SINR) and full temporal overlap between interfering and radar signals. Unlike conventional methods, the TCAE maintains phase fidelity and beat structure, enabling accurate range estimation even when interferers occupy more than one-quarter of the radar bandwidth. The implemented TCAE performs mitigation directly on fixed-length IQ windows using a single feed-forward pass and was integrated into the MATLAB/ONNX-based evaluation chain used for both simulation and OTA testing. These findings demonstrate that learned IQ-domain interference mitigation can enhance radar-altimeter resilience under a range of tested interference conditions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种时间卷积自编码器（TCAE），直接处理FMCW雷达高度计的IQ样本以抑制带内干扰，同时保留信号相位和频率信息用于距离估计。在仿真和外场实验中，相比最小均方（LMS）自适应滤波，高度估计误差降低超过85%，且能在干扰占用超过四分之一雷达带宽时保持相位保真度和拍频结构。
Motivation: FMCW雷达高度计因现代通信系统的带内干扰导致高度估计不可靠，传统方法（如LMS）在严重干扰条件下性能急剧下降。
Method: 提出时间卷积自编码器（TCAE），通过单次前向传播直接处理固定长度的IQ样本窗口，在时域学习干扰抑制，无需迭代过程。模型在完整雷达高度计仿真链中训练，并经USRP外场实验验证。
Result: 在低信干噪比（SINR）和干扰信号与雷达信号完全时间重叠等严重干扰条件下，TCAE将高度估计误差降低超过85%，优于LMS自适应滤波；即使干扰占用超过四分之一雷达带宽，仍能保持相位保真度与拍频结构。
Conclusion: 学习型IQ域干扰抑制方法（TCAE）能够显著提升FMCW雷达高度计在多种干扰条件下的鲁棒性，且可通过固定长度窗口进行高效前向推理。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: StableMotion: One-Step Motion Estimation with Diffusion Prior
papers.abstract_en: We present StableMotion, a novel framework that leverages geometric and content priors from pretrained large-scale image diffusion models for motion estimation in single-image rectification tasks such as Stitched Image Rectangling (SIR) and Rolling Shutter Correction (RSC). Specifically, StableMotion takes a text-to-image Stable Diffusion (SD) model as its backbone and repurposes it as an image-to-motion estimator. To mitigate inconsistent outputs produced by diffusion models, we propose Adaptive Ensemble Strategy (AES), which consolidates multiple outputs into a cohesive, high-fidelity result. Additionally, we present Sampling Steps Disaster (SSD), a counterintuitive phenomenon in which increasing the number of sampling steps can lead to poorer outcomes, motivating our one-step inference design. StableMotion is evaluated on two image rectification tasks and delivers state-of-the-art performance on both, while also showing promising transferability through qualitative examples and no-reference evaluations on unseen SIR-OOD and real-captured RSC benchmarks. Supported by SSD, StableMotion achieves efficient one-step inference, offering over 100$\times$ speedup compared to previous diffusion model-based methods even when combined with the optional AES post-processing. Code and weights are available at https://github.com/ivowang/StableMotion.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: StableMotion 利用预训练大规模图像扩散模型（Stable Diffusion）中的几何和内容先验，用于单图像校正任务（拼接图像矩形化 SIR 和滚动快门校正 RSC）。它通过自适应集成策略（AES）解决扩散模型输出不一致问题，并发现采样步骤灾难（SSD）现象——增加采样步数反而导致更差结果，从而采用一步推理。在两项任务上达到最先进性能，相比先前基于扩散模型的方法实现超过100倍加速。
Motivation: 现有扩散模型用于运动估计时存在输出不一致和采样效率低的问题，且增加采样步数可能损害性能。
Method: 以文本到图像的 Stable Diffusion 为骨干，将其改造为图像到运动估计器；提出 Adaptive Ensemble Strategy (AES) 融合多输出；基于 Sampling Steps Disaster (SSD) 现象设计一步推理。
Result: 在 SIR 和 RSC 任务上达到最先进性能，一步推理相比先前扩散方法加速超100倍，并在未见数据集上展示可迁移性。
Conclusion: 利用扩散先验实现高效单步运动估计，SSD 现象支持简化推理步骤，代码和权重已开源。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Web2Grasp: Learning Functional Grasps from Web Images of Hand-Object Interactions
papers.abstract_en: Functional grasping is essential for enabling dexterous multi-finger robot hands to manipulate objects effectively. Prior work largely focuses on power grasps, which only involve holding an object, or relies on in-domain demonstrations for specific objects. We propose leveraging human grasp information extracted from web images, which capture natural and functional hand-object interactions (HOI). Using a pretrained 3D reconstruction model, we recover 3D human HOI meshes from RGB images. To train on these noisy HOI data, we propose to use: (1) an interaction-centric model to learn the functional interaction pattern between hand and object, and (2) geometry-based filtering to remove the infeasible grasps and physical simulation to retain grasps who can resist disturbance. In IssacGym simulation, our model trained on reconstructed HOI grasps achieves a 75.8% success rate on objects from the web dataset and generalizes to unseen objects, outperforming baseline methods in both grasp success and functional quality. In real-world experiments with the LEAP hand and Inspire hand, it attains a 77.5% success rate across 12 objects, including challenging ones such as a syringe, spray bottle, knife, and tongs. Project website is at: https://web2grasp.github.io/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Web2Grasp方法，利用网络图像中的人手-物体交互（HOI）恢复3D网格，并训练功能性抓取模型。通过交互中心模型和几何过滤及物理仿真，在仿真和真实机器人手上取得高成功率。
Motivation: 现有功能性抓取工作多依赖特定领域演示或仅关注强力抓取，缺乏从自然交互中学习的方法。
Method: 使用预训练3D重建模型从RGB图像恢复3D HOI网格，提出交互中心模型学习功能性交互模式，结合几何过滤去除不可行抓取，并用物理仿真筛选抗干扰抓取。
Result: 在IssacGym仿真中，对网络数据集物体达到75.8%成功率，泛化到未见物体；在LEAP手和Inspire手上真实实验12个物体（包括注射器、喷瓶、刀、钳子等）达到77.5%成功率。
Conclusion: 证明了从网络图像中学习功能性抓取的可行性，方法可泛化到新物体和不同机器人手。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: DMind Benchmark: Toward a Holistic Assessment of LLM Capabilities across the Web3 Domain
papers.abstract_en: The Web3 ecosystem, underpinned by cryptographic primitives and decentralized consensus, represents a high-stakes environment where software vulnerabilities and incentive misalignments translate directly into financial loss. As Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly integrated into this domain for tasks ranging from smart contract auditing to decentralized finance analytics, ensuring their reliability is paramount. However, general-purpose benchmarks fail to capture the specialized reasoning required for these adversarial and protocol-driven settings. To bridge this gap, we introduce DMind Benchmark, a comprehensive evaluation suite designed to rigorously assess LLM proficiency across the Web3 stack. DMind Benchmark encompasses nine distinct subdomains (spanning infrastructure, smart contracts, token economics, etc.) and combines objective knowledge retrieval with complex open-ended reasoning tasks that emulate real-world operational challenges. We conduct an extensive evaluation of 31 leading proprietary and open-weights models, employing a contamination-aware pipeline and verifying the statistical robustness of our scoring protocol through rigorous cross-judge consistency checks. Our analysis reveals a critical dichotomy: while models demonstrate competence in foundational infrastructure concepts, they exhibit significant vulnerabilities in high-reasoning tasks such as security auditing. Furthermore, we provide a Pareto analysis to guide cost-effective deployment and demonstrate through adversarial experiments that high performance on DMind Benchmark necessitates genuine reasoning rather than superficial memorization. Since its open-source release in April 2025, DMind Benchmark achieved the #1 trending position on Hugging Face for nearly a week and accumulated over 13k downloads by June 2026, establishing itself as a standard for advancing secure and trustworthy AI in Web3.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DMind Benchmark是一个针对Web3领域的大型语言模型（LLM）评估套件，涵盖基础设施、智能合约、代币经济学等9个子领域，结合客观知识检索与开放推理任务。对31个领先模型进行评估，发现模型在基础设施概念上表现尚可，但在安全审计等高推理任务中存在显著脆弱性。通过帕累托分析指导成本效益部署，对抗实验证明高性能需要真实推理而非表面记忆。该基准自2025年4月开源后曾在Hugging Face上排名第一，截至2026年6月累计下载超13000次。
Motivation: Web3环境的高风险特性要求LLM具备专门推理能力，但通用基准无法捕捉这些需求。
Method: 提出了包含9个子领域和两类任务（客观知识检索与复杂开放推理）的评估套件，采用污染感知流水线和跨裁判一致性检查确保统计稳健性。
Result: 在31个模型上评估，发现模型在基础设施概念上表现良好，但在安全审计等高推理任务中脆弱。帕累托分析指导成本效益部署，对抗实验证明高性能需要真实推理。
Conclusion: DMind Benchmark可作为推动Web3中安全可信AI的标准，但摘要未明确讨论局限性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Efficient and Stable Multi-Dimensional Kolmogorov-Smirnov Distance
papers.abstract_en: We revisit extending the Kolmogorov-Smirnov distance between probability distributions to the multi-dimensional setting, and make new arguments about the proper way to approach this generalization. Our proposed formulation maximizes the difference over orthogonal dominating rectangular ranges (d-sided rectangles in R^d), and is an integral probability metric. We also prove that the distance between a distribution and a sample from the distribution converges to 0 as the sample size grows, and bound this rate. Moreover, we show that one can, up to this same approximation error, compute the distance efficiently in 4 or fewer dimensions; specifically, the runtime is near-linear in the size of the sample needed for that error. With this, we derive a delta-precision two-sample hypothesis test using this distance. Finally, we show these metrics and approximation properties do not hold for other popular variants.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文重新审视了将Kolmogorov-Smirnov距离扩展到多维设置的问题，提出了一种基于正交支配矩形范围（R^d中的d维矩形）的公式，并验证其作为积分概率度量的性质。作者证明了分布与样本之间的距离随样本量增大收敛到0，并给出了收敛速率；同时指出在4维及以下可以高效计算该距离（运行时接近线性于所需样本量），并由此构建了一个δ-精度两样本假设检验。此外，还证明了其他流行变体不具备这些度量和近似性质。
Motivation: 现有的多维KS距离扩展缺乏一致的理论保证和高效计算方案，许多变体不满足积分概率度量的性质，且在高维下难以计算。本文旨在提出一种理论上合理且实际可计算的多维KS距离。
Method: 提出在正交支配矩形范围上最大化分布差异的KS距离推广，将其定义为积分概率度量；证明从分布到样本的收敛性和收敛速率；设计算法使得在4维及以下能以近线性时间计算该距离，并基于此推导δ-精度两样本假设检验。
Result: 摘要指出该距离在4维及以下可高效计算（运行时近线性于所需样本量），且分布与样本之间的距离随样本量增长以有界速率收敛到0。同时，其他流行变体不具备这些性质。
Conclusion: 该工作为一个理论上合理且计算可行的多维KS距离提供了完整框架，尤其适用于低维（≤4）分布比较与两样本检验。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: CO-DEFEND: Continuous Decentralized Federated Learning for Secure DoH-Based Threat Detection
papers.abstract_en: The use of DNS over HTTPS (DoH) tunneling by an attacker to hide malicious activity within encrypted DNS traffic poses a serious threat to network security, as it allows malicious actors to bypass traditional monitoring and intrusion detection systems while evading detection by conventional traffic analysis techniques. ML techniques can be used to detect DoH tunnels; however, their effectiveness relies on large datasets containing both benign and malicious traffic. Sharing such datasets across entities is challenging due to privacy concerns. In this work, we propose CO-DEFEND framework that enables multiple entities to collaboratively train a classification machine learning model for DoH threat detection while preserving data privacy, enhancing scalability and resilience against single points of failure. The proposed DFL framework provides a realistic implementation for DoH threat detection, enabling multiple entities to train their local models online with incoming DoH flows in real-time batches as they are processed - an approach that fits naturally within modern Internet architectures. This framework adapts four classical machine learning algorithms, Support Vector Machines, Logistic Regression, Decision Trees, and Random Forest, for federated scenarios and efficient training. In addition, a key methodological feature of CO-DEFEND is the use of DT and RF as model selection rather than aggregation mechanisms, allowing each participant to retain interpretable and locally optimal decision structures while benefiting from collective updates. We compare our proposed method by using the dataset CIRA-CIC-DoHBrw-2020 with existing machine learning approaches, including more computationally complex alternatives such as neural networks, to demonstrate its effectiveness in detecting malicious DoH tunnels while improving scalability and computational efficiency.
papers.journal_ref: Computer Networks, Volume 276 (2026) 111961
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出CO-DEFEND，一种用于安全检测DNS over HTTPS（DoH）隧道的去中心化联邦学习框架。该框架允许多个实体协同训练机器学习模型，同时保护数据隐私。方法基于支持向量机、逻辑回归、决策树和随机森林等经典算法，并利用决策树和随机森林作为模型选择而非聚合机制。在CIRA-CIC-DoHBrw-2020数据集上验证了有效性，显示出比神经网络等复杂方法更好的可扩展性和计算效率。
Motivation: DoH隧道可使攻击者将恶意活动隐藏在加密DNS流量中，绕过传统监控和入侵检测系统。基于ML的检测需要大量数据集，但跨实体共享数据存在隐私问题。现有联邦学习解决方案缺乏针对DoH威胁检测的实时在线训练和抗单点故障能力。
Method: 提出CO-DEFEND去中心化联邦学习框架，支持多个实体在实时处理DoH流时在线训练本地模型。适配四种经典ML算法（SVM、LR、DT、RF）用于联邦场景，并创新地使用DT和RF作为模型选择机制而非聚合，使参与者保留可解释的局部最优决策结构，同时从集体更新中受益。
Result: 在CIRA-CIC-DoHBrw-2020数据集上的实验表明，CO-DEFEND在检测恶意DoH隧道方面有效，同时提高了可扩展性和计算效率，优于包括神经网络在内的更复杂替代方法。
Conclusion: 本文提出了一个实用的去中心化联邦学习框架用于DoH威胁检测，具有隐私保护、可扩展性和抗单点故障特性，特别适合现代互联网架构。使用决策树和随机森林作为模型选择机制是其主要方法论创新。

papers.title: Fine-Grained Behavior and Lane Constraints Guided Trajectory Prediction Method
papers.abstract_en: Trajectory prediction, as a critical component of autonomous driving systems, has attracted the attention of many researchers. Existing prediction algorithms focus on extracting more detailed scene features or selecting more reasonable trajectory destinations. However, in the face of dynamic and evolving future movements of the target vehicle, these algorithms cannot provide a fine-grained and continuous description of future behaviors and lane constraints, which degrades the prediction accuracy. To address this challenge, we present BLNet, a novel dualstream architecture that synergistically integrates behavioral intention recognition and lane constraint modeling through parallel attention mechanisms. The framework generates fine-grained behavior state queries (capturing spatial-temporal movement patterns) and lane queries (encoding lane topology constraints), supervised by two auxiliary losses, respectively. Subsequently, a two-stage decoder first produces trajectory proposals, then performs point-level refinement by jointly incorporating both the continuity of passed lanes and future motion features. Extensive experiments on two large datasets, nuScenes and Argoverse, show that our network exhibits significant performance gains over existing direct regression and goal-based algorithms.
papers.comment: This work has been submitted to the IEEE for possible publication
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出BLNet，一种双流架构，通过并行注意力机制融合行为意图识别和车道约束建模，用于自动驾驶轨迹预测。在nuScenes和Argoverse数据集上，该方法相比直接回归和基于目标的算法取得了显著性能提升。
Motivation: 现有预测算法无法为目标车辆的未来运动提供细粒度且连续的行为和车道约束描述，导致预测精度下降。
Method: BLNet采用双流架构，通过并行注意力机制生成细粒度行为状态查询（捕捉时空运动模式）和车道查询（编码车道拓扑约束），并辅以两个辅助损失监督。随后，两阶段解码器先产生轨迹提案，再结合通过的连续车道和未来运动特征进行点级细化。
Result: 在nuScenes和Argoverse两个大规模数据集上，BLNet相比直接回归和基于目标的算法表现出显著的性能提升。
Conclusion: 论文强调通过细粒度行为状态和车道约束的联合建模，可以有效提升轨迹预测的准确性。

papers.title: Permutation Learning with Only N Parameters: From SoftSort to Self-Organizing Gaussians
papers.abstract_en: Sorting and permutation learning are key concepts in optimization and machine learning, especially when organizing high-dimensional data into meaningful spatial layouts. The Gumbel-Sinkhorn method, while effective, requires N*N parameters to determine a full permutation matrix, making it computationally expensive for large datasets. Low-rank matrix factorization approximations reduce memory requirements to 2NM (with M << N), but they still struggle with very large problems. SoftSort, by providing a continuous relaxation of the argsort operator, allows differentiable 1D sorting, but it faces challenges with multidimensional data and complex permutations. In this paper, we present a novel method for learning permutations using only N parameters, which dramatically reduces storage costs. Our method extends SoftSort by iteratively shuffling the N indices of the elements and applying a few SoftSort optimization steps per iteration. This modification significantly improves sorting quality, especially for multidimensional data and complex optimization criteria, and outperforms pure SoftSort. Our method offers improved memory efficiency and scalability compared to existing approaches, while maintaining high-quality permutation learning. Its dramatically reduced memory requirements make it particularly well-suited for large-scale optimization tasks, such as "Self-Organizing Gaussians", where efficient and scalable permutation learning is critical.
papers.journal_ref: EUSIPCO 2025
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种仅需N个参数即可学习排列的方法，通过迭代混洗元素索引并应用少量SoftSort优化步骤，显著降低存储成本，适用于大规模优化任务如“自组织高斯”。该方法在多维数据和复杂排列上优于纯SoftSort，内存效率更高。
Motivation: 现有排列学习方法（如Gumbel-Sinkhorn）需要N²参数，低秩分解虽降低至2NM但仍不足以应对极大规模问题。
Method: 扩展SoftSort，通过迭代混洗N个元素索引并执行少量SoftSort优化步骤，实现仅N参数的排列学习。
Result: 摘要报告该方法在多维数据和复杂优化准则上的排序质量显著提升，优于纯SoftSort，且内存需求大幅降低。
Conclusion: 该方法具有极低内存需求，适用于如“自组织高斯”等大规模优化任务，强调可扩展性和效率。

papers.title: ReFreeKV: Towards Threshold-Free KV Cache Compression
papers.abstract_en: To reduce memory consumption during LLM inference, a handful of methods have been proposed for KV cache pruning. While these techniques can accomplish lossless memory reduction on many datasets, they often hinge on an under-emphasized condition: an input/domain-specific threshold for KV cache budget needs to be pre-determined to achieve the optimal performance. However, such input-sensitive design may be considerably limited in real-world scenarios, as open-domain inputs span diverse domains, lengths and difficulty levels, without clear boundaries for threshold selection. As a result, the dependence of such input-sensitive threshold can be a fundamental limitation that causes large degradation on arbitrary inputs. In this work, we propose a new objective that lifts the threshold constraints for robust KV compression, advocating for "threshold-free" methods that adaptively adjust budget allocation while preserving full-cache performance. We then propose a novel method, ReFreeKV, serving as the first instantiation of this objective. Extensive experiments across 13 datasets with diverse context lengths, task types, and model sizes demonstrate its efficacy and efficiency. Our code is publicly released at https://github.com/Patrick-Ni/ReFreeKV.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出ReFreeKV，一种免阈值的KV缓存压缩方法，旨在消除传统方法对输入/领域特定阈值的依赖，在保持全缓存性能的同时自适应调整预算分配。在13个数据集上的实验验证了其有效性和效率。
Motivation: 现有KV缓存剪枝方法通常需要预先设定输入/领域特定的阈值才能达到最优性能，这在开放域场景中难以实现，因为输入长度、领域和难度差异大，阈值选择困难。
Method: 提出免阈值压缩目标，并实现ReFreeKV作为首个实例化方法，自适应调整KV缓存预算分配而不依赖硬阈值。
Result: 在13个覆盖不同上下文长度、任务类型和模型规模的数据集上，ReFreeKV实现了与全缓存相当的性能，同时降低了内存消耗。
Conclusion: 免阈值设计使KV缓存压缩更鲁棒，适用于开放域输入，但方法的具体性能边界和局限性未在摘要中详述。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: The Minimal Search Space for Conditional Causal Bandits
papers.abstract_en: Causal knowledge can be used to support decision-making problems. This has been recognized in the causal bandits literature, where a causal (multi-armed) bandit is characterized by a causal graphical model and a target variable. The arms are then interventions on the causal model, and rewards are samples of the target variable. Causal bandits were originally studied with a focus on hard interventions. We focus instead on cases where the arms are conditional interventions, which more accurately model many real-world decision-making problems by allowing the value of the intervened variable to be chosen based on the observed values of other variables. This paper presents a graphical characterization of the minimal set of nodes guaranteed to contain the optimal conditional intervention, which maximizes the expected reward. We then propose an efficient algorithm with a time complexity of $O(|V| + |E|)$ to identify this minimal set of nodes. We prove that the graphical characterization and the proposed algorithm are correct. Finally, we empirically demonstrate that our algorithm significantly prunes the search space and substantially accelerates convergence rates when integrated into standard multi-armed bandit algorithms.
papers.comment: In the Proceedings of the 42nd Conference on Uncertainty in Artificial Intelligence (UAI 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究条件因果bandit问题，其中臂（arms）为条件干预（conditional interventions），目标是最大化期望奖励。作者给出了包含最优条件干预的最小节点集的图论刻画，并提出了一个时间复杂度为O(|V|+|E|)的算法来识别该最小集，理论证明了正确性，实验表明该算法能显著剪枝搜索空间并加速标准多臂bandit算法的收敛。
Motivation: 现有因果bandit文献主要关注硬干预（hard interventions），但许多实际决策问题要求条件干预（即根据观测值选择干预值）。需要找到保证包含最优条件干预的最小节点集，以缩小搜索空间。
Method: 提出一种图论刻画方法，定义最小搜索空间，并设计一个基于图的线性时间算法（O(|V|+|E|)）来识别该节点集。
Result: 实验表明，所提算法能显著剪枝搜索空间（具体未量化），并加速标准多臂bandit算法的收敛速度。
Conclusion: 本文给出的最小搜索空间的图论刻画和高效算法可应用于条件因果bandit问题，提升决策效率。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Supervised Quadratic Feature Analysis: Information Geometry Approach for Dimensionality Reduction
papers.abstract_en: Supervised dimensionality reduction maps labeled data into a low-dimensional feature space while preserving class separation. A common strategy is to learn features that maximize a measure of statistical dissimilarity between the class-conditional probability distributions. Information geometry, which is rooted in Riemannian geometry, provides an alternative framework for measuring class dissimilarity. It treats probability distributions as points in a statistical manifold and uses the Fisher information metric to define a geodesic distance--the Fisher-Rao distance--between distributions The Fisher-Rao distance is an appealing candidate for measuring class separation because the Fisher information metric is a local measure of discriminability, and because it allows a geometric interpretation. Here, we present Supervised Quadratic Feature Analysis (SQFA), a supervised dimensionality reduction method which learns linear features that maximize Fisher-Rao distances between class-conditional distributions, under Gaussian assumptions. In multiple real world datasets, we find that SQFA features support classification accuracy that is competitive with features that maximize more popular measures of dissimilarity, or that are learned by other state-of-the-art dimensionality reduction methods. Notably, the best classification accuracy is achieved by SQFA-H features, a variant of SQFA that maximizes the Hellinger distance, a rarely used objective for dimensionality reduction. These results demonstrate the potential of information geometry as a tool for supervised dimensionality reduction. We provide a Python implementation of SQFA at https://github.com/dherrera1911/sqfa.
papers.journal_ref: Transactions on Machine Learning Research (2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出监督二次特征分析（SQFA），一种基于信息几何的监督降维方法，通过最大化类条件分布之间的Fisher-Rao距离来学习线性特征。在多个真实数据集上，SQFA特征在分类准确率上表现有竞争力，其中SQFA-H变体（最大化Hellinger距离）取得最佳结果。
Motivation: 现有监督降维方法通常最大化统计差异度量，而信息几何提供了另一种度量类间差异的框架，Fisher-Rao距离具有局部可辨别性和几何解释，但尚未被充分探索。
Method: 提出SQFA方法，在高斯假设下学习线性特征以最大化类条件分布之间的Fisher-Rao距离。还提出SQFA-H变体最大化Hellinger距离。
Result: 在多个真实数据集上，SQFA特征支持与其它流行方法和SOTA降维方法竞争的分类准确率；SQFA-H取得最佳准确率。
Conclusion: 证明了信息几何作为监督降维工具的潜力；提供了Python实现。

papers.title: Image-based Geo-localization for Robotics: Are Black-box Vision-Language Models there yet?
papers.abstract_en: The advances in Vision-Language models (VLMs) offer exciting opportunities for robotic applications involving image geo-localization - the problem of identifying the geo-coordinates of a place based on visual data only. In robotics, such capabilities are particularly relevant to the global re-localization stage of the kidnapped robot problem, where a robot must recover its pose without prior knowledge of its location. Recent work has focused on using a VLM as embedding extractor for geo-localization. However, the most sophisticated VLMs may only be available as black boxes that are accessible through an API, and come with a number of limitations: there is no access to training data, model features and gradients; retraining is not possible; and the number of predictions may be limited by the API. The potential of state-of-the-art VLMs as a stand-alone, zero-shot geo-localization systems at planet scale using a single text-based prompt is largely unexplored. To bridge this gap, this paper undertakes the first systematic study, to the best of our knowledge, to investigate state-of-the-art generative VLMs as stand-alone, zero-shot geo-localization systems in a black-box setting with realistic constraints. We consider three main scenarios for this thorough investigation: a) fixed text-based prompt; b) semantically-equivalent text-based prompts; and c) semantically-equivalent query images. Beyond standard accuracy, we introduce model consistency as a metric to account for the auto-regressive and probabilistic nature of generative VLMs. Our findings reveal that while VLMs demonstrate strong coarse-level localization and navigation priors, fine-grained localization degrades significantly under realistic variations, highlighting reliability challenges for deploying generative VLMs in robust, open-world robotic navigation systems.
papers.comment: Accepted to the ICRA 2026 Workshop on Multi-Modal Spatial AI for Robust Navigation and Open-World Understanding (MM-SpatialAI)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文首次系统性地研究了黑盒（black-box）生成式视觉语言模型（VLM）作为独立零样本（zero-shot）图像地理定位系统在机器人应用中的表现。在API访问限制（无法训练、获取特征或梯度）下，考虑了固定文本提示、语义等价文本提示和语义等价查询图像三种场景，并提出了模型一致性（model consistency）作为评估指标。结果表明，VLM在粗粒度定位和导航先验方面表现良好，但在真实变化的细粒度定位中性能显著下降，揭示了其部署在开放世界机器人导航中的可靠性挑战。
Motivation: 现有工作使用VLM作为嵌入提取器，但最先进的VLM常以黑盒API形式提供，无法访问训练数据、特征或梯度，也无法重新训练；且单文本提示的零样本跨尺度地理定位能力尚未被探索。
Method: 在三种场景下评估黑盒生成式VLM的零样本地理定位：固定文本提示、语义等价文本提示和语义等价查询图像。引入模型一致性指标以应对生成式VLM的自回归和概率特性。
Result: VLM在粗粒度定位上表现强（如国家/城市级别），但在细粒度定位（如街道/建筑）中，面对现实变化（如视角、光照、季节变化）性能显著下降。

papers.title: Derivation of effective gradient flow equations and dynamical truncation of training data in Deep Learning
papers.abstract_en: We derive explicit equations governing the cumulative biases and weights in Deep Learning with ReLU activation function, based on gradient descent for the Euclidean loss in the input layer, and under the assumption that the weights are, in a precise sense, adapted to the coordinate system distinguished by the activations. We show that gradient descent corresponds to a dynamical process in the input layer, whereby clusters of data are progressively reduced in complexity ("truncated") at an exponential rate that increases with the number of data points that have already been truncated. We provide a detailed discussion of several types of solutions to the gradient flow equations. A main motivation for this work is to shed light on the interpretability question in supervised learning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文推导了使用ReLU激活函数的深度学习模型中累积偏差和权重的显式方程，基于输入层的欧几里得损失梯度下降，并假设权重适应于激活所区分的坐标系。研究表明，梯度下降对应输入层的一个动力学过程，数据簇以指数速率被逐步简化（“截断”），该速率随已截断数据点数量增加。论文详细讨论了梯度流方程的几种解，主要动机是阐明监督学习中的可解释性问题。
Motivation: 深度学习模型的可解释性不足，需要理论工具理解训练过程中的动态机制。
Method: 通过数学推导，基于梯度下降和ReLU激活，建立有效梯度流方程，并分析数据截断的指数衰减率。
Result: 数据簇在训练中被指数速率截断，该速率与已截断数据点数量正相关；给出了梯度流方程的多类解析解。
Conclusion: 该理论框架为理解监督学习中的可解释性提供了新视角，但论文未涉及具体实验验证。

papers.title: Towards Reliable Recommender Systems for Rating Data
papers.abstract_en: Recommender systems are widely used in the digital landscape to match users with content fitting their preferences. However, growing concerns about fake accounts, strategic manipulation, and other deceptive online behavior place increasing pressure on the reliability of these systems. A common statistical approach behind recommender systems is so-called matrix completion, which predicts how users would rate items they have not yet consumed based on patterns in observed ratings. Realistically applying matrix completion methods requires jointly addressing several overlooked challenges: (i) ratings on discrete scales (such as 1--5 stars); (ii) the presence of malicious users who deliberately manipulate the system to their advantage through fake profiles; (iii) ratings missing not at random since users are more likely to consume items they expect to like; and (iv) fostering transparency, reproducibility, and stability. We jointly address these challenges by proposing a novel method, Robust Discrete Matrix Completion (RDMC), designed to capture the key characteristics of sparse rating data while remaining reliable in the presence of manipulation. We evaluate RDMC through two case studies and carefully designed simulation experiments. Our work thereby offers a statistically-sound blueprint for future studies on how to evaluate recommender systems under realistic scenarios.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对推荐系统中评级数据的四个实际挑战（离散评分尺度、恶意用户操纵、非随机缺失以及透明性与可复现性），提出鲁棒离散矩阵补全（RDMC）方法。通过案例研究和模拟实验，RDMC在保留稀疏评级数据关键特征的同时，对操纵行为保持鲁棒性，为真实场景下推荐系统的评估提供了统计上可靠的框架。
Motivation: 现有矩阵补全方法忽视离散评分、恶意用户、非随机缺失等实际挑战，导致推荐系统在面对操纵时不可靠。
Method: 提出鲁棒离散矩阵补全（RDMC），联合处理离散评分、异常值鲁棒性、缺失非随机性，并注重可复现性。
Result: 通过两个案例研究和精心设计的模拟实验，RDMC在存在操纵的情况下仍能保持性能。
Conclusion: 该工作为未来在真实场景下评估推荐系统提供了统计上可靠的蓝图。

papers.title: MVGS: Multi-view Regulated Gaussian Splatting for Novel View Synthesis
papers.abstract_en: Recent works in volume rendering, \textit{e.g.} NeRF and 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS), significantly advance the rendering quality and efficiency with the help of the learned implicit neural radiance field or 3D Gaussians. Rendering on top of an explicit representation, the vanilla 3DGS and its variants deliver real-time efficiency by optimizing the parametric model with single-view supervision per iteration during training which is adopted from NeRF. Consequently, certain views are overfitted, leading to unsatisfying appearance in novel-view synthesis and imprecise 3D geometries. To solve aforementioned problems, we propose a new 3DGS optimization method embodying four key novel contributions: 1) We transform the conventional single-view training paradigm into a multi-view training strategy. With our proposed multi-view regulation, 3D Gaussian attributes are further optimized without overfitting certain training views. As a general solution, we improve the overall accuracy in a variety of scenarios and different Gaussian variants. 2) Inspired by the benefit introduced by additional views, we further propose a cross-intrinsic guidance scheme, leading to a coarse-to-fine training procedure concerning different resolutions. 3) Built on top of our multi-view regulated training, we further propose a cross-ray densification strategy, densifying more Gaussian kernels in the ray-intersect regions from a selection of views. 4) By further investigating the densification strategy, we found that the effect of densification should be enhanced when certain views are distinct dramatically. As a solution, we propose a novel multi-view augmented densification strategy, where 3D Gaussians are encouraged to get densified to a sufficient number accordingly, resulting in improved reconstruction accuracy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种多视图调节的3D高斯泼溅优化方法，用于改进新视角合成。核心包括：将单视图训练转换为多视图训练策略，提出跨内参引导方案、交叉射线稠密化策略和多视图增强稠密化策略，以缓解过拟合和几何不精确问题。
Motivation: 现有3DGS方法在训练时每步只使用单视图监督，容易过拟合某些视图，导致新视角合成质量不佳和3D几何不精确。
Method: 提出多视图训练范式，利用多视图监督优化高斯属性；引入跨内参引导实现从粗到细的训练；提出交叉射线稠密化在射线相交区域增加高斯核；并针对视图差异显著时增强稠密化的多视图增强稠密化策略。
Result: 摘要声称该方法作为一种通用方案，在不同场景和多种高斯变体上提升了整体准确性。
Conclusion: 摘要强调多视图调节可以避免过拟合特定训练视图，从而改善新视角合成质量和3D重建精度。

papers.title: iCost: A Novel Instance-Complexity-Based Cost-Sensitive Learning Framework
papers.abstract_en: Class imbalance poses a significant challenge in classification tasks, often causing standard learning algorithms to become biased toward the majority class. Cost-sensitive learning (CSL) addresses this issue by assigning higher penalties to minority-class misclassifications. However, conventional CSL typically applies a uniform penalty to all minority-class instances, ignoring the fact that minority samples may differ substantially in terms of local safety, overlap, boundary ambiguity, and outlier-like behavior. Uniform penalization can therefore introduce undue bias, increasing the number of misclassifications. In this study, we propose iCost, an instance-complexity-aware CSL framework that assigns adaptive penalties to minority-class samples according to their estimated learning difficulty. This fine-grained penalization strategy ensures fairer weighting, reduces unwarranted bias, and improves overall classification performance. Two complementary complexity estimation strategies are introduced: Neighbor-iCost, based on local neighborhood composition, and Gini-iCost, based on Gini-impurity-based feature-space partitioning. Extensive experiments on 65 binary and 10 multiclass imbalanced datasets show that iCost outperforms conventional CSL by a clear margin and remains highly competitive with widely used resampling methods. To support reproducibility and practical adoption, the proposed algorithm has been released as a scikit-learn-compatible Python package through PyPI. This work offers a fresh perspective on imbalanced learning by integrating instance-level data complexity into the learning process, opening new avenues for developing adaptive, complexity-aware strategies for imbalanced classification.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 iCost，一个基于实例复杂度（instance complexity）的成本敏感学习框架，用于处理类别不平衡分类问题。传统成本敏感学习对少数类样本统一惩罚，未考虑样本局部安全性、重叠、边界模糊等差异。iCost 根据样本学习难度自适应调整惩罚，设计了基于邻域组成的 Neighbor-iCost 和基于基尼不纯度的 Gini-iCost 两种复杂度估计方法。在 65 个二分类和 10 个多分类不平衡数据集上，iCost 优于传统成本敏感学习，并与重采样方法竞争力强。代码以 scikit-learn 兼容的 Python 包发布。
Motivation: 类别不平衡导致标准分类器偏向多数类。传统成本敏感学习对少数类所有样本施加统一惩罚，忽略少数类样本在局部安全性、重叠、边界模糊和离群行为上的差异，从而引入不必要偏置，增加误分类。
Method: 提出 iCost 框架，包含两种实例复杂度估计策略：Neighbor-iCost（基于局部邻域组成）和 Gini-iCost（基于基尼不纯度特征空间划分）。根据估计的学习难度为少数类样本分配自适应惩罚权重，实现细粒度惩罚。
Result: 在 65 个二分类和 10 个多分类不平衡数据集上，iCost 明显优于传统成本敏感学习，并与常用重采样方法具有高度竞争力。
Conclusion: 将实例级数据复杂度融入成本敏感学习，为不平衡分类提供了自适应、感知复杂度的新视角，并通过兼容 scikit-learn 的开源包促进可复现性和实际应用。

papers.title: An Expectation-Maximization Algorithm for Training Clean Diffusion Models from Corrupted Observations
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion models excel in solving imaging inverse problems due to their ability to model complex image priors. However, their reliance on large, clean datasets for training limits their practical use where clean data is scarce. In this paper, we propose EMDiffusion, an expectation-maximization (EM) approach to train diffusion models from corrupted observations. Our method alternates between reconstructing clean images from corrupted data using a known diffusion model (E-step) and refining diffusion model weights based on these reconstructions (M-step). This iterative process leads the learned diffusion model to gradually converge to the true clean data distribution. We validate our method through extensive experiments on diverse computational imaging tasks, including random inpainting, denoising, and deblurring, achieving new state-of-the-art performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 EMDiffusion，一种基于期望最大化（EM）的扩散模型训练方法，能够仅从损坏观测（如随机掩膜、噪声、模糊图像）中学习干净的图像分布，而无需大量干净数据。该方法交替进行干净图像重建（E步）和扩散模型权重更新（M步），在多种计算成像任务上取得当前最优性能。
Motivation: 传统扩散模型依赖大规模干净数据集进行训练，但在许多实际场景中干净数据稀缺，限制了其应用。本文旨在解决如何仅利用损坏观测数据训练高质量扩散模型的问题。
Method: 提出 EMDiffusion，将训练过程形式化为 EM 算法：E步使用当前扩散模型从损坏观测中重建干净图像；M步基于重建图像更新扩散模型参数。通过迭代，模型逐步收敛到真实干净数据分布。
Result: 在随机补全、去噪、去模糊等计算成像任务上，该方法取得了新的最优结果（state-of-the-art）。
Conclusion: EMDiffusion 有效降低了扩散模型对干净数据的依赖，为数据稀缺场景下的图像生成提供了可行方案。

papers.title: Active Exploration via Autoregressive Generation of Missing Data
papers.abstract_en: We pose uncertainty quantification and exploration in online decision-making as a problem of training and generation from an autoregressive sequence model, an area experiencing rapid innovation. Our approach rests on viewing uncertainty as arising from missing future outcomes that could be revealed through action choices, rather than from unobservable latent parameters of the environment. This reformulation aligns naturally with modern machine learning capabilities: we can i) train generative models through next-outcome prediction rather than fit explicit priors, ii) assess uncertainty through autoregressive generation rather than sampling latent parameters from posteriors, and iii) adapt to new information by extending the sequence model's context rather than explicit posterior updating. Our main theoretical result establishes a reduction from online learning to offline next-outcome prediction, showing that Bayesian regret is controlled by the offline sequence prediction loss. Semi-synthetic experiments show our insights bear out in a challenging news recommendation setting, where effective performance requires leveraging article headline text as prior information to focus exploration on resolving remaining uncertainties.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文将在线决策中的不确定性量化和探索问题重新表述为自回归序列模型的训练与生成。作者认为不确定性源于未来结果缺失而非环境潜在参数，并通过下一个结果预测训练模型，通过自回归生成评估不确定性，通过扩展序列上下文适应新信息。理论证明贝叶斯遗憾受离线序列预测损失控制，实验在新闻推荐中验证了方法有效性。
Motivation: 现有在线决策方法通常依赖显式先验和潜在参数采样，难以与现代生成模型能力对齐。本文旨在利用自回归序列模型的快速进展来统一探索和不确定性量化。
Method: 提出通过下一个结果预测训练生成模型，通过自回归生成评估不确定性，通过扩展序列模型上下文适应新信息，而非显式后验更新。
Result: 理论证明贝叶斯遗憾受离线序列预测损失控制；半合成实验表明该方法在新闻推荐中有效，需利用文章标题文本作为先验信息聚焦探索。
Conclusion: 该方法将在线学习与离线序列预测联系起来，为使用现代生成模型进行探索提供了理论框架和实用方法。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Monte Carlo with kernel-based Gibbs measures: Guarantees for probabilistic herding
papers.abstract_en: Kernel herding belongs to a family of deterministic quadratures that seek to minimize the maximum mean discrepancy (MMD), that is, the worst-case integration error over a reproducing kernel Hilbert space (RKHS). These MMD minimization procedures come with strong experimental support, but comparatively less theoretical footing. In particular, apart from recent progress in distribution compression, little has been proved in favor of an improvement of MMD minimization over classical Monte Carlo quadrature when the RKHS is infinite-dimensional. In this paper, we study a joint probability distribution over quadrature nodes, a tailored Gibbs distribution, whose support intuitively tends to concentrate around MMD minimizers as a temperature parameter is decreased. Our main contribution is to prove that drawing integration nodes from our distribution does outperform i.i.d Monte Carlo. While our bounds on the worst-case integration error feature the same rate as i.i.d. Monte Carlo, we do obtain a tighter concentration inequality as the temperature parameter decreases. This means smaller confidence intervals as the number of quadrature nodes increases. While arguably a first step, our results demonstrate that the mathematical toolbox developed around Gibbs measures can help understand to what extent kernel herding and its variants improve on computationally cheaper methods. There remains the issue of sampling from our Gibbs distribution. In our numerical experiments, we demonstrate that a simple MCMC chain already yields approximate samples that lead to improved confidence intervals around the target integrals, as supported by our theoretical results.
papers.comment: 24 pages. Accepted for publication in SIAM journal on Mathematics of Data Science
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究蒙特卡洛求积的改进方法，提出一种基于吉布斯分布（Gibbs distribution）的核方法（kernel herding）变体。该分布的支撑集倾向于集中在最小化最大平均差异（MMD）的节点上。理论证明，从该分布中抽取积分节点虽然最坏情况积分误差率与独立同分布蒙特卡洛相同，但能得到更紧的集中不等式，即随着温度参数降低，置信区间更小。数值实验显示，简单的MCMC链可近似采样，从而改进目标积分的置信区间。
Motivation: 核方法求积（如kernel herding）在实践中表现良好，但缺乏与经典蒙特卡洛相比的理论保证，尤其在无限维再生核希尔伯特空间（RKHS）中。
Method: 引入一个联合概率分布（吉布斯分布），其支撑集倾向于MMD最小化节点，通过调整温度参数控制集中程度。理论分析从该分布中抽取积分节点的最坏情况积分误差和集中不等式。
Result: 证明该方法在最坏情况积分误差率上与i.i.d.蒙特卡洛相同，但获得了随温度参数降低而更紧的集中不等式，即更小的置信区间。数值实验表明，简单的MCMC采样即可近似该分布，并改进置信区间。
Conclusion: 本文为理解核方法求积如何改进经典蒙特卡洛提供了理论第一步，但采样问题仍需进一步研究。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Deep Residual Networks Learn the Geodesic Curve in the Wasserstein Space
papers.abstract_en: Recent studies revealed the mathematical connection between deep neural networks (DNNs) and dynamic systems. However, the specific dynamics that DNNs, especially deep residual networks (ResNets), tend to learn during training remain insufficiently characterized. To this end, we model the forward propagation of deep residual networks using continuity equations, in which the measure is conserved and infinite curves in the measure space connect the input distribution to the output one of a ResNet. We find ResNets with $L_2$ regularization attempt to learn the geodesic curve in the Wasserstein space, induced by the optimal transport map. Compared with plain networks, ResNets can better approximate the geodesic curve, which explains why ResNets can be optimized and generalize better. Numerical experiments show that the data tracks of a ResNet tend to be line-shaped in terms of the line-shape score, and the map learned by a ResNet is closer to the optimal transport map in terms of the optimal transport score. In a word, we conclude that ResNets learn the geodesic curve in the Wasserstein space and discretely engineer the data transformation in high-dimensional spaces.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文利用连续性方程对深度残差网络（ResNet）的前向传播进行建模，发现带有L2正则化的ResNet在学习过程中趋向于学习Wasserstein空间中的测地线（geodesic curve），该测地线由最优传输映射（optimal transport map）诱导。相比普通网络，ResNet能更好地逼近测地线，从而解释了其优化和泛化优势。实验表明ResNet的数据轨迹具有线形（line-shaped）特征，且学到的映射更接近最优传输映射。
Motivation: 现有研究揭示了深度神经网络与动态系统之间的数学联系，但深度残差网络在训练中倾向于学习何种特定动态仍不清楚。
Method: 使用连续性方程建模ResNet的前向传播（测度守恒，测度空间中的无穷曲线连接输入分布与输出分布），并分析L2正则化下ResNet的优化目标。
Result: 带L2正则的ResNet试图学习Wasserstein空间中的测地线（由最优传输映射诱导）；数值实验显示ResNet的数据轨迹具有较高的线形得分，且学到的映射在最优传输得分上更接近最优传输映射。
Conclusion: ResNet学习的是Wasserstein空间中的测地线，并离散地工程化高维空间中的数据变换，这为其优化和泛化能力提供了理论解释。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: COOPA: A Modular LLM Agent Architecture for Operations Research Problems
papers.abstract_en: Operations Research (OR) provides a rigorous framework for high-stakes decision-making, but effective OR modeling requires substantial domain knowledge, mathematical abstraction, and solver expertise. Recent LLM-based systems automate parts of this pipeline, yet remain limited by low accuracy on complex problems, opaque outputs, and narrow solver support. We propose COOPA (COoperative OPerations Agent), a modular LLM-agent architecture for interpretable and scalable OR decision support. It combines three components: iterative confidence-based modeling, which generates multiple candidate formulations, self-evaluates them across modeling dimensions, and selects one using a max-min confidence criterion; element-level provenance and confidence explanations, which link variables, parameters, constraints, and objectives to quoted source text and provide an audit trail for human verification; and multi-solver routing to specialized optimizer agents for different OR problem classes. Across three OR benchmarks, eight LLM backbones, and four baselines under identical conditions, COOPA achieves the best macro-average accuracy on six of eight backbones and improves over the strongest baseline by up to 6.7 percentage points. A within-system ablation isolates the contribution of iterative confidence-based modeling, while additional analyses and case studies illustrate the value of source traceability and multi-solver dispatch.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: COOPA是一个用于运筹学问题的模块化LLM智能体架构，包含迭代置信度建模、元素级来源与置信度解释以及多求解器路由三个组件。在三个OR基准测试、八个LLM主干和四个基线下，COOPA在六个主干上取得最佳宏平均准确率，相比最强基线提升最高6.7个百分点。
Motivation: 现有基于LLM的OR系统自动化程度有限，存在复杂问题准确率低、输出不透明、求解器支持狭窄等问题。
Method: 提出COOPA架构，包含三个组件：迭代置信度建模（生成多个候选建模方案并自评估后选择）、元素级来源与置信度解释（链接变量等与原文）、多求解器路由（将问题分派给专用优化器）。
Result: 在三个OR基准、八个LLM主干和四个基线下，COOPA在六个主干上取得最佳宏平均准确率，相比最强基线提升最多6.7个百分点；消融实验验证了迭代置信度建模的贡献。
Conclusion: COOPA通过模块化设计和可解释性组件提升了OR决策支持的准确性和可审计性，多求解器路由扩展了求解器支持范围。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Training Observable Control Policies to Expose Agent State Through Actions
papers.abstract_en: Physical or operational constraints often impose communications limitations on autonomous agents. Such limitations complicate monitoring or multiagent coordination. Even when strong communications are absent, some information may still be available. The remainder of the relevant agent state may be reconstructed via estimation. The actions taken by an agent are a potential source of information -- as the agent interacts with the environment, these actions may be observed even in the absence of explicit communication. We investigate using actions to estimate the state of an agent, using reinforcement learning to develop policies which make the estimation problem more tractable. Policy observability is encouraged through the training reward and is analyzed using simulation of the trained agent. In an aircraft tracking problem a policy with enhanced observability is found that has minimal impact on nominal task performance.
papers.journal_ref: Journal of Aerospace Information Systems (2026): 1-11
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对自主代理在通信受限环境下状态估计困难的问题，提出通过强化学习训练具有可观测性策略（observable control policies）的方法，使代理的动作更有利于状态估计。在航空器跟踪问题中，该方法在保持任务性能的同时提升了策略的可观测性。
Motivation: 物理或操作约束常对自主代理施加通信限制，使得监控或多代理协调复杂化。即使没有强通信，代理的动作仍可被观测，但需要从动作中重建状态。本文旨在利用动作信息提高状态估计的可行性。
Method: 使用强化学习训练策略，在奖励函数中鼓励可观测性（policy observability），并通过仿真分析训练后代理的可观测性。
Result: 在航空器跟踪问题中，通过增强可观测性的策略，在最小影响标称任务性能的前提下，提升了状态估计的可行性。
Conclusion: 论文表明通过奖励函数引导可观测性，可以在不显著牺牲任务性能的情况下改善状态估计。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Qwen-Image-2.0-RL Technical Report
papers.abstract_en: We present Qwen-Image-2.0-RL, a post-training pipeline that applies reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF) and on-policy distillation (OPD) to improve both the visual quality and instruction-following capability of the Qwen-Image-2.0 diffusion model. To provide reliable reward signals, we construct task-specific composite reward models by fine-tuning vision-language models with a pointwise scoring paradigm and chain-of-thought reasoning. For text-to-image generation, the reward models cover alignment, aesthetics, and portrait fidelity dimensions. For image editing tasks, the reward system addresses instruction-following accuracy and face identity preservation. Building on this reward system, we develop a scalable GRPO-based RL training framework, incorporating a hybrid classifier-free guidance (CFG) strategy to preserve pre-trained knowledge, prompt curation via intra-group reward range filtering, and per-category reward weight calibration. To merge the task-specialized RL policies for T2I and editing, we propose on-policy distillation as the final training stage, which consolidates multiple teachers into a single student model through trajectory-level velocity matching. Extensive evaluation shows that Qwen-Image-2.0-RL achieves 57.84 overall score on Qwen-Image-Bench (+2.61 over the base model), Elo ratings of 1193 in text-to-image arena (+78) and 1349 in image edit arena (+93), demonstrating consistent gains in aesthetic quality, prompt adherence, and editing accuracy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Qwen-Image-2.0-RL，一种基于强化学习从人类反馈（RLHF）和同策略蒸馏（OPD）的后训练流程，用于提升Qwen-Image-2.0扩散模型的视觉质量和指令遵循能力。论文构建了任务特定的复合奖励模型，涵盖文本到图像生成的对齐、美学和人像保真度，以及图像编辑的指令遵循和人脸保持。通过基于GRPO的RL训练框架、混合无分类器引导（CFG）策略、提示筛选和类别权重校准，并利用同策略蒸馏合并多个专家策略。评估显示在Qwen-Image-Bench上总分57.84（+2.61），在文本到图像竞技场Elo为1193（+78），图像编辑竞技场Elo为1349（+93）。
Motivation: 现有扩散模型在视觉质量和指令遵循能力上仍有改进空间，特别是在文本到图像生成和图像编辑任务中，需要更可靠的奖励信号和有效的后训练方法。
Method: 通过微调视觉语言模型构建任务特定复合奖励模型（点式评分+链式推理），用于对齐、美学、人像等维度；提出基于GRPO的RL训练框架，包含混合CFG策略、组内奖励范围筛选和每类别奖励权重校准；最后采用同策略蒸馏（轨迹级速度匹配）合并多个教师策略为单一学生模型。
Result: Qwen-Image-2.0-RL在Qwen-Image-Bench上总分57.84（+2.61），文本到图像竞技场Elo 1193（+78），图像编辑竞技场Elo 1349（+93），在美学质量、提示遵循和编辑准确性上均有持续提升。
Conclusion: 论文表明RLHF和同策略蒸馏能有效提升扩散模型的视觉质量和指令遵循能力，但方法主要集中在文本到图像和图像编辑任务，未涉及其他领域如视频生成或3D。

papers.title: On the stability of scale-space metrics
papers.abstract_en: We study the stability of a classical family of metrics defined over functions' Gaussian scale-space representations, focusing on the comparison of images (functions of two variables). These metrics have precedents both in harmonic analysis, specifically the theory of Besov spaces, and in classical methods of image processing; special cases are also known to be metrically equivalent to certain Wasserstein distances. We quantify these metrics' robustness to geometric deformations, and introduce rotationally-invariant versions that are stable to changes in angle when comparing tomographic projections. We also describe computationally efficient algorithms for evaluating the metrics from finite samples, and prove their robustness to additive noise. The results are illustrated through numerical experiments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究函数高斯尺度空间表示的经典度量族的稳定性，特别是针对图像（二元函数）比较。这些度量在调和分析（Besov空间）和图像处理方法中均有先例；特殊情况已知与某些Wasserstein距离度量等价。作者量化了这些度量对几何形变的鲁棒性，并引入了旋转不变版本，在比较断层扫描投影时对角度变化稳定。还描述了从有限样本评估度量的高效算法，并证明其对加性噪声的鲁棒性。通过数值实验说明结果。
Motivation: 尺度空间度量在图像处理中有重要应用，但其对几何形变、旋转和噪声的稳定性缺乏严格分析。
Method: 理论分析度量族的稳定性性质，提出旋转不变变体，并设计基于有限样本的高效算法。
Result: 证明了度量对几何形变和加性噪声的鲁棒性，并给出旋转不变版本的角度稳定性。
Conclusion: 本文建立了尺度空间度量的稳定性理论，并提供了实用算法，适用于图像比较和断层扫描等应用。

papers.title: Spectral Subsurface Scattering from RGB via Biophysical Skin Inversion
papers.abstract_en: In this paper we present a spectral optical inversion for skin for path tracing-based rendering of subsurface scattering. Skin is a complex multilayered medium, with appearance determined by the mixture of biophysical chromophores. However, current methods rely on medium homogeneization, with optical parameters obtained via albedo inversion from a reflectance texture and hand-tuned scattering distance and anisotropy. This results into significant art-skilled manual labor for authoring, and an inaccurate scattering profile for skin. To solve these problems, we generalize existing albedo inversion techniques, and propose a framework that predicts full-spectral skin scattering parameters from a single RGB diffuse albedo. Our method builds upon a new mixture-of-media representation, that approximates the aggregated multilayered appearance of skin by mixing the aggregated scattering of three uncorrelated media. We train a chained neural decoder that maps RGB diffuse albedo to the optical properties of the mixture of media, including anisotropy, scattering radius and scattering albedo. Then, we show this mixture can be used in a random-walk-based path tracer with minimal modifications, by simply randomly selecting the medium to traverse.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种从单张RGB漫反射反照率预测全光谱皮肤散射参数的方法，用于路径追踪渲染中的次表面散射。该方法基于新的混合介质表示，将皮肤的多层外观近似为三种不相关介质的聚集散射，并通过链式神经解码器从RGB漫反射反照率映射出光学属性（各向异性、散射半径、散射反照率）。实验表明该混合介质可最小化修改地用于随机游走路径追踪。
Motivation: 现有皮肤散射渲染依赖介质均匀化，通过反照率反演获得光学参数并手工调节散射距离和各向异性，导致人工成本高且散射轮廓不准确。
Method: 提出混合介质表示（mixture-of-media），将皮肤多层外观近似为三种不相关介质的聚集散射；训练链式神经解码器（chained neural decoder），从RGB漫反射反照率预测混合介质的光学属性（各向异性、散射半径、散射反照率）。
Result: 摘要未提供定量结果，但声称该方法能直接从RGB漫反射反照率预测全光谱皮肤散射参数，并可无缝集成到随机游走路径追踪器中。
Conclusion: 该方法简化了皮肤散射参数的制作流程，提高了散射轮廓的准确性，但摘要未讨论局限性。

papers.title: Global Explanations for Multivariate Time Series Forecasting Models via $K$-Order Markov Approximations
papers.abstract_en: While many explainable AI (XAI) methods have been proposed, most are not designed for time-series forecasting models and often rely on the implicit assumption that timestamp features are independent. This assumption ignores the fundamental property of temporal dependence and can lead to explanations that violate the sequential and causal structure of the data. We introduce \textsc{KARMA}, a method for explaining time-series predictors by constructing a Markov surrogate model that captures the temporal dependencies learned by the predictor. Our approach revolves around three main aspects: identifying the minimal history length $K$ that is predictively sufficient for the model, estimating the best-fitting $K$-order Markov transition kernel from the discretized history space, and a five-level global explanation hierarchy that can be derived from the Markov transition kernel, which we illustrate using real-world weather data (Beijing PM 2.5). We also certify using complex synthetic data with known true causal edges that KARMA (i) recovers the data causal structure as learned by the model via a controlled experiment and (ii) identifies temporal dependencies better than established attribution methods such as TimeSHAP.
papers.comment: Accepted at the Workshop on Explainable Artificial Intelligence (XAI), International Joint Conference on Artificial Intelligence (IJCAI 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 KARMA 方法，通过构建 K 阶马尔可夫替代模型，为多变量时间序列预测模型提供全局解释。该方法包括识别最小历史长度 K、估计转移核和五级解释层级，并在北京 PM2.5 天气数据和复杂合成数据上验证了其还原因果结构和捕捉时间依赖性的能力。
Motivation: 现有 XAI 方法大多基于特征独立假设，忽略了时间序列中的时间依赖性和因果结构，导致解释违背数据本质。
Method: KARMA 方法围绕三方面：1）确定预测所需的充分历史长度 K；2）从离散化的历史空间估计最佳 K 阶马尔可夫转移核；3）从转移核中导出五级全局解释层次。
Result: 在真实天气数据（北京 PM2.5）上展示了五级解释层次，并通过复杂合成数据验证了 KARMA 能恢复模型学习到的因果结构，且比 TimeSHAP 等归因方法更好地识别时间依赖性。
Conclusion: KARMA 提供了一种可解释的全局解释框架，特别适用于多变量时间序列预测模型，并强调了时间依赖结构在解释中的重要性。
Relevance: 70

papers.title: Narrative-UFET: Narrative Generation for Ultra-Fine Entity Typing
papers.abstract_en: Ultra-fine entity typing (UFET) assigns highly specific types to entity mentions, but current approaches struggle with types in the long tail. We hypothesize that a key limitation is the reliance on sentence-level context, since disambiguating evidence is often spread across multiple sentences. Testing this has been difficult because all existing UFET resources are sentence-level. We present Narrative-UFET, a controlled extension of UFET in which each entity mention is paired with an automatically generated short, coherent narrative. Synthesizing narratives lets us isolate the effect of specific discourse properties. We experiment with two paired variants: one in which the entity's type is held constant across the narrative (Maintain) and one in which it shifts (Change). We show that narrative context yields consistent improvements on long-tail types over sentence-level baselines, with the Change variant providing the stronger signal. A comparison against naturally occurring contexts shows that synthetic narratives yield stronger gains, indicating that controlled discourse construction can surface signals that real text leaves implicit. Substantial room for improvement remains, suggesting open directions in both discourse modeling and narrative construction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Narrative-UFET，通过为实体提及自动生成短篇连贯叙事来扩展超细粒度实体类型标注（UFET），旨在改善长尾类型的识别。实验表明，叙事上下文相比句子级基线在长尾类型上取得一致提升，其中实体类型变化的变体（Change）信号更强。合成叙事比自然上下文带来更大增益，说明受控话语构建能揭示文本中隐含的信号。
Motivation: 当前UFET方法依赖句子级上下文，但区分证据常跨多个句子，限制了长尾类型识别。现有资源均为句子级，难以研究话语级影响。
Method: 构建Narrative-UFET数据集，为每个实体提及自动生成短篇叙事，并设计两种变体：Maintain（实体类型在叙事中保持不变）和Change（类型发生变化）。通过对比句子级基线评估叙事上下文的贡献。
Result: 叙事上下文在长尾类型上相比句子级基线有持续改进，Change变体提供更强信号；合成叙事比自然上下文增益更大。
Conclusion: 控制性话语构建能揭示真实文本中隐含的区分信号，但改进空间仍大，指向话语建模和叙事构造的开放方向。
